NAME: Chin Chin
DESCRIPTION: Chin Chin offers traditional Chinese food, sushi and pan-Asian specialties in a bright and colorful setting. From within its exhibition kitchens, Chin Chin Café & Sushi Bar's chefs can be found preparing exotic dishes.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3790 Las Vegas Blvd S, New York-New York Hotel & Casino, 89109-4338

NAME: Mr. Mamas
DESCRIPTION: Mr. Mama's is a Breakfast and Lunch diner that specializes in home cooking. Some of our favorite dishes include the Cali Omelet, Mama's Chicken Fried Steak and Eggs and our French Toast/ Pancakes. OH! and don't forget about our monstrous cinnamon rolls! The menu also offers lunch items; some favorite are the Mamas Sandwich, Philly Cheese Steak and Reuben! The environment is casual, family friendly and full of smiles from the staff! We promise our place will put a smile on your face!

NAME: Trevi Italian Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Located in the heart of The Forum Shops at Caesars, one of the world's premier shopping destinations, TREVI Italian Restaurant serves up authentic and approachable favorites daily for lunch and dinner.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3500 Las Vegas Blvd S, Forum Shops Caesars Palace, 89109-8900

NAME: Senor Frog's Las Vegas
DESCRIPTION: If you've ever been to a Senor Frog's, anywhere around the world, you already know that we're a place where people of all backgrounds hang together, dance, sing and basically act the way they want without worrying about silly rules and regulations. Our philosophy is simple: have fun, let yourself go and unleash your fiesta!

NAME: Maggiano's Little Italy
DESCRIPTION: Maggiano's is conveniently located at the Fashion Show Mall on the world famous Las Vegas Boulevard. Our 325 seat dining room is ideal for a romantic dinner for two, a festive gathering or a group lunch. Maggiano's specializes in serving generous portions of authentic Italian-American cuisine, served family style. Our menu is large and varied, offering a vast selection of homemade pastas, signature salads, prime steaks, fresh fish and delicious desserts.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3200 Las Vegas Blvd S, Ste 2144 Fashion Show Mall, 89109

NAME: Envy The Steakhouse
DESCRIPTION: Designed to please even the most discerning palates, the award-winning ENVY Steakhouse is a top choice in Las Vegas. The exquisite menus feature innovative dishes with an Italian flair & the most sinfully delicious gourmet steaks. From delectable Premium Angus Beef Filet to prime bone-in rib eye, you'll find ENVY to be a fine dining opportunity you just can't turn down. Made with fresh ingredients gathered from purveyors not just locally, but around the country - you'll find your friends & family absolutely envious of your experience.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3400 Paradise Rd, Renaissance Las Vegas Hotel, 89169-2770

NAME: Golden Steer Steakhouse Las Vegas
DESCRIPTION: Since 1958, The Golden Steer Steakhouse is Las Vegas' most iconic & longest-running steakhouse.

NAME: Yardbird Table & Bar
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3355 Las Vegas Blvd S, The Venetian, 89109-8941

NAME: Restaurant Guy Savoy at Caesars Palace
DESCRIPTION: Restaurant Guy Savoy at Caesars Palace has been called the best restaurant in Las Vegas, serving elegant French Cuisine in a fine dining environment. Designed to emulate the menu of his Paris restaurant, the Restaurant Guy Savoy Caesars Palace menu includes many classic Savoy dishes.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3570 Las Vegas Blvd S, Caesars Palace, 89109

NAME: Capo's Restaurant and Speakeasy
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Capo's Italian Steakhouse & Speakeasy! Our luxurious mob-style restaurant, speakeasy theme, live nightly entertainment, and incredible food will truly offer an evening that you won't find anywhere else in Las Vegas. Growing up with his family’s Italian restaurants in Chicago and inspired by the mobster era, Nico Santucci created Capo’s, a real “speakeasy” featuring actual Al Capone’s Family Secret sauces on our "made-man" pastas. We have served nearly a million diners, no small feat for an independently owned restaurant, and are known for our famous meatballs... Capo's is the kind of place that could be your home away from home - we offer a vast menu of traditional family specialties passed down through generations and modern adaptations sure to tempt every palate -- even the most discriminating of gourmets an exciting dining experience that you won't forget about...

NAME: Mon Ami Gabi
DESCRIPTION: Please note: NO RESERVATIONS are made for PATIO SEATING, this is on a first come, first serve basis. All reservations are for the indoor main dining room. Mon Ami Gabi is a classic French bistro & steakhouse located in the Paris Resort on 'The Strip!' Mon Ami Gabi specializes in Classic Bistro Fare including crepes and quiches. Our dinner menu features classics such as French Onion Soup, Trout Grenobloise, and our signature Steak Frites. French wines are served by the glass or the bottle from our rolling wine cart. We also serve breakfast specialties including French Toast, Waffles & our Big Skinny Panacakes and a variety of French sandwiches during lunch.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3655 Las Vegas Blvd S, Paris Las Vegas, 89109-4345

NAME: Zuma
DESCRIPTION: zuma serves modern Japanese cuisine and award-winning cocktails in an elegant and sophisticated environment.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3708 Las Vegas Blvd S, Level 3, Boulevard Tower, 89109

NAME: Yard House
DESCRIPTION: Yard House is the modern American gathering place where beer and food lovers unite. Known for great food, classic rock, an energetic vibe and endless fleet of tap handles featuring the best craft and local beers, each Yard House location offers 100+ beers on tap along with an array of craft cocktails. Our menu features favorites such as our signature Poke Nachos, street tacos, USDA prime burgers, seafood and steaks. Founded in Long Beach, Calif., in 1996, Yard House now spans across the U.S. with over 80 locations and is open daily for lunch, dinner, and late-night dining.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3545 Las Vegas Blvd S, The Linq, 89109-8978

NAME: Veranda
DESCRIPTION: Serving modern cuisine with a Mediterranean flair, Veranda offers an elevated start to the day, the perfect power lunch, and an elegant evening with friends or a special someone. Chef William Ledesma has introduced a new menu of shareable social plates, artisanal pastas, exquisitely selected seafood and steaks, and handcrafted seasonal desserts. Veranda’s famous weekend brunch features a wide selection of buffet-style and à la carte options along with our signature morning mixology menu. The well-appointed dining room pays homage to the romance of 1960s Italy, and the poolside outdoor terrace is ideal for an elegant al fresco experience.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3960 Las Vegas Blvd S, Four Seasons Hotel Las Vegas, 89119

NAME: Istanbul Mediterranean (Halal)
DESCRIPTION: At the heart of the Las Vegas Strip, we serve the best Mediterranean and Turkish food. All our food is 100% Halal. We make delicious Shawarma, Gyro and Doner Kebab as well as Falafel - a great vegan choice - at our restaurant. Our dishes are freshly cooked in front of you and served with warm pita and fresh vegetables.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3615 Las Vegas Blvd S Ste 101, Grand Bazaar Shops in front of Bally's, 89109-4329

NAME: Petrossian Bar
DESCRIPTION: Caviar Tacos and captivating cocktail pairings take center stage at Petrossian Bar’s new epicurean experience at Bellagio Resort & Casino. Along with live piano sounds and views of Dale Chihuly’s “Fiori di Como” over the resort’s bustling lobby, the legendary bar’s evolved menu blends signature components of Las Vegas’ culinary scene with extravagant ingredients to create an approachable way to indulge in the world’s finest spirits and caviar.

NAME: Chart House
DESCRIPTION: Chart House is a fine dining restaurant serving seafood & steak and famous for their spectacular views. For more than 50 years, Chart House has redefined the ideal dining experience. With 26 waterfront and showcase locations ranging from the historic to the unforgettable, Chart House restaurants specialize in dazzling views, unique cuisine and exceptional service. From fresh fish specialties and seasonal seafood to slow-roasted prime rib and craft cocktails, the renowned chefs of Chart House have tailored a menu that adds a unique touch to local flavors. And the Chart House happy hour is a guest favorite, where guest favor our signature cocktails and delicious bites you are sure to enjoy. Our original Hot Chocolate Lava Cake is the perfect end to a memorable dining experience at Chart House. Chart House offers the ideal setting for your next event. We would be happy to assist you with all the details of your special occasion.

NAME: Eureka! Discover American Craft
DESCRIPTION: Eureka! features an elevated collection of all-American fare paired with local craft beers, small-batch whiskeys, and cocktails making it the perfect place for for the Las Vegas community to dine, drink and socialize.

NAME: Hot N Juicy Crawfish
DESCRIPTION: Get your fill of great quality seafood in our unique cajun sauces. It's finger-licking good!

NAME: Tommy Bahama Marlin Bar & Store
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to your exclusive desert oasis, where the drinks are cold, the hospitality is warm, and it’s always island time. Located in the upscale, open-air shopping center at Town Square Las Vegas—we’re ready to greet you with our refreshing mai tais, signature coconut shrimp, and curated collection of Tommy Bahama apparel. Whether you’re starting the day off right or relaxing after a successful shopping outing—our newest Marlin Bar is the anytime escape you deserve.

NAME: Scarpetta
DESCRIPTION: An earthy yet modern approach to Italian cuisine, Scarpetta serves a pleasurable and soulful menu of seasonally-inspired fare.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3708 Las Vegas Blvd S, Level 3, Boulevard Tower, 89109-4309

NAME: Eiffel Tower Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Just above the Strip on the 11th floor of the Paris Las Vegas’ Eiffel Tower replica, Chef Joho’s Eiffel Tower Restaurant offers the city’s premier French cuisine, breathtaking views of the Las Vegas strip and is regarded as the crown jewel in Paris Las Vegas’ collection of restaurants. Guests are whisked to the restaurant in a glass elevator that opens to the electric activity of one of the city's top kitchens before being escorted to the dining room, where panoramic views and exquisite cuisine take center stage. The glittering lights of the Las Vegas Strip appear even more dramatic in the dining room's intimate lighting, and guests are treated to spectacular views of the glorious Bellagio water fountain show. Metal frameworks from the Eiffel Tower dramatically breaks through the restaurant walls and creates a modernized art deco style. "No matter what you call it, it's smashing," says Muriel Stevens of the Las Vegas Sun. Please visit our Facebook page to get to know us better.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3655 Las Vegas Blvd S, Paris Hotel, 89109

NAME: Settebello Pizzeria Napoletana
DESCRIPTION: Named after the most sought after card in the Italian card game, Scopa, Settebello was established to cultivate the culinary art of making Neapolitan style Pizza. Pizza Napoletana is hand made with a soft, naturally risen dough cooked in a 900 degree wood burning oven in about a minute. For this reason, Pizza Napoletana has several distinct characteristics. Pizza in Napoli is not crispy it is elastic, soft and fold-able. Blackened char spots on the crust is a tell tale sign of Pizza Napoletana that has been correctly cooked in a blistering hot wood burning oven. Each pizza is an individual work of art.

NAME: Ferraro's Ristorante
DESCRIPTION: Las Vegas, known worldwide as the food mecca for the most discerning palates, houses one of the leading upscale fine dining establishments for Italian cuisine, Ferraro's Ristorante. Featuring a chic and modern ambiance, Ferraro's is synonymous with extraordinary service and unforgettable dining experiences. Guests savor flavorful, uncomplicated dishes utilizing only premium ingredients, all-natural meats and seafood, and fresh, hand-made pasta. A recipient of the internationally acclaimed Gambero Rosso award for wine, the venue's extraordinary list is recognized as one of the top Italian wine collections in the world. Headed by Executive Chef Mimmo Ferraro, classic training, ingenuity, and passion for the Italian kitchen bring authenticity and creativity to the menu, carrying on the tradition and history that made Ferraro's an iconic name in the culinary space.

NAME: Sushi Roku Las Vegas
DESCRIPTION: Sushi Roku combines the finest, freshest fish from pristine waters around the globe with the kind of artistry that can only be provided by a mature sushi chef ensuring superlative traditional sushi, together with a splash of California innovation. Sushi Roku is a pioneer of contemporary sushi, incorporating diverse, non-traditional ingredients from Latin America (e.g. jalapeños) and Europe (e.g. olive oil) into its edible works of art. This unique culinary experience that bridges past and present is the result of an eagerness to embrace new ideas and a profound respect for tradition. Sushi Roku's bold and diverse menu also offers an array of hot and cold specialty appetizers and an extensive selection of exotic entrées.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3500 Las Vegas Blvd S, Ste T-18, 89109-8900

NAME: The Golden Tiki Bar Las Vegas
Oscar's Steakhouse
DESCRIPTION: Named after reputed mob attorney and former Las Vegas Mayor Oscar Goodman, Oscar's Steakhouse has an authentic steakhouse ambiance with a menu that pays homage to his beloved family and infamous ‘friends’ with diverse cuts of beef, classic seafood options and traditional sides. Guests can sip a handcrafted cocktail in the lounge before enjoying a meal inside the iconic glass domed dining room or on the rooftop patio, both overlooking the excitement of downtown. With amazing views, delectable food and personal service, Oscar’s offers an unforgettable vintage Vegas dining experience.

NAME: Edge Steakhouse
DESCRIPTION: The award-winning Edge Steakhouse is an immensely popular restaurant in Las Vegas at Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino. Edge Steakhouse features top quality Prime Cuts, Domestic Wagyu Beef, fresh seafood and other creative entrees, along with specialty appetizers and delectable side dishes. An extensive wine selection is also available.

NAME: Sid's Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Sid's Café in Las Vegas, where endless breakfasts, delectable appetizers, scrumptious burgers, and delightful desserts await you! Sid's offers a creative approach to homestyle cooking with large portions and friendly service that will surprise and delight you every time! Located immediately adjacent to the casino floor at Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino, Sid's has been a longtime local favorite for over 20 years!
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3000 S Paradise Rd, Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino, 89109

NAME: Anima By Edo
DESCRIPTION: The newest restaurant from the EDO Hospitality Group in Las Vegas, Anima by EDO continues the tradition of hospitality and border-free flavor from Roberto Liendo, Oscar Amador, and Joseph Mikulich. With a raw bar, charcuterie program, sharable plates, and considerate beverage program, Anima continues to elevate off-strip dining in Las Vegas. Anima is open dinner Thursday through Tuesday at The Gramercy.

DESCRIPTION: Master chefs and restaurateurs Eric and Bruce Bromberg bring a new version of their award-winning food lovers' heaven to The Cosmopolitan.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3708 Las Vegas Blvd S, Level 3, Blvd Tower, 89109

NAME: Del Frisco's Double Eagle Steakhouse
DESCRIPTION: Del Frisco's Double Eagle Steak House embodies the rich tradition of the classic American steakhouse, serving USDA Prime Beef, fresh seafood and premium wines from our award-winning wine selection.

NAME: Bahama Breeze
DESCRIPTION: Bahama Breeze Island Grille offers a To Go menu with easy online ordering. Take home a taste of the islands today. Bahama Breeze offers all your favorites: burgers, salads, seafood, chicken--all with our island flair. From jicama or plantains to jerk chicken pasta, you can enjoy the islands one taste at a time, discovering new flavors along the way. If our Latin and Caribbean-inspired recipes sound delicious but you're not sure you're ready to explore, ask us about the ingredients or preparation. We're always happy to share our knowledge of Latin American and Caribbean cuisine.

NAME: Bavette's Steakhouse & Bar - Park MGM Las Vegas
DESCRIPTION: An acclaimed Chicago classic has arrived in Las Vegas. A stylish departure from a traditional steakhouse, Bavette's embraces French flair without the formality, blending fine dining with unabashed fun. Indulge in timeless steakhouse fare, including richly flavorful ribeyes, fresh seafood, traditional side dishes, and house made desserts. Strong cocktails and a well-curated international wine list enhance the gilded space which features red leather banquettes and glowing chandeliers.

NAME: Grimaldi's Pizzeria
DESCRIPTION: Grimaldi's Pizzeria serves traditional coal fired brick-oven pizza using pizza-making traditions which includes only fresh ingredients, a "secret recipe" pizza sauce, handmade mozzarella cheese and dough. originating in Brooklyn over 100 years ago.

NAME: Pacific Catch
DESCRIPTION: Pacific Catch is a WestCoast Fish House dedicated to delivering high quality sustainable seafood with a unique perspective. From the day we opened we've been mindful about where our ingredients come from and how to bring to life the vibrant flavors and feeling of the Pacific. That's why we're a community. This is how we connect - over food we can share, and the diverse experiences we all bring to the table. Overall the tie that binds us is our mutual love of seafood and respect for the ocean's resources. It's important to us to be both good global and local citizens. That's why we've formalized our relationship with the Monterey Bay Seafood Aquarium's Seafood Watch, James Beard Foundation's Smart Catch and the Surfrider Foundation by becoming a partner and bringing on a director of sustainability to help steward these efforts. It's our commitment to our guests to keep things interesting, innovative, wholesome and thoughtfully sourced.

NAME: Pacific Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Pacific Cafe opened July 4th, 1974 at the corner of 34th Ave. & Geary Blvd. in San Francisco's Richmond district. We serve dinner Wednesday through Sunday from 5:00 pm until 9:00 pm. Our menu and extensive daily specials offer a wide variety of fish and shellfish. Each entree includes Boudin sourdough bread, your choice of soup or salad, and a side of rice, french fries, or vegetable. We do not accept reservations, but guests receive a glass of complimentary wine with their dinner! Our friendly and experienced staff will take great pleasure in making you feel at home in a warm neighborhood setting.

NAME: Fog Harbor Fish House
DESCRIPTION: It has been said that "no visit to San Francisco is complete without a meal at Fog Harbor Fish House!" Fog Harbor Fish House offers the quintessential San Francisco waterfront dining experience and was the first 100% sustainable seafood restaurant and San Francisco Green Business in Fisherman's Wharf. The restaurant features award-winning panoramic views of the Golden Gate Bridge and Alcatraz. Owned and operated by the Simmons Family, the founding family of PIER 39, you'll meet a member of the family when you dine!

NAME: Sam's Grill And Seafood Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Sam’s Grill, the fifth-oldest restaurant in the US, opened in 1867, shortly after the California gold rush. Its first location was in the old California Market, an open-air food emporium located where the Bank of America building stands now. Sam’s takes pride in serving exceptionally fresh and local seafood alongside classic San Francisco dishes from the turn of the century. Boasting old-school curtained booths, and superior traditional formal service by waiters in tuxedos, Sam’s has been a cornerstone of the San Francisco restaurant scene for over 150 years. Come join us, and take a step back in time to a more civilized era where lunches always begin with a cocktail. Start with local oysters on the half shell, clams Elizabeth with garlic, butter, and sherry wine, or classic Celery Victor. Coquille Saint Jacques, with mushrooms in cream sauce, and lobster Thermador are two of our favorite classic entrees. Finish with bourbon pecan pie or tiramisu.

NAME: Surisan
DESCRIPTION: absolute best breakfast and lunch in fisherman's wharf area. Fine Korean Cuisine dining nightly.

NAME: Lapisara Eatery
DESCRIPTION: We serve Brunch&Breakfast from 7:30 am - 3:00 pm, fresh made from scratch Experience Authentic Thai with a twist from 5:00 pm - 10:00 pm We invite you to enjoy a completely gastronomic experience!! We're located in Downtown, a few blocks from Union Square
GENERAL_LOCATION: 698 Post St, Post St. & Jones St., 94109-8232

NAME: Fred's Coffee Shop
DESCRIPTION: Classic Sausalito spot serving Breakfast, Brunch and Lunch for over 50 years! Try our special omelets, fluffy pancakes and unique french toast made with ice cream and grilled to perfection. Great for recovering after a wild night out or a meal with the family!

NAME: New Delhi Indian Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: We have a unique and affordable menu to choose from that will satisfy your craving for delicious Indian food. New Delhi Restaurant by Chef Ranjan Dey is an immigrant and mixed family owned, oldest Indian restaurant of San Francisco and a Legacy Business since 1988. We're delighted to be open and serving you again. We can't wait to see you all! Namaste

NAME: Mersea Restaurant & Bar
DESCRIPTION: “Come for the view, Stay for the food”! Breath-taking, panoraic views of SanFrancisco, Golden-Gate Bridge, Alcatraz and Bay Bridge! Built out of shipping containers, providing “comfort-casual” food created by renown SF Executive chef Parke Ulrich (Waterbar and Epic Steak), who partnered with tech entrepreneur MeeSun Boice to build a “destination restaurant” that has its own putting green, bocce courts and corn-hole game. Upcycled and repurposed pallets for outside seating and herb garden, tables from old Treasure Island bowling alley lanes and doors from the military kitchen!
GENERAL_LOCATION: 699 Avenue of the Palms, Treasure Island, 94130

NAME: Quince
DESCRIPTION: Restaurant Quince serves California contemporary cuisine guided by Chef Michael Tusk’s lifelong respect for seasonality, terroir and artisanal producers. While his culinary foundation is grounded in the principles of Italian cuisine, his years in California have influenced his approach with a sense of place. Quince is where every ingredient has its place and purpose, treated with the utmost care to elevate its purest flavors. It is our passion to source for the very best ingredients from a local and global network of artisanal producers to create memorable dishes, highlighting produce from our collaboration and partnership. Chef Michael Tusk was named "Best Chef: Pacific" by the James Beard Foundation in 2011. Quince has been awarded four stars by the San Francisco Chronicle, three stars from the Michelin Guide, a green star from the Michelin Guide, and is a distinguished member of Relais & Châteaux.

NAME: Fogo de Chao Brazilian Steakhouse
DESCRIPTION: Fogo de Chão is an internationally-renowned steakhouse from Brazil that allows guests to discover what's next at every turn. Founded in Southern Brazil in 1979, Fogo elevates the centuries-old culinary art of churrasco - roasting high-quality cuts of meat over an open flame - into a cultural dining experience of discovery. Please join us in our dining room, in our more casual Bar Fogo, or bring the Fogo Experience to you with Fogo To-Go or Catering. Visit our website to make a reservation or place an order.

NAME: L'ardoise Bistro
DESCRIPTION: French bistro fare & a varied wine list star in a cozy, colorful space.

NAME: Dragon Beaux
DESCRIPTION: We are a sophisticated dim sum and premium hotpot restaurant created by an owner of the spectacularly popular Koi Palace. At lunchtime, you can now enjoy the best dim sum in the Bay Area right here in San Francisco! We offer much of same popular quality dim sum items from Koi Palace, with additional unique offerings such as squid ink dumplings. We specialize in premium hotpot in the evening with an extensive selection of meats (including Australian wagyu and kurobuta pork), seafood, veggies, noodles (squid ink pulled noodles, taro noodles, etc.), and around ten housemade sauces. We are also the first restaurant in the Bay Area to offer the famous traditional Chinese fragrantly spicy frog stew (Ma La Tian Ji).

NAME: Betty Lou's Seafood and Grill
DESCRIPTION: Casual, no frills, family restaurant with friendly vibe serving San Francisco classics including cioppino, sand dabs, wok crab and even a great steak. There's something for everyone!
GENERAL_LOCATION: 318 Columbus Ave, Corner of Columbus & Grant, 94133-3908

NAME: Pescatore Trattoria
DESCRIPTION: Pescatore is the perfect neighborhood sidewalk cafe serving Italian specialties and wood-fired pizzas with an emphasis on fresh seafood and local California produce.

NAME: Old Skool Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Old Skool Cafe is a youth-run jazz-themed supper club, training and employing at-risk youth. Through jobs and community, together we’re breaking the cycle of incarceration, poverty, and violence. Get ready to come hungry and leave inspired!

NAME: Sweet Maple
DESCRIPTION: At Sweet Maple, we keep it real and simple. We focus on great food and friendly service. We have a relaxing and spacious atmosphere filled with aromas of fresh ground coffee.Come and enjoy the food, enjoy the drinks. Find out why Sweet Maple is rapidly becoming one of the best brunch places in San Francisco.We're open every day for breakfast and lunch!

NAME: Eagle Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Famous for our breakfast items such as banana pecan pancakes, crab benedicts and Boudin sourdough French toast with maple butter. For lunch enjoy a killer rueben, pastrami burger, fresh fish tacos or some tater tots.

NAME: Il Casaro Pizzeria and Mozzarella Bar
Bourbon and Branch
GENERAL_LOCATION: 501 Jones St, Look for the unmarked anti saloon league door., 94102-2007

NAME: Square Pie Guys
DESCRIPTION: Square Pie Guys is a modern pizza restaurant focused on improving the lives of its team, guests, and neighbors. They serve Detroit-style square crusted, pan-baked pizzas at Ghirardelli Square. They utilize seasonal ingredients for its creative chef-driven pizzas, wings, sides, and salads while offering a range of local craft beers and wines.

NAME: Harris' Restaurant - The San Francisco Steakhouse
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2100 Van Ness Ave, On the corner of Pacific Avenue and Van Ness Avenue, 94109-2511

NAME: Pier Market Seafood Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Voted Best Seafood in San Francisco by KRON 4 TV Best of the Bay, Pier Market is an authentic sustainable seafood restaurant where the locals go for the freshest local seafood in the city. Pier Market is family-owned and operated and one of the most popular dining destinations on Fisherman's Wharf. Pier Market has been selling San Francisco's freshest seafood since 1983. We feature Fresh, Mesquite-Grilled Fish and Meat, Dungeness Crab, Pastas, Steaming bowls of our Award-Winning Clam Chowder in Authentic Fresh Sourdough Bread Bowls. We offer two large al fresco patios for heated outdoor dining.

NAME: Taylor Street Coffee Shop
DESCRIPTION: The Taylor Street Coffee Shop is a long-standing favorite of San Francisco offering the city fresh, tasty coffee and delicious breakfast food including the millionaire's bacon. We love to serve a healthy breakfast with lots of fresh fruit, but also have items such as our breakfast pizza - hash browns under scrambled eggs, bacon, sausage, and more - that we know will satisfy. We keep the atmosphere casual and relaxed, the service friendly and fast, and the food hot and tasty. What more could you ask for?

NAME: Ideale Restaurant & Bar
DESCRIPTION: *Just awarded the prestigious "Gambero Rosso" for being one of the best Italian restaurants in America* "For an authentic Roman holiday without the airfare, this undiscovered North Beach gem is worth seeking out." (Zagat) . A bright, colorful Italian restaurant, Ideale is the modern version of a traditional Roman trattoria. It is "festive and boisterous...la vera cucina italiana." Ideale has been bringing Rome to North Beach for 30 yrs now with it's highly acclaimed chef, Maurizio Bruschi. Maurizio hails from 4 generations of Roman chefs, lovingly taught by his grandma, Serafina. The pastas & breads are all homemade & the ingredients are hand-picked daily. Zagat wrote, the "Italian fare is the real deal...one of the few no tourist eateries in North Beach.. excellent pasta & pizza..the service makes you feel like a friend..a delightful experience." Ideale has won numerous awards, including Zagat's "Best Italian Restaurants in America" & The Chronicle's "Best Pasta in North Beach."

NAME: The Codmother Fish & Chips
DESCRIPTION: The Codmother Fish & Chips is a popular food truck permanently located at the historic Fisherman's Wharf, and one of San Francisco's top Seafood destinations. It is known for its delicious and authentic British-style fish and chips, a classic dish of battered and deep-fried fish served with thick-cut fries. The Codmother Fish & Chips has garnered a loyal following among locals and visitors alike, who appreciate the restaurant's commitment to serving tasty and genuine fish and chips. It has become a must-visit destination for seafood lovers seeking a taste of Britain in the heart of San Francisco.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 496 Beach St, Between Jones and Taylor, 94133-1102

NAME: Boulevard
DESCRIPTION: Located in the historic Audiffred building, Boulevard is a celebrated San Francisco restaurant on the Embarcadero waterfront. First opened by Chef and Owner Nancy Oakes in 1993, Boulevard has continuously received high praise and a dedicated following. Quintessentially Californian, our menu seamlessly incorporates the regional seasonal bounty with studied classic and modern technique. We have recently undergone an exciting refresh to our space. While preserving the artisanal mosaics, iron work & hand blown glass intrinsic to Boulevard, we have enriched and updated just about everything else from our private dining room and wine vault to our beloved bar. In addition to the improvements, we are now offering two unique dining experiences: a highly adaptable set price menu which can be enjoyed in the dining room (or anywhere else you’d like in the restaurant) and an à la carte menu which will be available at the chef’s counter and in the recently expanded bar and lounge.

NAME: Zazie
DESCRIPTION: French Bistro in Cole Valley

NAME: Restaurant Gary Danko
DESCRIPTION: An “oasis of excellence” that “never loses its luster”, Gary Danko’s “stellar” Fisherman’s Wharf namesake manages to “mystically balance” “world-class” New American cuisine on a “brilliantly executed” prix fixe menu.

NAME: Brenda's French Soul Food
DESCRIPTION: Brenda's offers a soulful mixture of Southern, Creole and French cuisines presented in a down-home style and atmosphere in the heart of San Francisco's Civic Center neighborhood. Famous beignets, biscuits and fried chicken. Come for brunch, lunch & dinner daily except Tuesdays.

NAME: Luisa's Restaurant Wine Bar Since 1959
DESCRIPTION: Luisa's Restaurant Wine Bar since 1959 is an Italian Restaurant located in San Francisco, CA and has been servicing all of San Fran and the surrounding areas for many years. We specialize in Italian, Chicken Dishes, Pizza, Seafood, Gnocchi Meatballs, and Take Out. Here at Luisa's Restaurant Wine Bar since 1959, our mission is to always provide quality service at an affordable price. The success of our company is due to the dedication we provide to our customers. No matter the job, customer satisfaction is always our number one priority! Don’t hesitate to give us a call!

NAME: State Bird Provisions
DESCRIPTION: State Bird Provisions is an adventurous, inventive, delicious, thoughtful contemporary American restaurant; which started as a recipe for serving quail and has slowly evolved into a restaurant without any programmed elements.

NAME: Blue Mermaid Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Serving casual San Francisco fare and a large helping of Gold Rush Era ambiance, the Blue Mermaid Restaurant & Bar makes its home in the heart of Fisherman's Wharf. A menu, priced for the whole family, features fresh seafood with a regional focus and a great kids' menu. Diners will find distinctive homemade chowders served from steaming cauldrons in three different size bowls, including a traditional bread bowl. Also offered are such savory selections as Fresh Oysters on the Half Shell, Whole Dungeness Crab and Cioppino. A full bar specializes in a wide selection of beer and California wines, Irish Coffee and ocean-themed cocktails... guaranteed to promote mermaid sightings. Come in and listen for the siren songs of the legendary Blue Mermaid.

NAME: Pat's Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Charming neighborhood restaurant serving AWESOME American style cooking. We are located on Taylor Street, the Mason Taylor Cable Car rolls down Taylor Street where it turns around and goes back to Union Square.

NAME: Napa Valley Burger Company
DESCRIPTION: Located in the heart of downtown, the Napa Valley Burger Company® brings a taste of the Napa Valley to historic Sausalito by the Bay. Come in, relax and enjoy our fine wines and gourmet burgers.

NAME: Anchor Oyster Bar
DESCRIPTION: Founded in 1977, Anchor Oyster Bar is a small, locally-owned legacy seafood restaurant and fish market in the Castro serving sustainably-caught fish, shellfish, crab, oysters, and specially prepared seafood dishes, including its signature cioppino dish, which was beautifully described in a New York Times article in May of 2022. Located on Castro Street between 18th and 19th streets, the restaurant occupies a small storefront with a large plate glass window and trademark blue awning, with an intimate interior characterized by linoleum floors, a long white marble bar, chrome chairs, and a daily specials board. Anchor Oyster Bar has been owned and operated by Roseann Grimm for its entire 45-year history. Grimm attributes her love and knowledge of seafood to her grandfather, Nicola Desimone, a fisherman from Amalfi, Italy who worked on salmon and crab boats in North Beach and who opened a seafood market and oyster bar in the neighborhood during the turn of the 20th century.

NAME: Scoma's Of Sausalito
DESCRIPTION: Locals and visitors from around the world have been enjoying fresh seafood in this 19th century Victorian building. A historic landmark and family owned for over 40 years, Scoma's is surrounded by the beauty of the San Francisco bay.

NAME: Venice Gourmet
DESCRIPTION:
625 Bridgeway
Sausalito, CA 94965

(415) 332-3544

NAME: Luna Blu
DESCRIPTION: Established in 2013, owners Renzo and Crystal were honeymooning in Tiburon and came across the vacant restaurant on a romantic stroll on Main St. They put a lot of love into the renovations to enhance the beautiful spot. Executive Chef Renzo has been a restauranteur for over 15 years and his new wife Crystal is happy to assist with the front of house. The name Luna Blu means blue moon in Italian, it relates to their honeymoon and also something special and rare "once in a blue moon". Serving weekend brunch, lunch and dinner. We are business partners of the Monterey Bay Aquarium Seafood Watch Program, which means we only serve sustainable seafood. Also our meat and poultry is all naturally raised and from small farms. We serve as much organic produce as possible. Luna Blu is perfect for a romantic meal or large groups, we recommend reservations. We hope to create many more happy and special memories here.

NAME: Waterbar
DESCRIPTION: Waterbar is located on the South end of Rincon Park on San Francisco's scenic Embarcadero. If you're looking for a San Francisco restaurant with a view, Waterbar features panoramic views of the Bay and San Francisco skyline serving the freshest seafood.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 399 The Embarcadero, East side of Embarcadero, just North of the base of the Bay Bridge., 94105-1265

NAME: Cotogna
DESCRIPTION: Italian for ‘quince’ as a playful reference to its sister restaurant, Cotogna is the quintessential neighborhood spot known for its warm and convivial atmosphere, featuring seasonally-driven regional Italian cuisine with a forever changing menu with a selection of house-made pasta, spit-roasted and grilled meats from the wood-burning oven, local fish and shellfish, and produce coming directly from the restaurant’s own farm in West Marin. In keeping with the cuisine, Cotogna showcases the best of Italian viticulture with an emphasis on growers working organically, on a small scale, and making wines true to their terroir.

NAME: Tony's Pizza Napoletana
DESCRIPTION: Tony's Pizza Napoletana is a state of the art full service restaurant that offers several styles of pizzas which include Neapolitan, Classic American and Italian, Sicilian, Pizza Romana, Gluten Free and New York, Detroit and St. Louis Style and displays seven different types of pizza ovens. A delightful array of antipasti, pastas, insalata, and dolci are available at Tony's including a full bar that includes Italian and California wines, aperitifs, digestives and hand crafted artisan cocktails. At Tony's we pride ourselves in using only the finest ingredients which include fresh herbs and honey from our roof-top garden. We import authentic Neapolitan and Italian products each week and support several locally grown organic farmers and artisan cheese makers. All of our purveyors are specifically picked by Tony Gemignani bringing you the highest quality food or drink right to your table.

NAME: Poggio Trattoria
DESCRIPTION: Poggio is a classic Italian trattoria with comfortable neighborhood charm and destination-caliber cuisine. Using the best available local ingredients including organic herbs and vegetables, the daily changing menu features soulful classics of Northern Italy, simply and earnestly prepared by hand.

NAME: Montesacro Pinseria
DESCRIPTION: Montesacro is the first Pinseria Romana in the US. Pinsa is the ancestor of Pizza, perfectly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside - made with soy, rice and wheat flour imported from Rome and GMO free. Pinsa is hypocaloric, low in fat and easy to digest. Montesacro brings a piece of authentic Italian culture and Roman history to the US, utilizing food prepared only with the freshest seasonal, imported and local ingredients. A presto!

NAME: Lolinda
DESCRIPTION: Cuisine inspired by Latin America, Spain and Argentina. Sustainable meats, seven different types of grass-fed, grain finished beef cuts ranging from short ribs to blood sausage cooked over a wood-fired grill. Ceviche and a handful of vegetarian offerings such as a pastel de choclo (squash, onions, raisins, and olives, cooked in a corn crust) and platano al horno (ripe plantains with queso fresco, and jicama salsa). Artisanal cocktails, piscos, tequilas, wine list primarily focused on varietals from Portugal, Spain, Chile, and Argentina including sherry and port. Stellar selection of European and South American beers. Two levels of dining, two full bars and seating for 220 people divided in a mix of booths, tables, communal tables and bar stools. Happy hour: $7 Highball Cocktails + snacks, 7 days a week, 5:30 - 7pm. Open for late-night dining.

NAME: Bouche
DESCRIPTION: Our roots are Mediterranean and northern France In origin, where authenticity is key. So our menu is seasonal, inspired by our personal family recipes, and the bountiful northern California farmers markets. Our mission is to focus on esoteric French wines from small appellations, so that we are able to share our heritage with you.

NAME: Crab House at Pier 39
DESCRIPTION: Incredible Bay views & World-Famous Dungeness Crab served on a sizzling skillet in seriously addictive garlic sauce. Family-owned. 1 hour free parking. If you are looking for crab this is THE place.

NAME: Seven Hills
DESCRIPTION: SEVEN HILLS is a small neighborhood restaurant located in the romantic Russian Hill district of San Francisco. Our emphasis is on home made pasta and showcasing the best our local farmers have to offer. Our wine list was created to be extremely approachable and well suited to our cuisine. We are located on the cable car line on Hyde street. We look forward to seeing you soon...

NAME: Yank Sing
DESCRIPTION: Yank Sing Restaurants specializes in traditional and contemporary Dim Sum and is located in the heart of San Francisco.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 101 Spear St, One Rincon Ctr., Mission St, 94105-1559

NAME: Scoma's Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Scoma's, located perfectly on the San Francisco Bay, is one of the most iconic restaurants in the city, having opened in 1965. Since then, the restaurant has provided the freshest, most sustainable and delicious local seafood to locals and visitors alike. Priding itself on its "Pier To Plate" menu, Scoma's owners, chefs and management pride themselves on their deep relationships with the local fishing community where they source most of their seafood. Guests can even watch the fishing boats pull up to the restaurant's own fish receiving station and get a glimpse of that day's catch before it is artfully served on their plate. Scoma's also offers a full bar with a fantastic craft cocktail program and an extensive local beer award-winning wine list for those looking to relax and imbibe while watching the sun set over the water. We hope to see you at Scoma's soon! WE OFFER COMPLIMENTARY VALET PARKING ~
GENERAL_LOCATION: 1965 Al Scoma Way, Pier 47, Fisherman's Whaft, 94133

NAME: Original Joe's
DESCRIPTION: Original Joe’s is a three-generation family owned and operated restaurant. Established over 80 years ago in 1937, Joe’s is defined by quiet elegance, yet bustling with energy, affording a standard of excellence that enhances the total dining experience. Hospitality, familiarity, predictability—these are the key elements of the brand, providing guests with a sense of comfort upon first entering the lobby doors. The oldest of all the “Joe’s” restaurants, Original Joe’s is the innovator of the now nationally known “Joe’s Concept”—exhibition-style kitchen, notable leather booths, smooth cocktails, and renowned Italian-American menu. Original Joe’s has succeeded in establishing a high-profile identity in San Francisco and surrounding Bay Area, standing tall amongst the well-known restaurants and bars—a sustainable business genuinely worthy of its proven credential.

NAME: Chili House SF
DESCRIPTION: Chili House Restaurant is a Chinese and Dim Sum restaurant serving delicious authentic cuisine in the Richmond neighborhood of San Francisco. Chili House is located on Clement Street, between 8th and 9th Avenue. Our restaurant offers an authentic Chinese atmosphere and Cuisine with specialties such as Peking duck, Sichuan, seafood. Some of our customers' favorites include Spicy Crab, Ma Po Tofu, Xiao Long Bo, Dong Po Pork, Potstickers and more. Perhaps nothing defines Chinese food as strongly as our rice and noodles. We offer Dan Dan Noodle, Chicken, Shrimp, Beef and Vegetable Chow Mein, Vegetable Fired Rice and Steamed Rice. If you are looking for some spicy food, check out our Frog or Pork Feet with Flaming Chili Oil and our Tender Fish Filet Boiled in Szechuan Pickled Mustard Broth. We also provide more "mainstream" Chinese food options such as Spicy Beef or Stir Fried Chicken.

NAME: Shuckers Oyster Bar
DESCRIPTION: Boasting the beautifully carved oak paneling and unique tin ceiling of the haberdashery it once was in the 1930's, Shuckers Oyster Bar in Seattle is one of Seattle's oldest and most pre-eminent oyster bars.

NAME: Six Seven Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: It's all about cravings at Six Seven Seattle Restaurant. Satisfying the ones you have, and creating sensory experiences that are totally unexpected. At our Seattle restaurant, you'll find a delightful melange of exciting flavors-highlighting the best of Northwestern cuisine and of the area. Our signature Seattle restaurant offers Pacific Northwest Cuisine and breathtaking views. Located inside The Edgewater, our waterfront Seattle restaurant, Six Seven, features seasonally inspired cuisine crafted with only the freshest and finest organic and naturally raised ingredients, procured for you to enjoy in our Executive Chef's new and exciting menus. To complement our Chef's special preparations, our ever-evolving wine selections highlight the finest artisan, boutique and hard to find Washington, Oregon and Northern California wineries. A purposeful selection of allocated wines are sought and paired with ongoing special dinners and promotions to highlight your dining experience.

NAME: The Capital Grille
DESCRIPTION: Make it a day to remember. From birthdays and anniversaries to professional milestones, we aim to make every gathering special at The Capital Grille. Open seven days a week, The Capital Grille is best known for our expertly prepared steaks, which are dry aged in house for 18 to 24 days and then hand-cut by our restaurant's on-premise butcher. The Capital Grille's wine list features more than 350 selections, and its floor-to-ceiling wine kiosk regularly houses 3,500 - 5,000 bottles. Reservations are recommended but not required. For more information, please visit our website. We look forward to delighting you.

NAME: Tilikum Place Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Located in Belltown near the Space Needle. Specializing in European influenced Northwest cuisine. Reservations required for lunch and brunch. Please note: We will be closed July 1-4, 2021.

NAME: Chan Seattle
DESCRIPTION: Chan Seattle offers progressive Korean food bringing a modern approach to classic dishes prepared with Western cooking techniques. Our cuisine is carefully prepared with locally grown, fresh, seasonal ingredients. Chan is a distinctive style of dining not found in other Korean restaurants. Our restaurant offer shareable portions served as several courses allowing diners to experience the flavor of both traditional and modern Korean food. Our full bar features Asian-inspired specialty cocktails, beer and wine. Join us!

NAME: The Loupe Lounge
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in an exclusive culinary experience in the iconic Space Needle upon the world’s 1st and only revolving glass floor, 500 feet above Seattle. Limited edition menus feature show-stopping mixology paired with locally influenced food Towers to bring your night out to new heights. Your prepaid reservation includes VIP entry, a preselected multi-course culinary Tower, three craft cocktails (additional drinks and sides available for purchase) and dessert. 23/24 Season: November through April

NAME: Charlotte Restaurant & Lounge
DESCRIPTION: Charlotte Restaurant & Lounge is located on the 16th floor of Lotte Hotel Seattle and offers a panoramic view of Elliott Bay and downtown Seattle. A culinary experience featuring contemporary Pacific Northwest cuisine. Since serving our first meal in 2020, we’ve been delighted to be the place where locals and visitors of Seattle celebrate special occasions big and small – from first dates to anniversaries to family reunions. Our culinary team has dazzled guests with special prix-fixe menus that have become core to our locally-sourced and seasonal approach to Contemporary Pacific Northwest cuisine. We’re excited to announce that our dining room is exclusively offering a 3 or 4-Course Prix-Fixe menu as of March 15th, 2022. An extended Bar Menu will continue to be available to guests in our Bar and Lounge. We look forward to continuing to showcase the best of PNW cuisine and to the many special moments ahead!

NAME: Petra Bistro
DESCRIPTION: At Petra Mediterranean Bistro, we'll take you on a journey that stretches from Jordan and Lebanon, to Greece, to the Northern shores of Africa, with an extensive variety of authentic dishes and house specialties. While visiting, you'll enjoy the enriching personal elements that tie this vast global area together, creating one of Seattle's loveliest dining experiences.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2501 4th Ave, At the Corner of Wall St. and 4TH. Ave, 98121-1437

NAME: Shaker + Spear
DESCRIPTION: Fresh local ingredients and fresh seafood is the hallmark of Shaker + Spear, a standout among Seattle seafood restaurants.

NAME: Radiator Whiskey
GENERAL_LOCATION: 94 Pike St Ste 30, Corner of 1st & pike. Top floor of brick building across from showgirls, 98101-2066

NAME: Can Can Culinary Cabaret
DESCRIPTION: Seattle’s Pike Place Market is home to the world famous Can Can, an intimate 120 seat dinner theatre and production house. The venue's entertainment, food, and drink experience is unmatched. Featuring a menu of French-inspired north west fare sourced from the freshest ingredients from neighboring Market farmers, butchers, and seafood businesses. Experience the gorgeous views of Post Alley and the Puget Sound from the patio of Can Can’s bistro and bar titled, “The Dressing Room.” Moving further into the space, ticketholders will be transported to the theatre.The venue is a romantic space with an interior bathed in art and lush booth seating. At the heart of the institution is the creative team, a professional group of artists who transform the venue with each new show, producing inventive scenic design, choreography, original music, costuming, and more several times each year.

NAME: Spinasse
DESCRIPTION: Opened in August of 2008, Cascina Spinasse captivated local and national attention for its authentic incorporation of Piedmontese dishes, including handmade pastas and use of local and Italian ingredients. Spinasse, is open for dinner from 5:00 pm- 10:00 pm Sunday -Thursday and until 11 pm on Friday and Saturday. We take reservations via phone or on our website.

NAME: Seastar Restaurant & Raw Bar
DESCRIPTION: Seastar Restaurant & Raw Bar in downtown Bellevue, WA is brought to you by renowned chef John Howie, providing guests with freshly prepared seafood, as well as steak, poultry, pastas and a raw bar serving sushi and rolls. Enjoy the comfort of the luxurious Seastar dining room or the upbeat Raw Bar for drinks, cocktails or happy hour. Private dining and catering is available.

NAME: All Water Seafood & Oyster Bar
DESCRIPTION: All Water Seafood & Oyster Bar is the new full-service restaurant and bar located inside Hotel 1000, Seattle. A boat-to-plate concept featuring fresh and flavorful cuisine inspired by the local maritime industry as well as locally brewed craft beers and handcrafted cocktails. Happy Hour everyday 3-5pm!!

NAME: The Pink Door
DESCRIPTION: The Pink Door is an independently owned (never cloned, never genetically modified) restaurant that has been quietly dedicated to fresh & local Italian food since 1981. Its seafood & produce driven menu has been the central theme throughout its wildly popular domain in Seattle's Pike Place Market.

NAME: Andaluca Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Seattle's Andaluca Restaurant serves the finest breakfast in town and offers a warm, inviting ambiance with hand painted murals and large paned windows.

NAME: Lola
DESCRIPTION: Lola offers modern, Greek-influenced cuisine with local ingredients. With menu items like salads, kebabs, lamb chops, eggplant, and cod, you’ll enjoy a bit of Greek food with a Pacific Northwest twist. Located in downtown Seattle, Lola restaurant serves a contemporary twist on the classic favorite Greek fare. It’s a lively eatery by Tom Douglas honoring his wife, Jackie’s grandmother Lola who married Louis a Greek immigrant, both full of life. With our menu, we celebrate Louie's Greek spirit and Lola's feistiness. You can find photos of them both on the walls behind Pope's table.

NAME: Ba Bar U-Village
DESCRIPTION: Specialties Ba Bar is the place for authentic Vietnamese cuisine in Seattle. We use the highest quality ingredients to create the best Pho in town. We also have one of the top selections of high end spirits on Capitol Hill and we make a great Moscow Mule to boot. Bonus - we serve food until 1:30am on weeknights and 3:30am on weekends. History Established in 2011. Sophie and Eric Banh grew up together eating street food in Saigon, and that was really the inspiration for Ba Bar. When they first opened Monsoon Seattle in 1999, they drew much of their inspiration from the very same "street food" we are serving. With Ba Bar we're just a little closer to the street. But yeah, same owners. Same chefs. Same commitment to quality. And did you know, Ba means father and number 3 in Vietnamese?

NAME: Bacco Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Bacco serves breakfast, lunch and brunch using fresh, local ingredients with a Pacific Northwest flair. Evening service complete with craft cocktails, small plates and desserts coming Summer 2017 - stay tuned!
GENERAL_LOCATION: 86 Pine St, Corner of 1st Ave & Stewart Street, 98101-1531

NAME: Assaggio Ristorante
DESCRIPTION: Authentic central Italian food served up just blocks from downtown Seattle's shopping district and the Space Needle. Visit today and taste the passion.

NAME: Rays
DESCRIPTION: A Seattle icon since 1973, Ray’s Boathouse, Café & Catering is internationally renowned for its unparalleled Northwest seafood and breathtaking waterfront view of Puget Sound and the Olympic Mountains. Ray’s Boathouse is comfortably elegant, serving refined sustainable seafood, local meats and produce, and an extensive list of Northwest wines nightly. Ray’s Cafe is lively and fun, serving casual regional fare for lunch and dinner, with seasonal outdoor dining. Ray’s Catering offers professional full-service catering and a beautiful waterfront banquet room that is perfect for social and corporate entertaining.

NAME: Oliver's Lounge
DESCRIPTION: Oliver's is the perfect place to unwind and soak up the stunning cityscape. An elegant downtown bar, Oliver's provides a casual setting for lunch, snacks or your favorite cocktail.

NAME: Zeeks Pizza
DESCRIPTION: We founded Zeeks under the simple premise that pizza should be flavorful, not just cheap and fast. Don’t get us wrong; we like fast and reasonably priced, but cheap can suck it. To be driven by flavor, you need to care about things like what kind of flour and cheese you’re using and know where it’s coming from and how it’s handled. You need to do things like chop your herbs fresh every day. You need to wake up early and make dough every morning. You need to hand-toss and make every pizza to order. Your pizza needs to be baked by real humans in real ovens. It needs to get to your table or door before it’s done steaming. Basically, real food made with real love results in real flavor. Got it?

NAME: Peyrassol Cafe
DESCRIPTION: The goal at Peyrassol is to prepare simple, rustic, homemade food with familiar flavors, served with passion and paired with an inspired wine selection and cocktails. At Peyrassol you’ll be greeted with a familiar face, find a changing seasonal menu, handpicked wine list, choice beers on tap and an eclectic bar selection along with new friends, festive vibe and cozy atmosphere! Salute!

NAME: Japonessa Sushi Cocina
DESCRIPTION: The best sushi and Japanese food - and Happy Hour - in downtown Seattle. Delivery and takeout available.

NAME: El Gaucho Seattle
DESCRIPTION: Named as "the definitive steakhouse in the country," El Gaucho's award-winning menu features 28-Day Dry-Aged Niman Ranch All-Natural Certified Angus Beef(R) Brand Prime steaks and custom aged Certified Angus Beef(R) brand tenderloin filets, ribs, pork, poultry and the freshest seafood, all prepared to perfection over an open bed of glowing coals in an exhibition-style kitchen. Our extensive wine list is award-winning, and happy hour menu is widely recognized as one of Seattle's best. El Gaucho is the Northwest's steakhouse legacy focused on old-school, tableside service. We revel in helping guests create a night to remember.

NAME: Cafe Campagne
DESCRIPTION: Since 1994, Café Campagne has built a regional and national reputation as Seattle's foremost classic French restaurant. Located just along the historic Post Alley of the Pike Place Market, we offer a dining experience that is exceptional in traditional food & wine, and comfortable in ambiance and service.

NAME: Yard House
DESCRIPTION: Yard House is the modern American gathering place where beer and food lovers unite. Known for great food, classic rock, an energetic vibe and endless fleet of tap handles featuring the best craft and local beers, each Yard House location offers 100+ beers on tap along with an array of craft cocktails. Our menu features favorites such as our signature Poke Nachos, street tacos, USDA prime burgers, seafood and steaks. Founded in Long Beach, Calif., in 1996, Yard House now spans across the U.S. with over 80 locations and is open daily for lunch, dinner, happy hour and late-night dining.

NAME: Toulouse Petit Kitchen & Lounge
DESCRIPTION:
Centered around the cuisine, decor and imagery of the French Quarter and New Orleans and creating the feel of the Big Easy, Toulouse is one of the most intricate and ambitiously built restaurants in a generation.   
Our expansive menus offer culinary diversity and range from traditional Creole and French Quarter menu choices to traditional Parisian and French countryside preparations to more innovative dishes that are entirely unique to Toulouse.   
At Toulouse we are tremendously committed to offering value in all of its various forms, which includes our intricate and texturally rich decor, cuisine prepared with discipline and skill, fabulous cocktails, a diverse Northwest and French centered wine list, unrepeatable and unique people, and accessible prices in an adult escapist and community environment.

NAME: Rockcreek Seafood & Spirits
DESCRIPTION: Our menu centers around globally sourced seafood from well managed fisheries; with offerings of local Northwest familiars like crab, oysters and mussels, to more tropical fish like Kona Kampachi or Hawaiian Ono, and East Coast staples like Striped Bass. Our preparations emphasize fresh ingredients that arrive daily, and pronounced flavors from around the world. Our urban-industrial two-story 'fishing lodge' was built with local and reclaimed resources by Dovetail Construction and Marian Built. Our tables were crafted from bark-beetle pine, and we even found a home for our favorite repurposed farm equipment! Our space includes the main dining area, our killer bar, a large modern patio and an upstairs loft and private dining room.

NAME: The George
DESCRIPTION: The George is a modern brasserie that focuses on seasonality and impeccable ingredients, representing the luscious terroir of the Pacific Northwest. Open breakfast, lunch and dinner and weekend brunch, The George is your ideal spot for downtown dining.

NAME: Portage Bay Cafe - Roosevelt
DESCRIPTION: Portage Bay Cafe is a Seattle restaurant serving 100% breakfast, brunch and lunch 7 days a week. Eat like you give a damn! is our motto. Locally sourced, organic food items. We offer catering options including private dining, corporate events, private parties, weddings and box lunches.

NAME: Din Tai Fung
GENERAL_LOCATION: 700 Bellevue Way NE, between 6th St & 8th St, 98004-5046

NAME: AQUA by El Gaucho
DESCRIPTION: Named Gayot's Top Ten Seafood Restaurants in America in 2012, AQUA by El Gaucho sparkles at the tip of Pier 70, offering Seattle's best waterfront dining experience. In addition to fantastic views and ambiance, guests are treated to the legendary El Gaucho personalized, fine-dining service. Our award-winning wine list, coupled with a menu highlighting fresh wild seafood preparations, as well as 28-Day Dry-Aged Niman Ranch All-Natural Certified Angus Beef(R) Brand Prime steaks and custom aged Certified Angus Beef(R) Brand, are all prepared on an open-pit charcoal grill in the exhibition kitchen. AQUA by El Gaucho delivers a quintessential Seattle fine dining experience.

NAME: Geraldine's Counter Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Open at 25% dine in as well as takeout 8am-3pm daily. Geraldine's Counter Restaurant is a local favorite for brunch & breakfast in Seattle, also serving lunch and dinner with a full bar, beer and wine. Breakfast served all day. A contemporary but traditional diner, Geraldine's offers highly regarded versions of locally sourced ingredients and food including French toast with the topping of the day and 100% pure maple syrup. The Slammin: Your choice of sausage patty, chicken sausage or bacon, any style of eggs and pancakes of the day. Substitute pancakes with French Toast for 2.75. Bacon, egg, and arugula breakfast sandwich with tomato, aioli and scrambled eggs on sour batard. Served with hash browns. No meat? Substitute bacon with avocado NC. Dinner and lunch options also available. Other breakfast and brunch items include biscuits and gravy, corned beef hash, Geraldine's Casserole, Chicken Fried Steak and eggs, pancakes, granola and oatmeal.

NAME: Ruth's Chris Steak House
DESCRIPTION: Ruth's Chris Steak House specializes in serving USDA Prime steaks, each seared to perfection, finished with butter and freshly chopped parsley, and served sizzling on a 500-degree plate. We invite you to join us in Seattle, WA!

NAME: Duke's Seafood West Seattle
DESCRIPTION: For more than two decades, Duke’s Seafood has had the honor of serving the Alki Beach neighborhood by providing sustainable, delicious food in a cozy and inviting atmosphere. Our menu features a wide variety of incredible signature dishes you won’t find anywhere else. Try our oysters on the half shell paired with your favorite Duketail, or warm up with a bowl of our award-winning clam chowder. Whatever you’re craving, our incredible staff will always go above and beyond to create a fantastic dining experience. Located right on Alki Beach, our deck and streetside patio offer the most gorgeous views of the Puget Sound and Seattle skyline. Whether you’re enjoying the ferry boats zipping across Elliot Bay in the summer or savoring a winter sunset over the Olympics, come experience the view from one of the best West Seattle restaurants.

NAME: Daniel's Broiler - Bellevue
DESCRIPTION: Located on the 21st floor of the Bank of America building in the Bellevue Place complex, guests enjoy stunning views of the Olympic Mountains, downtown Bellevue, and the Seattle skyline from our outdoor decks while enjoying USDA Prime Steaks—the top two percent of all graded beef in the nation—as well as other traditional steakhouse favorites and a selection of high-end spirits from our Prime 21 Spirits Lounge.

NAME: Noi Thai Cuisine
DESCRIPTION: Noi Thai Cuisine continues the traditional of Bai Tong Restaurants in Seattle, Washington which originally began as a favorite stopover for Thai Airways Crew at SeaTac Airport over two decades ago. At Noi Thai Cuisine Downtown Seattle, we pride ourselves on making high-quality food and giving our guests a real authentic Thai taste. We strive to bring our guests the best in Thai cuisine as our food is authentically prepared and beautifully presented. Here you will find your familiar favorites but even more dishes you may not be familiar with yet. Each dish on our menu is prepared to order using the freshest and highest quality ingredients. Most of our dishes are created and modified by one of the best chefs in Thailand. All of our dishes are prepared by our Executive Chef and his Thai culinary team with care to ensure our guests enjoy the best dining experience, so you can trust that every little detail has been taken care of.

NAME: Sushi Kashiba
DESCRIPTION: Chef Shiro Kashiba has delighted Seattle diners with his culinary artistry and craft for over five decades. Located next to the Pike Place Market, Sushi Kashiba offers the highest standard Japanese cuisine that sushi lovers have come to expect from who the Seattle Times calls, the "Sushi Sensei" of Seattle.

NAME: Ivar's Acres of Clams
DESCRIPTION: Upon entering Ivar’s Acres of Clams you will be immersed in the history and lore of Ivar’s and our flounder Ivar Haglund. Original features of the Pier, which opened in 1901, including exposed fir beams and a refurbished Galbraith-Bacon & Co. sign from the original tenant (some say the Seattle Costco of its time) were restored. With a more airy feel and expansive views, diners enjoy views of the Puget Sound, passing Washington State ferries and fireboats from historic Fire Station #3.

NAME: Portage Bay Cafe - South Lake Union
DESCRIPTION: Portage Bay Cafe offers organic, fresh and 100% locally sourced food items from around the Pacific Northwest. We serve breakfast and brunch 7 days a week, as well as lunch 7 days a week. We offer a wide range of catering options as well - private dining, private parties, wedding, box lunches and various other catering options. Four Seattle locations!

NAME: Palisade
DESCRIPTION: Palisade has always had amazing elements. We've created a new range of dishes, updated the atmosphere, and rededicated ourselves to the best service in Seattle. These pieces add up to the best all occasion experience in town.

NAME: The Pike Pub and Brewery
DESCRIPTION: The Pike Pub, features locally-sourced and artisan pub fare paired with Pike Brewing Company's hancrafted beers. The family friendly Pike Pub is located right next door to Seattle's world famous Pike Place Market. Our menu of pub fare classics, such as hand-formed burgers, unique pizzas, fresh salads and Dungeness crab chowder, are all carefully prepared and reflective of Northwest tastes. It's all served amidst Pike Brewing's extensive collection of beer memorabilia and in full view of our brewing kettle where you can watch our brewers at work. At The Pike Pub beers are served in perfect condition, directly from our on-site brewery's bright tanks. The Pike Pub welcomes large parties. Pike Brewing's commitment to local and sustainable ingredients is very evident at The Pike Pub where we feature ingredients from local farmers and food artisans, such as: Penn Cove Clams & Mussels, Uli's at the Market, Hempler's bacon, Gelatiamo, Macrina Bakery and more.

NAME: Stateside
DESCRIPTION: Stateside serves global cuisine inspired by over a decade of living, traveling, exploring and cooking abroad in Europe and Asia.

NAME: Altura Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Each day, we create a tasting menu inspired by the season's ingredients gathered from our garden, farmers, foragers, and the sea. The price of dinner is $157 per person. WE HAVE REOPENED OUR DINING ROOM at limited capacity, Wednesday-Saturday. We are taking utmost caution to ensure a safe and responsible environment. We hope to see you soon!

NAME: Taylor Shellfish Oyster Bar
DESCRIPTION: Taylor Oyster Bar is the perfect place to meet and share world-class shellfish at happy hour or special occasions, as a pre-dinner appetizer or a late-night snack, or whenever you gather with family, friends, and colleagues. As far as we are concerned, any time is a good time to celebrate the oyster!

NAME: John Howie Steak
DESCRIPTION: John Howie Steak - a downtown Bellevue favorite. Located in the Bravern near 405 (freeway) off of 8th Ave. A great happy hour with a near famous cheeseburger, bar and lounge open till 11pm or midnight. Fine dining in the dining room. Lunch is quite reasonable ($12-$15 entreees) and delicious. Premium steakhouse for lunch meetings, dates or of course any occasion for dinner. Private dining rooms available as well. Catering available. A fine dining restaurant with more casual options for lunch, happy hour, the bar and lounge.

NAME: Il Bistro
DESCRIPTION: For 40 years, IL Bistro, in the Heart of the Pike Place Market, has offered visitors Classic Italian Cuisine with the freshest Market Seafood, Meats and Produce. IL Bistro has frequently been voted "Seattle's Most Romantic Dining Room" by readers of various publications. The IL Bistro menu is complimented by an extensive list of Italian, California and Northwest wines. Fans love the "underground and intimate", historic bar which is open every night until 2 and offers an excellent late night menu.

NAME: Duke's Seafood South Lake Union
DESCRIPTION: South Lake Union Restaurant with waterfront views. Join us at Duke's for a tasty, sustainable lunch, happy hour or dinner from the second story of our waterfront restaurant overlooking South Lake Union. Try our oyster bar, a signature Duketail, or any of our sustainable meat and seafood options – all while enjoying sweeping lakefront views of the stunning Seattle landscape. Take in the sights of the Space Needle, the entrance to the Seattle Locks, and a lake teeming with pleasure boats and seaplanes.

NAME: Ivar's Salmon House
DESCRIPTION: Ivar’s Salmon House on north Lake Union in Seattle is a beautiful cedar replica of a Northwest Native American Longhouse, complete with an open-pit Native American-style barbecue for preparing succulent alder-smoked dishes. Here, in a dining setting filled with Northwest native art, décor and historical photographs, you'll enjoy memorable meals surrounded by spectacular views of boats cruising the lake and the city skyline. Favorite daily entrees and fresh-sheet selections include alder-smoked salmon, prawns, alder-smoked chicken, and seasonal seafood specials. The outdoor Fish Bar offers casual lakeside dining or quick take-out food.

NAME: Purple Cafe and Wine Bar
DESCRIPTION: Purple Café and Wine Bar pairs a global wine selection with a menu that combines classic American styles with seasonal Northwest ingredients..

NAME: Sugo Hand Roll Bar
DESCRIPTION: Sugo is Seattle's first dedicated Hand Roll Bar. Our menu highlights sustainable seafood and pairs wonderfully with our selection of unique sake cocktails. Make a reservation or use our digital waitlist for the Hand Roll Bar OR walk in to dine at SHIO, our bar/lounge area with a select Sugo menu available. 21+ after 5pm for the entire restaurant. Takeout Sugo Hand Roll Sets also available.

NAME: Staple and Fancy
DESCRIPTION: Staple & Fancy is simple, Italian-inspired food and offers an innovative multi-course feast of seasonal dishes crafted by our chef. Of course you can expect craft cocktails, a thoughtful wine list spanning both old and new world, as well as the signature friendly service and intimate experience that Staple & Fancy has always been known for. We really recommend that you relax and put your dining experience in our hands. We’ll take care of everything.

NAME: Tulio
DESCRIPTION: Touted by a national magazine as the best Italian restaurant in Seattle, Tulio is a local favorite for delicious Italian food and a warm atmosphere.

NAME: The Crab Pot Seafood Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Crab Pot Seafood Restaurant at Pier 57 in Seattle Washington, home of the World Famous "Alaskan SeaFeast"! As seen on the TV Show "Man vs Food" in The Travel Channel.

NAME: Mecca Cafe
DESCRIPTION: One of Seattle's oldest diners with a legendary dive bar. Stiff drinks and huge portions of homemade diner classics. Open for breakfast, lunch, dinner and late night. Seattle's best happy hour. We're known for our great Philly Cheesesteaks, hamburgers, chicken fried steak, sandwiches, fish & chips and Pot Roast. And we're famous for our small, dimly lit dive bar. We've been serving Queen Anne since 1930. In the shadow of the Space Needle and steps away from Seattle Center and the new Climate Pledge Arena. A great place to eat and drink before and after Kraken games!

NAME: Ostra
DESCRIPTION: Discover Ostra, a contemporary Mediterranean seafood restaurant located at One Charles Street South in Boston's Back Bay. Led by Chef/Owner Jamie Mammano and Executive Chef Mitchell Randall, we draw inspiration from local and European varieties of seafood. Our focus is on specialty seafood from the Mediterranean and regions within the U.S. Experience the natural and fresh flavors of each dish through our light preparations. The dining room at Ostra exudes style and sophistication, creating a comfortable and inviting atmosphere. Enjoy our fine bar and lounge area with live piano entertainment. For private events, our dining room accommodates up to 42 guests for seated events and up to 70 guests for cocktail receptions.

NAME: Mistral
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Mistral, Boston’s acclaimed French restaurant, where Chef/Owner Jamie Mammano delights diners with uncomplicated French Mediterranean cuisine using the season's finest ingredients. Located in the stylish South End, Mistral's dramatic dining room offers an unforgettable culinary experience.

NAME: The Warren Tavern
Atlantic Fish Co
DESCRIPTION: A landmark for Bostons best seafood, Atlantic Fish has been serving New Englands freshest catch since 1978.

NAME: Boston Sail Loft
DESCRIPTION: “The Best Clam Chowder in Boston” - Boston Magazine Located right on the water in Boston’s historic North End, the charmingly rustic Boston Sail Loft has been serving up classic seaside eats to locals and tourists alike since 1984. The family-owned restaurant has become a Boston landmark for its great service, casual waterfront atmosphere, and fresh seafood, and there’s one dish that’s really put it on the map: their New England clam chowder.

NAME: Tresca
DESCRIPTION: Tresca is an authentic Italian restaurant featuring hearty multi-regional cuisine with an exceptional wine cellar, offering a wide selection of the finest vintages. Recently named winner of the 'Wine Spectator' award of excellence. Tresca combines the Italian tradition of hospitality with food that comforts and welcomes its guests. The warm fireplaces and outstanding views of Hanover St. enhance every meal. The service is exceptional and the menu remarkable, a true dining experience.

NAME: Ernesto's Pizza
DESCRIPTION: Order your favorite pizza, pasta, salads, wings and more Ernesto's Pizza located at 69 Salem St in Boston, MA. Ernesto's Pizza is accepting orders online for takeout. To begin your order simply click on any menu. Enjoy!

NAME: The Hourly Oyster House
DESCRIPTION: The Hourly Oyster House is a vibrant and welcoming neighborhood outpost in the heart of Harvard Square, where guests can enjoy thoughtfully sourced and playfully prepared seafood (oysters, especially) from New England and beyond, accompanied by a carefully curated selection of signature cocktails, beer and wine.

NAME: Sorellina
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Sorelina, the 'kid sister' of acclaimed Chef Jamie Mammano's Mistral, where you can indulge in contemporary Italian-Mediterranean cuisine in an upbeat and sophisticated environment. Our staff is dedicated to providing you with a truly memorable dining experience. Experience an intense look at regional Italian food with a modern twist. Our curated wine list features hidden Italian gems and international selections, creating an effortless opportunity to explore the unknown. The warm-modern design, back wall mural, and floor-to-ceiling windows create a visually stunning combination.

NAME: Siam Bistro Thai Cuisine
DESCRIPTION: On the corner of Pearl and Purchase Street, there's a quaint little place to enjoy Thai food anytime. From the moment you enter, the Wiwatyukhan family will be here to greet you with a smile. At Siam Bistro, it's our homemade noodles, curry, and fresh vegetables that keep customers coming back for more. Powered by recipes that've been passed down for generations, the authentic flavors we have to offer are beyond compare. Our expansive menu includes plenty of options to fit anyone's lifestyle or diet, so there's truly a dish for everyone.

NAME: The Salty Pig
DESCRIPTION: Located in Back Bay/ South End

NAME: Highland Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: Highland Kitchen is a family-owned neighborhood restaurant and bar located "up the hill" in the heart of Somerville. HK has been delivering American comfort food, well-crafted cocktails, friendly service and a killer jukebox since 2007.

NAME: Toscano Beacon Hill
DESCRIPTION: Nestled among the antique shops, boutiques and cafes along Beacon Hill's famous Charles Street, Toscano restaurant remains a staple of Boston's oldest neighborhood.

NAME: Barcelona Wine Bar
DESCRIPTION: Barcelona Wine Bar & Restaurant is a warm and welcoming tapas bar inspired by the culture of Spain. The ever-changing menu is focused on clean flavors, seasonal ingredients, specialties from Spain and the Mediterranean, and rustic small plate presentations created by chefs with tremendous talent. Barcelona offers an award-winning selection of wines from Spain and South America-and boasts one of the largest Spanish wine programs in the U.S.

NAME: Deuxave
DESCRIPTION: Co-Owners Brian Piccini & Chef Christopher Coombs are proud of their award winning Restaurant, Deuxave in the Back Bay. The inspiration behind the restaurant's American Nouveau Cuisine is seasonality, with a focus on working with the finest farms and purveyors, sourcing out the freshest, local ingredients and amplifying their magnificence. The cuisine is strongly rooted in the nouvelle techniques of contemporary French cuisine, married with the splendor of American ingredients in a refined, but casual setting. Deuxave's (pronounced doo-ave) name plays homage to its location at the corners of Commonwealth Ave and Massachusetts Ave.

NAME: Parish Cafe & Bar
DESCRIPTION: The Parish Cafe opened in November 1992. Its concept is simple, but fabulous! Owner Gordon Wilcox approached Boston’s famous chefs and asked them each to create a sandwich for the Parish Cafe menu. Each sandwich is named for the chef and the restaurant they are from. Since our menu items are created by other chefs our standards are extremely high, which shows through in our enormous following.

NAME: La Voile
DESCRIPTION: La Voile is an authentic French brasserie, opened in Cannes in 1947. After a few years under a new ownership, it relocated to Boston in 2007.

NAME: Grill 23 & Bar
DESCRIPTION: For more than 37 years, Grill 23 & Bar has been New England's premier steak and seafood grill. Grill 23 & Bar is renowned for its prime, all-natural, dry-aged beef, and fresh, creative seafood presentations. Grill 23's menu showcases signature entrées as well as classic favorites. These creatively composed dishes, each reflecting the best ingredients of the region, offer an addition to our à la carte menu. Grill 23 consistently receives the "Best of Boston" steakhouse award from Boston Magazine and the award-winning wine list has achieved The Wine Spectator's prestigious Grand Award since 2017.

NAME: The Capital Grille
DESCRIPTION: Make it a day to remember. From birthdays and anniversaries to professional milestones, we aim to make every gathering special at The Capital Grille. Open seven days a week, The Capital Grille is best known for our expertly prepared steaks, which are dry aged in house for 18 to 24 days and then hand-cut by our restaurant's on-premise butcher. The Capital Grille's wine list features more than 350 selections, and its floor-to-ceiling wine kiosk regularly houses 3,500 - 5,000 bottles. Reservations are recommended but not required. For more information, please visit our website. We look forward to delighting you.

NAME: Yvonne's
DESCRIPTION: Built around social dining, Yvonne’s is a modern interpretation of the supper club, catering to groups looking for shareable plates in a setting that keeps glasses raised and conversations buzzing. Dishes weave in flavors of the Far & Middle East, Mediterranean, Europe, and America creating a globally-inspired menu, refusing to be defined.

NAME: Bostonia Public House
