DESCRIPTION: Located in the landmark Board of Trade building at the intersection of State and Broad streets; Bostonia Public House celebrates the history and tradition of Boston. The design thoughtfully combines, rustic elements, modern accents and unique finishes that will remind Bostonians of their rich and colorful heritage. Bostonia is a polished and playful venue offering an American menu within a vibrant bar atmosphere. Bostonia Public House is a genuinely alluring gathering spot. Bostonia has two floors offering a range of event possibilities. The upstairs (1880 Room & Board of Trade Room) is the most popular to rent for private events. For cocktail events with up to 180 guests OR 80 seated guests. You can also rent out all of Bostonia (buyout) with a capacity of 420 guests for a cocktail event. Feel free to send us an inquiry via the Bostonia website.

NAME: Toro Boston
DESCRIPTION: Toro, located off of Washington Street in Boston, Massachusetts, is a lively Spanish tapas restaurant and bar, serving brunch, lunch, dinner and a late night eats. The menu features Spanish food and small plates, designed to be served and enjoyed tapas-style. Wine, beer and cocktails are available as well and compliments the food perfectly. Toro is open seven days a week for dinner, serves lunch on the weekdays and features a special brunch on Sunday. Due to our small size we are unable to accommodate dinner reservations and seat all parties on a first-come, first serve basis. We do accept lunch and brunch reservations for parties of any size.

NAME: Cafe Bonjour
DESCRIPTION: Our food is ethically grown, locally sourced, unprocessed/free of artificial preservatives, free of added/refined sugars & organic whenever possible. We use only free-range meat and dairy, wild caught fish, incorporate whole-grains into our dishes & take advantage of nature's seasonal bounty. We source food and product consciously for a sustainable world. We offer gluten-free, vegetarian & plant-based dishes.

NAME: Mooo Beacon Hill
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Mooo Beacon Hill, the epitome of a modern steakhouse, where sophistication meets a relaxed atmosphere in the heart of Boston's Beacon Hill. Our warm and inviting décor sets the perfect backdrop for a memorable dining experience. Indulge in our expertly crafted steaks while enjoying the ambiance of our full bar and award-winning wine list. Whether it's a special occasion or a casual night out, Mooo Beacon Hill offers an unparalleled dining experience.

NAME: The Daily Catch North End
DESCRIPTION: The original location founded in 1973 offers a friendly dining atmosphere. With only twenty seats, you are guranteed fast, effecient service and fresh seafood! This will be an experience to remember. The chalkboard menu features all the classic dishes, in addition to weekly specials! Bring a friend and join the fun!

NAME: Barcelona Wine Bar
DESCRIPTION: Barcelona Wine Bar & Restaurant is a warm and welcoming tapas bar inspired by the culture of Spain. The ever-changing menu is focused on clean flavors, seasonal ingredients, specialties from Spain and the Mediterranean, and rustic small plate presentations created by chefs with tremendous talent. Barcelona offers an award-winning selection of wines from Spain and South America-and boasts one of the largest Spanish wine programs in the U.S.

NAME: Row 34
DESCRIPTION: We’re Row 34. If we could eat oysters and drink beer for every meal period, we probably would. Professionals Only.

NAME: Cantina Italiana
DESCRIPTION: We have been serving generations of families, locals and tourists in the North End since 1931. People crave the taste of our food. Some say their mouths water just thinking about eating here. That’s why when we change even the slightest thing, they let us know it. We’re set in our Ways and Proud of It!

NAME: Abe & Louie's
DESCRIPTION: Abe & Louie's sets the standard for the classic American steakhouse, offering unparalleled flavor combinations and undeniably superior service with an air of timeless sophistication.

NAME: Ocean Prime
DESCRIPTION: Nationally acclaimed, modern American restaurant and lounge known for its stunning settings, impressive menu of seafood and steak, and private dining options.

NAME: The Q
DESCRIPTION: Take a culinary tour through Asia at The Q. This restaurant serves a mix of classic Chinese, Japanese and Mongolian hotpot in upscale, hip surrounds that include a cozy lounge. Sift through a vast menu packed with hot pot specials, sushi and savory entrees. A popular neighborhood destination, The Q is a nice pick if you're in the mood for some pan-Asian cuisine. The restaurant's spacious interior plays well to small- and medium-sized groups.

NAME: Veggie Galaxy
DESCRIPTION: Veggie Galaxy is located in the diverse & creative neighborhood of Central Square, Cambridge, MA. We're a vegetarian diner and serve breakfast all day. Everything can be made vegan! We have a big menu of diner standards and run weekly specials just to keep things fun around here. We’re in business to provide friendly old-time diner hospitality to all of our guests. We want to be the best part of your day!

NAME: Turner's Seafood Grill & Mrkt
DESCRIPTION: Open Tues- Fri Dining 4pm, Sat-Sun Dining Noon, FISH MKT 10 am With our own processing plant in Gloucester, MA, no one gets the best freshest New England seafood from the dock to your plate faster. A truly special and authentic New England seafood experience at our flagship location. With our interactive menu, you can self-order or work in conjunction with your server, to dine and pay at your convenience.

NAME: OAK Long Bar + Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to OAK Long Bar + Kitchen, a stunning American brasserie style restaurant located in the heart of Back Bay in Boston. OAK is a bold, inspired dining concept, bringing you hand crafted, specialty cocktails and a farm-to-table menu featuring locally sourced ingredients.

NAME: Emmets Irish Pub & Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Emmet's Irish Pub and Restaurant located at 6 Beacon Street Boston is one of the most authentic Irish Pubs in Boston, serving authentic Irish food along with Guinness and a large and diverse beer and wine list to choose from to compliment your meal.

NAME: Bistro du Midi
DESCRIPTION: With two floors overlooking the Boston Public Gardens, Bistro du Midi is one of the most beloved destinations in the Back Bay of Boston. Offering seasonal al fresco dining and a carefully curated wine list to pair with Executive Chef/Partner Robert Sisca's French cuisine inspired by coastal New England influences.

NAME: Prezza
DESCRIPTION: Prezza has created a menu that is bound to satisfy all your Italian cravings. We are a cut above all the other competitors in the neighborhood. Servicing the Boston, MA Areas.

NAME: Alden & Harlow
DESCRIPTION: Located at 40 Brattle Street, Alden & Harlow serves thoughtfully sourced, honest American food in a subterranean, modern and comfortable space. Inspired by the gathering of family and friends at his home kitchen table, Chef Michael Scelfo prepares bold and flavor-forward food that honors tradition of place in its quality. It is how he connects with anyone who joins him at his table - and we hope it is why you will join us at ours!

NAME: Fiorella's Cucina
DESCRIPTION: Italian-inspired cuisine, prepared with fresh, locally sourced ingredients, and served with hospitality from the heart.

NAME: Davio's Northern Italian Steakhouse - Back Bay
DESCRIPTION: Boston's only Northern Italian Steakhouse, Davio's offers the finest Italian cuisine featuring the finest seafood & a full range of the best meats available. The perfect stage for Davio’s signature Northern Italian steaks, veal chops and handmade pasta creations. Boston, MA is where Davio’s was born. And, in essence, re-born. Once on Newbury Street, in Brookline and in Cambridge, Davio’s now resides in the Back Bay in Park Square and serves as an elegant oasis from the hustle and bustle just outside our doors. Stop in and have a drink after work in our welcoming lounge or bar area. The white table cloths of our spacious, relaxed dining room serve as the perfect stage for Davio’s signature Northern Italian steaks, veal chops and handmade pasta creations. Additional theatrical flair is provided by our lively, open kitchen layout. Attention to detail and attentiveness to your needs is evident in everything we do. At Davio's, it's all about the guest.

NAME: Yard House
DESCRIPTION: Yard House is the modern American gathering place where beer and food lovers unite. Known for great food, classic rock, an energetic vibe and endless fleet of tap handles featuring the best craft and local beers, each Yard House location offers 100+ beers on tap along with an array of craft cocktails. Our menu features favorites such as our signature Poke Nachos, street tacos, USDA prime burgers, seafood and steaks. Founded in Long Beach, Calif., in 1996, Yard House now spans across the U.S. with over 80 locations and is open daily for lunch, dinner, happy hour and late-night dining.

NAME: South Street Diner
DESCRIPTION: South Street Diner, Boston's ONLY 24-hour full service restaurant. Located in Boston’s Leather District, the Diner is currently owned and operated by local restaurateur, Sol Sidell. The Diner has become a local landmark, a constant in Boston's late night or after-hours scene and a final evening destination for local residents, students and visitors. The Diner is the place to grab something to eat, hang out with friends, celebrity watch, and keep the party going. No visit to Boston is complete without a stop at South Street Diner. The Diner was named Best of Boston by Boston Magazine, as well as named for The Best Late Night Food in the U.S.A. by Esquire. Thrillist Media Group named South Street Diner one of the best 24-Hour Diners in the country. Most recently, the Diner’s famous Boston Cream Pancakes were featured on the Food Network’s “Top 5 Restaurants - Best Late Night Eats.”

NAME: Cafe Luna
DESCRIPTION: Casual, full service restaurant /cafe serving breakfast lunch and dinner with a popular weekend brunch. Modern decor with outdoor seating. Specialties include salads, sandwiches, flatbread pizzas, chicken burgers, vegetarian and vegan options. Take out and delivery available.

NAME: Lucia Ristorante
DESCRIPTION: Located at the heart of Hanover Street, Lucia Ristorante is an institution in Boston's North End. Opened in 1977, Lucia was the first restaurant to bring authentic Italian cuisine to Boston's oldest neighborhood. We continue to combine traditional Italian favorites with innovative new dishes in our distinctive atmosphere. Ample summertime patio seating is available in the newly bricked courtyard of our neighbor, St. Stephen's Church.

NAME: Euno
DESCRIPTION: Nestled in the heart of Boston's historic North End, Euno is a hidden gem serving only the finest in Italian and Mediterranean cuisine and wines. From exquisite Sea Bass to Osso Bucco to tender Pollo Parmigian our culinary artists will create a delightful dish to satisfy each and every palate. And if it's a taste of Americana you desire, please enjoy our classic Filet Mignon or world famous Boston Lobster (served in-season only). Voted Most Romantic and highly recommended by celebrity chef Rachael Ray, we are open nightly for dinner at 5pm. Buon Appetito. Enjoy!

NAME: Ruka Restobar
DESCRIPTION: Peruvian-Japanese-Chinese food in a sexy dining room that mixes cultural motifs to dramatic effect

NAME: Antico Forno
DESCRIPTION: Restaurants Around the World: 9. Antico Forno Boston, MA Antico Forno is billed as “The Most Authentic Italian Restaurant,” and we’re hard pressed to argue. This mainstay in Boston’s North End manages a cozy mom-and-pop atmosphere with world-class traditional cuisine. Entrees like Saltimbocca di Pollo and Linguine al Frutti di Mare hearken back to the old country, but Antico Forno is best known for its brick-oven pizzas piled high with house-made Italian sausages and mozzarella. 10BEST Says (#8 Boston Family Friendly) Best Value: Traditional Italian baked in a brick oven sets this Italian restaurant apart. Serving a selection of pastas, entrees and pizzas all cooked to perfection in their famous brick oven at reasonable prices, Antico Forno is a good value. Kid friendly (although lacking a children’s menu), Antico Forno serves even the littlest one sin style. Serving some of the best pies around, Antico Forno carries a large selection of toppings as well.

NAME: Tasty Burger
DESCRIPTION: With five locations in the Boston area, Tasty Burger is a modern American neighborhood burger restaurant. Outstanding fresh ingredients are cooked to order in an incredibly fun, laid back atmosphere that has made ‘Tasty’ an instant classic. Our burgers come from grass-fed steer raised on family farms; are served alongside shakes, rings, fries, beer & wine; and surrounded by local artists’ work, free pool & foosball, and a digital jukebox with great music. Tasty Burger is the Official Burger of the Boston Calling Music Festival.

NAME: Summer Shack
DESCRIPTION: Very good food for a quick lunch

NAME: Zaftigs Delicatessen
DESCRIPTION: Zaftigs Jewish - Style Delicatessen Serving breakfast (all day), lunch, and dinner ! Come check us out today!

NAME: The Blue Ox
DESCRIPTION: The Blue Ox provides upscale casual American dining to the Lynn, MA area.

NAME: Ruth's Chris Steak House
DESCRIPTION: Ruth's Chris Steak House specializes in serving USDA Prime steaks, each seared to perfection, finished with butter and freshly chopped parsley, and served sizzling on a 500-degree plate. We invite you to join us in Boston, MA!

NAME: Legal Sea Foods - Logan Airport Terminal B
DESCRIPTION: Boston is known for its seafood and whether traveling to or from the city, you ought to eat as the natives do. Located post-security, our restaurant is the perfect place to dine or take off with take-out. *Hours of operation may vary with airport operations and flight schedules
GENERAL_LOCATION: 1 Harborside Drive, Boston Logan International Airport, Terminal B, 02128-2907

NAME: Salt Traders Coastal Cooking Zilker
DESCRIPTION: Salt Traders Coastal Cooking is the surfside home for the team behind Jack Allen’s Kitchen, and we offer the best of land & sea we can dream up. The ambiance, the food, and the drinks are all inspired by our coastal travels — bits of nostalgia spent with family & friends that we thought are too good not to share.

NAME: Plank Seafood & Provisions
DESCRIPTION: Plank is a coastally-inspired oyster bar and seafood grill located in the heart of the Old Market in Omaha, Nebraska, at The Domain in Austin, Texas, and coming soon to The Shops at Clearfork in Fort Worth, Texas. Thoughtful service, notable flavors, and social moments found here.

NAME: Uchiko Austin
DESCRIPTION: Originated from the famed Uchi restaurant in Austin founded by James Beard Award-winning Chef Tyson Cole, Uchiko specializes in upscale sushi, cool tastings, omakase, and small plates in a farmhouse-chic space.

NAME: Truluck's Ocean's Finest Seafood & Crab - Austin Downtown
DESCRIPTION: At the corner of 3rd St. and Colorado (one block down the street from our previous location). Pioneers of Austin’s fine-dining scene since 2000, Truluck’s is raising the stakes once again with a totally reimagined, two-level space, featuring a second-story wraparound patio with panoramic skyline views. Expect to be dazzled by what’s new, and made to feel right at home by the same familiar, friendly faces. Your table is waiting.

NAME: Red Ash
DESCRIPTION: Influenced by the culinary traditions of Northern and Southern Italy, Red Ash features craft Italian cuisine expertly prepared by Owner and Executive Chef John Carver. The star of the Red Ash kitchen is the custom-built wood-burning grill, oven and plancha. Chef Carver's menu features fresh handmade pastas, pristine seafood, locally sourced prime meats roasted on the wood-burning grill and plancha. Join us for Happy Hour 4:30pm to 6:30pm $2 Off all Cocktails, Beer & Wines by the Glass Enjoy all Appetizers, Salads & Small Pastas for $7

NAME: Eddie V's Prime Seafood
DESCRIPTION: Eddie V's Prime Seafood is a luxury dining destination known for the seafood flown in from pristine waters around the world, as well as its premium hand-carved steaks. Dishes are artistically prepared and feature an ever-changing array of seasonal seafood, along with critically acclaimed prime center-cut steaks broiled to perfection. The restaurant's award-wining wine list, which has been recognized by Wine Spectator, has more than 300 wines curated by Eddie V's very own Advanced Sommelier. In the V Lounge, guests can sip classic and creative cocktails, and enjoy signature appetizers against a backdrop of live music trios.

NAME: Eddie V's Prime Seafood
DESCRIPTION: Eddie V's Prime Seafood is a luxury dining destination known for the seafood flown in from pristine waters around the world, as well as its premium hand-carved steaks. Dishes are artistically prepared and feature an ever-changing array of seasonal seafood, along with critically acclaimed prime center-cut steaks broiled to perfection. The restaurant's award-wining wine list, which has been recognized by Wine Spectator, has more than 300 wines curated by Eddie V's very own Advanced Sommelier. In the V Lounge, guests can sip classic creative cocktails and enjoy signature appetizers.

NAME: Banger's Sausage House and Beer Garden
Acre 41
DESCRIPTION: Acre 41 is an upscale steakhouse with the highest standards of food, service, and experience. Top-rated on TripAdvisor and conveniently located in the west campus district in central Austin, Texas. Serving breakfast, brunch, lunch and dinner, Acre 41 has everything you need for an unforgettable meal. Enjoy U.S.D.A. prime steaks, comfort classics like iron skillet cornbread, and an extensive wine and whiskey selection Not only does Acre 41 use locally sourced ingredients, but we go the “extra acre” to provide guests with impeccable service.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 1901 San Antonio St, The Otis Hotel Austin, Autograph Collection, 78705

NAME: Jack Allen's Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: Local in source, Texan in spirit, not only in the kitchen, but in the community, is what Jack Allen's Kitchen is all about. Since 2009, our restaurant has been bringing Southern-inspired flavors infused with the spice of Southwestern cuisine to the Austin area. Chef and owner Jack Allen Gilmore's dedication to local farmers and purveyors yields us the best from each season.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 3600 N Capital of Texas Hwy Bldg D, 78746-3314

NAME: Cypress Grill
DESCRIPTION: Louisiana-style cafe with Bayou classics & cocktails, plus daily specials
GENERAL_LOCATION: 4404 W William Cannon Dr, Suite L, 78749-1401

NAME: Diner Bar
DESCRIPTION: The duo behind The Grey in Savannah, GA, Mashama Bailey and Johno Morisano, bring their Port City Southern fare and service to the downtown Austin community. Stop in for a craft cocktail, glass of wine or reserve a seat in the beautiful dining room that is referential to the iconic bus terminal that houses their original restaurant in Savannah.

NAME: Corner Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Discover the heart of Texas with our modern twists on local favorites, all while enjoying the best margaritas in town, including our famous Corner Marg at Corner Restaurant. Nestled on one of Congress Avenue's most visited corners, Corner offers the flavors of Texas and the perfect location in Austin, Texas for happy hour or a boozy brunch.

NAME: Perry's Steakhouse & Grille- Downtown Austin
DESCRIPTION: Perry's Steakhouse & Grille creates an experience that is casually elegant, while staying grounded to its roots as a meat market by serving only the choicest cuts of hand-selected, USDA-aged Prime beef, cut fresh daily. Perry's also offers a Social Hour with specially priced appetizers, wine and martinis, piano bar featuring live entertainment and an array of private dining rooms for every occasion. From its modern interior with a towering wine wall to succulent signature dishes cooked to perfection, Perry's family has redefined dining with an experience that's truly Rare and Well Done.

NAME: Terry Black's Barbecue
DESCRIPTION: Spacious, casual stop for pit-smoked meats & housemade sides from famous 4th-generation pitmasters.

NAME: Chuy's
DESCRIPTION: An authentic Tex-Mex restaurant known for made from scratch "big as yo' face" burritos, fresh-squeezed lime juice margaritas and a fun, eclectic atmosphere.

NAME: Otopia Rooftop Lounge
DESCRIPTION: Savor sunset views and craft cocktails from Austin Campus District's only rooftop lounge and pool. One of the best rooftop bars in Austin, Texas, Otopia offers a full menu of signature cocktails and light bites.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 1901 San Antonio St., Unit 1100, The Otis Hotel Austin, Autograph Collection, 78705

NAME: Stella San Jac
DESCRIPTION: Lovingly crafted recipes, a fresh take on Southern favorites, and a lively ambience to boot make Stella San Jac a go-to spot for flavor-forward dishes, expertly hand-crafted drinks, and downright good vibes. Join us for one of the best happy hours in downtown Austin or weekend brunch.

NAME: Uchi Austin
DESCRIPTION: Uchi, "house" in Japanese, is founded by James Beard Award-winning Chef Tyson Cole. A delicate balance of elevated food and impeccable service, Uchi offers non-traditional Japanese cuisine with signature tastings, sushi, and seasonal omakase.

NAME: Pappadeaux Seafood Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: Convivial chain dishing up hearty portions of New Orleans-style seafood, steaks, salads & more.

NAME: Fonda San Miguel
DESCRIPTION: Fonda San Miguel is recognized as one of the finest interior Mexican restaurants in the country, having garnered national and international attention for more than 35 years. Chef Miguel Ravago’s menu of classic regional Mexican cuisine prepared with authentic recipes and ingredients has made the menu offerings and the Sunday Hacienda Brunch Buffet legendary. Considered by many as “Austin’s most beautiful restaurant,” owner Tom Gilliland’s collection of museum-quality artwork, exotic plants, and international décor complete the exquisite dining experience. The restaurant pioneered “interior Mexican” cuisine in the U.S. being one of the first in the nation to introduce the full-flavored and more complex specialties from Mexico’s interior regions. Fonda San Miguel is a celebration of this distinctive cuisine, its colorful history, and the transforming influence it has had on Mexican restaurants across the country.

NAME: Azul Rooftop
DESCRIPTION: Azul Rooftop is the tallest rooftop bar & lounge in Austin featuring incredible views of Lady Bird Lake and the Texas Hill Country. Enjoy a vibrant daytime pool scene or sunset vibes in the evening with handcrafted cocktails, frozen and great local beer list in Austin, Texas.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 310 E. 5th Street, The Westin Austin Downtown, 78701

NAME: Moonshine Patio Bar & Grill
DESCRIPTION: In one of the oldest buildings in Austin, Moonshine Patio Bar & Grill has been serving up some of the best Southern comfort food in Central Texas since 2003. Over the years, we’ve developed quite a reputation for our bountiful Sunday Brunch and our attentive, hospitable staff -- and that’s the service you’ll get no matter what time of the day you come in. Our Southern-inspired dishes take an innovative approach to the classics, like our Corn Dog Shrimp and our award-winning chicken fried steak with chipotle cream gravy. So stop on in for some local, made-from-scratch food, and let us tell you our story in person. From Bourbon to Brunch - there's something for everyone!

NAME: Clay Pit
DESCRIPTION: Clay Pit is a nationally - acclaimed, high-energy, contemporary Indian restaurant located in the historical "Bertram building" in beautiful downtown Austin. We are a locally owned business proud to fill the niche for great Indian food in a sophisticated, casually elegant setting.

NAME: 24 Diner
DESCRIPTION: 24 Diner is a 24-hour urban restaurant offering chef-driven comfort food, local and organic fare, a full bar and a killer beer/wine list at affordable prices. The concept has been named one of the best diners in the United States by Bon Appétit and Food & Wine, featured multiple times on Food Network and showcased in publications such as Texas Monthly, USA Today, Saveur, Mother Jones, Zagat, Thrillist, Guardian UK and more.

NAME: Verbena
DESCRIPTION: Verbena is a restaurant and bar located in the heart of W 6th Street occupying the street side ground level of the Canopy by Hilton hotel. The venue is comprised of a 36 seat bar and lounge, a 60 seat dining room with open kitchen, and wood-burning hearth, both which open to a lush open air courtyard. Brought to you by Chef Nic Yanes, owner and executive chef of Juniper and Uncle Nicky's, Verbena delivers a menu reminiscent of old-world farm to table fare that is artfully composed in a modern presentation to delight our guests. Whether plant or protein, our menu celebrates these ingredients with perfectly balanced seasoning and light sauces to enhance natural flavors. What grows together goes together, explains Chef Nic. Come grab a coffee and freshly baked pastry on your way to work, or spend a Sunday morning over a bountiful brunch. Meet a friend for a vibrant patio lunch or gather with co-workers for drinks and dinner. You're always welcome here.

NAME: Rudy's BBQ
DESCRIPTION: Rudy's "Country Store" and Bar-B-Q serves Real Texas Bar-B-Q seven days a week. They offer breakfast, lunch, dinner and group meals.

NAME: Wink Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Established in 2001 by Austin Natives Stewart Scruggs and Mark Paul, Wink is Austin's original farm to table restaurant. Chef Driven Menus change daily, featuring the best seasonal products from Austin's local farms and ranches , as well as carefully cultivated items from around the world. The Dining Room features 5 and 7 Course Tasting Menus as well as an A La Carte menu that evolves daily. The Wine Bar pours over 50 wines by the glass from around the globe, with a casual West Austin neighborhood atmosphere. Happy Hour in the Wine Bar is 5-7 PM daily with a half-priced bar food menu, featuring sharable plates, grass-fed burgers, and the famous Truffle Mac-N-Cheese.

NAME: Roaring Fork
DESCRIPTION: The Roaring Fork captures the spirit of bold American cuisine matched with a contemporary Western ambiance and unmatched service, creating upscale flavors that crackle with a rugged edge. Select from lamb, chicken, beef, pork and fresh fish entrees all perfectly prepared by wood fire rotisserie, open flame grill or wood oven roasting.

NAME: Black's Barbecue Austin
DESCRIPTION: Located just outside of the UT campus in Austin's lively neighborhood known as The Drag, lies The Original Black's BBQ Austin. Our legendary Texas-style BBQ is cooked fresh on the old Lockhart pits and hand-delivered to the Austin location hot and fresh every day.

NAME: Juan in a Million
DESCRIPTION: In the summer of 1980, two school teachers opened a restaurant in East Austin on a mission to revolutionize breakfast. Nearly 40 years later, Juan in a Million’s authentic Mexican cuisine has become famous both in Austin and around the world. Some say our legendary Don Juan taco, a heaping plate of bacon, potatoes, eggs, and cheese served on a warm tortilla, could even feed a family of four. This monster of a taco was even featured on Travel Channel’s Man vs. Food. Since we first opened, our restaurant has felt like an extension of our guests’ homes, and they count on a handshake and a big smile every time. So come on down and start your day off right -- we’ve got some fresh tacos and friendly greeting waiting for you.

NAME: Lonesome Dove Western Bistro
DESCRIPTION: 15 years after the birth of the Lonesome Dove, chef Tim Love opened his second flagship, Lonesome Dove Austin, located downtown on Colorado Street! Chef Love has designed a menu influenced by the ingredients, traditions, and cultures that have been part of the West since the first adventure began on the Goodnight-Loving and Chisholm Trails—with an added level of modern sophistication. Lonesome Dove Austin features both classic and new tastes, with Austin-inspired dishes that showcase Love’s creative use of bold flavors, wild game, and signature wood-fired cooking techniques alongside a diverse wine program. The menu is divided into several sections, beginning with Love’s proprietary Wild Game Fettine. It features a selection of choice cuts spit-roasted over open mesquite fire, such as DUCK, RABBIT-RATTLESNAKE SAUSAGE, PISTACHIOS, and QUINCE; ELK, PORK SPINALIS, HUCKLEBERRIES, and BLACK GARLIC; and LAMB, QUAIL, TEXAS HERBS, and CITRUS-CHILI PASTE.

NAME: Easy Tiger
DESCRIPTION: Located in Austin, Texas, Easy Tiger features artisan bread, cured meats, full bar, and craft beers. Easy Tiger’s in-house bakery offers a selection of Old World hearth breads, European-style pastries, and signature soft pretzels— all baked fresh daily.

NAME: Fogo de Chão Brazilian Steakhouse
DESCRIPTION:
RECENTLY RELOCATED 

Fogo de Chão is an internationally-renowned steakhouse from Brazil that allows guests to discover what's next at every turn. Founded in Southern Brazil in 1979, Fogo elevates the centuries-old culinary art of churrasco - roasting high-quality cuts of meat over an open flame - into a cultural dining experience of discovery.  Please join us in our dining room, in our more casual Bar Fogo, or bring the Fogo Experience to you with Fogo To-Go or Catering. Visit our website to make a reservation or place an order.

NAME: la Barbecue
DESCRIPTION: la Barbecue was established in 2012 by LeAnn Mueller. Formerly a food truck we now have a home and share a building with the Quickie Pickie on E. Cesar Chavez. Drinks, beer and wind by Quickie Pickie and BBQ by la Barbecue.

NAME: Eureka!
DESCRIPTION: Eureka! features an elevated collection of all-American fare paired with local craft beers, small-batch whiskeys, and cocktails making it the perfect place for for the Austin community to dine, drink and socialize.

NAME: Sawyer and Co
DESCRIPTION: Sawyer and Co. is a more refiner diner on the east side of Austin, Texas. We have a full craft cocktail bar, dinner menu as well as a breakfast and brunch menu with daily specials! Check out our Midcentury Modern decor and Spartan Trailer Tiki bar on the patio. Great for outdoor dining and anytime you'd like comfort good with a side of Texas hospitality.

NAME: La Condesa
DESCRIPTION: La Condesa is an award-winning modern Mexican restaurant located in Austin’s vibrant 2nd Street District. Helmed by Executive Chef Rick Lopez, La Condesa’s menu features contemporary Mexican dishes made with fresh, locally sourced ingredients, plus a renowned bar program with one of the largest collections of 100% blue agave tequila and mezcal in the city.

NAME: True Food Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: Relaxed, eco-chic chain serving health-conscious fare, including vegan options, plus cocktails.

NAME: The Capital Grille
DESCRIPTION: Make it a day to remember. From birthdays and anniversaries to professional milestones, we aim to make every gathering special at The Capital Grille. Open seven days a week, The Capital Grille is best known for our expertly prepared steaks, which are dry aged in house for 18 to 24 days and then hand-cut by our restaurant's on-premise butcher. The Capital Grille's wine list features more than 350 selections, and its floor-to-ceiling wine kiosk regularly houses 3,500 - 5,000 bottles. Reservations are recommended but not required. For more information, please visit our website. We look forward to delighting you.

NAME: Steiner Ranch Steakhouse
DESCRIPTION: Steiner Ranch Steakhouse is a 14,000 sq ft restaurant built on a mountain over looking Lake Travis. We have three levels, four bars, and three outdoor dining areas with breath taking views. All steaks are hand selected Prime beef cuts, seasoned, broiled to order and topped with our house butter blend with caramlized shallots and chives. It is the perfect destination any night of the week.

NAME: Revue
DESCRIPTION: Dining hall with four globally inspired open kitchens including Italian, Asian, pastries, and raw bar.

NAME: Austin Taco Project
DESCRIPTION: Located in the heart of downtown, Austin Taco Project - a 2023 recipient of the OpenTable Diners' Choice award - is a vibrant playground for your senses. Open for breakfast, lunch and dinner, this energetic hot spot serves up a novel take on fusion tacos, custom craft cocktails and interactive gaming and dining experiences to keep Austin weird in the best possible way.

NAME: Gloria's Latin Cuisine
DESCRIPTION: Gloria's® Latin Cuisine is an authentic Salvadoran and Tex-Mex restaurant with 23 locations throughout Dallas-Fort Worth, Austin, Houston and San Antonio. Gloria's was conceived by Gloria and Jose Fuentes and born out of the traditions of El Salvador. Inspired Latin additions and award-winning margaritas have provided diversity, skirting the line between tradition and innovation for more than 38 years.

NAME: Lucky Robot
DESCRIPTION: Lucky Robot is the first sustainable sushi restaurant in Texas. We have been recognized by the James Beard Foundation's Smart Catch Program as leaders in the movement to protect the future of our oceans.We source our poultry, beef and pork from local farms and cooperatives using sustainable and regenerative ranching practices. The farms we work with hold their partners and ranchers to the highest environmental, sustainability and ranching practices.

NAME: Bob's Steak & Chop House - Austin Downtown
DESCRIPTION: Texas-born chain serving big slabs of beef, seafood & a large wine list in a classy atmosphere.

NAME: Guero's Taco Bar
DESCRIPTION: Enjoy our handmade corn tortillas, specialty dishes and fresh salsa bar. Our caldo de pollo and tacos al pastor are just a few of our tried-and-true favorites. Start off with a hand-shaken margarita in our cantina, or enjoy an icy cold cerveza while listening to music in our Oak Garden. Enjoy our delicious breakfast on Saturday and Sunday mornings. We would love to cater your next event! Guero's catering ensures that any of your affairs will be memorable occasions. Client consideration, great food and service are our priorities.

NAME: Chez Zee American Bistro
DESCRIPTION: Chez Zee combines a Parisian-style bakery with a casual American-style bistro and offers guests award winning dessert selections. We describe our menu as "American fare with an Austin flair". We have an ever-expanding lunch, dinner, and brunch menu, a full bar, as well as a private banquet party room to celebrate special occasions. All desserts are made on-site in our award winning bakery and all entrees are made to order with the best and local ingredients around. Come celebrate! with us. We're saving a chair for you!

NAME: III Forks
DESCRIPTION: III Forks is an award-winning steakhouse, located on Lavaca Street at Cesar Chavez, in downtown Austin. Considered the Crown Jewel of American Dining, III Forks serves USDA Prime steaks, fresh fish and cold-water lobster. The steakhouse, finished in mahogany and marble, is designed to accommodate private parties of up to 60 guests. With four private rooms, a piano bar, and over 500 different wines, III Forks is sure to provide the best food and service in town. Open daily at 5:00 PM. Bar is open daily at 4:00 PM.

NAME: Garrison
DESCRIPTION: A modern American live fire grill with an extensive wine selection.

NAME: Kerbey Lane Cafe - Central
DESCRIPTION: Kerbey Lane Cafe first opened our doors on May 5, 1980, serving made-from scratch comfort food out of a small house on Kerbey Lane. Today, Kerbey Lane Cafe remains 100% family-owned and we continue to stay true to our original values. We have 8 locations across Austin, many of which are 24-hours. Known for amazing queso and fluffy pancakes, Kerbey Lane Cafe is a place where everyone feels welcome.

NAME: Swift's Attic
DESCRIPTION: Food you’ve had, like you’ve never had before. Familiarly strange, strangely familiar. Nestled upstairs off of one of the busiest streets in Austin, the lure of our funky twist on classics pulls patrons into our hidden attic for a journey into an eccentric and eclectic culinary world serving modern, whimsical shared plates.

NAME: Peche
DESCRIPTION: Fine Dining and cocktail lounge

NAME: Caroline
DESCRIPTION: Caroline is a heart-of-Austin hot spot for breakfast, lunch, dinner and house-made goodness located on popular Congress Avenue. Our trio of open and airy spaces buzz with the aroma of fresh-brewed coffee, craft cocktails, and all-round delicious fare served throughout the day and well into the night in Austin, Texas.

NAME: 1886 Cafe & Bakery
DESCRIPTION: In the citizen-owned era, The Heritage Society founded the 1886 Lunchroom, successfully operated and staffed for over 20 years by members. Stocked with recipes from the hotel's past (including a stint by Neiman Marcus culinary director and "duchess of Texas cuisine" Helen Corbitt), and their own family histories, the ladies of the Heritage Society operated a venue that to this day is known as "Austin's socializing parlor." Paying homage to the city and Heritage Society's roles, the 1886 Café & Bakery opened on July 4, 2002. Today, located on 6th Street in downtown Austin, the 1886 Café & Bakery remains a respected establishment and favorite bakery for many. The quaint Victorian-style café serves up delicious traditional Texas comfort foods that combine time-honored original recipes with contemporary preparation. Dine on dishes such as Helen Corbitt's Cheese Soup, our famous Texas Shaped Pecan Waffle and Quiche Lorraine, or a bonafide Texas classic, Fried Chicken Sandwich.

NAME: Salty Sow
DESCRIPTION: Salty Sow comes out of the gate offering exotic and staple cuts — all under $16 — in one of the best spaces in Austin

NAME: Iron Cactus Mexican Restaurant and Margarita Bar
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1996 on historic Sixth Street the Iron Cactus Mexican Restaurant, Grill and Margarita Bar has been serving contemporary Mexican food for over 20 years. We draw our inspiration for our cuisine from various regions in Mexico. The Iron Cactus can be found in 3 locations across Texas. Named one of the top 10 tequila bars in the country, we feature over 100 different types of tequila. With a deep passion for creating bold, unique and flavorful mexican dishes the Iron Cactus stands apart as a premier Mexican restaurant and drinking destination.

NAME: Vince Young Steakhouse
DESCRIPTION: Located in the heart of Austin, Vince Young Steakhouse epitomizes the fusion of sophistication with the warm spirit of Texas hospitality. As a locally-owned establishment, it stands as a testament to the city's vibrant culinary passion and heritage. Every visit unveils a journey where prime steaks, meticulously aged to perfection, become the main attraction. Yet, it's not just about steaks. With a curated collection of rare bourbons and an extensive, handpicked wine list, connoisseurs are in for a treat. The ambiance strikes the right balance between elegance and comfort, making it perfect for intimate dinners, celebratory occasions, or business engagements. Dive into the Vince Young experience and savor the distinct flavors that make it Austin's premier steakhouse destination.

NAME: Lamberts Downtown Barbecue
DESCRIPTION: Lamberts Downtown Barbecue, located in the 2nd Street District of downtown Austin, features modern Texas classics in a hiply restored historic building.  With an emphasis on fresh local ingredients and all natural meats, produce, and seafood, Lamberts has invented "Fancy Barbecue."  The beautifully restored Schneider Store, located on the corner of Guadalupe and 2nd streets, features an open kitchen and dining room on the first floor, with outdoor patio seating available.  The upstairs bar and lounge features premium live music most nights and can accommodate large parties for private events. Since opening in 2006, Lamberts has been featured in Food & Wine, The New York Times, Conde Naste Traveler, and voted the 4th best new restaurant in Texas by Texas Monthly.

NAME: Truluck's Ocean's Finest Seafood & Crab - Austin Arboretum
DESCRIPTION: Dining at Truluck’s is a celebration for the senses. Captivating ambience and genuine Southern Hospitality–we believe small touches inspire lasting memories. Delight in dining again. Your table is waiting.

NAME: Elizabeth Street Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Elizabeth Street Café is a neighborhood Vietnamese café and French bakery in South Austin. The restaurant boasts sunny dining rooms, a shady garden patio, and serves fresh breakfast, brunch, lunch, dinner as well as takeout. Known for our great croissants, bánh mì served on fresh baked baguettes, spring rolls, steaming bowls of pho, spicy curries, house cocktails & boozy punches, and tropical-flavored macarons. The adjacent Croissant Room is available for private events.

NAME: North Italia
DESCRIPTION: At North Italia, we’re passionate about more than just our crave-worthy Italian food menu. We put our all into every detail, creating an environment that lets you know you’re in for something special. Every day there is a new delicious favorite made from scratch, like our Chef’s daily pizzas, waiting to be discovered and devoured. A tempting assortment of wines, beer, and house-made cocktails give you endless ways to treat yourself. From the moment you walk through our doors, to your last scoops of budino at the end of a satisfying meal, you’ll know you’re in good hands.

NAME: Culinary Dropout
DESCRIPTION: At Culinary Dropout, raise your glass to friends coming together in Austin. A place where food and music are life. Join us at happy hour for ice cold beer and our famous soft pretzels with provolone fondue. At dinner, a signature cocktail and slow braised 36-hour pork ribs are a perfect pair. While you and your crew enjoy damn good food & drinks, a local band plays live for great vibes. Come hang out and stay a while.

NAME: Snooze, an A.M. Eatery
DESCRIPTION: Most breakfast & brunch restaurants start with the same script: eggs, batter, coffee & a big ol' griddle. We've found scripts are a lot like pancakes, they're best when flipped, so we're always looking to turn the best breakfast classics upside-down & on their side. Stop by for delicious pancakes, french toast, benedicts, breakfast burritos, oatmeal, breakfast sandwiches, bacon & more! From paleo to vegetarian & vegan or dairy free & gluten free friendly, we'll happily accommodate food allergies & diets. We want each morning to feel like your weekend & happy hour rolled into one, so our restaurants feature a full bar with alcoholic beverages. From mimosas to bloody marys, margaritas & local craft beers, we've got cocktails & brews covered!

NAME: Fleming's Prime Steakhouse & Wine Bar
DESCRIPTION: Your Austin/The Domain Fleming's is located in the heart of the northwest high-tech corridor on Century Oaks Terrace, near the historic IBM campus. Fleming's in Austin is an outstanding choice to enjoy an exceptional Prime steak, glass of wine or handcrafted cocktail. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion, hosting a business dinner or simply wanting to enjoy a night out - we will create a safe and memorable evening in our Dining Room or Outdoor Patio. If you prefer to enjoy your fine dining experience at home, you can order and pay for lunch or dinner online and then pick up curbside or select from one of our delivery partners.

NAME: Le Cafe Crepe
GENERAL_LOCATION: 200 San Jacinto Blvd., Hampton Inn & Suites Austin-Downtown/Convention Center, TX, 78701

NAME: Azure
DESCRIPTION: A world-class restaurant perched along the Waikiki beachfront under the canopy of resort’s dramatic Spanish-Moorish architecture. The bejewelled oceanfront space is adorned with intimate candles and pristine table settings – creating an ambience of exquisite relaxation and upscale dining. Azure is currently serving a four-course dinner menu.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2259 Kalakaua Ave, The Royal Hawaiian, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Waikiki, 96815

NAME: Hy's Steak House - Waikiki
DESCRIPTION: Join us for select Holiday brunch buffets, celebrate your family holiday traditions at Honolulu's most iconic restaurants. Hy's Steak House, one of the best-known steakhouses in Hawaii, has been a tradition in Waikiki for 40 years and continues to be a favorite with visitors and locals alike. Tuxedoed waiters expertly prepare Caesar Salad, carve Chateaubriand for two and flambè delicious desserts (like Bananas Foster and Cherries Jubilee ) tableside. The real specialties of this steak house, of course, are the USDA Prime grade cuts of beef - New York Strip, Porterhouse T-Bone, Delmonico and Filet Mignon - which are dry-aged and trimmed on the premises. The kiawe wood sears the steaks with an intense heat, while complementing the flavor of the fine beef perfectly. Enjoy a cognac or glass of Port from Hy's full bar in the intimacy of the library lounge, while enjoying the acoustic musical offerings of Audy Kimura, Vernon Sakata or Chris Hopper. Join us for Easter & Mother's Day Brunch.

NAME: Roy's Hawaii Kai
DESCRIPTION: For the past 30 years, guests have enjoyed Roy Yamaguchi's award-winning Internationally Influenced, Hawaii Inspired Cuisine, globally sourced wines and Roy's Aloha style of service. Roy's chefs utilize the freshest local ingredients, bold Asian spices, European sauces and focus on fresh seafood. A breathtaking view of Maunalua Bay may be enjoyed from the main dining room or private dining room that is available for a special occasion or business gathering.

NAME: Tommy Bahama Restaurant & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Our location in the heart of Waikiki is a three-story oasis where you’ll find a farm-to-table restaurant, a gorgeous living wall of herbs and tropical plant life, and an open-air rooftop complete with sand, a fire pit, live music, and a stunning view of Honolulu. Reservations are highly recommended, but walk-ins are welcome.are welcome.

NAME: Kahuku Grill
DESCRIPTION: Seven Brothers "at the mill" is located at the historical Kahuku Sugar Mill. From the street you can see a large wheel that was part of the old mill. When entering the parking lot to the right there is a gas station. Parking can be found on at the curb in front of the large wheel and to the left of the entrance. The restaurantl is right behind the big sugar mill "wheel". Hope to see you soon.

NAME: goofy cafe & dine
DESCRIPTION: West of Waikiki near Hilton Hawaiian Village, a road leading to ‘Bowls’ where goofy surf spots. Breakfast-Lunch-Cafe-Dinner, anytime, surfer’s cafe is open, welcoming you. We are always standing by healthy and natural foods, sweets, and drinks are concerned with the using Hawaiian local food theme-based on ’EAT LOCAL’. You can enjoy our original menu such as Goofy Eggs Benedicts, Goofy Omelet, Local Bibimbap, Grilled Mahi Mahi. We're open from 7am for breakfast. Lunch menu starts from 11am and Dinner is open from 5pm. Please stop by and enjoy our menu & Cozy atmosphere. 《Parking Information》 Unfortunately, we do not have a parking. However you can park at Ala Wai Boat Harbor which is behind the Ilikai Hotel and beside the Hilton lagoon.

NAME: Uncle Sharkii Poke Bar
DESCRIPTION: Food. Family. Simplicity.™ These values resonate through our concept of simply made Poke Bowls that are healthy, affordable, and family friendly. Attractive for both first-timers and poke pros, we offer quick-serve freshly made bowls along with our delicious Boba Milk Teas & Dole Soft Serve Ice Cream to help bring Poke to the masses.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2330 Kalakaua Ave Ste 208, 2nd floor of the INTERNATIONAL MARKETPLACE - Across the street from Waikiki Beach, 96815-5045

NAME: Momosan Waikiki
DESCRIPTION: At Momosan, noodles are front and center. Whether indulging in a bowl of signature tonkotsu ramen, tokyo chicken ramen, tantan, or tsukemen, you'll realize it is quality you can only find dining with an Iron Chef. Stop by alone and grab a seat at the bar, or with a group and relax at one of the communal tables. Drop in for a lunch set, or feast on appetizers and noodles for dinner. Wash it all down with a Morimoto signature sake, beer, or wine. No matter which path you choose, with your meal in the hands of Momo san, it's bound to be unforgettable.

NAME: Highway Inn Kaka'ako
DESCRIPTION: Hawaiian Food - Since 1947 - Three generations of tradition. Tasty, authentic, award-winning local cuisine. Serving Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner. Lau Lau, Kalua Pig and Beef Stew Combos. Pipikaula, Poi, Smoke Meat, Squid Luau, Poke, Lomi Salmon. Featured on Food Network's "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives."

NAME: La Mer
DESCRIPTION: Award-winning restaurant featuring exquisite Neoclassic French cuisine, oceanfront views. Hawaii’s longest-running AAA Five Diamond restaurant, since 1990, and the only restaurant in Hawaii to be awarded a Five-Star designation by Forbes Travel Guide. Recognized as the finest restaurant in Honolulu, La Mer captures the elegance and romance of Halekulani. Its internationally acclaimed menu features local, tropical ingredients in dishes inspired by flavors from France. Elegant evening attire for women. Dinner jackets or dress shirts, dress slacks and shoes for gentlemen. Reservations recommended. Open daily from 5:30 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. As an elegant fine dining restaurant, La Mer restricts patrons to adults and children 8 years or older.

NAME: Karai Crab
DESCRIPTION: Located in the Interstate Building next to Easy Music Center on 1314 S. King St. Ste. #G-2. We will miss our outdoor ambiance at the old Karai, but on to a new more modern look! We still HIGHLY RECOMMEND making reservations, but we will still accept walk ins if any tables cancel or no-show. Parking available in the Interstate Building $3 flat rate with validation or street parking available after 6;30pm. OPEN AT 5pm, LAST SEATING AT 8pm, LAST CALL FOR FOOD AND ALCOHOL AT 8:45pm, AND WE CLOSE THE RESTAURANT AT 9pm.

NAME: Poke Bar
DESCRIPTION: Poke is one of our most favorite traditional Hawaiian dish, and we have taken this classic dish and put several twists to it. We use ahi, salmon, kajiki, shrimp, octopus, scallop and tofu with different mixtures including seaweed, onions, kale and more to create a fresh, light, delicious meal. We believe not only the tourists from all over the world will love this new concept of Poke Bowls but also Kama'aina.

NAME: Deck.
DESCRIPTION: DECK. View. Bar. Grill situated on the 3rd floor pool deck of the Queen Kapiʻolani Hotel, features panoramic views of the iconic Diamond Head and world famous Waikiki beach! This open-air venue provides a stunning backdrop for the chef’s unique American Pacific inspired menu, fresh handcrafted cocktails, locally brewed beers as well as a vast selection of interesting wines. DECK. keeps it fresh, incorporating locally sourced and sustainable ingredients wherever possible through partnerships with local farms, ranches, distilleries, and breweries.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 150 Kapahulu Ave, 3rd floor of the Queen Kapiolani Hotel, 96815-4032

NAME: Cafe Kaila
GENERAL_LOCATION: Market City Shopping Center, 2919 Kapiolani Blvd., 96826

NAME: Hula Grill Waikiki
GENERAL_LOCATION: 233 Elm Street, Outrigger Waikiki Beach Resort, 96815-2941

NAME: Banzai Sushi Bar
DESCRIPTION: Voted one of Oahu's best by Honolulu Star Advertiser 7 consecutive years, BANZAI Sushi Bar is truly one of Haleiwa's best kept secrets. Tucked away in a back corner of the North Shore Marketplace, casual fine dinning, outdoor covered seating with Japanese-style seating on Zabuton pillows or conventional tables, diners relax all while watching surf videos and enjoy live local musicians on the weekend. BANZAI uses local organic produce when ever possible and has their very own Hawaiian fish buyer who presents himself on a daily basis at the worlds largest Tuna fish auction here in Honolulu allowing them to serve the freshest fish almost immediately. With one of Hawaii's best Sake selections, any sushi lover and sake connoisseur will be in pure nirvana. Don't miss BANZAI Sushi Bar on your next visit to Oahu's North Shore in Historic Haleiwa Town.

NAME: Michel's At the Colony Surf
DESCRIPTION: Come and experience French fine-dining cuisine at its best at Hawaii's premier ocean front restaurant, voted "Most Romantic Restaurant" by "The Lifestyles of the Rich and Famous" on Oahu's Gold Coast.

NAME: Heavenly Island Lifestyle Waikiki
DESCRIPTION: With a passion to serve fresh, locally sourced food, Heavenly Island Lifestyle offers customers delicious meals all day long. The locally owned and operated restaurant located in Honolulu, HI, is determined to provide the ideal island experience through wholesome, organic food choices. Their restaurant prides themselves on the freshness and taste of their food. Their dedicated staff works hard to gather products from local farms including vegetables, fruits and meats. Your taste buds will be delighted by their vast array of delectable food options. In the morning, reward yourself with a power packed fruit bowl or indulge in a kalua pig eggs benedict. If you're looking for a new lunch spot, take advantage of their local pork and cilantro maze-soba or organic coconut green curry during your lunch hour. Finally, unwind after a long day with one of their signature cocktails and some fresh local seafood.

NAME: Arancino at The Kahala
DESCRIPTION: Recognized as the Best Italian Restaurant in Hawaii, Arancino at The Kahala showcases a modern take on classic Italian dishes featuring fine ingredients imported from Italy and fresh local products from land and sea. Experience a culinary journey of Italy through Executive Chef Daisuke Hamamoto's thoughtfully crafted menu which features a wide selection of house-made pastas, brick oven pizzas, gibier (game meat delicacies) and more. In addition, an extensive wine list designed by Shinya Tasaki, winner of the 'World's Best Sommelier Award' in 1995, features different premium wines from Italy and Pacific Rim countries around Hawaii. Complete your dining experience with house made dessert creations by our pastry team along with after dinner beverage offerings.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 5000 Kahala Ave, The Kahala Hotel & Resort, 96816-5411

NAME: Hideout
DESCRIPTION: A hidden gem tucked away above the Kuhio Avenue hubbub, Hideout serves modern Hapa Hawaiian cuisine morning & night. Chill out inside or cop a seat out on our lanai. Enjoy an extensive cocktail list and open fire pits on the patio.

NAME: Ginza Bairin Tonkatsu & Yoshoku Bistro
DESCRIPTION: Ginza Bairin Tonkatsu & Yoshoku Bistro is Honolulu’s premier destination for authentic Japanese cuisine. The Waikiki location is the first of the Ginza Bairin restaurants to open outside of Asia. At their location at 255 Beach Walk in the heart of Waikiki diners can find them serving plates of their world-famous Tonkatsu along with the specialty sauce created by Ginza Bairin’s founder, Nobukatsu Shibuya, in 1927. The chain of restaurants is owned and managed by the third generation of the Shibuya family, embodying a true legacy dining experience. Ginza Bairin offers a variety of exciting plates for those who love the Western-influenced dishes that emerged during Japan’s Meiji Restoration Period, illustrating a truly fascinating history in every bite. Validated parking is available for dinner / all day weekends at the corner of Kalakaua and Beach Walk (new Bank of Hawaii Waikiki Ctr Bldg underground garage).

NAME: Tanaka of Tokyo Central
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Tanaka of Tokyo, Japanese Seafood and Steak House! Enjoy the finest steak and seafood skillfully prepared and presented with great flair by Master teppan-yaki chefs on your table top grill. The speed and dexterity of our chefs will dazzle you, and the exotic and elegant atmosphere will delight you. Bringing people together in a convivial atmosphere of laughter, warmth, and lively conversation is our specialty and providing the highest quality of seafood and steak with impeccable service is our mission. At Tanaka of Tokyo, diners are always "Honored Guests." Join us soon and discover why we are "The Best Japanese Restaurant in Hawaii."
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2250 Kalakaua Ave. 3rd Fl., Waikiki Shopping Plaza, 3rd Floor, 96815

NAME: House Without a Key
DESCRIPTION: Offering daily breakfast buffet, Hawaiian inspired lunch and dinner menu, and sunset cocktails. Voted one of the best restaurants in Waikiki, House Without A Key is known for its signature Mai Tai, a classic to be enjoyed any time of the day. Notable Hawaiian Hula Dancers, all whom have been awarded the title Ms. Hawaii, and entertainment are offered nightly at sunset and under the stars. There is a $5 entertainment charge for non-hotel guests, reservations available for hotel guest through Dining Reservations or OpenTable. Daytime: Casual, swimwear cover-up and footwear required. Evening: Informal, footwear required.

NAME: Down to Earth Organic & Natural Kapolei
DESCRIPTION: The Kapolei store is located just up the street from Wet and Wild Hawaii water park. It carries a wide range of natural and organic foods and groceries, including dairy products and local fresh organic produce. It also has bulk foods, which allow customers to purchase the amount they want and save unnecessary packaging and marketing costs on a wide variety of beans, grains and flours, cereals, candies, and more. They have body care products and truly green household items and the most complete range of all-vegetarian and natural, vitamins, supplements, herbs, and homeopathic remedies available in Hawaii.

NAME: Monkeypod Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: Monkeypod Kitchen by Merriman is a place where foodies, beer lovers, and families escape the stresses of their day-to-day lives by enjoying an ice-cold beer and a great meal while surrounded by people who consider them honored guests and friends. Our restaurants are founded upon a passion for craft and we are dedicated to mastering the craft of food, drink, and merrymaking...With Aloha! Our menu features fresh island fish, hand tossed pizzas from our kiawe wood-burning oven, and homemade cream pies made from scratch. Thirty-six craft beers are on tap, each served at an optimal twenty-nine degrees. Our culinary cocktails feature unique ingredients such as acai spirit, coconut water, and Kula lavender. Our passion for craft also extends to our diverse wine list, which emphasizes sustainability, drinkability and fun. Come join us at our communal table, with friends old and new, and learn what it's like to share our "Lucky Live Hawaii" story.

NAME: Roy's Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: The Ko Olina Resort welcomed Roy's Ko Olina in 2004 and has since established itself as a premier dining destination in Oahu's second major city, Kapolei. Open daily for lunch, Aloha Hour, and dinner, inside seating as well as covered outdoor seating on the Bridge Bar lanai which overlooks the 18th hole of the Ko Olina Golf Course. Along with Roy's classic items, our guests can enjoy a vast selection of our chef's innovative creations using the freshest local ingredients available.

NAME: Beachhouse at the Moana
DESCRIPTION: Enjoy a modern take on refined oceanfront dining. Using fresh Oahu ingredients, our menu highlights island-inspired classics, succulent seafood and the finest cuts of steak.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2365 Kalakaua Ave, Moana Surfrider, A Westin Resort & Spa, Waikiki Beach, 96815-5041

NAME: STRIPSTEAK Waikiki
DESCRIPTION: STRIPSTEAK Waikiki is the modern American Steakhouse remixed, remade, and reinvented with a unique blend of Asian influence and the signature Chef Michael Mina flair. An evocative, inventive, and highly curated menu offers guests the best seafood, foie gras, and of course signature cuts of premium steaks in all of Waikiki. Located on the 3rd floor Grand Lanai in the International Market Place, STRIPSTEAK Waikiki is where the sun and sand meet sizzling satisfaction offering the perfect dining experience after a day in paradise. Guests will also enjoy the seasonal, ever-evolving menu featuring locally sourced ingredients and global flavors.

NAME: Le Crepe Cafe Kailua
DESCRIPTION: breakfast, brunch and dessert specialized in Crepes, waffles, omelettes, coffee and more homemade batter, sauces and local fresh ingredients plenty of free parking and inside and outside seatings!

NAME: Wai'olu Ocean Cuisine
DESCRIPTION: Open-air seafood restaurant in Waikiki that features locally sourced ingredients, a modern take on sushi including sushi Omakase and market driven seafood. An intimate and romantic setting to enjoy a handcrafted specialty cocktail while experiencing a beautiful Hawaiian sunset.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 223 Saratoga Road, Trump International Hotel Waikiki, 96815

NAME: Tempura Kiki
DESCRIPTION: "SPECIALTY TEMPURA RESTAURANT Dedication of premium ingredients providing sumptuous tender, light and crispy textures in our Traditional Japanese Tempura"

NAME: Ramen Akatsuki
DESCRIPTION: “Combination of mountain and sea ingredients, clear amber pork bone broth and homemade noodles” Locally available ingredients, preservation methods, and cooking methods provide a new ramen experience.

NAME: Down to Earth Organic & Natural Kailua
DESCRIPTION: The best source for locally grown, organic, and sustainable produce, groceries, and healthy deli foods! Check out our 100% vegetarian deli with everything made-from-scratch, plus a fresh salad bar. Smoothies, acai bowls, organic espresso, burgers, sandwiches, hot bar, & baked goods- we have something you'll love. Located in the former Macy's building, this store was opened in 2019 with over 15,000 square feet. The store was relocated from near the Hamakua Marsh, which was opened in 2000. It offers a variety of natural and organic foods and groceries including dairy products, local organic produce, bulk foods, vitamins and natural supplements, body care products, and household items.

NAME: Moani Waikiki
DESCRIPTION: Moani Waikiki Island Bistro & Bar is a locally owned and operated restaurant nestled in the heart of Waikiki, on the Grand Lanai of the International Market Place, a world-renowned shopping center. We are the go-to place for island-style dining in Waikiki. Our family-style menu ensures there's something for everyone, and the best part is that we have live music daily! It's the island experience everyone loves, right here in Waikiki! So, visit us and dine where the locals go!

NAME: Arden Waikiki
DESCRIPTION: Nestled in Waikiki, beneath Diamond Head, Arden offers Contemporary Hawaiian cuisine. Culinary artisans Makoto Ono and Amanda Cheng craft fresh, colorful meals that nourish both body and soul. Each bite tells a story, creating cherished memories. At Arden, every visit feels like coming home, where food becomes art, and the allure of Hawaii's flavors awaits.

NAME: d.k Steak House
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2552 Kalakaua Ave, Waikiki Beach Marriott Resort & Spa, 96815-3662

NAME: Down to Earth Organic & Natural Kakaako
DESCRIPTION: This expansive 13,000 square foot location has a huge deli! Deli options include fresh baked pizzas, made-to-order wok fried Asian style bowls, vegetarian sushi and much more. Create your own custom plate at our acclaimed hot table and salad bar—with over 60 items to choose from. Order from our wide assortment of made-to-order deli items including sandwiches, smoothies, organic espresso drinks, fresh juices and more.

NAME: Basalt Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Within Dukes Lane Market & Eatery, we present BASALT, a contemporary and refined, yet casual restaurant that features local cuisine ranging from familiar comfort food favorites to finer dining selections. Come and experience quality service with great food in a fun and unique environment — BASALT.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2255 Kuhio Ave, Dukes Lane Market & Eatery, 96815-2642

NAME: Ruth's Chris Steak House
DESCRIPTION: Ruth's Chris Steak House specializes in serving USDA Prime steaks, each seared to perfection, finished with butter and freshly chopped parsley, and served sizzling on a 500-degree plate. We invite you to join us in Honolulu, HI!

NAME: Ruth's Chris Steak House
DESCRIPTION: Ruth's Chris Steak House specializes in serving USDA Prime steaks, each seared to perfection, finished with butter and freshly chopped parsley, and served sizzling on a 500-degree plate. We invite you to join us in Waikiki, HI!

NAME: Orchids
DESCRIPTION: With sweeping views of Diamond Head and the Pacific Ocean, Orchids is an ocean-side open air Dining Room serving Mediterranean inspired dishes for breakfast, lunch, dinner and Sunday Brunch. Sunday Brunch buffet offers choices from traditional American to distinctly Japanese cuisines. Resort casual attire for breakfast, lunch, brunch and afternoon tea; tank tops, beachwear, exercise attire or flip-flops are not permitted. Casual elegant attire for dinner; casual t-shirts, tank tops, beachwear, exercise attire or flip-flops are not permitted. Reservations strongly advised.

NAME: Arancino di Mare
DESCRIPTION: Arancino di Mare is our flagship location which opened in 2004. Enjoy your dining at our open terrace with a beautiful view of the world famous Waikiki Beach! (located at Waikiki Beach Marriott Resort & Spa).

NAME: Hoku's
DESCRIPTION: Hoku's at The Kahala Hotel & Resort is heralded for its tantalizing menu featuring global Hawaiian cuisine. Open nightly for dinner and for its famous Sunday Brunch Buffet, the menu draws on Executive Chef Jonathan Mizukami's Michelin-starred experience blending classic French technique with bold local flavors.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 5000 Kahala Ave, The Kahala Hotel & Resort, 96816

NAME: Noi Thai Cuisine - Hawaii
DESCRIPTION: Whether you're visiting the Honolulu area or are a local, Noi Thai Cuisine in Hawaii has top-notch recipes and a comfortable atmosphere for you to enjoy. Since 1989, this upscale Thai restaurant has kept up with food trends, delivering traditional dishes with a contemporary twist. Stop by to browse their extensive menu in a one-of-a-kind environment. Stop by in the afternoon and try one of their filling lunch meals, including curries, pad Thai, and a host of vegetarian options. If you're coming in for a romantic evening out, come early to take advantage of great happy hour specials. For dinner, feast on signature dishes such as tamarind duck, yellow curry crab, and tom yum lobster, all plated and presented beautifully and served to you hot. If you're looking for a cozy night in but want to enjoy some delicious dinner, this restaurant offers speedy delivery services. Celebrate upcoming birthdays and anniversaries at this restaurant.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2301 Kalakaua Ave # C308, Royal Hawaiian Center Building C, Level 3-C308, 96815-5007

NAME: Morimoto Asia Waikiki
DESCRIPTION: Morimoto Asia Waikiki, conceived by internationall acclaimed Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto, serves as the signature restaurant of Alohilani Resort Waikiki Beach. The dinner-only culinary destination features Iron Chef Morimoto's iconic cuisine that seamlessly integrates Western and traditional Asian ingredients with unmatched creativity and innovation. Located on the second floor of this new city resort, Morimoto Asia Waikiki brings an interactive culinary experience to Waikiki Beach, courtesy of a glass-encased exhibition kitchen that will offer a behind-the- scenes glimpse into culinary preparations and traditions, and outdoor lanai's with stunning views and sunsets. that have made Waikiki Beach a vacation destination for d

NAME: Hau Tree
DESCRIPTION: A casual beach-centric menu offering Honolulu's best beachside brunch, lunch, and casual dinner. Join us at the Hau Tree, located within the Kaimana Beach Hotel!
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2863 Kalakaua Ave, Inside the Kaimana Beach Hotel, 96815-4016

NAME: Taormina Sicilian Cuisine
DESCRIPTION: Inspired by authentic Sicilian recipes from the kitchens of Southern Italy's seaside town of Taormina, Chef Hiroyuki Mimura pairs fresh pastas with the highest quality seafoods and meats. Unspoiled by heavy sauces, Sicilian-style pastas are dressed in pure, extra virgin olive oil. Fresh vegetables, lightly grilled fresh local fish, and lamb seasoned with herbs offer diners a healthy range of options.Featured dishes include fresh Fettucine Carbonara finished with tableside Truffle service, grilled Lamb Chops "Palermo" and Veal "Siciliana." Taormina's specialty dish is Uni Pasta (Sea Urchin), a delicacy enjoyed in Japan and Italy. Italian espressos compliment Dolci (dessert) selections of house made desserts.

NAME: Kona Brewing Company Hawaii Kai Pub
DESCRIPTION: Kona Brewing Co opened it's second pub location in Hawaii Kai, on Oahu's east side, in 2003. Limited Dine-In (reservation required; 5 person max from the same family per latest regulations), Take-Out and Delivery now available. Reserve a table on opentable.com or order online by clicking the link to our website! Great food and fresh Liquid Aloha!

NAME: Arancino Beachwalk
DESCRIPTION: Opened in 1995, Arancino on Beachwalk and well-known to the locals as well as visitors from around the world - Arancino is a hidden gem in the heart of Waikiki. Arancino's recipes reflect the cuisine of Naples Italy. The presentations and taste are kept simple while the flavors and ingredients are nicely accentuated. Our executive chef incorporates ingredients imported from Italy and locally grown products which provide guests with a truly authentic and unique dining experience only available in HawaiI! Please also visit our flagship location - Arancino di Mare located in the Waikiki Beach Marriott Resort & Arancino at The Kahala located in the iconic Kahala Hotel - both featuring beautiful al fresco dining!

NAME: Nico's Pier 38
DESCRIPTION: Located at Pier 38 in Honolulu, Nico's offers fresh fish direct from the fish auction next foor, daily specials, fresh poke bowls and seafood from the fish market, breakfast, lunch and dinner. Full service bar with wine on tap, cold beer and delicious tropical cocktails on the Tiki menu. Harbor views and fast food service by day. Open air dining on the outdoor lanai. At night, Nico's is a full service restaurant with harbor light views, a full bar and the freshest seafood in town. There is a fish market within that offers sashimi platters, a poke bar and fresh Hawaiian food daily.

NAME: Yard House
DESCRIPTION: Yard House is the modern American gathering place where beer and food lovers unite. Known for great food, classic rock, an energetic vibe and endless fleet of tap handles featuring the best craft and local beers, each Yard House location offers 100+ beers on tap along with an array of craft cocktails. Our menu features favorites such as our signature Poke Nachos, street tacos, USDA prime burgers, seafood and steaks. Founded in Long Beach, Calif., in 1996, Yard House now spans across the U.S. with over 80 locations and is open daily for lunch, dinner, happy hour and late-night dining.

NAME: Mahina and Sun's
DESCRIPTION: Mahina & Sun’s features delicious and groundbreaking island cuisine in a hip, casual atmosphere. Experience “elevated home cooking with a Hawaiian sense of place” through the use of local, organic ingredients represented in each unique dish. Serving Breakfast daily from 8am to 12pm; Lanai Happy Hour Menu daily from 12pm – 10pm. Dinner available 5:30pm to 9pm last seating, Thursday to Sunday nights ONLY. Last call at 9pm.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 412 Lewers St, Surfjack Hotel & Swim Club, 96815-2436

NAME: Restaurant 604
DESCRIPTION: Conveniently located next to the Arizona Memorial Visitor center, it's the perfect place for military families, local residents or visitors who are just passing through to enjoy a quality meal with a breathtaking view and world class service. Don't forget to try one of Hawaii's Best Bloody Marys!

NAME: Tiki's Grill & Bar
DESCRIPTION: A hip, open-air restaurant with a retro South Pacific design and experience, Tiki's Grill & Bar features a menu highlighting the flavors of the islands prepared in an open exhibition kitchen. The restaurant appeals to residents and visitors alike and draws the late-night crowd with live contemporary Hawaiian entertainment every evening. Tiki's Grill & Bar provides a casual American and Pacific-Rim menu with flavors of the islands, using fresh local produce. Tiki’s offers lanai seating with beautiful sunsets on Kuhio Beach.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2570 Kalakaua Avenue, located in the Twin Fin Hotel, 96815-3663

NAME: Hard Rock Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Hard Rock Cafe is a global phenomenon with 185 cafes that are visited by nearly 80 million guests each year. The first Hard Rock Cafe opened on June 14, 1971, in London, England, and from there the brand has expanded to major cities and exotic locations around the world.

NAME: Plumeria Beach House
DESCRIPTION: Nestled beachfront at the iconic Kahala Hotel & Resort, Plumeria Beach House is our open-air restaurant serving breakfast, lunch and dinner on spacious indoor and outdoor terraces. Executive Chef Jonathan Mizukami and his Michelin-starred experience are at the forefront of the tantalizing menu, highlighting local Hawaiian ingredients and fresh-caught seafood.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 5000 Kahala Ave, The Kahala Hotel & Resort, 96816-5411

NAME: Noe
DESCRIPTION: This famed Italian restaurant in Oahu is a remix of traditional Southern Italian ingredients and age-old recipes, impeccably prepared and presented in a reimagined contemporary outdoor setting.

NAME: Mai Tai Bar
DESCRIPTION: Located steps away from the beautiful sands of Waikiki Beach, the oceanfront Mai Tai Bar is an ideal setting for enjoying the Waikiki scene while sipping on your favorite umbrella drink and savoring tasty cuisine. Your memorable Hawaii experience begins at this inimitable beachfront bar where you can lounge watch the surf roll in.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2259 Kalakaua Ave, The Royal Hawaiian, a Luxury Collection Resort, Waikiki, 96815-2515

NAME: Round Table Pizza
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2005 Kalia Road, Hilton Hawaiian Village Waikiki Beach Resort, 96815

NAME: Waikiki Brewing Company
DESCRIPTION: Located in the beginning of historic Waikiki Beach, right on the corner of Kalakaua Ave and Ala Moana Blvd. Waikiki's first and only brewery, brewing craft beer right here in our restaurant. We we offer a full bar and food menu featuring smoked meats, including brisket and pulled pork.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 1945 Kalakaua Ave, Ala Moana and Ena Road, 96815-1851

NAME: Moku Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: Full table service resumes 12/18/23! Located in the heart of the Kaka'ako art district, Moku Kitchen is a chef-driven concept that brings Hawaii's rich upcountry farming and ranching heritage to downtown Honolulu's urban lifestyle. Our award winning cocktail program is ever-evolving, highlighted by the Monkeypod Mai Tai. We offer a wide variety of local craft beer and wines from small independent producers. Please go to mokukitchen.com for up to date menus and our daily live music calendar.

NAME: LuMi Bar & Dining
DESCRIPTION: Beneath a multitude of pendent lights creating an intimate atmosphere, LuMi Dining comes to life under the guidance of Federico Zanellato. A casual fine dining experience coupled with a modern European bar. LuMi Dining invite you to explore ingredients, textures and flavours beyond the confines of cuisine. Set to the backdrop of Sydney Harbour, LuMi Dining presents both new and reinvented gastrono

NAME: Malabar South Indian Restaurant in Darlinghurst
DESCRIPTION: The culinary corner stone in the heart of Darlinghurst, Malabar enjoys a long-held reputation for excellence in food, wine and hospitality. Executive Chef Mohammed celebrates carefully sourced local ingredients from nearby farmer's market, where he collaborates with local growers. Chef Mohammed's innovative and skilfully executed dishes deliver intelligent compositions and delightful flavours, carefully married to our Australian wine list.

NAME: Four Frogs Creperie Mosman
DESCRIPTION: In France we love our crêpes. Whether sweet or savoury - called galettes - they are a delicious meal, traditionally enjoyed with a glass of cider or white wine and some good company. Opening our third outlet in the vibrant heart of Sydney's CBD was a natural move following the success of our first two restaurants in the north and south.

NAME: Sokyo
DESCRIPTION: Sokyo continues to pay homage to Japanese heritage whilst infusing it with a modern touch using the finest Australian produce. It’s where tradition and innovation collide. Our refreshed menu and interiors take the Sokyo experience to new heights, complete with a sunken dining room and bold, rule-breaking Japanese calligraphy. Sokyo’s philosophy of Ritual meets Art is evident in every dish and every little detail, everywhere you look. We can’t wait to share it with you.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Star City Casino Entertainment 80 Pyrmont St, The Darling, Level G, 2009

NAME: Mach2
DESCRIPTION: From the famed Machiavelli restaurant family, Mach2 is the International Terminal’s newest dining venue serving Italian favourites such as Antipasto, Calamari Fritti, Spaghetti & Meatballs and Risotto as well as an All-Day Breakfast menu. Mach2 offers a full bar and wine list, a Kids Menu and also serves take-away coffe and snacks.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Ross Smith Ave, Sydney International Terminal 1, Foodcourt Landside Departures, 2020

NAME: The Herring Room
DESCRIPTION: ‘You don’t see many restaurants like this anymore’ Nicholas Jordan, Broadsheet. Manly's favourite restaurant, is located just off the beach in a landmark site that locals have long admired. The Herring Room is family owned & run by veterans of the industry. It's set in a 1920’s inspired space w good old fashioned hospitality. It's contemporary meals are delivered confidently, inspired by flavours from all around the world. The Herring Room is the sister restaurant to the recently closed & hugely successful, long running Potts Point restaurant The Sardine Room. HOST YOUR PRIVATE LUNCH ANY DAY OF THE WEEK! Select from a range of cosy rooms to suit your event. Celebrate a birthday, special occasion or corporate event with us!

NAME: Fish At The Rocks
DESCRIPTION: Modern Australian seafood restaurant located in one of the rocks historic buildings, where those in the know go! Open for: Lunch 12 noon Monday- Friday, Dinner from 6pm 7 days. Daily specials

NAME: Maestro & Co
DESCRIPTION: maestro & co is a Manly tapas bar and restaurant that showcases Middle Eastern cuisine. Created and founded by Graeme Moses and and now taken over by Head Chef and Manager Ben Elfahim together they have created a first for Manly and the northern beaches - a Middle Eastern menu with a contemporary edge that is all meant for sharing.

NAME: Fortune Village Chinese Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Located close to the Queen Victoria Building (QVB) and serving Chinese food since 1981. Fortune Village offers you a wide selection on our a la carte, banquet and take out menus. At Fortune Village we believe in providing a restaurant experience that gives good, friendly service along side menu choices that are comforting, high quality and consistent at good pricing. Please do not hesitate to ask if you have any special menu requirements or requests.

NAME: Caffe Amici
DESCRIPTION: Here at Caffè Amici in Sydney you find a casual and friendly environment where you can taste the best Italian recipes cooked with the finest and fresh ingredients and enjoy imported Italian wines and beers. Buon appetito!

NAME: The Gantry Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: A uniquely Australian harbour side dining experience, with a focus on showcasing sustainable local produce.

NAME: Nour
