DESCRIPTION: NOUR is built on a dream of presenting classic Lebanese flavours in a fresh, exciting way. We believe Australians deserve to know what this humble country on the Mediterranean coastline has hiding in its Cedar branches. Take a leap outside of the box and flirt with our beautiful, contemporary interior that will set your senses alight. You may think you know Lebanese food but we want to show you the surface is yet to be scratched and there is so much more to offer.

NAME: The Ternary
DESCRIPTION: The Grill Kitchen, Asian Kitchen and Wine Bar represent the idea of a comfortable and social space where not only great food and wine is shared, but also moments and memories. Our objective is to celebrate fresh produce, capturing three senses; smell, taste and sight. Executive Chef Anthony Flowers brings a contemporary approach to the menu with a focus on texture, balance, local produce and a harmony of flavours. At The Ternary, we have a unique ability to intertwine cultures and cuisines while showcasing an impressive diversity of interactive live cooking styles. Our atmosphere is open and welcoming and serves to highlight the cooking skills and creativity of our Chefs, bringing the three Ternary pillars together and encouraging our guests to converse and engage.

NAME: El Indio Bondi Beach
DESCRIPTION: An unpretentious family restaurant which opened in october 2017. Passionnate about food we aim to offer the best quality, service and atmosphere to all our customers and the local community. Typically from Venezuela and Colombia, Arepas are made out of white corn pockets filled with different ingredients. Our meats are slowly cooked and we have vegetarian and vegan options. All our Arepas are gluten free. Corrientazos reunite a bit of every food in a plate.

NAME: AALIA Restaurant Sydney
DESCRIPTION: AALIA, located in the heart of Sydney, welcomes guests on a journey through the Middle East. The menu boasts a selection of dishes that showcase the beautiful Middle Eastern and North African regions of the world, flanked by oceans, rivers, and seas. The idea behind the menu is to start with a few raw dishes and mezze, followed by mains and sides, with each dish crafted to represent a particular region, or specific era of Arabian culture. We consciously consider the finest details of our service to ensure our guests enjoy a memorable experience. AALIA's interior organically emerges from Harry Seidler's original iconic MLC architecture. Sculptural architectural features, tactile materials and furnishings are used in perfect synergy to create intimate and relaxing spaces.

NAME: Flying Fish Restaurant & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Introducing a fresh approach to Sydney’s finest seafood. At Flying Fish at The Star, you’ll discover the very best from Australian and New Zealand waters, served with sublime simplicity. Delicately prepared with a tempered hand, each dish puts taste ahead of technique with an emphasis on minimal waste and maximum flavour. Take your seat, admire the view and soak up the welcoming ambience that invites you to sit, relax and savour.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Level G, Harbourside, The Star, 80 Pyrmont St, 2009

NAME: Claires kitchen at le Salon
DESCRIPTION: French born Marc Kuzma AKA Claire de Lune, has created a traditional French Brasserie menu with a few modern twists. Claire has decorated the venue with fabulous imported wall papers, antiques and chic furniture. Business partner, Valentin has hand picked a team of charming professional french waiters and waitresses... Upstairs is le salon, a cosy private mezzanine, you can reserve exclusively for up to 50 guests for sit down dinner or up to 80 for a cocktail party. le Salon is also our cabaret space with show weekly starring la creme de la creme of Australian and international talent. ​ "Bringing a little French style to the Paris end of Oxford street"

NAME: Social Brew Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Kitchen closes at 3pm Monday - Friday & 3:30pm on weekends. Social Brew Cafe - something of an oasis of good food and drinks in Pyrmont. Where, let’s face it, the cafe options aren’t as abundant as one would like. Which isn’t to say we’d just head there out of necessity; Social Brew Cafe is a stylish spot, with great service, as well as that aforementioned delicious feed. In the main cafe space, dark walls and hanging lights give Social Brew an industrial, stylish feel. Splashes of red, as well as big windows that open up onto the verandah and trees outside however, give proceedings a welcoming, friendly, relaxed air. Speaking of the “verandah”, outside is where you’ll want to be when the weather’s good and you’ve got a posse together to congregate over a smoothie, or a coffee, or a plate full of pancakes and bacon. Or, let’s face it, all of the above. Social Brew Cafe is found on Harris Street in Pyrmont, just a short walk from Darling Harbour.

NAME: Zahli
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Zahli - A modern take on traditional Middle Eastern flavours. Zahli Restaurant, located on Sydney’s iconic Elizabeth Street in Surry Hills, brings an exceptional culinary experience to life. It allows patrons to get a feel for the culture and tradition of authentic Lebanese dining, drawn from one of the country's most exemplary regions- Zahlé. We have created an environment, atmosphere and menu that is a modern take on age-old Middle Eastern foods. We take pride in delivering excellence – in taste, service, experience and memories. Our award-winning meals curated by our Executive Chef are a testament to what Zahli is all about and the joy we have brought to our local community, international travellers and special guests.

NAME: Platform 818
DESCRIPTION: Experience a modern take on classic Australian dishes made with locally sourced produce that once would have travelled from railway towns along the NSW goods line. Enjoy these dishes with our meticulously curated all Australian wine list or carefully crafted highball cocktails. Hop on board as we take a palatable excursion through time. Last Order at 9:15pm and Kitchen Closed at 9:30pm

NAME: Afous
DESCRIPTION: The perfume of life ~Afous~ ۞Taste…..…the flavours of two lands ۞Touch…….the palms of two hands ۞Hear………their music, the food of love that sings ۞Smell……..the perfume of life, from the sun and the rain ۞Feel ……...the spirit of food and life From the heart of Morocco and Spain

NAME: Cucina Porto
DESCRIPTION: Cucina Porto serves up simple, honest Italian food using the best ingredients along with a touch of old-world hospitality and charm. We look forward to welcoming you.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Star City Casino Entertainment 80 Pyrmont St, 80 Pyrmont St. Level G, 2009

NAME: La Boca Bar and Grill
DESCRIPTION: You'll love the vibrant dining experience of our stylish Argentinian restaurant and bar. Featuring the wood fired Parilla at its heart, the traditional asado cooking style and celebrated Argentinian flavours offer a sublime culinary journey. The colourful vibe, funky murals and great tasting wood fired grill flavours set the scene for a unique dining experience. La Boca Bar and Grill Sydney at Stamford Plaza Sydney Airport hotel at Mascot - it's the next best thing to being in Argentina.

NAME: Ormeggio at The Spit
DESCRIPTION: Ormeggio at The Spit, one of Australia’s most progressive Italian restaurants since opening in 2009, has relaunched in June 2020 with an entirely new concept, look, and feel: A buzzy Italian seafood restaurant with a beautiful cocktail and gelato bar centre stage. ​ Alessandro, Victor, and their team have completely reinvented themselves in their 11th year of operation. There has been a major interior design change to a casual yet refined, neutral and natural colour scheme, with pops of colour and texture. Expect high quality sustainable seafood, great cocktails, some very fun desserts, and those same knockout water views. ​ Ormeggio 2.0’s menu is a meat-free, a la carte seafood menu, complimented with a regularly changing 'Ormeggio Classic’ sharing menu, and very group friendly. Be ready for some very unique and delicious specialties such as an incredible (as usual) Pavoni risotto, tuna ‘cotoletta’, crudo crostini and don’t forget the ‘coppa gelato’!
GENERAL_LOCATION: Spit Road, D'Albora Marinas The Spit, 2088

NAME: Caffe Pendolino
DESCRIPTION: Caffe Pendolino, with views overlooking the beautiful Strand Arcade is the perfect setting to enjoy a morning coffee, breakfast or light lunch. It is open from 9am for breakfast and 11.30am for lunch. Unfortunately we are unable to take reservations for the Caffe as it operates on a walk in basis. All pasta served in The Caffe is from the Pendolino range of house-made dry pasta.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Shop 100 Level 2 the Strand Arcade, 412-414 George Street, 2000

NAME: NOMAD
DESCRIPTION: Some of the world’s finest produce and best wine is found here in Australia. We source the best produce from small growers who share that passion and, inspired by our travels through Spain, Morocco and the Middle East, cook with fire and smoke. Our wine list also has a focus on small growers making great wine sustainably, with a few internationals that share that same ethos.

NAME: Garfish
DESCRIPTION: Located opposite the ferry terminal in Manly, our focus is on serving the freshest fish available at a reasonable price for the ultimate seafood dining experience. We have daily blackboard specials as well as a great seasonal menu.

NAME: Bambini Trust Restaurant & Wine Room
DESCRIPTION: A stylish European Restaurant and WineRoom & Bar situated in the heart of the city.. Sydney Established 23 years with many beloved regular Bambini Diners Post Covid Trading is a lunch and dinner service with a great menu filled with classic dishes Italian French cuisine from Spaghettini Prawns and Angus Steak Frites, We are proud of our 3 goblet Wine list - A long list of wines by the glass and classic cocktails

NAME: Alegrias
DESCRIPTION: Alegrias Spanish Tapas, nestled in the heart of Rozelle, Sydney, has over the past 10 years established itself as the premier destination for authentic Spanish cuisine in Australia. This claim to authenticity is not just anecdotal; it is substantiated by a historic accolade in Dec 2023 that sets Alegrias apart from its contemporaries. The restaurant has been honored with the "Restaurants from Spain" (ICEX) certification, an esteemed recognition granted by the Spanish Government. This award marks Alegrias as the first restaurant in Australia's history to receive such an endorsement, highlighting its unparalleled commitment to offering an authentic Spanish dining experience. From traditional flavors to the ambience that echoes the lively streets of Spain, Alegrias stands as a testament to genuine Spanish culinary artistry, entertainment and culture on Australian shores.

NAME: Graze MCA
DESCRIPTION: Graze MCA is located on the Ground Floor (Circular Quay side) of the Museum of Contemporary Art, George Street The Rocks. With stunning views of the Opera House and Cirqular Quay, innovative menu at an affordable price, Graze MCA is a popular choice for both locals and visitors alike. Open Lunch Monday to Friday from 11.30am to 3pm Breakfast Saturday & Sunday from 8am to 11.30am Lunch Saturday & Sunday from 12pm to 3pm Bookings recommended

NAME: Gelato Messina Circular Quay
GENERAL_LOCATION: 1 Macquarie Pl, Shop G-10, Gateway Plaza, Circular Quay, 2000

NAME: Bon Vin Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Bon Vin (pronounced Bon Vaah) meaning 'Fine Wine' seeks to provide outstanding French-inspired food and wine in a warm intimate unique space. Don't wait anymore to discover this hidden gem. Chef Lisa and her team are glad to make you discover their innovative and seasonal menu. The experience wouldn't be complete without a glass of one of our delightful french wines, all reasonably priced. Our space is also perfect for your small function (max 30 seated and 50 standing). Don't hesitate to contact us.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 10/82 Stanley Street Darlinghurst NSW 2010, Enter via Stanley Lane, Crown Street End, 2010

NAME: Black Bar & Grill
DESCRIPTION: BLACK Bar & Grill's menu presents the finest steakhouse cuisine inspired by contemporary Australia and its seasonal produce.With stylish décor and stunning views of the Sydney harbour and the city backdrops, you'll enjoy an entirely novel dining experience. The menu showcases the best Australian produce with innovative flavour combinations, including a wide variety of seafood and an emphasis on fresh, seasonal ingredients. The wine list is very extensive, indicative of a true contemporary steakhouse, complementing the menu perfectly. A completely separate bar welcomes guests in with comfortable seating, creative cocktails and a delicious bar menu should you choose to graze over some snacks.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 80 Pyrmont Street, Level G, Harbourside, The Star, 2009

NAME: Chedi Thai
DESCRIPTION: Chedi Thai on Blues Point Road, McMahons Point is a destination with the heart and soul of a stylish local café combined with the food and service of an award winning Thai restaurant. Located in the picturesque McMahons Point dining precinct, by Day Chedi Thai is a contemporary café serving local residents and businesses near to the North Sydney CBD, Milsons Point and Kirribilli. By Night, the daytime ambience transforms into an elegant Thai restaurant offering dine-in, or take-away and delivery options to McMahons Point, North Sydney and other surrounding Lower North Shore suburbs. Chedi Thai offers a casual yet intimate dining experience in a setting that is modern, relaxed and inviting. We are also a venue for corporate functions and all special occasions. Our modern and banquette seating is spaced for comfort and can be arranged for small or large groups.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Shop G3 182 Blues Point Rd, Cnr Blues Point Rd and Victoria St, 2060

NAME: Harvest Buffet Sydney
DESCRIPTION: An abundance of delicious, seasonal cuisine awaits you at our brand new Harvest Buffet. Offering a feast for the senses, Harvest Buffet features five food stations with an array of delicious international cuisine. From Peking duck to naan bread, dim sum to stone fired pizzas, there is something to tantalise everyone's taste buds. We will also be offering more seafood than ever with a spectacular spread featuring sushi, fresh oysters, prawns, crab, mussels, clams, fish dishes and more. Our dessert station features three large chocolate fountains, a self-serve soft ice cream machine and a variety of condiments, cakes and pastries.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 80 Pyrmont St, Star City Casino Entertainment L 1, 2009

NAME: Tetsuya's
DESCRIPTION: Tetsuya's serves a Degustation menu of Eight courses. The menu is unique and is based on the Japanese philosophy of using natural seasonal flavours enhanced by classic French technique and utilising the freshest possible ingredients. Tetsuya designed his own on-site "test kitchen" within the restaurant to enable him to create the constantly evolving and inspiring dishes on which he has built his esteemed international reputation. Tetsuya's offers one of Sydney's most comprehensive wine lists and our sommeliers will, upon request, match the dishes with wine available by the glass. Tetsuya's does not accept or allow the service of any BYO Beverages or items of Food.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 529 Kent St, Directly between Liverpool and Bathurst Streets behind the Old Judge's House, 2000

NAME: Anason - Turkish Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Sample traditional Turkish Raki, sip your way through the wine regions of Turkey, celebrate life with signature cocktails, and most importantly feast on contemporary Turkish meze dishes at Sydney's most popular water meyhane in Barangaroo. Invoking the concept of the traditional restaurants and bars of Istanbul, Anason offers the Anatolian cooking Owner and MasterChef Turkey Judge Somer Sivrioglu is celebrated for, in a new, modern waterside environment.​ The modern dishes use traditional Turkish cooking methods such as pickling, drying, yogurt, salcha and tarhana making whenever possible; the team try to keep the use of modern technologies to a minimum. The typical Bosphorus Blue is prominent in and around this meze bar and Turkish restaurant. Let the team take you on a journey to sample some of Turkey's famous hospitality!
GENERAL_LOCATION: Barangaroo Anadara Shop 5/23 Barangaroo Ave, Barangaroo, 2000

NAME: The Apollo
DESCRIPTION: The Apollo is an Australian Greek restaurant that draws on the joint heritage and professional success of Jonathan Barthelmess in partnership with Longrain's Sam Christie with a keen eye to detail and the flavours of the mediterranean. Located in Potts Point, the elegantly minimalist refurbishment includes both banquette and outdoor seating, and a chef's table sitting adjacent to the kitchen - not unlike the family dining table, as a transition between dining room, kitchen and pantry.

NAME: X74
DESCRIPTION: We are proudly COVID Safe. X74 is a welcoming environment serving world class food in a light filled space. The menu changes seasonally and is never static, using ingredients that are grown and cultivated by our chefs from our very own garden. Our produce is carefully grown and hand picked so we can provide you all the freshness and flavour in every dish.

NAME: The Lord Nelson Brewery Hotel Restaurant
Macleay Street Bistro
DESCRIPTION: This is bistro cuisine at its finest, influenced by France with the best of modern Australia completing the mix. The menu is complemented by our weekly blackboard specials, showcasing the best in market freshness, alongside our benchmark bistro dishes. Local and international diners value the intimate privacy and discretion of the modern dining experience on offer. The Bistro has a great wine list showcasing a range of French and Australian wines. As well you can BYO wine with a corkage charge. The Bistro nestled in the 'Paris end' of Potts Point. Join us, to enjoy quality and consistency in all aspects of modern food and wine service. Macleay Street Bistro is open 7 nights from 5.30-11Pm and all day dining on Saturday and Sunday. We only close on Christmas Day.

NAME: Catalina Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Situated on the shores of Sydney Harbour on Rose Bay, Catalina is a beautiful, airy light-filled restaurant and bar with floor to ceiling glass sliding doors opening out onto a long curved balcony over the water. In keeping with its harbourside location, the a la carte menu features beautifully fresh seafood - Sydney Rock oysters shucked to order; house cured Mount Cook King salmon; whole snapper and barramundi filleted on the premises - but also a wide range of the best meat Australia has to offer. A fabulous Australian and global wine list (over 800 wines, many available by the glass) and welcoming, attentive service, make this restaurant a must-do Sydney dining experience. Open all day from midday until late, Catalina doesn't close between lunch and dinner. Between 3.00 pm and 6.00 pm graze on bar food overlooking the most beautiful harbour in the world.

NAME: Manly Thai Gourmet
The Spice Room
DESCRIPTION: Authentic Indian cuisine specialising in Peshawari style cooking located on Sydney Harbour, Circular Quay
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2 Phillip St, Ground Floor The Quay Building, 2000

NAME: Saveur
DESCRIPTION: ‘’’Much, much more than a Roseville local gem...” Saveur - 2020 NORTH SHORE LOCAL BUSINESS AWARDS WINNER OUTSTANDING RESTAURANT

NAME: Bentley Restaurant & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Bentley Restaurant + Bar offers a very special dining experience in an industrial-chic space in Sydney’s CBD. Chef Brent Savage’s innovative and inventive food is expertly paired with boutique wines from Nick Hildebrandt’s eclectic international list. The Bentley and its founders have a deserved reputation for excellence in food, wine-matching and service, which has earned them a swag of industry awards.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Radisson Blu Hotel, 27 O'Connell St, Sydney CBD, 2000

NAME: Bondi Trattoria
DESCRIPTION: Looking down over the iconic Bondi Beach, the Tratt is a true Sydney local. For 32 years this restaurant has served modern Italian food made from the best Australian ingredients and a full bar offering Australian and Italian wines, spirits and liqueurs. Under new ownership since May 2017, Joe Pavlovich and Alasdair France bring a lifetime of experience and a fresh approach to simplicity and quality.

NAME: 6 HEAD 1788
DESCRIPTION: 6HEAD is the world-class waterfront restaurant on Sydney Harbour. Every detail has been planned and executed by careful, experienced professionals, all in order to create a spectacular dining experience. Choose from a handpicked selection of a la carte dishes, or for bigger groups, select from our set and sharing menu options featuring some of our most popular cuts of steak, seafood and seasonal offerings. Our menu is prepared with simple and consistent cooking techniques to enhance the flavour of the ingredients and celebrate their authenticity.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 7-27 Circular Qy W, 7-27 Circular Quay West, 2000

NAME: Cho Cho San
DESCRIPTION: Restaurateurs Sam Christie and Jonathan Barthelmess are excited to announce the opening of their new joint venture, Cho Cho San, an interpretation of the Tokyo izakaya. Building on a successful partnership that began with celebrated Potts Point restaurant, The Apollo, Christie and Barthelmess's next project is an exploration of Japanese food culture. Together they will bring free-thinking and a creative approach to the traditions and heritage of Japanese cuisine. As Chef and Co-owner, Barthelmess is developing an ever-changing, seasonal menu keeping to the Japanese philosophy of simplicity where ingredients are the stars. Joined by Head Chef Nicholas Wong working together the focus will be fresh food and healthy eating, using hibachi grilling and steaming techniques. Cho Cho San has created an inventive drinks offering that draws on Japanese drinking traditions reflective of Christie's pioneering experience matching wine with Asian food. "We love the amazing drinking culture in Japan: the tiny bars, the buzzing izakayas and the huge variety of drinks with their deep traditions," he says. "So we've sourced the best sake, shochu, whisky, beer, and a wine list perfectly tailored to suit the food." A small, punchy cocktail menu will change seasonally, drawing on ingredients suchas melon, yuzu, apples, nashi pears and seaweed. Designer George Livissianis once again joins to create a simple, light space that feels Japanese without the cliches or kitsch.

NAME: monte restaurant
DESCRIPTION: monté is a modern Australian restaurant in Leichhardt, Sydney Inner West. We combine what we believe is the ultimate menu with the best contemporary dining experience. Our food is the freshest, our atmosphere is relaxed and there is an extensive range of Australian wines.

NAME: Mode Kitchen & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Mode Kitchen & Bar continues to perfect modern Australian cuisine embracing different cultural influences creating uncomplicated menu with delicious flavours. A modern Australian restaurant offering breakfast, lunch, aperitivo and dinner.

NAME: Basket Brothers
DESCRIPTION: We believe that quality is everything, so the brothers have carefully designed a bespoke menu for breakfast and lunch of classic dishes and unique signatures, using premium locally sourced ingredients. Serving P&R Espresso, T-Nomics Tea, cold pressed juices by Vegpress, in-house slow cooked and smoked meats, and an ever rotating choice of salads, burgers, sandwiches and other stuff, BB's is the new destination for great coffee, delicious food, and friendly service.

NAME: Lucio Pizzeria
DESCRIPTION: Lucio Pizzeria, founded and owned by Chef Lucio De Falco, brings the traditional taste of Naples to Sydney. We are a proud member of the AVPN.

NAME: Aqua Dining
DESCRIPTION: Situated above the North Sydney Olympic Pool, Aqua Dining is a refined award-winning restaurant that boasts one of the best international cityscapes. Aqua Dining offers a quintessential Sydney dining experience with unrivalled harbour views that sweep from Luna Park to the world famous Sydney Harbour Bridge and the Sydney Opera House. The venue features a modern and minimalistic design with a nice space for functions, parties and weddings. Executive Chef Davide Rebeccato uses the freshest Australian produce to create one of Australia's top contemporary Italian menus. Freshly made pasta and seasonal ingredients play major roles in the creative menu and highlight Davide's love for good Italian cooking. An extensive award winning wine list matched with seamless and friendly service completes this sophisticated dining experience. Aqua Dining is open for lunch and dinner 7 days.

NAME: Two Good Eggs Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Breakfast, Brunch and Lunch Cafe open every day. Well known for serving breakfast all day and unique twists on breakfast favourites.

NAME: Red Lantern Restaurant & Private Dining Room
DESCRIPTION: Set within a designer space reminiscent of French Colonial Vietnam, Red Lantern on Riley mixes the nostalgia of Indochine with the personal quirkiness of the Nguyen family. The restaurant is owned and operated by chefs Luke Nguyen and Mark Jensen, and Luke's sister Pauline Nguyen. With a focus on shared dishes, an evening at Red Lantern on Riley is an experience best enjoyed with friends and family.

NAME: Lotus Barangaroo
DESCRIPTION: Lotus Barangaroo serves authentic Asian fusion cuisine in the newest financial centre and liveliest business zone in Sydney. We also serve high-quality wines and spirits, as well as delicately crafted cocktails and other beverages. Located at the waterfront, Lotus Barangaroo's team looks forward to welcoming you to Lotus Barangaroo for a memorable harbour-side experience.

NAME: Public Dining Room
DESCRIPTION: Our restaurant revolves around a seasonally-driven menu that celebrates exceptional Australian produce every day. Our vision is to showcase local ingredients while reflecting the diverse backgrounds of the culinary team. Exceptional ingredients are prepared simply, combined with classic technique and clean flavours. We aim to offer casual fine dining in a relaxed luxury space. The menu is complemented by an extensive wine list, curated by our head sommelier.

NAME: Teddy Larkin's Seafood and Steakhouse
DESCRIPTION: Teddy Larkin's menu has been crafted around outstanding Australian produce. Our steaks are sourced from the Rangers Valley and Riverina District of NSW, as well as Gympie QLD. Seafood arrives fresh from the markets daily. Our focus is on great service and ensuring you have a fantastic experience at Teddy Larkin's time and time again. Teddy's bar is available for a casual drink anytime, so if you are not dining, swing by for a cocktail or one of our craft beers. Expect a warm welcome.
REVIEW_TAGS: look forward to our next visit

NAME: Quay Restaurant
GENERAL_LOCATION: Upper Level, Overseas Passenger Terminal, Circular Quay West, The Rocks, 2000

NAME: The Rocks Cafe
DESCRIPTION: The rocks cafe The Rocks Cafe is one of The Rocks' favourite icons. It offers a truly European dining experience just opposite the MCA on George Street. The Cafe spans two floors and combines the best of modern Australian architecture with a traditional bohemian feel that adds genuine warmth which is echoed by the friendly staff. The Cafe is open seven days a week from 8am to late at night so you can enjoy the breakfast, lunch or dinner. The menus are updated regularly and are complimented by the daily specials where our Chief Chef exercises his flair. Just around the corner from Circular Quay it's very central to the CBD and the financial district for lunch or after work dinner with friends or colleagues. The Rocks Cafe is the perfect for an intimate meal or large corporate bookings can be hosted upstairs and made private if required. Our wine list features wine from the best Australian wine producing regions and our staff are fully trained to help you in any way

NAME: Encasa Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Encasa means ‘’at home’’ in Spanish, which encapsulates our vision: to provide Sydney with real Spanish food. Real Spanish food, like you would find in the cafes and bars throughout Spain. Our tapas menu includes everybody’s favourites and our specials menu changes frequently. This site has been home to a Spanish restaurant for over 20 years. At Encasa Restaurant you’ll find a relaxed atmosphere that equally suits large group celebrations or an intimate dinner for two. Located just around the corner from the Capitol Theatre, it’s an excellent choice for a pre-theatre meal.

NAME: Bopp & Tone
DESCRIPTION: Bopp & Tone is a tribute to the Applejack founders' grandfathers. The venue reflects the nostalgic and optimistic post WW2 era they lived in. Embodying every day opulence and grandeur, it is lived-in luxury in style, with a welcoming and relaxed atmosphere. The Australian menu centres around honest and generous share food with Mediterranean influences.

NAME: Glass Brasserie
DESCRIPTION: Whether you come to dine with friends, family or a loved one, our restaurant is the perfect place to soak up Sydney’s vibrant atmosphere while dining on the finest Modern Australian cuisine.

NAME: Tapavino Tapas Bar
DESCRIPTION: A celebration of Sherry, Wine, Food, & Friends Influenced by the culture of sip-a-little-bit-of-this-and-eat-a-little-bit-of-that, Tapavino began in August 2012 as Australia's first Sherry Bar, in a little lane-way not unlike something you would find in the cobblestoned alleyways of Spain. Helped by the beautiful warm vibe that greets you as you step inside and take a seat among floor-to-ceiling wine bottles, Tapavino was named runner-up in Sydney Morning Herald's 'Best New Bar' Awards within 4-months of opening. 12-months later we were named 'Best Bar with Food'. Our endless pages of over 300 Spanish wines and 80 Sherries is an important component of our obsession of all things Spanish, and this reflects in our dedication of bringing the most exciting boutique and artisan wines from around Spain to the Australian Market

NAME: Capriccio Osteria & Bar
DESCRIPTION: "Fantastic, innovative, but definitely Italian food" is the perfect description of this brand new, fun and fresh Leichhardt space. Michele Rispoli, 3rd generation restaurateurs bring you casual, modern Italian at its best, courtesy of their vision and the skills of Chef Nicole Bampton (Ex lucio’s in Paddington ). Tuesday to Thursday from 4pm to late Friday to Sunday 12pm to late.

NAME: Macchiato Wood Fire Pizza & Coffee Roastery
DESCRIPTION: Italian restaurant, authentic woodfire pizzeria and in-house coffee roaster located in the heart of Sydney CBD.

NAME: Palmer & Co.
DESCRIPTION: Tucked down an alley and hidden underground, Palmer & Co. is a time warp to the era of prohibition with its bootleggers, sly-groggers and the like. The 1920s-style clandestine bar serves up an extensive menu of spirits and specially crafted cocktails using the finest seasonal ingredients.

NAME: Indu
GENERAL_LOCATION: Societe Generale House 350 George St, Societe Generale House, Basement Level, 2000

NAME: Brown Sugar Bondi
DESCRIPTION: A unique Bondi institution with a vibrant, welcoming ambience. Our philosophy is simple: we endeavor to bring a small slice of the Mediterranean to Bondi Beach with creative, ethical and seasonal menu offerings.

NAME: Elettropizza
DESCRIPTION: Pizza Restaurant & Italian eatery , located in the heart of Sydney, with large terrace overlooking the night lifestyle of Potts Point

NAME: Home Thai Restaurant
GENERAL_LOCATION: Shop 1 - 2 Shelley St, 299 Sussex Street, Sydney, 2000

NAME: Bay Hong
DESCRIPTION: Bay Hong Food+Wine is a Vietnamese Restaurant located on Oxford Street ,Darlinghurst SYDNEY - Cooking up our interpretation of Modern Vietnamese Cuisine served family-style in an Elegant Ambiance. Our in-house sommelier is proudly handpicked a boutique wine list to suit our cuisine, along with Vietnamese &local beers , as well as classic cocktails , last but definitely not least Our wonderful Staffs will make your Dining at Bay Hong Food+Wine a Memorable Experience.

NAME: Gunners' Barracks
DESCRIPTION: Nestled within the bushland of Georges Heights in Mosman, this superb historic location offers an experience of great food, friendly service & stunning Sydney Harbour views. Enjoy contemporary lunch menu or indulge in the tradition of one of Sydney's most revered high tea services, complete with an array of delectable delights, including sweet items, savoury pastries, finger sandwiches and home made scones. Open for a la carte lunches Monday to Friday (excluding public holidays) and High Tea Monday to Sunday. Gunners' Barracks is also one of Sydney's most loved wedding venues offering a captivating and intimate space for couples to host their reception and ceremony.
GENERAL_LOCATION: End of Suakin Drive, Georges Heights, 2088

NAME: The French Brasserie
DESCRIPTION: Instantly welcoming the French Brasserie offers a relaxing sanctuary at the top end of town. Soaring ceilings and vast glass expanses achieve a chic contemporary atmosphere while friendly attentive staff anticipates your every need.

NAME: Straight Outta Saigon
DESCRIPTION: Straight Outta Saigon brings you the best from the south of Vietnam. The newly renovated restaurant has a much similar ambiance to the sister restaurant Hochi Mama. The rustic-street vibe restaurant focuses on bringing the best from Saigon with a modern twist. Diners can expect to experience high-quality casual dining, a full range of cocktails inspired by tropical areas of Vietnam such as Nha Trang & Da Nang, great alcoholic fresh off the boat drinks inspired by our parents using ingredients such as Grass Jelly, Chia Seeds and Tea infused kombucha.

NAME: David's Master Pot (Elizabeth St - CBD)
DESCRIPTION: At David’s Spicy Pot, you can enjoy more including Sichuan ‘Mao Cai’ (either in spicy or non-spicy) as well as quite a few authentic Sichuan street foods. In order to bring you the most authentic Sichuan flavour, we prepare the ‘Mao Cai’ soup base by adopting a traditional Sichuan technique from Tianfu area in Chengdu, and using over 10 Chinese herbs boiled in bone broth.

NAME: Da Guido 365
DESCRIPTION: Our menu was drawn up with special focus on homemade pizza and pasta, which we prepare everyday using fresh natural ingredients. We use prime quality ingredients imported from Italy as well as select Australian products. To ensure genuine Italian taste and style, the dishes are exclusively prepared by Italian pizza makers and chefs trained in our restaurant in Italy.

NAME: Sezar
DESCRIPTION: Nestled down the small Melbourne Place laneway in Melbourne’s CBD, Sezar was opened in 2013 by Chef Garen Maskal and cousins Aret and Sasoon Arzadian. The restaurant continues to attract local foodies, corporate customers and international visitors in a friendly atmosphere. The menu is designed around Middle Eastern cuisine with modern twists, while simultaneously drawing influences from the owners’ heritage of Armenia. Open six days a week for lunch and dinner (except Saturday lunch), this bistro style restaurant is an ideal spot for weekday corporate lunches, a casual meal with friends or those wanting to treat themselves to a scrumptious banquet for group bookings, either downstairs in the main dining room or upstairs in a private area.

NAME: The Railway Club Hotel Steakhouse
DESCRIPTION: The Railway Club Hotel has remained one of the busiest dining rooms in Melbourne for over ten years. Its atmosphere and ambiance has stood the test of time. No pretence, just true Port Melbourne style. You can choose your own meat from our display fridge and see it cooked to perfection in our open kitchen. With such a commanding range of cuts and sizes we never disappoint. But it's not just all about the steaks. We are also famous for our seafood and expansive selection of specials. Try our chef's-own Cevapcici skinless sausages with olive tapenade, or our whole grilled flounder. Our busy traditional bar and restaurant is now complimented by our newly refurbished upstairs dining rooms that also cater for a variety of private dining needs. Restaurant Food Service Hours: Monday - Saturday: 12:00 - 15:00 / 17:45 - 21:00 Sunday: 12:00 - 21:00 Public Bar Food Service Hours: Monday - Friday: 12:00 - 15:00 / 18:00 - 21:00 Saturday - Sunday: 12:00 - 21:00

NAME: Geppetto Trattoria
DESCRIPTION: NOW OPEN FOR TAKE AWAYS OR ON UBEREATS! Established in 1981, Geppetto Trattoria is a family run restaurant that has been providing locals, regulars and new customers with passionate home-style Italian food ranging from fresh pasta, offal, seafood and slow cooked dishes such as Osso buco, Goat, Rabbit and pork belly, along with many options for those with a sweet tooth such as Pannacotta, tiramisu' and gelati. Our friendly staff will be able to assist you for any dietary requirements needed.

NAME: Rice Paper Scissors
DESCRIPTION: Rice Paper Scissors offers a punchy, share-style menu influenced by traditional South East Asian flavours. Guests will experience bold street food-inspired dining that showcases the very best in local produce. Indulge in our twice-cooked sticky pork belly, smothered in tamarind caramel or perhaps our sashimi grade, cured South Australian kingfish nestled on crisp prawn crackers. Rice Paper Scissors' mouth-watering menu is also partnered with signature cocktails, craft beers, and curated wines. Motivated by the excitable snapping of chopsticks and clinking of glassware. Rice Paper Scissors is a restaurant that prides itself on creating a space for guests to indulge in not only its menu but the company of others.

NAME: Tinto
DESCRIPTION: Spanish Restaurant & Wine Bar specializing in authentic Spanish. Tinto has a bar, a dining area as well as footpath eating and a small courtyard. One of the main features is its long Spanish style bar, perfect for a casual catch-up with friends or simply sitting by yourself. Have a chat over a ‘cerveza’ [beer] or ‘vino tinto’ while enjoying delicious tapas or raciones [larger plates], matched with a varied selection of Spanish and local Victorian wines and beers. The intimate dining area has a gas log fire and during the colder months provides warmth and a cozy ambience. An integral part of Tinto’s offering is the ‘jamonera’, like in most bars in Spain. It is the place where one of the world’s prized delicacies – ‘Jamon Iberico’ or air-dried ham is displayed and sliced on an old-fashioned flywheel slicer. Tinto provides an approachable, casual environment focusing on quality of wine and food.

NAME: Da Guido La Pasta
DESCRIPTION: Our menu was drawn up with special focus on homemade pasta, which we prepare every day using fresh natural ingredients. We use prime quality ingredients imported from Italy as well as select Australian products. To ensure genuine Venetian taste and style the dishes are exclusively prepared by Italian chefs trained in our restaurant in Italy.

NAME: Brick Lane Melbourne
DESCRIPTION: Brick Lane Melbourne is one of the best cafe/restaurant’s in Melbourne, well known for breakfast, brunch, lunch dishes. All Day breakfast

NAME: 11 Inch Pizza
DESCRIPTION: 11 Inch Pizza Melbourne CBD is the Melbourne CBD's newest gourmet pizza venue. Centrally located in the heart of Melbourne's CBD, 11 Inch is bringing fresh gourmet pizza to Melbourne's lunch and dinner scenes. With a wide variety of tasty offerings, 11 Inch Pizza brings you a creative range of breakfast offerings, gourmet pizzas, calzones, focaccias, crispy fresh salads and delicious desserts. Eat in, take-away or home and office delivery is available by ordering online now. Once your order is received, we will call you to confirm and let you know your classic 11 Inch-style pizza is in the oven, and soon to be on its way!

NAME: Kazuki's
DESCRIPTION: Kazuki's has relocated to Melbourne. Bringing the sensibility of his native Japan to a menu that sings with the best Australian produce, Chef Kazuki strives for balance and simplicity. A slow restaurant on a fast street, Kazuki’s is a place where flavours, service and interiors are harmonious — where new traditions are forged, and where delightful and restorative food encounters become nutrition for the soul.

NAME: Rice Paper Scissors Fitzroy
DESCRIPTION: Rice Paper Scissors offers a punchy, share-style menu influenced by traditional South East Asian flavours. Guests will experience bold street food-inspired dining that showcases the very best in local produce. Indulge in our twice-cooked sticky pork belly, smothered in tamarind caramel or perhaps our sashimi grade, cured South Australian kingfish nestled on crisp prawn crackers. Rice Paper Scissors' mouth-watering menu is also partnered with signature cocktails, craft beers, and curated wines. Motivated by the excitable snapping of chopsticks and clinking of glassware. Rice Paper Scissors is a restaurant that prides itself on creating a space for guests to indulge in not only its menu but the company of others.

NAME: El Rincon
DESCRIPTION: El Rincón is an Authentic Spanish Tapas Venue located in the heart of the Queen Victoria Market, Melbourne CBD. We are open on market days and weekends, catering for breakfast, lunch, dinner and everything in between! We have a large range of premium Spanish & Australian wines & create traditional Spanish meals and tapas that will take you back to the streets of Southern Spain. Our Philosophy is to give our patrons a true Spanish experience with our welcoming hospitality and our love for authentic Spanish cuisine. We are an intimate space that encourages the celebration of gatherings, food and wine. So, gather your family, friends and colleagues and come and celebrate your love for life. Enjoy the Taste of Spain!
GENERAL_LOCATION: 69 Victoria Street, Adjacent to the Queen Victoria Markets, 3000

NAME: 1932 Cafe & Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: 1932 Cafe & Restaurant is located in the arcade of one of Melbourne’s most loved architectural icons – the Manchester Unity Building. The cafe is an art deco inspired destination and the restaurant’s 1930 era décor showcases the history of the building itself. Fully licensed and open Monday to Friday from 7am until 3pm, 1932 Cafe & Restaurant offers a seasonal breakfast menu and fresh gourmet sandwich bar, along with sumptuous cakes and coffee in keeping with the Melbourne Café scene.

NAME: Rare Steakhouse Midtown
DESCRIPTION: Savour the flavour of Australian beef at its very best at Rare Steakhouse Midtown on Goldie Place in the heart of Melbourne's bustling CBD. Worn exposed brick walls create a rustic ambiance while oak barrels and suspended circular globe lights emit a cosy glow, ideal for intimate dinners along with after work drinks with friends. Each cut of beef on the menu is chosen for its distinct characteristics, flavour profile and eating quality such as Angus Beef spare ribs with chips, mashed potato or garden salad; or perhaps tuck into a grain fed Scotch fillet with red wine jus. Don't eat meat? No worries, how about slow cooked chicken Maryland with lemon, tomato and spinach risotto, or a vegetarian house-made gnocchi; finish indulgently with a divine dessert tasting plate.

NAME: The Grain Store
DESCRIPTION: Welcome. Come inside. For within these walls, good food is more than something we serve up on a plate. It’s a way of life.

NAME: Piccolo Mondo
DESCRIPTION: This iconic Italian restaurant was established in 1980. Inspired by traditional Italian home style cooking, Piccolo Mondo offers a delicious range of home made pasta, freshly caught seafood, a great selection of steaks, chicken and veal. Piccolo Mondo also offers a large variety of vegetarian, gluten free and vegan options. An upstairs function room is available for any occasion and balcony overlooking busy Lygon Street. Piccolo Mondo will not disappoint.

NAME: Delhi Streets Indian Street Food
DESCRIPTION: It's not just food at Delhi Streets, it's a spectacle as well. With the authentic flavours of Indian street food and the vibrant energy of the markets, Delhi Streets brings a new delicious dining experience, sure to surprise and excite the senses. In India, families don't go to restaurants for dinner, instead they say to each other, "Chai pani" - "Let's go out to eat,' and to the markets they will go. Rather than just a few dishes, one meal is made up from a bevy of delicious options, from savoury snacks and filling roti's, to sweet Gulam Jamun, one meal consisting of many items. At Delhi Streets, we're taking just some of our favourites and bringing the experience to Melbourne in it's entirety, with traditional flavours and all the flair. India lives and eats on its streets, and our cooking and energy pays homage to that, bringing the flavours that we miss from our hometown to our new home to share. Have a snack, or eat a full meal, but just give it a go!

NAME: Coda
DESCRIPTION: Upon opening our doors in 2009, we were thrilled to receive the The Age Good Food Guide's 'HatAward' and have maintained it ever since. Complementing these achievements, we are very proud of Head Sommelier, Travis Howe, who not only won Sommelier of the Year but also picked up the 2013 Wine List of the Year. Nestled in one of Melbourne's iconic laneways (basement Oliver Lane, and Flinders Lane), Coda is located in the busiest and most dynamic culinary precinct the city has to offer. A stone's throw away from the Yarra River, Flinders Street station and Federation Square, the restaurant enjoys hosting a diverse group of diners from frequenting locals who live and work on its doorstep to diners from all over the globe. Upon entering the restaurant you will be greeted by a member of our friendly team headed by Mykal and Kate Bartholomew and Executive Chef Adam D'Sylva. The trio has assembled a dedicated team with highly sought-after experience from many international and Melbourne-based restaurants. Coda's relaxed environment provides a versatile setting for a range of engagements. Whatever your occasion - from a quick pre-football meal, to a long Sunday lunch, business dining or a cosy seat for an anniversary - we look forward to your visit. While bookings are highly recommended, patrons without a reservation can enjoy the full menu at the bar.

NAME: Donovans
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Donovans - our ‘house on the beach’ and home we love to share. Donovans is located on the St.Kilda beach front offering guests a memorable dining experience in Melbourne. With a bay side view, beautiful mediterranean inspired food and the special relaxed atmosphere of the restaurant, Donovans is where you will feel at home.

NAME: Afternoon Tea at The Hotel Windsor
DESCRIPTION: Come partake in Melbourne's longest-running Afternoon Tea, with Champagne, silver stands of sandwiches, scones, canapes and beautiful desserts, and specialty tea - a ritual since 1883. Afternoon Tea is set in our historic dining room, One Eleven, and celebrations - from birthdays to anniversaries, bridal showers and weddings - are welcome.

NAME: Vivace
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Vivace. Our Suburban Italian restaurant (established in 2004) has a very classy and warm atmosphere, with soft and intimate lighting. Professional staff members are knowledgeable about the menu and wine list, and offer a non-intrusive level of service at all times. The tantalising menu ranges from fresh seafood to quality meat, with specials that change daily to keep regular diners happy.

NAME: Chocolate Buddha
DESCRIPTION: CHOCOLATE BUDDHA has REOPENED with an AMAZING NEW Refurbishment. Right in the heart of Federation Square with some of Melbourne's most impressive views, Chocolate Buddha is a Japanese casual dining experience. We have a sushi train and express train that currently operates Wednesday to Sunday 12-3pm. The restaurant menu consists of sushi, sharing dishes, Ramen, Donburi & Bento. We cater for vegetarians and have a substantial gluten free friendly section on our menu. We offer 3 set menus and our menus can be viewed on our website. We hope to see you. soon.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Cnr. Flinders & Swanston Street, Federation Square, 3000

NAME: Bistrot d'Orsay
DESCRIPTION: Bistrot d'Orsay has been situated in picturesque Collins Street for 20 years, in an area regarded as the ‘Paris End’. The interior is instantly evocative of the French capital with trompe l’oeil ceiling and a towering vintage French poster adorning the dining room. Dark wood paneling and soft lighting completes the picture. Lunch and dinner menus are provençal Mediterranean with French bistro classics such as bouillabaisse and crème brûlée all prepared with flair. Dishes such as seafood linguini and risotto complement the Mediterranean style. With a spectacular view of the ornate Regent Theatre directly opposite, Bistrot d’Orsay can lay claim to one of the best views of any restaurant in Melbourne. The bistro has a multi-award winning, extensive wine list with expertly chosen selections from the best international and Australian/NZ regions.

NAME: Amiconi
GENERAL_LOCATION: 359 Victoria St, Locality is West Melbourne, 3003

NAME: Straits Cafe Melbourne
DESCRIPTION: Straits Cafe offers authentic international cuisine that showcases the finest local and organic produce. Enjoy a meal made with fresh seasonal ingredients, complemented by the restaurant's refined ambiance. The friendly staff at our restaurant in Melbourne city center will be happy to help you pair your food with a fine Australian or international wine from our extensive wine list.

NAME: pastuso
DESCRIPTION: The thrilling food of Peru by Chef Alejandro Saravia, including a ceviche bar, parrilla and pisco bar.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 19 Acdc Lane, Off Flinders Lane Between Collins St and Exhibition St, 3000

NAME: Movida Bar de Tapas
DESCRIPTION: The first restaurant to ignite Melbourne’s obsession with tapas, sharing plates, and venues tucked away down graffiti-scrawled laneways, MoVida Original stands proud in Hosier Lane as a stalwart Melbourne icon. Whether it's from the bustling dining room or the front row seat of the bar, Original has been offering the same things since it opened its doors in 2003: great food, killer booze and, most importantly, a sense of theatre and fun.

NAME: Taxi Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: For a 180 degree view of Melbourne's city skyline, Yarra River and Arts Precinct, journey to Taxi Kitchen in Federation Square's Transport Hotel. Hosting cocktail events, a la carte dining, pre-show drinks and boasting three private function dining rooms, Taxi Kitchen dazzles guests with views through floor to ceiling louvered glass windows complemented by earthy tones, indoor greenery and natural light for a clean, semi-alfresco feel. Playful menu items provoke a certain inquisitiveness of guests, charmingly presented on a bed of black pebbles, rustic wooden boards or in colourful, textured dishes. Delight in any or all six courses from seared scallops with red radish, smoked chilli mayo and katiafi to Wagyu porterhouse with creamed potato and jus gras - just be sure to leave room for dessert
GENERAL_LOCATION: Level 1, Federation Square, Flinders Street, Transport Hotel, 3000

NAME: MoVida Next Door
DESCRIPTION: Bustling, electric and rustic, Next Door is where you can pop in for a bowl of clams, some chargrilled occy and a swift couple of Manzanillas before or after a show, and easily imagine you're in a bar in Jerez.

NAME: Auction Rooms
DESCRIPTION: Influential Melbourne cafe of 10+ years with a focus on specialty coffee and seasonal, breakfast-focussed dishes, as well as hearty lunch fare . We also carry a large range of Australian beers, wine, and spirits, and our beautiful venue - inside of what was once an auction house - is available for functions big and small.

NAME: Rare Steakhouse Downtown
DESCRIPTION: We are committed to serving premium quality produce and creating a welcoming environment where customers can savour the flavour of Australian beef at its very best. Our beef is sourced from across the country, ranging from Gippsland and Ballan in Victoria, Murray Bridge in South Australia and Rockhampton in Queensland, and is graded by Meat Standards of Australia for its cut and quality. Each cut is chosen for its distinct characteristics, flavour profile and eating quality, as well as its impact on the environment. Learn more about the different cuts of beef and sustainable farming practices.

NAME: Tonka
DESCRIPTION: Tonka is a modern Indian restaurant just off Flinders Lane, down one of Melbourne’s iconic laneways, Duckboard Place. At Tonka we celebrate the vibrancy of Indian flavours complimented by our award winning wine list. Delivered by our experienced and passionate team. Tonka opened in 2013 and is the proud sister to Coda restaurant, a short walk away. Since their inception, both restaurants have received the Age Good Food Guide’s ‘Hat Award’ every year. While bookings are highly recommended we also have an area available for walk-in patrons. For those looking for a cocktail and a relaxed meal we have a substantial menu in our bar, Thali.

NAME: Cargo Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Cargo is a lively all-day eatery and beer garden located in the heart of NewQuay, Docklands between Marvel Stadium & the Bolte Bridge.

NAME: +39 Pizzeria
DESCRIPTION: +39 Is The International Dialling Code For Italy And A Thread Back To Everything We’re Inspired By Started By Six Friends Who Have Their Stomachs In Melbourne But Their Hearts In Naples — We’ve Been Sharing Pizza, Fighting Over The Last Bite Of Lasagna And Spilling Wine All Over The Table For Years. We Miss Our Nonna’s, So We’re Often Calling Home. Hours Have Been Spent On The Phone Scribbling Down Recipes, Reminiscing Over The Long Nights And Talking About Our Love For Italia. +39 Pizzeria Is Born From That Love. An Ode To The Pizzaiolo Of Naples, The Boys Riding Vespas Down Cobbled Alleyways, And To Our Nonna’s Who Would Whack Our Cheeky Backsides With Wooden Spoons And Then Feed Us Bowls Of Pasta.

NAME: MoVida Aqui
DESCRIPTION: Away from the mania of Hosier Lane, nestled next to the dome of the Supreme Court, sits MoVida Aqui. Not lacking the intimacy of the laneway venues, but with a lot more space for larger groups, Aqui has a private dining room for special events and one of the best outdoor terraces in the city to enjoy dinner and an icy cold bottle of Moritz over the warmer months.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Nab Building, 1 500 Bourke St, NAB Building, 3000

NAME: Rare Steakhouse Uptown
DESCRIPTION: Committed to serving premium quality produce in a welcoming environment, our beef is sourced from across the country from Gippsland to Rockhampton and is graded by Meat Standards of Australia for its cut and quality - Come experience premium beef, basted and grilled to perfection, at three steak restaurants in Melbourne's CBD.

NAME: Vue De Monde
DESCRIPTION: Vue de monde is a testament to the belief that dining can be a wondrous and unforgettable experience. The ever-changing chef’s menu pays homage to classical fine dining in a modern context by exploring the beauty of native Australian ingredients. While in the past the menu looked to Europe for inspiration, Executive Chef Hugh Allen continues to celebrate the unparalleled quality of home-grown produce with thoughtfully considered dishes committed to seasonality and locality. Vue de monde has been synonymous with Melbourne dining for almost 20 years, continuing to present an exciting and dynamic experience with a progression of flavours and sense of curiosity. The whimsical spirit at the heart of the Vue de monde menu has not been lost throughout the years, with the lighter-handed and more natural approach to cooking being no less infused with theatre.

NAME: Punch Lane
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1995, Punch Lane is a Melbourne dining icon and a pioneer amongst its laneway counterparts. Punch Lane is a cosy and inclusive Wine Bar and restaurant, which prides itself on serving delicious food from a seasonal menu, mouth-watering cheeses from an eclectic board, matched with exceptional wine and service. Conveniently nestled along the northern section of Little Bourke Street, Punch Lane sits right in the heart of Melbourne’s entertainment and political district. Chinatown, Princess Theatre and Her Majesty’s Theatre are just minutes away by foot. Open five days a week, Punch Lane can cater for business lunches, after work drinks, group celebrations or intimate dinners for two. Simply want to relax and watch the world go by? Then pop in for a glass of wine and a yarn with Punch Lane’s friendly staff – the choice is yours!

NAME: Bowery to Williamsburg
DESCRIPTION: Since 2013, Bowery to Williamsburg (B2W) has combined the best of America in a refined style, and surroundings that Melbournians have come to expect. The classic New York City’s diner style joint is an homage to the NYC Bowery subway station. The venue can seat 60, with a large communal table inside and undercover cafeteria-style tables outside, as well as plenty of smaller cozy spots for something more private, weather it be for brunching, casual coffee sipping or for quickly scoffing a bagel before rushing off to your next destination. B2W is also available for your office catering needs.

NAME: Il Bacaro Cucina e Bar
GENERAL_LOCATION: 68-170 Little Collins St, 168-170 Little Collins St, 3000

NAME: Hochi Mama
DESCRIPTION: Hochi Mama has integrated itself in Melbourne’s top list of must-eat restaurants. We bring an innovative approach to Asian fusion cuisine, and our commitment to reinventing the classics – we strive to create an unforgettable dining experience for all. Picture fluffy baos filled with our crowd-favoured Hochi Fried Chicken, the explosion of flavour filling our signature Southside Curry or Mama’s spicy Salmon Sashimi. But we are not bound by our culinary expertise. With a keen focus on visuals, music and the lively nature of our team, we stimulate of all of your senses.

NAME: Longrain
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Longrain, Melbourne. Our menu brings together South East Asian influences with the best Victorian produce. Inspired by the communal eating philosophy of the Asian table, our menu is made up of dishes created for sharing. Large servings and communal tables encourage the spirit of eating together, so you can try each dish as part of a full tasting experience, just as it was intended. The wine and cocktail list is created to work in harmony with the menu's intense and aromatic flavours.

NAME: Giro d'Italia
DESCRIPTION: Beautiful ambience with spacious dining and great atmosphere, Giro D'Italia brings to your table the most succulent recipes from all the regions of Italy.

NAME: Bouzy Rouge
DESCRIPTION: Bouzy Rouge Richmond, Mediterranean inspired cuisine. We have an extensive tapas and main course menu designed to share.Extensive wine list. Express lunch Monday to Friday $20. With a Private function space upstairs and all weather courtyard, we cater for small intimate dinners to large canape functions. Happy Hour 7 days a week 4:30pm to 6:30pm. Come join us for your next lunch or dinner.

NAME: Lucy Liu Kitchen and Bar
DESCRIPTION: Lucy Liu Kitchen & Bar is an eclectic multicultural Asian eating & drinking space designed to cater for people wanting Asian sharing tastes with cool drinks in a buzzing, stylish and fun street food environment.

NAME: Red Spice Road
DESCRIPTION: Red Spice Road is back, and bookings are now live! We look forward to hosting you soon at this iconic Melbourne restaurant.

NAME: Sud Food and Wine
DESCRIPTION: SUD is an intimate 45 seat Italian restaurant situated at 219 King street Melbourne This small upmarket restaurant on King st (between Lonsdale and Little Bourke) not only boasts fantastic seasonal produce, allowing the menu to constantly evolve daily but also an extensively dynamic wine list to compliment any meal, hailing from various regions of Italy as well as carefully sourced local producers. SUD frequently caters to a corporate clientele as the quiet, warmly lit ambiance promotes a comfortable familiar atmosphere.

NAME: B'Churrasco Brazilian BBQ
DESCRIPTION: We serve Brazilian BBQ in a heritage building, place conveniently located in Melbourne CBD. Experience 12 different cuts of meat, served and carved tableside all done with the best of Brazilian hospitality.

NAME: Railway Hotel
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to the Railway Hotel, where quality food, beer and wine has been served since 1856. Enjoy a meal 6 days a week, in Melbourne’s premier courtyard (beer garden), or cozy up by one of our three fire places.

NAME: Matteo's
DESCRIPTION: Housed in an elegant triple-fronted Victorian terrace,past the bohemian enclave of Melbourne’s famous ‘Brunswick Street’offering seasonal contemporary Australian cuisine and professional hospitality since 1994. Awarded a minimum of 1 hat in the coveted “Age Good Food Guide” every year since 1996.

1806 is Melbourne’s most unique, full service, cocktail bar. Combining “prohibition-era” decor, and quirky, insightful staff, with a repertoire of classic cocktails to please everyone from the casual patron to the connoisseur, 1806 is an experience like no other.

NAME: Squires Loft South Yarra
DESCRIPTION: Squires Loft, - South Yarra Online Orders at http://squiresloft.com.au/menu/ The Steak Specialists, have proudly been serving steaks for over 25 years. The corner stone of our success is our proprietary sauces and baste, custom built grills allowing for a unique cooking process that creates an incredible taste profile. Most importantly our top quality beef is primarily sourced from the Western District of Victoria and the lush pastures of Gippsland, renowned for producing premium grass fed beef excelling in taste and tenderness. We have over 15 steakhouse restaurants in Australia Squires Loft has a dedicated production facility making all our proprietary food products to the highest standard. Many of our products are Gluten Free including meats,baste and sauces.

NAME: Claypots Seafood Bar
DESCRIPTION: Take away meals and local home delivery while we're in lock down. Our current trading hours are 12pm until 9pm, Wednesday to Sunday. Call us to chat about what you'd like to eat xx

NAME: Philippe
DESCRIPTION: Philippe Mouchel Rated as one of the world's finest French Chefs, undertaking his apprenticeship at Hotel Le Grand Cerf, Evreux, Philippe Mouchel began his career at the age of 16 and recently opened 'Philippe' in Melbourne. Philippe is a contemporary French bistro, which showcases traditional yet innovative French cooking with high quality seasonal produce serving refined dishes at an affordable casual dining experience. In recognition of his significant contribution to the Victorian culinary scene, Philippe was named Chef of the year at the 2011 Savour AustraliaTM Restaurant Catering Awards for Excellence, along with the Vittoria Legends Award from The Age Good Food Guide in 2012

NAME: Fiorelli
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1991, Fiorelli has cemented a reputation for consistency, quality and service. Italian and Mediterranean flavours and authentic cooking techniques have formulated a versatile and universally approachable menu. We are open 7 days for lunch, dinner and drinks. Our reputation for great food fast means you can visit pre or post theater, catch your show and relax for supper afterwards. Catering for locals, businesses and movie goers. We hope to see you soon. Cheers!

NAME: Ahi.
DESCRIPTION: Ahi. strives to deliver the best, freshest New Zealand dining experience, right in the heart of Downtown Auckland.

NAME: Blitza
DESCRIPTION: Blitza pizza and pasta restaurant serving meditteranean and Italian. We do takeaways and Dine in. Our Gourmet pizzas are our specialty but we serve beautiful top quality steak, Pasta, Seafood and many other meditteranean dishes

NAME: The Heke Waiheke
DESCRIPTION: Four acres of beautiful gardens surround The 'HEKE. The 'brand home' of Waiheke Brewing Co. and award-winning Waiheke Whisky. You'll find our luxe and peaceful Tasting Room, and a vibrant and relaxed restaurant where our chefs prepare your food over glowing wood fires. Alongside is a spectacular new brewery, distillery. The 'HEKE is the home for our growing craft distillery and craft brewery on Waiheke Island. Visit us to experience The 'HEKE. Tasting Flights and our artworks in the garden. Sit under a tree, or a long VIP table, or just prop yourself up at the bar and have a chat. Our knowledgable team can take you right through the distilling and brewing process.

NAME: Everest Dine
DESCRIPTION: Nepalese and Indian restaurant in Parnell with warmest Nepalese hospitality. Climbing Everest isn't on everyone's bucket list, but eating at Everest Dine should be!

NAME: XOONG
DESCRIPTION: Fun fusion a mix of Japanese & Chinese cuisine XOONG, the newest addition to Auckland’s thriving hospitality hub of Mt Eden Village offers diners contrasting flavours of Asia in a series of captivating dining rooms. Drawing from North East Asian influences, one is immersed into the bold and textural design of the 150 seat restaurant. Over two stories diners will find intimate spaces and secluded dining areas juxtaposed by minimalist Japanese and intricate Chinese designs. Opposite the cocktail bar a canopy of dramatic red lanterns leads you past the open kitchen and chef tables to the courtyard, offering guests a delightful journey of discovery. China and Japan make strange bedfellows as their tumultuous history would tell us and this dramatic past is the inspiration for the restaurant. Xoong beautifully marries this theme with the ever-popular aromas of a Vietnamese kitchen simultaneously tying the styles together and creating a menu of big flavours that is unmistakably unique.

NAME: Oh Calcutta
DESCRIPTION: When you google us or check out our Facebook page you will discover we have a cult following, not because we are the coolest but because we consistently offer personal service of the highest standard and create mouth-watering, time-honoured family recipe dishes, made with passion and humble, honest flavours. This is not made-to-measure cooking. This is cooking from the heart. So much so, that our chefs instinctively know when a dish is just right; how it should feel, how it should taste, how it should look. Indeed an art and its entertainment, so we showcase this spice-dance for you with our glass kitchen. Our target was to offer authentic rustic Indian food from a unique part of India; this is not just food, these are memories of my childhood. Our outlook on life is simple, why waste time with bad food and bad company? We are locals, we love serving food lovers and we love to share our passion.

NAME: Mulan Malaysian Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Mulan Malaysian located in historic building and serve Chef's traditional home cooked style food, Penang Malaysia. Mix culture in the family Indian, Chinese and Eurasian. Melting pot of flavors , fresh ingredients from local produce served to the table.

NAME: Paris Butter
DESCRIPTION: Paris Butter is the new wave of fine dining with an emphasis on what is on the plate and how it is delivered. Chef Nick Honeyman, Chef Zennon Wijlens and their team create innovative and interpretive modern New Zealand cuisine, adapted to New Zealand ingredients and its culture of food.

NAME: Culprit.
DESCRIPTION: Culprit serves nostalgic kiwi cuisine with a modern global edge. We offer chefs choice menus that hero local suppliers. Owner & Chef Kyle Street creates playful dishes that are innovative and big on flavour, often with a nod to his New Zealand upbringing.

NAME: One Tree Grill
DESCRIPTION: Outstanding cellared wines, innovative cuisine, thoroughly professional service - as one of Auckland's favourite local restaurants, One Tree Grill offers a complete dining experience.

NAME: The Grove
DESCRIPTION: Fine dining restaurant in the heart of Auckland city, serving a degustation menu of modern New Zealand cuisine

NAME: Gerome Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Our philosophy is that food is reflective of many elements - a way of thinking, a view into someone's culture and the nostalgia of one's upbringing. The food at 'gerome' is indicative of this - approachable yet contemporary. Join us on a unique culinary journey...

NAME: Tokyo Bay
DESCRIPTION: Tokyo Bay is located beachside, on Auckland's famous Takapuna Beach. Our Japanese team serve modern, not fusion, Japanese cuisine, of the highest standard.

NAME: Poderi Crisci
DESCRIPTION: WelcomePoderi Crisci Vineyard and Winery, set in a stunning amphitheatre surrounded by vines and olive trees, has fast become the quintessence of what in Italy is called: Agroturismo. Located 30 minutes from Matiatia in Awaawaroa Bay, Poderi Crisci occupies 7.7 hectares of north-facing slopes in the heart of Waiheke’s unique wine growing microclimate. The narrow rocky strip underlying Poderi Crisci is believed to be 30 million years older than the rest of the Island, boasting soil criss-crossed with mineralised veins. For four generations the Crisci family has been immersed in food and wine, Antonio born and raised in Napoli came to NZ in early 1990 and established Toto Restaurant in Nelson Street . With his partner Vivienne Farnell they opened Non Solo Pizza, an institution in Parnell in 1997 and Bar Vino in 2009.

NAME: Sails Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Sails Restaurant has an amazing location. Set in the middle of Westhaven Marina, beside the Harbour Bridge, with breathtaking views of the harbour. There are few views in the world that capture the essence of the city than the one from Sails Restaurant. A couple of minutes from the centre of Auckland, yet in a world of its own, with unlimited free parking at the door, Sails Restaurant is not just about its location. Over the last three decades the restaurant has forged its reputation as one of New Zealand’s top restaurants through an uncompromising belief in using only the freshest ingredients, the most talented chefs, and professional waiting staff. The menu at Sails is seafood focused, but also includes New Zealand’s finest beef and lamb. The full menu and all the details can be found on our website.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 103-113 Westhaven Drive - Westhaven Marina, St Mary's Bay, 1011

NAME: Casita Miro
DESCRIPTION: Casita Miro specialises in the cuisine of Spain and the wider Mediterranean Rim and take enormous pleasure in sharing our love for fine food, wine and sherry. Casita Miro is all about shared dining and our 'tapas' and 'raciones' (large plates) are perfect for a fun, relaxed and social dining experience. This year, Casita Miro was once again included in the acclaimed list of the Top 50 Auckland Restaurants in the Metro Magazine Restaurant of the Year Awards! In the past Casita Miro has been winner or runner up in this 'Best Destination Restaurant' category of Metro Magazine's Top 50 Auckland Restaurants. In addition, proprietor Cat Vosper won the title of 'Restaurant Personality of the Year' in 2011. Cat was also a finalist in the Lewisham Foundation's 'Outstanding Restaurateur' category 2013.

NAME: Kazuya
DESCRIPTION: We are a unique European Japanese fusion fine dining in Auckland.

NAME: Bushmans Grill
DESCRIPTION: Bushman's Grill is a Steakhouse with an effervescent African atmosphere. We pride ourselves in serving consistently excellent Steaks, a wild Peri Peri Chicken and the best Spare Ribs in Auckland. We are also Children friendly.

NAME: Hello Beasty
DESCRIPTION: Contemporary NZ fusion cuisine, inspired by the cuisines of Japan, Korea and China. Relaxed all day dining on Auckland's Viaduct Harbour. Open every day from 12pm.

NAME: Tantalus Estate Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Tantalus Estate is a family owned, premium vineyard destination located in the heart of Onetangi Valley, Waiheke Island. Established in 2016, the award-winning Estate is an iconic location for world-class cuisine, wine tasting, craft beer, weddings, events and special occasions. 'Best Destination Restaurant - 2022' Metro Magazine Situated on 20 acres of vineyards, olive and macadamia groves, beehives, and native wetlands; the Estate is also home to its own winery and craft brewery both featuring leading-edge technology and best practice sustainability.

NAME: Sid at The French Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Sid at The French Cafe is a fine dining restaurant in Auckland City offering the very best in food, wine and service.

NAME: Cooke's
DESCRIPTION: Located in Fable Auckland, Cooke's Restaurant & Bar pays homage to the famed eatery of the same name which first occupied the Windsor House building in 1928. Immerse yourself in the opulent art deco surroundings as you enjoy carefully crafted dishes. With a strong focus on nourishing wholefoods, the menu also features signature dishes that put a modern twist

NAME: Blue Elephant Thai Restaurant Parnell
DESCRIPTION: Auckland's taste sensation in a warm cosy atmosphere with great service. Whether for a romantic dinner or lunch, a catch up with friends or family or for business entertainment, we can cater for your needs. With seating capacity maxing out at around 40 to 50 (depending on seating arrangements), it is advisable to make a telephone reservation. The restaurant also offers great wines, cocktails, beers and a nice selection of teas. Open 6 nights (closed Mondays & public holidays)

NAME: Beast & Butterflies Auckland
DESCRIPTION: Located within M Social Auckland, Beast & Butterflies is a casual all-day dining destination complete with an outdoor terrace. The tantalising menu features exotic flavours from the Pacific Rim with Asian street food influences, including dishes that showcase the region's best fresh seafood.

NAME: Rothko at Sculptureum
DESCRIPTION: Led by Head Chef Josh Hazel, Rothko's team crafts each menu using the freshest seasonal ingredients to deliver tasty, interesting dishes that celebrate local produce and suppliers. One of Matakana’s top 3 restaurants (Tripadvisor 2021) and voted a Metro Top 50 Restaurant in Auckland 2019, Rothko at Sculptureum provides a relaxed dining experience with attentive service in a spacious country setting.

NAME: Mekong Baby
DESCRIPTION: Mekong Baby takes diners on an adventurous tour down the Mekong River, offering sophisticated, authentic Southeast Asian flavours and a mixology of spices. Every dish has unique, intensified flavour profiles and is made from absolutely the freshest produce.

NAME: Vivace
DESCRIPTION: Vivace Restaurant and Bar is one of the best inner city restaurants Auckland has to offer and has been consistent over the last 30 years. The environment is lively & offers a warm ambience with excellent table service, a superb wine list and a menu which caters to diverse palates. Vivace’s food is unmistakably Mediterranean. We offer a full al-a-carte menu and for those wanting a more casual approach to eating, tapas are available throughout the day. There is a separate vegan menu and a large proportion of the menu is suitable for Coeliacs. Off to one side (& hidden by large barn doors) is a small discreet bar reminiscent of the Speakeasies of old - perfect for a casual drink & nibble pre show or after work. Full table service & the whole menu are available in the bar at the high top tables. The wine selection is extensive with 30 by the glass & there is a good selection of spirits, craft beers & cocktails. Bookings suggested on Friday & Saturdays however walk ins are welcome

NAME: Cassia @ Skycity
DESCRIPTION: Cassia is a modern Indian restaurant by award winning Chef Sid Sahrawat. A la carte and tasting menus available.

NAME: MASU by Nic Watt
DESCRIPTION: "A passion for flavour and dedication to detail" Welcome to MASU, the exciting Japanese robata restaurant and bar located in the Federal Street dining precinct. MASU brings atmosphere, passion and a contemporary twist to the traditional robata style of cooking over an open charcoal grill. My philosophy is simple - use fresh local ingredients, enhance the natural flavours of each dish and let the food speak for itself. This pure approach to cuisine is reflected in our clean, natural decor. Add to this a lively, informal atmosphere and you have a beautifully bold and dramatically different style of Japanese dining in the heart of Auckland. Nic Watt

NAME: Tony's Steak & Seafood Restaurant & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Auckland's original steakhouse, serving great steaks for over nearly 60 years. An Auckland icon loved by locals and tourists alike, if you are looking for a good meal in a cosy environment then Tony's Wellesley Street is the spot for you. In the heart of the city, close to the central city theatres, hotels and casino, Tony's is the perfect spot for a meal before a show or after a big day exploring the city. For a taste of NZ stop in and say hi... Don't you deserve a Tony's experience?

NAME: Cibo
GENERAL_LOCATION: Axis Building 91 St Georges Bay Road, Parnell, 1052

NAME: Le Garde-Manger
GENERAL_LOCATION: 466 Queen Street, 466 Queen Street, Auckland, North Island, 1010

NAME: Sidart
DESCRIPTION: Sidart Restaurant is an award winning fine dining restaurant located in the Three Lamps Plaza, 283 Ponsonby Road, Ponsonby, Auckland. We are open Tuesday to Saturday for dinner from 6pm and Saturday's for lunch. We are closed on Sundays and Mondays.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Level 1 Lamps Plaza, 3 283 Ponsonby Road, Ponsonby, 1011

NAME: Ship & Anchor
DESCRIPTION: Situated at the heart of Orewa Beach, We have a great variety of Food & Beverages, all cooked in our own unique style we specialize in fresh seafood and steak. Bring the family along and enjoy our hospitality.

NAME: Scarecrow
DESCRIPTION: Scarecrow is a unique cafe/restaurant - it's like an urban farmers market, contemporary kitchen and florist - celebrating the best of our region. We showcase the best seasonal produce from our region, by choosing to dine with us you are supporting small local food & beverage producers. There are always many vegan and vegetarian options available. We proudly serve Kokako organic fair-trade coffee.

NAME: Bracu Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: A space to savour Bracu Restaurant is a place where we share our life with others in the noblest of all traditions - through good friends, great company and even better food. In a nod to our Mediterranean roots, we believe that a meal should be an experience - an opportunity to share, to connect, and most importantly, to create memories. It’s this ethos that Bracu’s award-winning restaurant was founded upon. Please note, our restaurant closes between lunch and dinner service. Please call us to make a reservation.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Bombay, Auckland, New Zealand 49 Main Road RD 1, 2675

NAME: Depot Eatery & Oyster Bar
DESCRIPTION: The perfect place to drop in and refuel. It’s chef Al Brown’s place and reflects perfectly his attitude towards food: in season, beautifully cooked, to be enjoyed with friends. Order a selection of small plates and pass them round. Try the freshly shucked oysters. Then there’s the wine list – small, but perfectly formed, with many of Al’s top picks. Park yourself up.

NAME: Little Jimmy
DESCRIPTION: Brought to you by the same owners of One Tree Grill, Little Jimmy offers a completely different type of experience. Little Jimmy is a casual, down-to-earth bar & eatery where you can kick back and relax with friends, complete with an upstairs function space. It's a genuine local hangout serving some great tasting food and drinks including its own, ever-changing line of beer.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 557 Manukau Road, Corner of Manukau and Empire Roads, Epsom, 1023

NAME: Prego Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: outdoor dining, Take out available, Full menu all day and night.

NAME: Mudbrick Archive Bar and Bistro
