DESCRIPTION: The menu is more casual than at our flagship Mudbrick Restaurant. We take bookings but if we happen to be full, take a seat at the bar – or by the fire. We will come and get you when a table is ready.

NAME: Plume Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Situated just an hour's drive from Auckland or Whangarei, Plume, the vineyard restaurant, Matakana is a must visit destination on any Matakana wine or food journey - we believe we are all about fabulous local New Zealand wine and produce which together can celebrate "culinary diversity." Plume is a small town, rural, rustic restaurant with friendly service from locally employed staff. It is a great change from the starchy fine dining service of a big city like Auckland yet is in a class of its own. Our Vineyard is called Runner Duck Estate and we make superb wines like PInot Gris, Rose, Syrah, Red Blend (Bordeaux style) Sangiovese - now from the 14th of February 2019 ie Valentine's Day introducing our very own CHARDONNAY and ALBARINO! We also make a 100% non-alcoholic Grape Juice from our Syrah Grapes without any additives, preservatives or sugar! For those of you who do not wish to drink and drive we also have accomodation right next door to the restaurant!

NAME: Chikos Restaurant and Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Chikos Restaurant and Cafe is an exciting elegant casual dining restaurant located in West Auckland. Pacific Rim Fusion cuisine with New Zealand's finest and freshest produce complimented by friendly service in a warm inviting atmosphere in modern decor design with Japanese influences, surrounding an open kitchen allowing you to view the creation of tantalizing dishes in front of your eyes

NAME: Jervois Steak House
DESCRIPTION: “The steakhouse to end all arguments”The Jervois Steakhouse or JSH to its regulars opened in 2006 with a 5 star rating as New Zealand’s first premium steak restaurant and continues to exceed customer expectations. We could, as most web sites do, talk about ourselves in a very complimentary tone, but guess what - we are not the hero, the meat is.So here’s just a tipple of why customers love the Jervois experience:Steaks to die forSimply the bestFood heavenBest steakhouse in AustralasiaHighly recommended, highly anticipated and even more highly appreciated

NAME: Cafe Hanoi
DESCRIPTION: Café Hanoi is a modern Vietnamese restaurant housed within a heritage warehouse space in Britomart, the city’s oldest commercial district. The restaurant reflects our passion and respect for Vietnamese food and culture. Our menu offers authentic Hanoian street food that has made the city world famous, and other more modern dishes that pair traditional Northern Vietnamese cooking techniques with the best of New Zealand produce. We are very careful to choose ingredients that have been sourced with a deep respect for the environment.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Galway St & Commerce St, Conrner Galway Street & Commerce Street

NAME: Andiamo
DESCRIPTION: Andiamo has a Herne Bay provenance that spans three decades, and acts as an extension to the local’s dining rooms. A fresh and modern Italian-inspired menu showcasing seasonal ingredients at their best. Known for house made pastas, delectable tipples, and a bustling Jervois Road location, Andiamo — ‘let’s go’ in Italian — is your friendly local.

NAME: Cafe Midnight Express
DESCRIPTION: Found in 1989 in the heart of Auckland.Since then we have been providing the most famous Mediterranean and Turkish cuisines.

NAME: Brick Bay Glass House Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: The Glass House is the spectacular home of Brick Bay Wines and gateway to the Brick Bay Sculpture Trail. Cantilevered over a shimmering lake, The Glass House Kitchen offers relaxed all-day dining showcasing the freshest seasonal produce. Our passionate chefs create contemporary New Zealand cuisine, inspired by our farm produce, our orchards, gardens and other locally sourced ingredients. The tempting menu encompasses brunch, lunch, platters and small bites, while locally roasted coffee and irresistible sweets make the perfect morning or afternoon tea. From the magnificent transparency of The Glass House or our tranquil outdoor dining spaces, you can view the vineyard at close-hand, witnessing the individual care that underpins a small artisan vineyard. Taste our highly acclaimed range of handcrafted wines, alongside our estate grown olive oil and honey. We celebrate a classic Pinot Gris, a deliciously fruity Rose and distinctively complex red wines made from our Bordeaux varieties.

NAME: Volare Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Volare Italian Restaurant & Pizzeria strives to bring you the finest Italian cuisine in a relaxed and welcoming dining environment. We are open from 6pm till late, Tuesday to Sunday. Bookings are recommended so feel free to contact us at your convenience.

NAME: Wild Estate
DESCRIPTION: Wild Estate Vineyard is a contemporary boutique vineyard on Waiheke Island, with it's unique offering as Waiheke's ultimate Multi-Activity Experience. Also home of Waiheke Island Brewery & Wild on Waiheke Activities, this casual yet stylish restaurant features in & outdoor dining right amongst the vines. Enjoy modern New Zealand cuisine matched with our handcrafted beers while contemplating a sedate game of petanque. Alternately hit the tasting room for sampling in our cellar door with views over the pond and vineyard. It doesn't matter if you're on your own or with a large group - we cater to everyone. Being a multi-activity venue we provide a diverse range of fun outdoor activities (including archery, laser claybird shooting), a licensed restaurant and brewery, all set within the magic of a Waiheke vineyard. We cater to both small and large groups, corporate team building, Weddings, functions and meetings.

NAME: Goode Brothers NorthWest
GENERAL_LOCATION: Shop 5, Maki Street Massey, NorthWest Shopping Centre,

NAME: Orbit 360° Dining
DESCRIPTION: Soaring high above Auckland you'll discover Orbit, a truly iconic New Zealand brasserie offering diners sensational views - and food to match. Situated at the top of Auckland’s Sky Tower, the dining room rotates once every hour, providing a truly unique experience with amazing 360-degree panoramas of the city, the Hauraki Gulf and beyond Orbit offers a modern dining experience in a relaxed, open atmosphere with a delicious kiwi-inspired à la carte menu that features the best local and seasonal produce. As New Zealand’s only rotating restaurant offering 360-degree views, it’s an unforgettable experience that never ceases to delight.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Cnr Victoria and Federal Streets, Level 52, Sky Tower, 1010

NAME: The Oyster Inn
DESCRIPTION: We’re an award-winning beachside bistro with three gorgeous guest rooms. Situated on stunning Waiheke Island, The Inn’s perfectly located in the heart of Oneroa village, with gorgeous views across the bay. Whether you are settling in for a weekend lunch with friends, a night away, or simply a crisp glass of wine at the bar, we have just the spot for you. Since opening we've become a Waiheke institution, much-loved by the resident locals, our regular Auckland visitors and those visiting from further afield. Just a 35 minute ferry ride from downtown Auckland, there’s no traffic jams getting here. Book a table on our sunny verandah and happily sip away as you watch the world, and a few dolphins, go by. Open 12 noon until late...

NAME: Little Bird Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: A little birdie told us food should be three things: plant based , definitely organic and full of goodness. So here at little bird we do just that and with all that combined, the result is pure deliciousness. Organic foods are grown without harmful chemicals. No chemicals in the food means no chemicals in your food or environment. Goodness, because food should be good for you, packed with all the nutrition you need to feel fabulous. Goodness tastes good too. We are completely gluten and dairy free and proudly serve plant based menus that suit anybody really as well as vegans, vegetarians and healthy minded people looking for an easy way to include more goodness and nutrition in their diet.

NAME: Mudbrick Vineyard & Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Mudbrick is world-renowned for its superb restaurant and award-winning wines. With its spectacular sea views, French potager gardens and hand-hewn mud-brick buildings, the setting is "A must-see when visiting Auckland" (New York Times).

NAME: Dans Le Noir ?
DESCRIPTION: Dans le Noir ? Auckland - the "Dining in the Dark" experience at Grand Millennium Auckland, offers a unique sensory and human experience in complete darkness. Embark on an unforgettable culinary journey in the heart of Auckland!

NAME: DeBretts Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: Nestled in the heart of Hotel DeBrett, conveniently located within a couple of minutes’ walk from the Britomart, lower Queen Street and the iconic Auckland waterfront. DeBretts Kitchen is bathed in natural light from a soaring glass roofed atrium, serving simple, elegant food where menus are seasonal, creative and attuned to local produce. The restaurant is open for Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner, and its adjoining lounge offers continuous cafe and bar service throughout the day. Each weekend the restaurant transforms into a jazz joint when the 1920s-inspired high tea shimmies in, complete with Prohibition cocktails and faux pearls. For those looking to dine with friends and family, private dining spaces are available from an intimate table of 8 through to 32 guests. We look forward to welcoming you.

NAME: Al Forno
DESCRIPTION: Al Forno Italian Restaurant in Auckland serves traditional Italian dishes along with a excellent selection of wine, beer and non alcoholic beverages.

NAME: The Riverhead
DESCRIPTION: Dine on the deck this in summer with pleasant views overlooking the water. Our 'Landing Restaurant' offers delicious meals exceeding the expectations of a semi-rural tavern, served with iconic kiwi hospitality. Nestled on the shores of the upper Waitemata, The Riverhead is steeped in local history and was a vital part of the development of early New Zealand. Prior to The Riverhead being built on this site, Thomas Deacon, the original owner, owned a pub on the point just below where The Riverhead now stands. The early Maori used this landing point as the place to disembark and portage their waka across land to the Kumeu River to get easier access to the lands in the Far North. Early immigrants then used this same route to travel north, disembarking at Helensville and continuing by ship north via the Kaipara Harbour.

NAME: Giraffe Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Giraffe is a celebration of everything that makes New Zealand great. Homegrown is front and center, showcasing the finest local producers and growers our country has to offer. However, we're mature enough to recognise, that occasionally, the very best ingredients are from further afield. The spirit of innovation is captured in the preparation and presentation of deliciousness. We are uncompromising in our promise to surprise and delight every time. Most importantly we make every guest feel at home. Enjoy.

NAME: Tokyo Club
DESCRIPTION: Tokyo Club is located in the busy entertainment hub, Ponsonby Central. We are a Izakaya style dining bar, with great, freshly prepared Japanese cuisine. We are an authentic, licensed restaurant, like you would see in the yokocho alleys of Tokyo. No bookings taken.

NAME: Monsoon Poon Akl ltd
DESCRIPTION: South East Asian Restaurant & Bar Dishes from Malaysia, India, Thailand, China Great cocktails and an extensive range of wine and beer Vegan options and a good allergy menu
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2 Lower Hobson St., Corner of Lower Hobson ST and Customs St West, 1001

NAME: Safran Cafe Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Sokol and Astrit, 2 bestfriends since 1999, embarked on their culinary journey in 2007. Their shared love for the Mediterranean's culinary treasures brought Safran to life in the heart of Newmarket. Over the years, they've cultivated relationships with local suppliers, ensuring that their ingredients are of the finest quality, setting the stage for every remarkable dish. At Safran, we believe that dining is more than just food; it's an experience. Sokol and Astrit, with their warm and dedicated staff, are here to make every visit special, ensuring you experience the warmth and flavors of Italy and Spain. Sokol and Astrit, along with their head chef, Dan, bring the heart of the Mediterranean to every plate. With a dedicated team of culinary enthusiasts, they strive to create an unforgettable dining adventure. With 15 years of friendship and a commitment to authentic Mediterranean flavors, we welcome you to savor our unique blend of Italian and Spanish Cuisine.

NAME: Szimpla Gastro Bar
DESCRIPTION: Szimpla Gastro Bar is a new concept bar & restaurant located under the ibis budget Hotel at Auckland Airport, not far from Mangere Bridge, Manukau. A home away from home for visitors to New Zealand staying in neighbouring hotels and an exciting new social venue for members of the local business community and nearby suburbs. With its rustic Kiwi charm, top-notch hospitality, delicious grub and range of brews.

NAME: FISH Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Tomorrow’s Fish Are Still In The Sea FISH Restaurant, located on level 1 of Hilton Auckland, is perched at the end of Princess Wharf, 300 meters out to sea, with the most spectacular views out over Waitemata Harbour. FISH offers a casual fine dining experience with Waitemata Harbour as your backdrop. Focusing on ethically caught seafood, our menu is continuously changing to give you the opportunity to try the best of seasonality and sample dishes that reflect some of best produce that New Zealand has to offer.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Princes Wharf Quay Street, Hilton Auckland Hotel, 1010

NAME: Federal Delicatessen
DESCRIPTION: Drop in and sample deli life at its most authentic. Mull a while over a bottomless ‘cuppa’ Joe or a delicious cocktail and sample some of the classic New York Deli dishes. Fill your kishka - tablecloths are pointless as eating 'Deli' is a meal of spills. 'Remember to keep your fork – there's pie'

NAME: Hugo's Bistro
DESCRIPTION: Situated in the heart of Auckland's bustling cityscape, Hugo's Bistro marks the latest venture from Auckland restaurateurs, Clare & Joost van den Berg, positioning the all-day bistro as big brother to sister restaurant, Odettes Eatery. Open for Take-Away Coffee, Breakfast, Lunch, Drinks & Dinner from two menus, the Earlier and the Later.

NAME: Botswana Butchery - Auckland, NZ
DESCRIPTION: Botswana Butchery, one of Auckland's newest waterfront restaurant, combines premium produce, wine and local ingredients from the Auckland region with the best of what Central Otago can offer Located in the historic Ferry Building on Quay Street, Botswana Butchery brings a taste of the South to the heart of Auckland city. The restaurant offers lunch, dinner and bar menus in gorgeous surroundings. The ethos of 'fun dining' is key to Botswana Auckland, which is plush and wonderfully distinctive but also welcoming and fun. Botswana Butchery is all about relaxed, fun dining in a premium atmosphere. Botswana Butchery is well known in Central Otago with a restaurant in Queenstown and is highly regarded for providing sumptuous meals and superb service in opulent surroundings. Following its popular 'sister' restaurant, the Auckland restaurant produces fabulously flavoursome, succulent meals from the best local produce with high levels of service and attention to detail at every stage of its wine and food delivery. The restaurant seats approximately 120 guests inside and up to 40 on the terrace outside. Open from 11am until late, Botswana Butchery is the perfect option for an exciting new dining experience.

NAME: Passage Rock Wines
DESCRIPTION: Passage Rock Winery and Bistro is set among the vines on the Te Matuku estuary. Our Cellar door and restaurant is open Wednesday to Sunday 12 mid day til 4pm, In our relaxed environment you can enjoy our stunning range of excellent Waiheke wines with tasty freshly prepared food sourced locally. Our current menu has lots of tasty treats including cured salmon with wasabi snow. Duck breast fish of the day. Kids pizza. tomahawk steak with black garlic butter, lamb rack chimchuri fish of the day cooked over the embers in our wood fired oven. You are welcome here to come and relax and be spoiled in our little piece of Waiheke wine country paradise!

NAME: The Conservatory
DESCRIPTION: The award winning Conservatory bar and restaurant is the perfect blend between casual dining and drinking. Perfectly situated on the waters edge in the heart of the city, the ambience is fun, unpretentious and incredibly welcoming. As the worlds "first living bar", the green wall is the main feature with comfortable seating designed for you to relax all day and late into the night. Our delectable food is produced with local,free range and predominantly organic produce, with plates designed to share, from fresh seafood to salads, our infamous 18 inch pizzas, or our mouth watering mains. With vases of beer, a supreme selection of New Zealand wine and carefully designed cocktails, this truly is that place that suits every occasion. The Conservatory - it's about living
GENERAL_LOCATION: East 1 1-17 Jellicoe Street, North Wharf, Wynyard Quarter, 1010

NAME: Loire Bistro
GENERAL_LOCATION: Avenidas Das Américas, 8585, Loja Ss117 e Ss118 - Vogue Square - Barra Da Tijuca, Rio De Janeiro - Rj, 22793-081

NAME: Hachiko
DESCRIPTION: Located in a charming colonial-style building in the 15th-century Cultural Corridor, Hachiko is an invitation to the palate. Translation of the perfect symbiosis between contemporary cuisine and the ancient oriental cuisine, Hachiko awakens sensations with its innovative and diversified menu of mini tastings. Born Tanaka San in the year 1994, the restaurant gained new name and flavors two years later, under the command of Mauricio and Maria Helena Eskinasi. For more than a decade, the duo have been honored by Hachiko's signature innovation brand, which has made the restaurant a benchmark for oriental and contemporary cuisine. Its notorious menu, which sometimes bears the signature of renowned chefs, mixes Asian influences with creative Western touches, always accompanied by four essential elements of culinary art: harmony, tradition, wisdom and balance. Only in Hachiko do you know the true flavor of contemporary Japanese cuisine. Live this experience!

NAME: Camarada Camarao Rio de Janeiro - Shopping Nova America
DESCRIPTION: Somos um restaurante informal, rústico e elegante e decorado com lembranças do mar. O restaurante inaugurou sua primeira operação em dezembro de 2005. Hoje o planejamento do Camarada Camarão é estar em cada cantinho do país, levando sabor, ingredientes de qualidade e uma experiência única para seus clientes. O cardápio desenvolvido pelo chef francês François Schmitt, que mora há mais de 25 anos no Brasil, tem como diferencial a união da culinária internacional com a brasileira. Nesta casa há uma brinquedoteca para os Camaradinhas!
GENERAL_LOCATION: Av. Pastor Martin Luther King Júnior, 126, 20765-971

NAME: Restaurante Marius Degustare
DESCRIPTION: Tasting Menu - A unique selection of special meats, fish, and seafood served at the table, a buffet of hot and cold dishes from Brazilian and Mediterranean cuisine, and a variety of organic salads.

NAME: Coco Bambu Botafogo Rio
DESCRIPTION: The best restaurant in brazil now in rio de janeiro

NAME: Tragga del Mar
DESCRIPTION: Inspired by Uruguayan cuisine, Tragga Del Mar arrives in Barra, in Vogue Square, which offers the same premium grill quality as Grupo Tragga, now with a focus on grilled fish and seafood. Prepared by the executive chef of the group, Adair Herrera, the menu presents a perfect meeting between sea and land. The space, which combines rustic elegance with charming and cozy decoration, brings a foot-in-the-sand atmosphere from Punta del Este to Rio. wooden furniture with blue tones, straw elements, and walls with white stones reinforce the atmosphere sophisticated beach style of the project signed by the architect Mariana Debize, from the MS office Studio Architecture. The restaurant also has a room reserved for events. with capacity for 15 people and exclusive service.

NAME: L'Etoile
DESCRIPTION: Located on the 26th floor of the Sheraton Grand Rio Hotel and with a breatheaking view, L'Etoile offers refinement and sophistication with the highest quality service. The menu prepared by Chef Felix Sanchez offers the best of French cuisine with local and fresh ingredients for our client, always aiming to provide an incredible dining experience at the highest level. Come have this experience with us! Dress code policy: The restaurant restricts the entrance of people dressed swimsuit, short, slippers and tank top.

NAME: Marchezinho
DESCRIPTION: Marchezinho is a celebration to fine eating and drinking ! Our location is a mix of Coffee shop, Grocery, Bistrot and Tapas Bar. We champion great produce and local ingredients, selecting them directly from local producers and artisans. We love bringing people together behind quality food and drinks. For Lunch, simple and healthy dishes to eat here or to go. At Night, fine selection of drinks, wines, cocktails and craft beers to enjoy with our tapas and dishes prepared with local products. All day, come discover sustainable and original produce on our shelves and taste our delicious snacks.

NAME: Camarada Camarao Rio de Janeiro - Riosul Shopping
DESCRIPTION: Somos um restaurante informal, rústico e elegante e decorado com lembranças do mar. O restaurante inaugurou sua primeira operação em dezembro de 2005. Hoje o planejamento do Camarada Camarão é estar em cada cantinho do país, levando sabor, ingredientes de qualidade e uma experiência única para seus clientes. O cardápio desenvolvido pelo chef francês François Schmitt, que mora há mais de 25 anos no Brasil, tem como diferencial a união da culinária internacional com a brasileira.

With gastronomy inspired by the Mediterranean Sea, chef @jerome.dardillac has brought the greatest flavors of Greek cuisine to the shores of Copacabana. Experience the amazing attractions during the day and enjoy the evening on the little princess of the sea. Posto 6, Copacabana. 8am to 12am.

DESCRIPTION: Comida mineira, feijoada, tutu à mineira, feijão tropeiro, frango com quiabo ou orapronobis. Encontro de arte, cultura e gastronomia brasileira. Descontraído, temos um terraço bem arejado.

NAME: Spirit Copa Bar

Cocktails are made with exotic Brazilian tropical fruits and the best selection of drinks, spirits, local and artisan beers. Discover the Classic Perfected menu with Fairmont drinks that you may find around the world.

NAME: Marine Resto
DESCRIPTION: In front of the most beautiful sea view, the Marine Restô offers a healthy offer, with the freshest seafood, meats and vegetables grilled in the charcoal oven, Josper Grill, which imparts a light smoked aroma to the dishes.

NAME: Coa&Co Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Coa &Co Café is an invitation to get to know and consume the best Brazilian coffees of local micro producers and different forms of extraction. Bring a variety of fresh fruit juices, croissants and homemade ice creams. The afternoon break can be accompanied by assorted coffees or teas with tarteletes and cakes.

NAME: Classico Beach Club Recreio
DESCRIPTION: The best beach club in Rio de Janeiro is now at Recreio dos Bandeirantes. Classico meet sports, gastronomy, live music and unforgettable sunsets. Come enjoy a day by our side.

NAME: Olivo Cucina e Pizzeria
DESCRIPTION: Olivo Cucina e Pizzeria is a typical Italian house with an emphasis on pasta, pizza and wine tasting, inspired by recipes from north to south of the country on the Old Continent. The olive tree on our doorstep is the clue we give to our customers of our concern to always offer fresh and quality ingredients. Olivo has a robust wine list for pairing, pizzas made in a wood-fired oven, and light and elegant cuisine.

DESCRIPTION: Dj, Drinks e Gatsronomia

NAME: Mitsuba
DESCRIPTION: Valorizamos todo o caminho pelo qual passa o peixe que chega à mesa do Mitsubá. Do mar carioca, habitat de nossa principal matéria-prima, à cozinha de nosso restaurante, onde colocamos em prática a técnica apurada e precisa de manipulação japonesa, sem deixar de lado a pesca e os pescadores, a conservação e o manuseio adequados dos peixes. Por isso, nosso cardápio varia diariamente.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Avenida Ataulfo de Paiva, 270, Shopping Rio Design Leblon - Loja 106/107 - Leblon, 22440-033

NAME: Explorer Bar
DESCRIPTION: Explorer bar is more than just a cocktail bar - its a feeling. Sophisticated, worldly, courageous. Our focus are delicious Cocktails and we have created exclusive drinks that will excite your tastebuds. Our menu is filled with a fusion of international flavors made with all local ingredients sure to transport you to another place. Enjoy our bar and outdoor dining here in Santa Teresa, Rio de Janeiro!
GENERAL_LOCATION: Rua Almirante Alexandrino, 399, Entrada pela Rua Correa da Sa, 20241-260

NAME: Coco Bambu Niteroi

DESCRIPTION: The bar and restaurant is located in a tourist spot, on the lookout point of the community of Babilônia, a quiet and safe pacified favela in the south of RJ. Here you will have a unique view over the city, here you will experience a gentle and different face of Brazil. Managed by the owner, Colombian Bibiana, at the restaurant you will find some dishes of Latin cuisine, made with high quality ingredients, the menu also includes vegan and vegetarian options, so that no one is left out when it comes to coming and living the experience of visiting the stars.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Ladeira Ari Barroso, Mirante, Morro da Babilonia, 22010-060
