NAME: Oro Restaurante
DESCRIPTION: Brazilian Vanguard Cuisine. Cooked Over Fire. Opened its doors in 2010 and has since consolidated itself as a reference for innovation and revolution in the Brazilian food scene.

NAME: Casanova Gastronomia
DESCRIPTION: We offer a selection of Portuguese dishes and wines in a sophisticated yet cozy ambiance. The restaurant is a creation of the chef António Casanova, a native of Póvoa de Varzim, Portugal. Opened in October 2012, the discreet and attentive service combined with its cuisine has quickly won the hearts and minds of the locals.

NAME: Org Bistro
DESCRIPTION: Organic and vegetarian restaurant located in the Barra da Tijuca, RJ since 2011. The .Org is much more than a restaurant: it's a philosophy of life! Here we seek to bring quality of life and show new paths. We go way beyond serving a dish. We make food thinking about health, communities, animals and planet. We work only with whole, local, seasonal, fresh, organic and unprocessed ingredients. We do not use industrialized products or chemical additives. Everything is handmade with love and care. We want that all the stakeholders feel happy to be here !! Tati Lund is the owner and Chef of .Org Bistro since 2011. Nutritionist and Vegetarian Chef formed by Natural Gourmet Institute for Health and Culinary Arts (NY). Enthusiastic about conscious eating, working with high quality local products, valuing healthy eating habits and supporting sustainable farming practices.

NAME: Teva
DESCRIPTION: Espaço elegante em estilo industrial que serve um menu vegano criativo, com ingredientes sustentáveis e orgânicos.

NAME: L' Atelier du Cuisinier
DESCRIPTION: The cozy L'Atelier du Cuisinier meets only 26 diners at a time and has an exclusive service in charge of Chef David Jobert. Trained in French cuisine and with years of experience in Brazil and abroad. David Jobert offers cuisine with creativity and harmony filled with seasonal produce. Dishes are seeking the softness and respect to raw materials, so you can enjoy the simplicity of delicious French flavors. Located in a house arrived in 1883 as part of the Cultural Corridor of the City, is an obligatory stop on the gastronomic circuit of the city center. Come taste the L'atelier du Cuisinier.David Jobert and his team will do everything for you to discover the pleasure of fine dining

NAME: Planeta Sushi
DESCRIPTION: O Planeta Sushi tem 25 anos de história, sendo um dos restaurantes pioneiros de gastronomia japonesa no Rio de Janeiro. Possui uma unidade no Anil (Jacarepaguá) e Downtown (Barra da Tijuca), com um menu à la carte e também rodízio. Além de uma carta de drinks completa e peças frescas em seu cardápio, o Planeta Sushi é o local ideal para encontros de familiares e amigos.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Avenida das Américas, 500, Downtown - Barra da Tijuca, 22640-904

NAME: Kacua
DESCRIPTION: Culinária Brasileira com base na gastronomia nordestina e frutos do mar. Petiscos variados e pratos muito bem servidos. A noite a casa oferece shows ao vivo de MPB de quinta a sábado. O ambiente descontraído e animado encanta os visitantes.

NAME: Gruta de Santo Antonio
DESCRIPTION: "Founded in 1977, the Gruta de Santo Antonio restaurant is run by chef Henriqueta Henriques (Dona Henriqueta, as she likes to be known). She is the one who prepares the Portuguese menu dishes alongside her son Alexandre Henriques, the award-winning chef who followed in her footsteps. Gruta de Santo Antonio collects awards Already won 10 times Best Seafood and Fish Restaurant for Water in the Mouth of O Globo Newspaper, won first place in Portuguese Cuisine for four consecutive years by TripAdvisor, Hours concours Award of best seafood 2015 by Agua na Boca, Best Codfish Cake of Rio 2017, by Epoca Magazine; was five-time champion in the category Best Portuguese of Rio, by Epoca Magazine; among many others. "

NAME: Amburgueria Mocellin
DESCRIPTION: O jeito Mocellin de fazer amburgueres: 100% artesanais e feitos na brasa! Nosso blend é feito com carnes nobres Swift Black, aliado a experiência de mais de 40 anos dos Mocellins. Ainda contamos com o Chef francês Frédéric Monnier com sua expertise em pães, molhos e harmonizações.

NAME: Xian
DESCRIPTION: Restaurante asiático moderno, localizado em ponto privilegiado da cidade, com vista para o Pão de Açúcar e Cristo Redentor. Temos ambientes diversificados, todos contemplando a melhor vista da cidade!

NAME: Seu Antonio
GENERAL_LOCATION: Rua Doutor Heleno de Gregório, Engenho Do Mato, 24350-065

NAME: Nonna Per Heaven
DESCRIPTION: Nonna represents a search for a return to the essence, guided by the right way of doing things, of giving time to time! That's why the house brings pasta and pizzas made in the olden days… Just the way our grandmothers used to do it! With principles governed by familiarity, warmth, but without giving up excellence.

NAME: Casa Camolese
DESCRIPTION: Restaurante com uma grande área externa, com mesinhas ao ar livre em meio a um jardim exuberante e uma magnifica vista do Cristo e da pista de corrida do Joquei. Uma fábrica de cerveja artesanal à vista dos clientes no segundo andar e o Clube Manouche, palco intimista de musica ao vivo instalado em nosso subsolo, fazem da Casa Camolese um lugar completo, com diversão e qualidade na medida certa para todos os gostos. Perfeito para casais e grupos. Localizado bem na frente do parque do Jardim Botânico, outro programa obrigatório da cidade do Rio de Janeiro.

NAME: Mocellin Churrascaria
DESCRIPTION: Mocellin Churrascaria is known for its variety of cuts. There are more than 30 specialties of beef, pork, lamb, poultry, exotic, and fish, which can be served through the carvery or in exclusive recipes for the client. We excel in the careful selection of our products that guarantee excellence in the quality of what is served at the table. The carvery is well accompanied by the buffet options. But if the idea is to ask for a different follow-up, the tip is to ask the professional who serves you what are the good options of the day. We have sophisticated suggestions, carefully prepared to make your visit even more delicious.

NAME: Le Ble Noir
DESCRIPTION: Crêperie

NAME: Restaurante Emile
DESCRIPTION: The Emile restaurant will feature a contemporary cuisine with the best Brazilian organic products, prepared throroughly by Chef Damien Montecer, with the minimalist essence and consistency already established in the Emiliano São Paulo. Divided in two rooms in a warm atmosphere, a huge vertical garden reproduces the feel of the Atlantic Forest around the restaurant tables. Launched at the most recent Milan Furniture Show, the “lampião” chairs, designed by Arthur de Mattos Casas, make up for some exclusive details of this restaurant.

NAME: Cabos Restaurante del Puerto
DESCRIPTION: The port restaurant, where traditional seasoning blends with the best of Peruvian and international gourmet cuisine.

NAME: Molly's Irish Bar & Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Within our walls you will discover we have kept the traditional colonial style of the building with huge 3m high ceilings and cornicing throughout the numerous different rooms, our stained-glass doors and windows, shining silver chandeliers and a fascinating collection of memorabilia bring a little bit of Ireland to this South American city. The traditions of Ireland have been extended to our menu, which has been developed by the philosophy of food for the body, offering Irish classics like fish & chips, bangers & mash, shepherd's pie and our famous Irish stew. Enjoy a Drink for the spirit with a perfectly poured pint of Molly’s Irish Stout or Red Ale or savour some of Lima’s best signature house cocktails. We also boast 4 taps from local craft breweries and bottled beers from around the globe. We have a large selection of spirits as well as a good wine list. We look forward to greeting you with a warm welcome in the heart of Lima. Come for the Molly’s, stay for the Craic. Sláinte!

NAME: Costanera 700
DESCRIPTION: Su creador Humberto Sato, un apasionado de la cocina inspirado por su herencia familiar, ofrecía en sus inicios comida criolla, pero añadiendo siempre algún ingrediente japonés que le daba ese sabor original e inconfundible, lo que causó gran éxito en sus comensales. Es así que decidió que la mayor parte de su carta esté constituida por un abanico de platos a base de pescados y mariscos frescos y preparados con una talentosa y delicada mezcla de sabores del lejano oriente y del Perú que producen infinito placer a quien los disfruta.

NAME: Paralelo Restaurante Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Paralelo Restaurante Café, located in the heart of Miraflores, just 2 blocks from Ovalo Gutierrez. You can enjoy excellent food and the best signature cocktails in a completely instagrammable environment! A truly unforgettable experience. Best place to have brunch in Lima!

NAME: Poke 51
DESCRIPTION: Poke 51 is a Sushi/PokeBar that mixes a Nikkei Sushi Bar and a Poke Bar in one same place. A super dynamic environment, with full-on flavors where food is re-invented everyday, primarily based on fish protein. Peruvian - Japanese fusion, called Nikkei Cuisine. Poke 51 is Food, Drinks, and Good Times!!!

NAME: Merito
DESCRIPTION: MERITO's unassuming two-story space wants to stay as far away as possible from pretention and formality, using natural materials that give a cozy yet simple ambience. The kitchen is exposed for everyone to see and has a coal oven that uses carob tree wood. Every dish served in this restaurant passes through the coal oven. The Merito experience can be quite close and personal when seated by the bar. You will witness every move the kitchen team makes while prepping, cooking and plating each dish. MERITO is a contemporary and modern space, that reflect a feel of easiness. Its cuisine’s creativity and heart beats through the blends and fusions of the origins of the South American continent, it’s common ground, to go back to the basics in order to transform what’s daily and common into magic.

NAME: Embarcadero 41
DESCRIPTION: Embarcadero 41 Proud to be “The Ceviche Experts” We are a chain of restaurants where you can find the best of Peruvian and international cuisine, specializing in fish and seafood, fusing flavors, sensations, cultures and dreams that allow us to provide the best of gastronomic richness. Join this great family! https://embarcadero41.com/

NAME: Mattoni Peru
DESCRIPTION: Ristorante, Atelier & Cafe. Mattoni recreates the best of Italian food in Peru, offering a familiar and personalized space for our clients.

NAME: Las Bolena Tea Room & Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Restaurante y casa de té Comida Internacional, brindamos los servicios de Desayuno, Brunch (sábados y domingos) , Almuerzo, tea time y cena (Martes a Domingo) Contamos con más de 30 variedades de té que pueden pedirse en Tea Tonic, caliente o Frío.

NAME: Alma Bar Restaurante
DESCRIPTION: Alma Restaurante & Bar offers an assortment of classic Peruvian recipes with contemporary flair. The varied menu highlights the ingredientes used in each of its dishes, which include appetizers, tapas, main dishes, things to share and sides, as weel as chef recommendations.

NAME: Barra Maretazo
DESCRIPTION: Come join us for a quick ceviche/seafood lunch or an appetizer and drink for dinner. We have a boat you can sit in and have a coffee or a Pisco Sour. We have a sandbox that you can put your feet in. With 23 years of experience cooking Peruvian cuisine you will not be disappointed! We are waiting for you to join us for a #MagicalMoment!

NAME: Intro Cafe Bar
DESCRIPTION: Authentic and local Cafe Bar that will introduce you to the best of peruvian culture from your earliest morning coffee to your last cocktail in the wee hours. Renowned Chef Ignacio Barrios made an exquisite job to cater you the best of the best in Lima.

NAME: La Caleta de La Punta
DESCRIPTION: La Caleta de La Punta is a family restaurant. The owners Peñaflor De Souza family day to day dedicated to providing the most familiar and personalized attention to each costumer that visit us. We only have two locations, one beside the other, on the Malecon Pardo de La Punta against the Malecon. We have no other place outside La Punta.

NAME: 21.02 Resto & Lounge by Dazzler Lima Miraflores
Limana
DESCRIPTION: Limaná ofrece una gastronomía deliciosa y natural basada en el uso de superfoods. Su bello diseño interior ofrece la atmósfera perfecta para disfrutar de exquisitos platos elaborados con ingredientes orgánicos. Cuenta con opciones para todos los gustos: keto, paleo, vegano, vegetariano, sin gluten y sin lactosa. Limaná es el primer restaurante peruano que cuenta con una certificación en sostenibilidad otorgada por la Sustainable Restaurant Association.

NAME: El Peregrino Restobar
DESCRIPTION: Lunches, snacks, fun and more. Chill and pleasant atmosphere in a mysterious environment with a very good vibe. Come and enjoy our famous chicharrones con leche de tigre and tartar sauce, wings with mango sauce and cream cheese, our wok dishes: lomo saltado, noodle saltado, and more. Take advantage of our delicious cocktails mojitos, pisco sour, piña colada, negroni and cocktails in the house

NAME: Insumo
DESCRIPTION: Insumo es un restaurante que, con una apuesta por la calidad e ingredientes frescos y complementada con técnicas de cocina como los hornos Josper y Kamado, unifica la cocina mediterránea con los sabores peruanos, presentando productos de la costa, los Andes y la Amazonía peruana. Ubicado en el AC Hotel Lima Miraflores, Insumo es el destino perfecto para los amantes de la comida que quieren descubrir la ciudad a través de sus sabores y acompañar la experiencia de la mejor vista al mar de Lima.

NAME: Guarguero Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Promovemos la tradición de nuestra cocina, uniendo el talento, técnicas y procesos contemporáneos. Aprovechando las bondades de nuestra envidiable biodiversidad, variedad de suelos y microclimas, que hacen de nuestros productos e insumos únicos en cada región. Motivo y razón para llevar nuestra gastronomía a lo mas alto de la élite mundial sin perder la esencia inicial.

NAME: El Merlin de Cabo Blanco - Miraflores
Nuevo Mundo Bar Lima
DESCRIPTION: We want to share with you the experience of a rich handmade chela in draft or in the bottle, accompanied by good music and delicious food. Share as a couple, between friends or with the family. We assure you that you will have a good time! We wait for you! Bar, Music, drinks, Sports *Manuel Bonilla 103, Miraflores. In front of Kennedy Park. #BonillaStreet #RicaChela

NAME: Matria Restaurante
DESCRIPTION: Chef Arlette Eulert´s signature restaurant offers a fresh, modern menu full of innovative creations and specialties that change with the seasons. Using primary organic ingredients, Matria has options for vegetarians and vegans, as well as lactose and/or gluten intolerant. The décor incorporates both modern and rustic details, using wood, plants and impeccable lighting to create a warm ambiance With a staff dedicated to exploration, MATRIA beautifully combines gourmet comfort food with an inviting low key ambiance.
GENERAL_LOCATION: General Manuel Mendiburu 823, Urb. Santa Cruz Miraflores, 18

NAME: CHE CHA Tea Bar & Food Station
DESCRIPTION: We created Ché Chá thinking of a relaxed and flexible space where you can enjoy with family and friends a new gastronomic proposal that uses high quality natural products, combining them in creative and stimulating recipes. We are a restaurant & Bar concept that brings us together in an urban oasis.

NAME: Asu Maki
DESCRIPTION: We are a fast casual nikkei (japanese-peruvian) restaurant sharing our passion for explosive tastes through our makis, nigiris, poke bowls, chicken and juices. Sourcing locally and sustainably trying to make a difference on the world around us. Eat fair and fast in style with us!

NAME: Eden Bar Lima
DESCRIPTION: An amazing space, consisting of open air terraces and a large beer garden in the heart of Miraflores. We offer amazing food, signature cocktails, craft beer with all your sports live and in english. At night, the vibe changes and the fiesta starts! A unique and unmissbale experience when in Lima.

NAME: Contraste
DESCRIPTION: We are a Peruvian Bistrot, showcasing local products and offering peruvian food whit a twist, plates to share, peruvian and global wines. Enjoy as well a great cocktail in our terrace or dining room in a cozy and relax atmosphere whit cool vibes and music from the world.

NAME: El Merlin de Cabo Blanco - Lince
El Parrillon de Pablo Profumo
DESCRIPTION: Restaurante El Parrillon de Pablo Profumo , su especialidad son las mas sabrosas Carnes preparadas a la brasa cocidas en el punto exacto ,al mejor estilo de la Tipica Parrilla Uruguaya. Variedad de platos Charruas, fondos y postres . EL Parrillon se encuentra en el corazon de Miraflores , Los Esperamos con el cariño de siempre .

NAME: Chifa Titi
DESCRIPTION: Chifa Titi is a representative of Chinese food in Peru, offering classic dishes slightly adapted to the local palate.

NAME: Ozu Asian Peruvian Cuisine
DESCRIPTION: At Ozu we take a little from the countries of Asia through cooking techniques using ingredients from these regions, such as curry, coconut milk, miso, tausi, fish sauce, and we incorporate them into the kitchen to offer you a new experience, a journey with the senses. To this we add contemporary Peruvian food with slight oriental nuances, which break the schemes of the more traditional diner. Finally, the signature cocktails based on ingredients such as lemon verbena, ginger, lychee, coconut milk, turmeric, among others, perfectly pair the dishes and make Ozu a wonderful experience. Visit us at Avenida Benavides 4862, Santiago de Surco, Lima, Peru. #OZU #NikkeiFood #ThaiCuisine

NAME: Museo Larco Cafe Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: The Museo Larco Café-Restaurant, offers an enchanting ambiance where one can savour the best of Peruvian and International cuisine, including hot dishes, salads, sandwiches, pastries and desserts, as well as hot and cold drinks, Pisco Sour, wines, and beers. All of the food is prepared using the freshest of ingredients that are bought daily. The restaurant is situated on the Museum’s terraces overlooking its vibrant and captivating gardens.

NAME: Asnapa
DESCRIPTION: En Asnapa Restaurante buscamos la mejor versión de los platos peruanos para engreír a todos los que nos visiten y hacer que vivan una excelente experiencia gastronómica.

NAME: Costazul Seafood
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to RESTAURANT COSTAZUL SEAFOOD. We have been cooking great affordable seafood with the freshest ingredients since 1989. All dishes are made to order and we are always looking forward to give the best peruvian and seafood culinary experience along with the warmth that characterizes peruvians. Plese note we are open everyday from 12pm-8 30pm and sudays we close at 6 pm. For groups or after hours reservations don't hesitate to write us an email. We look forward to your next visit with us soon!! Carlos Moscol-Manager

NAME: Saha Kitchen & Cocktails
DESCRIPTION: Saha nace gracias a la idea de crear un ambiente divertido en el cual podrás disfrutar la mejor gastronomía del mundo acompañada de exclusivos cocktails. Costa, Sierra y Selva se unen en nuestra carta dirigida al público con el más selecto paladar. Nuestro nombre proviene de la cultura Nazca, y significa "Casa Festiva", el lugar donde disfrutarás la más selecta y contemporánea comida peruana.

NAME: Awicha
DESCRIPTION: Dentro de una casona limeña de barranco se encuentra Awicha un restaurante NEOBISTRO en el cual la comida es elaborada con exigencias de un restaurante gastronómico de alto nivel pero con un ambiente y servicio más descontracturado y familiar, su ambiente en tonos naturales, ventanales antiguos, maderas frescas y una iluminación que destaca y acentúa cada mesa y cada rincón; pensado para brindar en manera natural una comodidad cotidiana sin pretensiones donde el confort prevalece ante todas las cosas. Naciendo de la necesidad de acercar la alta gastronomía y las mejores técnicas culinarias a través de una innovadora carta a un precio justo.; resultado que sólo se logra a través de las manos de nuestro chef jason roman que nos presenta diferentes platos de calidad perfectamente bien ejecutados y listos para sorprender a todos aquellos que busca continuamente reinventarse, conocer y apreciar los sabores y la presentación en cada experiencia gastronómica.

NAME: La Plaza Bar & Grill
DESCRIPTION: This modern locale is know for its fresh, regional ingredientes and its light, casual ambiance. Its menu includes ribs, hamburguers, fajitas and a variety of classic Peruvian dishes, as well as an Open Salad option for those who wish to create their own personalized salad. The bar serves both infused piscos and pisco cocktails

NAME: Maras Restaurante
DESCRIPTION: Maras es el lugar perfecto para descubrir y degustar lo mejor de la alta cocina peruana en un ambiente acogedor y exclusivo en San Isidro. Su propuesta culinaria se centra en la calidad del producto y la técnica, combinando tradición y vanguardia. Tanto en su cálido salón como en su encantadora terraza, Maras se enorgullece de ofrecer platos inolvidables que se convierten en auténticas leyendas.

NAME: Market 770
DESCRIPTION: Restaurante abierto desde el desayuno hasta la cena, presenta una propuesta innovadora de cocina peruana e internacional y se basa en productos de gran calidad propios de cada temporada.Market 770 se encuentra en el primer piso del hotel y ofrece un interesante lay out de mesas de distintos tamaños, así como un área de buffet con islas centrales, decoradas con murales. En la entrada destacan dos cavas de vino y un dispensador de vino por copa. Tiene un atractivo salón privado en el segundo piso donde se puede ofrecer desayunos, reuniones, almuerzos o cenas de trabajo. También contamos con opciones de SuperFoodsRx ™ para los comensales que prefieran opciones más saludables.Horario de atención: De Lunes a Domingo de 6:30 hrs. a 23:00 hrs

NAME: Xoma Gastronomico
DESCRIPTION: XOMA GASTRONOMICO: CONTEMPORARY PERUVIAN RESTAURANT The proposal revolves around rediscovering flavors of Peruvian cuisine, both à la carte and the Tasting menu or the tasting menu where we call it experiences, with contemporary signature cuisine where not only international and national cooking techniques are fused, but also memories. of the chef in order to have a fresh, healthy and balanced cuisine. In a few words, modern, fun and creative Peruvian cuisine seeking to exploit the sense of taste. “Classique ou moderne, il n'y a qu'une seule cuisine, la bonne” Paul Bocuse

NAME: Saqra
DESCRIPTION: Saqra, means “little devil”, or “prankster” in Quechua. Our menu has Peruvian roots and all of our dishes have been designed with an element of surprise in mind: either in the ingredients, flavours, colours or presentation, our clients will find something different. Saqra offers modern Peruvian food faithful to our Peruvian identity with in a playful and contemporary key, conjuring up fun and colourful results.

NAME: Nanka San Isidro
DESCRIPTION: NANKA is a gastronomic space in La Molina and San Isidro. We offer a seasonal menu, especially designed for sharing, that aims to promote local and sustainable produce... A friendly and informative service culture by a team of young professionals passionate about gastronomy ... A space specially designed that allow us to offer you an experience, more than something yummy to eat.

NAME: Burrito Bar - Lima
DESCRIPTION: We serve freshly made hand stretched tortillas filled with your choice of chicken, steak, pork, veggies, rice, beans, cheese, guacamole and salsas. We also have a selection of soft drinks and beers. The restaurant is 2 blocks from the main plaza (Parque Municipal) in Barranco

NAME: Restaurante Alfresco
DESCRIPTION: Since 1992. Alfresco has positioned itself in the market as one of the icons of coastal food, revolutionizing the style of seafood in Peru. From the hands of its creator and emblematic chef, Alfredo Aramburú, Alfresco after 25 years continues to grow, being a benchmark of Peruvian gastronomy.

NAME: Isolina
GENERAL_LOCATION: Avenida San Martin Prolongacion 101, Esquina con Calle Domeyer, LIMA 04

NAME: Mar y Selva Cocina Amazonica Fusion
DESCRIPTION: El sueño de fusionar lo mejor de nuestra cocina Amazónica, el exquisito sabor marino y criollo de nuestra tierra, fue sin duda lo que nos llevó a crear el único restaurante de la ciudad en ofrecer una selecta, contemporánea y sofisticada cocina peruana fusión. Con los mejores insumos de todos los rincones de nuestro querido Perú. Es así como Mar y Selva día a día ofrece a nuestros comensales, la mejor experiencia de sabor y pasión por la fusión de nuestra maravillosa gastronomía. The dream about mixing the best of our Amazonic cuisine, the marvelous taste of the seafood and tipical food of our land, was without a doubt, what drove us to create this unique restaurant of the city that offers a selected, contemporary and sofisticated peruvian mixed cuisine. With the best inputs from all the corners of our beloved Peru. That's how Mar y Selva, day after day, offers to our customers, the great experience and passion of our marvelous gastronomy.

NAME: Astrid & Gaston
DESCRIPTION: Peruvian restaurant where creativity, quality, integration and commitment converge. Tasting menu is only served from 13:00 to 14:30 and from 19:00 to 22:30

NAME: Amoramar
DESCRIPTION: Located in the heart of San Isidro, Amoramar is a restaurant full of love. Love for the freshest ingredients, quality and service. Love for the talent of a team that always makes good things better. Love for everything that our sea and land gives us daily to make the Amoramar experience possible.

NAME: Maido
DESCRIPTION: Nikkei food restaurant
GENERAL_LOCATION: Calle San Martín 399, Esquina con calle Colon, Lima 18

NAME: Fuego Smoke House
DESCRIPTION: Somos la primera Smoked House de Lima realizada por nuestro chef Christian Bravo y nuestra misión es que vivas una experiencia única en Fuego. Nuestras carnes son seleccionadas con muchísima rigurosidad y pasan largas horas por el proceso de ahumado en maderas especiales, tales como Olivo, Manzano y Algarrobo.

NAME: Ache
GENERAL_LOCATION: Av. La Paz 1055, Interseccion Con Av. 28 de Julio

NAME: JOSELO by Rigoletto
DESCRIPTION: Joselo by Rigoletto If you fell in love with the flavors of Mediterranean food at the Rigoletto restaurant, then come and discover its new gastronomic proposal, JOSELO by Rigoletto, a new restaurant concept that seeks to incorporate Peruvian dishes into its menu that were always among the demands of its customers. , especially among those who know the expertise of JOSELO, owner of Rigoletto, in the preparation of Peruvian food. JOSELO by Rigoletto seeks to bring to the table the most varied of local cuisine, always with the same quality and good service that you already know. Although the soul of Rigoletto is Mediterranean food, especially Italian food, JOSELO by Rigoletto will respect this essence, since the same dishes that you know and that you have made your favorites will continue to be present on your menu. The restaurant will be open to the public in the usual place, Calle Colon 161, Miraflores, Lima. Don't waste any more time and come visit us.

NAME: Bistro 400
DESCRIPTION: Bistro Peruano e internacional con destacada coctelería. Buffet desayuno variado, estación de waffles, jugos, café, opciones dulces entre otras. Almuerzo a la carta & opción de menú. Bar con oferta de barra libre.

NAME: Lima27
DESCRIPTION: Peruvian contemporary restaurant where Chef Carlos Testino inspired by his experiences, presents new creative gastronomic proposals.

NAME: Mayta Restaurante
DESCRIPTION: A contemporary Peruvian cuisine restaurant and pisco bar in Lima, Peru, where the traceability of native products is always sought and combined with contemporary culinary techniques and local products to create sophisticated and modern dishes.

NAME: Delfino Mar Restaurante
DESCRIPTION: Delfino Mar is a peruvian restaurant specializes in seafood cuisine and seafood dishes. We are open all days.

NAME: Panchita
DESCRIPTION: We cook ancient and contemporary Peruvian Creole food, and honor the tradition and culture of Lima. We imprint flavor onto high-level products, sometimes with a slow burn and other times with a vivid flame. One thing remains unchanged: we cook with the same passion our grandmothers did and preserve their seasoning. Our cuisine is ​bold, roguish and generous, just like Marthita, our chef, who is as mischievous as a good jarana limeña.

NAME: La Picanteria
GENERAL_LOCATION: Francisco Moreno 388- Surquillo, Esquina con cuadra 6 de Gonzáles Prada

NAME: Canuto Trattoria Peruana
DESCRIPTION: Trattoría peruana que mezcla tradiciones, cultura, costumbres de ambas partes y nos lleva a deleitarnos en una experiencia única.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Av. Dos de Mayo 455, 455 en San Isidro

NAME: LA73 Paradero Gourmet
DESCRIPTION: LA73 Paradero Gourmet, Desde el 2005, nos inspiramos en la cocina de mercado, creamos sobre lo popular. Chef Daniel Sologuren

NAME: Amankaya - Peruvian Food
DESCRIPTION: The best Peruvian food is in the heart of Miraflores, inside the emblematic "Quinta Bustos" from 1920s. Enjoy the best ceviche, Rock 'n' Roll, pisco cocktails, craft beers and hits from the bar. Don't miss the Open Mic nights on Tuesdays, Rock DJ on Fridays and live music every Thursdays & Saturdays. We are located at Av. 28 de Julio 562, Miraflores (Inside the Quinta Bustos). #HiddenJewel.

NAME: La Vista Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: La Vista is located at JW Marriott Hotel Lima and it offers both local and international cuisine. Our restaurant in Lima, Peru is recognized for its incomparable breakfast, lunch and tea time buffets. For dinner we offer an A La Carte menu as well as periodically offering different activities including food and wine pairing dinners. At La Vista you will enjoy personalized service, as well as an excellent location with ocean view, all accompanied with the creativity of our Peruvians Chefs.

NAME: El Charrua
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to El Charrua. Where today's families find the spirit of real Uruguayan and Rio-platense food, the flavors they crave, and something-for-everyone variety. El Charrua serve great Steaks, Pastas, Salads and a variety of Appetizers and Desserts. When it comes to friendly atmosphere, our staff offers full-service at your table and a help-yourself from the owner and family.

NAME: Costumbres Argentinas
DESCRIPTION: Argentinean BBQ

NAME: La Locanda
DESCRIPTION: The best European Cuisine in Lima. At La Locanda, guests enjoy classic elegance in an exclusive environment with a beautiful view of the garden. With warm service, each detail has been meticulously attended to for an unforgettable experience. La Locanda also offers a great selection of desserts and the finest wines and liquors. This is the perfect place for a business lunch, a romantic dinner or just a fun evening with friends.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Av. Santo Toribio 173-Via Central 150, Centro Empresarial Real, 15073

NAME: Le Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Le Café restaurant offers Peruvian and international flavours, from a hearty daily buffet breakfast to weekdays buffet lunch. It also offers a variety of a la carte dishes. SCHEDULE: BREAKFAST: Monday through Friday | 6:00 am to 10:00 am Saturday and Sunday | 6:00 am to 12:00 pm LUNCH: Monday through Friday | 12:30 pm am to 16:00 pm

NAME: Giornatta
DESCRIPTION: Panadería & Pastelería con sabor a fantasía ¡Prepárate para decir todas las mañanas Buona GIORNATTA con nuestras opciones dulces y saladas para desayunar!

NAME: Tonnarello Restaurante Bogota
DESCRIPTION: El Placer de descubrir una ruta de sabores clásicos de la gastronomía italiana.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Calle 127 # 15a - 10, Ubicado en el Hotel Estelar La Fontana, 110121

NAME: Tierra 84
DESCRIPTION: Cocina colombiana contemporánea Nickol

NAME: Restaurante Peruano - Indio De Machu Picchu
DESCRIPTION: Quaint family run Peruvian restaurant which serves the best Peruvian in Bogota. Mr. Cesar Fernandez Vizconde and his all-Peruvian team our proud ambassadors of the exquisite traditions of Peruvian cuisine from the causas and anticuchos to the lomo saltado and tiradito.

NAME: Santa Fe Cafe & Restaurante
DESCRIPTION: Gastronomic scene where are executed preparations that are aligned with the Author Cuisine, taking elements of the Colombian gastronomy in the framework of the French technique. The architecture of the place goes back to the 20's, therefore, its decoration and romantic atmosphere transport the diner at that time in history. The menu includes dishes such as Meats (Buffalo, Beef and Pork), Poultry (Turkey and Chicken), Fish, Seafood, Fresh salads, Gluten-free preparations, Vegan and Vegetarian. It has a varied and exquisite beverages menu, where it will be possible to find Fruit Drinks, Smoothies, Sorbets, Cocktails, Spirits, Liqueurs, Beers and a carefully selected wine list. Your visitors will be able to enjoy with their family, friends or co-workers, the spaces that have been created for their delight: Dining room, Terrace or Courtyard with exposed kitchens; Ideal for romantic dinners, business meetings, family celebrations or simply an after-office drink. And in the afternoons, it has developed hallucinating desserts, which pairing perfectly with preparations of Coffee or Organic tea.

NAME: La Cabrera Bogota l Parrilla Argentina
DESCRIPTION: El secreto mejor guardado de Palermo llega a Bogotá con la mejor variedad y calidad de carnes para disfrutar con toda la familia.

NAME: Frenessi
DESCRIPTION: FRENESSI: La cápsula de inmersión gastronómica que traspasa los límites de la realidad No te quedes con la curiosidad y conoce el primer restaurante de Colombia con una única mesa y un sinfín de experiencias creadas por medio de realidad virtual.

NAME: Momentino Wine Bar
DESCRIPTION: Momentino is much more than just a wine bar. New to Bogotá's burgeoning gastro scene, Momentino is a hidden oasis for those that enjoy a well-deserved break from the hustle and bustle of today’s urban life. At Momentino we believe that everyone should be able to enjoy wine at reasonable prices. This has inspired us to create a selection of wines from around the world to accompany you during those everyday encounters or special occasions. Today we have more than 110 wines from 9 countries: Spain, Italy, France, Portugal, Hungría, Austria, Argentina, Uruguay, Chile and USA. Furthermore, we have meticulously created a colourful array of delicious tapas dishes to share with your friends and family and to complement your wine of choice. Located in the artistic Chapinero district, we are the key destination in Bogotá for enjoying great wines at affordable prices in a unique but informal environment. We look forward to welcoming you!

NAME: Bar Continental
DESCRIPTION: Somos la conjunción de todo lo que nos hace caribe, salseros, libacionistas mulatos con paladar por el buen ron, cocteles, comida y más. Somos la personificación de la atención latina, descomplicados pero profesionales, siempre aprendiendo y dispuestos para que su/tu experiencia con nosotros sea inigualable.

NAME: Cantina La 15 Bogota
DESCRIPTION: Cantina La 15 es el mejor restaurante mexicano de Colombia. Te transporta a México con su gastronomía y música en vivo. Fuego, dj, personajes, mariachis, platos terminados en la mesa y mucho más vas a encontrar todos los días en nuestras sedes.

NAME: Insolente Mexican-Asian Gastrobar
DESCRIPTION: Mexican-Asian Gastrobar

NAME: Marie Antoinette
DESCRIPTION: ¡QUE COMAN PASTELES Y UNO QUE OTRO DÉSIR FRANCÉS! Bienvenue à la maison de Marie Antoinette, el lugar perfecto para brindar; pero brindar con autoridad, rebeldía y mucho glamour. Aquí serás testigo de una nueva revolución liderada por esta icónica mujer que nos enseña que la vida no tiene porqué ser aburrida. Entre gastronomía francesa, experiencias y vino (mucho vino) te haremos sentir como de la realeza, una que va contra la corriente y vive para romper las reglas.

NAME: Austin's Texas BBQ
DESCRIPTION: Within a very short time, you will be able to enjoy the taste of Texas in the only authentic Texas BBQ restaurant in Colombia. We serve lunch and dinner. We offer catering, delivery, outdoor seating, take out and walk-ins are welcome. Ubicado en la vía a Subachoque, entre las montañas de la vereda La Cuesta rodeados de caballerizas y un ambiente campestre, Austin's es el sitio ideal para relajarse y disfrutar del original BBQ Texano y una variedad de acompañamientos auténticos de Texas. Olvídate del caos de Bogota por unas horas con el único - Authentic Texas Style BBQ - de Colombia.

NAME: Oliveto Pizza & Pasta Rosales
DESCRIPTION: Estamos en el barrio Rosales desde el 2004. Dentro del restaurante contamos con tres ambientes; el comedor principal, que está al lado de una chimenea perfecta para disfrutar de un postre o un trago. Está la terraza interna para los días calurosos y el segundo piso, en donde podemos recibir grupos de hasta 30 personas.

NAME: Storia D'amore - Zona T
DESCRIPTION: Storia D'amore está inspirado en un viaje por la gastronomía italiana, la cual es conocida a nivel mundial por su variedad de platos y por su conciencia tradicional. El restaurante cuenta con las principales características de la mesa italiana como las experiencias que traspasan los sentidos mientras se plasman historias inspiradoras de amor a través de su carta.

NAME: Pesquera Jaramillo Parque de la 93
DESCRIPTION: Pesquera Jaramillo cumple más de 85 años consolidándose como la empresa líder en la comercialización de pescados y mariscos en Colombia. Es un ícono de la gastronomía de mar por sus productos importados exóticos como las langostas vivas del Canadá, salmón fresco calidad premier de Chile, brazos de cangrejo de Alaska, entre otros. El amplio y exclusivo restaurante del parque de la 93 ofrece tres ambientes en los que se destaca la Marisquería un espacio único para disfrutar de las mejores tapas y una extraordinaria cava para reuniones privadas. En su carta para no perderse: la langosta, que puedes escoger viva del acuario, preparada en mantequilla de coñac.

NAME: Todo Es Color Di Rosa
DESCRIPTION: La vida en rosa al servicio del paladar: pasta fresca, pizzas, carpaccios, sopas y quesos… hacen una oda donde las cocinas de Italia y Colombia se fusionan para convertir la alegría en una entrada; el glamour en el plato fuerte y los postres y cocteles en una hipnosis eterna que hacen regresar una y mil veces.

NAME: Pizza Candelaria
DESCRIPTION: Comida inspirada en la gastronomía italiana, en el centro histórico, La Candelaria. Execelente servicio, ¡compruébalo!

NAME: Descortes
DESCRIPTION: Descortés is the fusion of the Mediterranean, Japanese and Caribbean culinary tradition, influenced by the marine gastronomy of more than 700 years ago without forgetting the contributions and culinary customs brought from each culture. We give great prominence to drinks and spirits with influences from the sea and cocktails based on pirate stories related to legends of the seven seas.

NAME: Piazza by Storia D' Amore - Calle 122 Bogota
DESCRIPTION: Storia D'amore está inspirado en un viaje por la gastronomía italiana, la cual es conocida a nivel mundial por su variedad de platos y por su conciencia tradicional. El restaurante cuenta con las principales características de la mesa italiana como las experiencias que traspasan los sentidos mientras se plasman historias inspiradoras de amor a través de su carta. Productos y servicios: - Preparaciones tradicionales y modernas italianas con experiencia como el fettuccine a la parmigiana hecho en la mesa. - Pizzería al estilo italiano con masas maduradas. - Pastas, risottos, del mar, aves y carnes. - Pesca responsable. - Gelateria artesanal italiana. - Panadería con masa madre y pastelería exclusiva. - Selección de vinos tintos, blancos, rosados y espumosos. - Cocteles clásicos, de autor, cervezas, aperitivos y digestivos, whisky, vodka y tequila. - Sodas italianas, jugos, gaseosas, cafés y tés. - Ambientación en cada espacio, calidez del servicio y música en vivo.

NAME: Kuzina
DESCRIPTION: Restaurante de gastronomía internacional con toques de origen local. ubicado en el Hotel Estelar Suites Jones.

NAME: Capitalino Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: With the freshness of fruits and vegetables of the Colombian countryside, Capitalino offers a varied menu where international techniques are mixed with local flavors in a dynamic and familiar atmosphere. Enjoy a varied buffet breakfast and lunch with a la carte options or live an unforgettable experience at dinner time with family-style menu. On Sundays, find the perfect scenario to enjoy Brunch

NAME: Santa Juana Gastrobar
DESCRIPTION: Santa Juana es un gastrobar ubicado en una casa Patrimonio Nacional de Quinta Camacho en la ciudad de Bogotá, nuestra inspiración el la fusión entre el arte con la gastronomía y es así como se denomina ; ARTRONOMÍA. Nuestra musa de Santa Juana viene de Juana de Arco; la heroína, la santa doncella guerrera, fervorosa y fuerte, enviada para la salvación del reino, y es así como revolucionamos la gastronomía en medio de una Pandemia Mundial con una investigación vanguardista fusión latina el cual su misión es brindar momentos de felicidad a nuestros comensales, superando las expectativas de nuestros clientes ofreciéndoles la mejor experiencia y servicio dentro de un espacio donde se respira arte, gastronomía y diseño, junto con una amplia oferta de brunch, almuerzo, cena, tapas y coctelería artesanal de autor con inspiraciones ancestrales.

NAME: Flambee Bistro
DESCRIPTION: Flambée Café & Bistró nace de nuestra pasión por acercar la cocina Francesa a todas las personas de Bogotá, utilizando los mejores ingredientes y la experiencia de nuestro chef francés, Denis Schwebel, en restaurantes alrededor de mundo.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Carrera 11 # 93-40, Dentro de la Alianza Francesa Chicó, 110221

NAME: Anima
DESCRIPTION: Por: Paulo Airaudo (Chef Guía Michelin) Nuestra filosofía de trabajo se centra en utilizar la mejor materia prima para el disfrute y el placer del comensal. Todo lo que hacemos y que se traslada al equipo, es buscar el disfrute de los sentidos. Para ello, contamos con proveedores locales que nos permiten seleccionar los mejores productos. Desde la cocina y el comedor ejecutaremos un menú degustación que cambiará estacionalmente. Nuestra bodega de sumillería comparte la misma filosofía, abarcamos diferentes países del mundo y creamos una curación para maridar correctamente nuestro menú omakase. Bienvenido a omakase.

NAME: Piazza Italia By Storia D'amore Calle 93
DESCRIPTION: Cada espacio ha sido diseñado para hacerte sentir en Italia, disfruta de un viaje extraordinario a través de su gastronomía, espacios únicos y un ambiente encantador. Un lugar ideal para compartir entre familia y amigos.

NAME: La Kasta Grill and Wine
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to the best experience around the fire. Thank you for considering our restaurant, La Kasta, as your option for your event, it will be an honor for us to be your hosts. Our highly qualified staff will anticipate the needs of each of your guests. As you know, the restaurant is located in the Soledad neighborhood; our convenient location, just one block from the Park way, makes it very accessible, our Restaurant "LA KASTA" whose specialty is the grill and we have dishes with Meat, Chicken, Fish, Seafood, vegetarian options, Wines, Spirits and signature cocktails and international

NAME: Dondoh Bogota
DESCRIPTION: La primera parrilla japonesa de Colombia

NAME: Selvatiko By Petronio
DESCRIPTION: Después de una extensa investigación gastronómica por los 32 departamentos de Colombia traemos a ti la oportunidad de vivir el FINE DINING de una manera única. Gastronomía de autor inspirada en las selvas colombianas llevando la riqueza de Colombia en flora, fauna y cultura a otro nivel.

NAME: Katarssis Restaurante
DESCRIPTION: El verbo hecho carne La magia de la comida forjada en el fuego medieval, sabores que despiertan lo más profundos deseos y sensaciones que liberan
GENERAL_LOCATION: CHORRO DE QUEVEDO LA CANDELARIA CRA 1a #12b - 40, 111711

NAME: Inkanto Peruvian Cuisine C.C Multiplaza
DESCRIPTION: Restaurante de gastronomía Peruana internacional y coctelería de autor. Inkanto una experiencia que ya puedes vivir en centro comercial Gran Estación y Centro comercial Multiplaza
GENERAL_LOCATION: Av. Boyaca No. 17A – 09, Centro Comercial Multiplaza Local: A 111 Primer piso, 110931

NAME: Restaurante Cook"s Porterhouse
DESCRIPTION: Uno de los mejores restaurantes de carne de Bogotá, donde encontrarás una variedad de cortes nacionales e importados

NAME: Cuerdo
DESCRIPTION: Si has llegado a Cuerdo es porque tienes un alma curiosa, viajera y sin tabús. Te invitamos a conocer nuestro loco mundo a través de sus sabores colombianos, texturas, creaciones y sensaciones. ​ ¡Abre tu mente, porque aquí lo ilógica es cuestión de perspectiva!

NAME: Restaurante Punta Camaron
DESCRIPTION: Deliciosa comida de mar para compartir en familia y amigos. Disfruta y celebra esos momentos especiales en Punta Camarón ¡Te esperamos!

NAME: Babou Candelaria
DESCRIPTION: El Espiritu del Mundo, restaurante con platos nacionales e internacionales, ambiente salsero, clases de salsa, show de música en vivo y bailarines profesionales, todo en el Centro Histórico de Bogotá.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Carrera 2 #12b-31, Chorro De Quevedo, Callejón Del Embudo, 110411

NAME: Otafuku Omakase
DESCRIPTION: Contamos con una barra con capacidad para 10 personas, dónde nuestros comensales podrán disfrutar de un Menú Degustación Omakase. Otafuku, se encuentra ubicado en el nuevo Complejo Gastronómico del Grupo Seratta, en el cuarto piso del Centro Comercial Atlantis, una de las zonas gastronómicas más importantes de Bogotá, Colombia.

NAME: Oficial
DESCRIPTION: Somos la interpretación de los sabores clásicos de Perú, entendidos por el reconocido chef Rafael Osterling. Nuestro menú incluye platos que han hecho famosa la gastronomía peruana como los sánguches, ceviches, saltados y chaufas. Cuidamos cada detalle para llevar a su mesa platos sabrosos y con los mejores ingredientes.

NAME: Tierra Restaurante
DESCRIPTION: La tierra es parte fundamental de ser, estar y evolucionar por eso queremos conectarte con ella a través de nuestra comida. En ·T I E R R A· hemos creado un concepto denominado -NIKCOL-, el cual fusiona los sabores de la gastronomía japonesa con la cocina colombiana y ciertas tradiciones peruanas, resaltando los productos propios de nuestra región, que hacen de Colombia una tierra diversa y maravillosa. Apoyamos a campesinos, productores y emprendedores comprometidos con el medio ambiente, asegurando así una despensa fresca, de calidad, responsable y sostenible con nuestro entorno. La cocina creativa de TIERRA los invita principalmente a vivir su experiencia para compartir al centro de mesa en familia o con amigos o, en casa a través de nuestros domicilios propios. ¡Siempre bienvenidos!

NAME: Romeo Osteria
DESCRIPTION: Junto a Rafael Osterling hacemos un homenaje contemporáneo a la gastronomía italiana. Tenemos una cuidadosa selección de vinos y recogemos la tradición de varias regiones para crear una versión más propia y moderna de antipasti, tavolas, pizzas en horno de leña y pasta hecha en casa. Celebremos juntos la vida hecha placer.

NAME: La Ventana Restaurante
DESCRIPTION: Guests can experience a universe of flavors, based on grilled dishes, that will guide them on a delicious tour through Colombia. A delicious breakfast menu and buffet are offered every morning, along with a wide variety of well balanced, healthy and nutritious dishes. Brunch is served every Sunday.

NAME: Cafe Restaurante El Gato Gris
DESCRIPTION: El Gato Gris is a romantic and charming place in the heart of La Candelaria. We offer live music show every day, at noon and in the evenings. We are a place to fall in love, share with friends or family and enjoy the bohemian in Bogotá. Come and enjoy with us the #experienciagatogris

NAME: Petronio Cocina De Autor
DESCRIPTION: En Petronio - Cocina de autor cada uno de nuestros platos están inspirados en Colombia, su historia, su gente y su cultura. La combinación de modernidad y tendencias con tradición son el punto de encuentro en Petronio. Te invitamos a vivir esta experiencia llena de sabor, historia, música, texturas y aromas.

NAME: Origen Bistro
DESCRIPTION: Origen Bistro is a recreated Colombian cousine concept with ingredients from all around country, we are focus in offer such great experince further just food and beverage service our renovated house keeps the style and colonial charm from ancient Bogota, it gives a picturesque touch to have lunch also a dine out with family and friends

NAME: Guadalupe Latina
DESCRIPTION: 30 years of travelling Latam, 30 years of feeling excitement and desire within the humble of this holly land. The magic of the Caribbean, the Amazon, the Andes, the Pacífic, the Atlántic and the Patagonia gave Guadalupe - latina the touch of love, colour and flavour within everytjing we do, relax and enjoy tbe real Latam essence in this unique gastronomíc Experience.

NAME: La Provence de Andrei
DESCRIPTION: La Provence de Andrei is a cute French corner, located in the area of Usaquén, magical and charming place of the city of Bogota where you can live an experience full of harmony, taste, flavor and European delight. We have a varied menu, which satisfies the tastes of the French Mediterranean food, live market music and dedicated service so you can live your best experiences. Our restaurant is characterized for the very French Provencal colors and our flavors take you on a sigh to want to live a little more of our experience.

NAME: Pimento Cucina Italiana
DESCRIPTION: Pimento Cucina Italiana combines traditional Italian cuisine with innovative techniques which brings back the flavors of Italy to Bogota

NAME: Tanoshii Asian Cuisine & Lounge Bar
DESCRIPTION: Tanoshii Asian Cuisine & Bar Lounge. The place to be in Bogota. Good music and food combined in a lounge where people can relax and unwind after a hard day of work. Located at the Main Lobby of the Bogota Marriott Hotel.

NAME: Circo Terraza Zona G
DESCRIPTION: A new scene inspired in the circus esthetics where artistic expressions and the best pizzas fuse into one same spectacle.

NAME: Mini Mal
DESCRIPTION: This small restaurant is also the base of a design bureau. The fusion food served here is an amazing mix of the most delicious Colombian flavors. Coastal recipes meets traditional fruit desserts, along with some delicacies that are exotic even for the locals. I have lived here for a long time and this place is a revelation.

NAME: Inkanto Peruvian Cuisine C.C Gran Estacion
DESCRIPTION: Restaurante de gastronomía Peruana internacional y coctelería de autor. Inkanto una experiencia que ya puedes vivir en centro comercial Gran Estación y Centro comercial Multiplaza

NAME: T Bone Restaurante
DESCRIPTION: Restaurant specialized in wines and meat cuts with a touch of romance, a pinch of love and good music, the perfect recipe.

NAME: La Jugueteria Kennedy
DESCRIPTION: Restaurante Tematico.

NAME: Isola - Trattoria Bar
DESCRIPTION: Italian restaurant in Bogota, Colombia the best place around zona T, inspired by the mediterranean glamour, embodied in its identity the best of the sea fusion its stones and its colors and its diversity, this makes us a parallel world where the difference is in the mixture taking it to create a musical and artisan culinary identity, transporting you to an island of your own in the hectic city, Isola goes beyond the conventional restaurant combining flavors, colors and smells, managing to create a unique experience of beloning tha allows you to express your own being, it is a different space where for a moment the city stops being a city and becomes an exclusive itailan island in the middle of the sea.

NAME: Leo
DESCRIPTION: LEO offers a journey through the biocultural richness through tasting menus in the two spaces that make up the restaurant: Laura’s room and Leo’s room, while the sommelier supports her proposal of fermented drinks, macerations and distilled from botanical ingredients typical of local cultures. The creative process in the proposal of the chef Leonor Espinosa and the sommelier Laura Hernández, is supported by their FUNLEO foundation and is based on elements that allow sensations and emotions to be transferred to a story where you can feel, smell, remember, travel and listen, allows to build a new narrative of Colombian gastronomy exalting the biodiversity of the territory.

NAME: Sapiens
DESCRIPTION: SAPIENS es la nueva creación Ultra-Experience del Grupo Seratta y es el único Restaurante (a nivel mundial) en ser diseñado y dirigido por una inteligencia artificial. Al ingresar en nuestra Cápsula Multisensorial entrarás en una experiencia inmersiva, de 9 mundos y 9 tiempos gastronómicos. Una mesa única, será el lienzo (y el espejo) que te mostrará la odisea y el dilema de salvarnos de nosotros mismos.

NAME: Mirador La Paloma
DESCRIPTION: Todo en un lugar la única mejor vista a bogota. Cantantes todos los días Calefaccion chimeneas fogatas. Comidas carnes mariscos todo en uno Parqueadero gratis. Día y. Noche Hasta las 3 am ***No cover/ Free entrance***

NAME: Black Bear
DESCRIPTION: Exaltamos la cocina de autor con un capítulo importante de Raw Bar (productos de mar crudos) y preparaciones únicas de ceviches, carnes, ensaladas o sándwiches para disfrutar con unos tragos en nuestra icónica barra.

NAME: Osk Cocina Nikkei Bogota
DESCRIPTION: Our Nikkei cuisine takes the best of Japanese culture and Peruvian gastronomy to bring to the table a combination of unique flavors and memorable experiences.

NAME: Restaurante Casa San Isidro
DESCRIPTION: En el Cerro de Monserrate, hace mas de 40 años, hay un lugar exclusivo para grandes experiencias más cerca al cielo. San Isidro es un restaurante destacado por su tradición gastronómica europea, cuyos platos son elaborados con maestría, utilizando ingredientes frescos y locales de la mas alta calidad. Además de su carta permanente con preparaciones emblemáticas del viejo continente, presenta un menú de degustación con preparación única de temporada. San Isidro funciona en una casona tradicional colombiana con la mejor vista de todo el país. Su carta de selectos vinos y licores, ofrecen el maridaje perfecto.

NAME: Teo Estiatorio
DESCRIPTION: TEO MEDITERRANEO "Goddesses's Food". Gourmet Greek and Mediterranean food with an exclusive selection of wines and handcrafted beers. Mr. Teo Lykos is a known greek Chef in the city. For those not familiar with Greece, Estiatorio means Restaurant in greek language. Exclusive Hotel Morrison 114 is home of TEO Estiatorio, located at the most desirable residential and business district of Santa Barbara north of vibrant Bogota. Welcome to TEO ESTIATORIO, it will be an unique experience you should not miss. Reservations are suggested don't forget to try our desserts.Yours in hospitality.Teo.

NAME: Uma Cantina Peruana
DESCRIPTION: In our menu you will find a menu full of ingredients from the Peruvian territory that under a contemporary look become the best way to tell our story.

NAME: Oliveto Pizza & Pasta Parkway
DESCRIPTION: Este es nuestro punto más reciente y aquí estamos desde 2015. El ParkWay y la gran oferta de eventos culturales en la zona hace que Oliveto sea la mejor opción para disfrutar de un buen vino acompañado de la mejor comida italiana. En este local tenemos capacidad para grupos de hasta 35 personas.

NAME: Sumo Sushi Zona G
DESCRIPTION: We are a casual sushi restaurant where our goal it's to exceed your expectations in service and the best quality of sushi you can find in Bogota! Our service it's not the fastest but it is because we guarantee freshness and everything prepared from scratch as ordered... Gluten free meals available

NAME: 80 Sillas
DESCRIPTION: Nuestro concepto back to basics inspiró un menú donde ingredientes como el pescado fresco y otras carnes son los protagonistas de nuestras preparaciones honestas y sencillas.

NAME: La Aguada
DESCRIPTION: Comida tradicional Argentina, Empanadas, Comidas Regionales, Tartas, Sándwiches y Hamburguesas. Todo muy casero y fresco. Para los que quieren conocer la verdadera cocina de Argentina...
GENERAL_LOCATION: Billinghurst 1862,, intersección Arenales- Barrio Palermo, C1425DTL

NAME: Casa Coupage
DESCRIPTION: Learn about the breadth of Argentine wine with a sommelier as your guide. Casa Coupage is a unique space where you can discover & interpret wine paired with delicious argentinian modern food in a truly personal atmosphere. Casa Coupage offers an haute-cuisine venue for Argentine as well as international patrons. “The wine is a noble beverage that reaches its best expression when shared. That’s why we created an exclusive meeting point where a personal relationship with the wine can be developed, together with people who share the same passion”. - Santiago Mymicopulo. The concept itself is irresistibly delicious: dinner is held in a charming dining room of a late 19th century house. Seasonal first and main courses are each accompanied with a specially selected wine, allowing for both a comparative wine tasting and an optimal food pairing. The sommelier of the house guide the experience and provide background information regarding the specific terroir, variety of grape, and winemaker.

NAME: Cabernet
DESCRIPTION: Cabernet offers finest haute cuisine in an exclusive cozy and quiet environment. Our patio places us in contact with nature while we enjoy the exquisite food and an excellent selection of wines. Our wine list is the largest you will find in Buenos Aires. All our staff is trained to recommend you the best wine and food pairing in our menu. Like wine, Cabernet engages all the senses. Specialties: meats, fish and pasta.

NAME: Sullivan's Irish Pub & Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Su inicio en el año 2002 lo convirtió en el primer Irish Pub de Palermo; lugar de culto donde miles de personas se acercan a esta gran esquina para vivir el sentimiento que refleja la auténtica cultura, hospitalidad y tradición irlandesa. Sullivan´s es el lugar ideal para disfrutar de comidas y bebidas, ver deportes, encontrarse con amigos, y conversar en un ambiente de pleno frenesí celta. Se combinan los factores claves del tradicional Irish Pub: un clásico diseño irlandés, alegre, acogedor, con iluminación cálida, buena música, excelente comida, bebidas premium y un amable personal dispuesto a brindar el mejor servicio. Cervezas tiradas de todo el mundo y una completa carta de tragos y vinos.La participación, el entretenimiento, la incorporación de las tendencias actuales y la preponderancia del concepto sportbar, son la clave para sentirnos rodeados por esta hermosa cultura, mientras brindamos con una pinta bien fría de Guinness!

NAME: Huacho
DESCRIPTION: Cocina a leña.Carnes, pescados y pasta casera con identidad patagonica.Cava de vinos de toda la Argentina.Servicio increíble y buenas vibras

NAME: Rufino Argentino (at Mio Buenos Aires)
DESCRIPTION: Rufino persigue un concepto rupturista, aggiornado, moderno, globalizado, que abarca desde la comida clásica argentina, como eje central, hasta una propuesta completa con una amplia carta de vinos (de bodegas clásicas y productores jóvenes y pujantes), barra con tragos de autor, decoración, iluminación, música y por supuesto servicio (de la mano de un staff de salón joven). En ese eje central de la comida, el gran concepto son las reversiones de carnes y vegetales al fuego como protagonistas de la mesa (con gran variedad de opciones veggies). El principal objetivo de Rufino es abordar los platos clásicos argentinos, conocidos por todos, pero siempre con una vuelta más: un detalle, un color, un aroma, un condimento, un sabor, para generar sorpresa y que nuestros clientes vuelvan a enamorarse de ellos.

NAME: La Dorita de Palermo
DESCRIPTION: It was established in 2002 with a clear concept of Parrilla-Cantina, the best home cooking from Buenos Aires with a great taste. There was not another place with such proposal. The gratitude of the people was evident and definitive. It is de kind of reliable restaurant. It never fails, a real solution when is time to choose a good place to eat out. It is a good, modern, warm and lovely environment, open to the public, wide spectrum. It is a familiar place, for medium or big friend tables, couples and lonely clients. The cutlery is constantly rotating thanks to an instructed and oiled service. La Dorita announces. People call more people. They already know what they are going to look for, the best meat, made with great care. It is presented stylishly and without pretentious, the dishes of red-hot iron leaned on planks, land over the table offering a warm moment,whetting your appetite. The portions are abundant. The detail of the color is the typical penguins and a bottle where the wine comes from wineries of first quality, served from barrels in full view of everyone. The home-made desserts are the perfect close of the service, dynamic and kind. La Dorita offers a good relation between quality-price and that is how, the restaurant gaing fidelity with the reliable clients. These characteristics become this restaurant into a place where you can go daily. The client is satisfied. La Dorita is the best option to eat well every day.

NAME: Toro 777
DESCRIPTION: We are a closed doors restaurante, we offer a gastronomic experience and enjoyment for those who visit us. We receive them in our house, so that they feel like yours. We offer a menu of 5 steps with and a list of selected Argentine wines, from different strains and regions of the country.

NAME: Alberto's Lobby Bar
DESCRIPTION: Excellent place to enjoy the best cocktails with by a variety of tapas and dishes. Alberto's Lobby Bar proposes a new experience combining a sophisticated atmosphere with the warmth and hospitality that characterizes us as a brand.

NAME: Positano Lirica, Opera Ristorante
DESCRIPTION: We have am amazing proposal for Christmas' Eve and New Year's Eve! Lirica in Venice, Lirica with Humor, and Lirica Boheme. We offer a unique dinner experience featuring outstanding performers in an Italian atmosphere.

NAME: Italpast
DESCRIPTION: Bistró Sur —one of the most spectacular gastronomic settings in the country— welcomes a new pop-up experience by Chef Pedro Picciau with Signature dishes and traditional flavors of Italian-Sardinian haute cuisine

NAME: Michelangelo Legend
DESCRIPTION: Opcional de Menu a la carta o Menu Buffet para poder elegir . El resturant se encuentra abierto todos los dias de 19.30 a 00.00hs . Nuestro teatro ofrece un show de tango & Folclore integrado por el Sexteto dirigido por Nicolas Ledesma con la participación de Horacio Romo y Pablo Agri y músicos integrantes de las Famosas Orquestas de Leopoldo Federico y de Sexteto Mayor / Con la presencia estelar de Nestor Fabian y Maria Pisoni en la voz / Homenaje a Mariano Mores / Mateo Crespi interpreta con su guitarra temas populares reconocidos en el mundo/ acompañan grandes bailarines de folclore y 5 parejas de tango completan el elenco. Tenemos en el 1 piso nuestro Bar Dante para disfrutar de los mejores tragos de autor.

NAME: Restaurante Griego Kefi . Estiatorio
DESCRIPTION: Kéfi - Restaurante Griego en Palermo - Kéfi Estiatorio "Grecia ofrece al mundo su exquisita gastronomía para disfrutar en buena compañía. En Kéfi te proponemos transportarte a Grecia por un ratito, experimentar sus exclusivos, únicos y auténticos aromas, sus sabores y texturas para descubrir o rememorar así el maravilloso e idílico universo de la comida griega. Kefi, Restaurante en Palermo. Restaurante Griego."

NAME: La Pescadorita
GENERAL_LOCATION: Humboldt 1905, esquina Costa Rica- Barrio Palermo-, 1414

NAME: Casa SaltShaker
DESCRIPTION: We offer a unique social and dining experience, sharing a table with other guests in our home. The setting is casual and the conversation lively. Our food is eclectic — exploring the spices, herbs, chilies, and ingredients of the Andes, fused with global cuisine. Although not vegetarian, our focus is on fresh vegetables and fruits of the season as the key elements of each dish. We do tend to work with a lot of seafood, and generally at least one course will be fish and/or shellfish. It’s all about meeting new friends over good food and wine. For more than a decade, a truly don’t-miss experience for both travelers and locals!

NAME: Fogon Asado
DESCRIPTION: Discover the Asado steak tradition, served with a twist. This is a reservation only experience that starts at 19:45. We have created a closed-door dining experience that explores new ways of serving Argentine Asado classics, like provoleta, ribeye, tira de asado, seasonal vegetables and more. While seated at our bar you’ll see, feel and experience different grill cooking techniques, up close and personal. Our tasting menu consists of eight courses prepared on the grill, using seasonal ingredients. We aim to create a memorable fireside experience for each guest, beyond your regular steakhouse expectations. The optional wine pairings have been designed to best enhance the overall flavors, and present different wines from Argentina.

NAME: Encuentro Nativo
DESCRIPTION: We are a typical Argentine food restaurant, but we also elaborate unique dishes that distinguish us within the neighborhood of the riverbank. Here you can taste from tasty meats, to exquisite wines, all products of our lands. Cocktails are also present with classic and signature drinks, prepared by expert hands in our bar. Referring to our name, here you can find gastronomy, art and culture of our country. We have artistic samples of first level. Tango and folklore show with live musicians, dancers who show Argentine native dances and exhibition of paintings by local painters. Going inside the conventillo, arriving at the patio, a door leads to the hidden Vinoteca, where you can taste the best wines from exclusive boutique wineries in Argentina.

NAME: RonConCon
DESCRIPTION: RONCONCON | Cocina Latina True flavors of Mexico, Colombia, Peru, Venezuela and more together with boutique wines and the best cocktails in Caballito (Buenos Aires).

NAME: Criolla Cooking & Wine
DESCRIPTION: Immersive local cooking classes, asado masterclass, wine tastings and group events, in the heart of Palermo Soho. Our modern and inviting cooking space is the perfect environment to spend time discovering the local specialties and recipes of Argentina, just like our abuelas made them! Our wine tastings are a great activity to discover the different grape varieties of Argentina that have become world-renowned.

NAME: Argentine Experience
DESCRIPTION: Experience rich Argentine culture through food: taste fantastic local dishes, drink exceptional wine, and mingle with fellow travelers from around the world. Deep dive into the culinary treasures of Argentina in one night! Our tasting menu consists of ten mouth-watering dishes, giving you an incredible introduction to the traditional local specialties—paired with three hand-selected wines, each sourced from Argentina’s most celebrated wine regions. Our English and Portuguese speaking guides are on hand to spoil you all evening!

NAME: La Posta de Los Tucu
DESCRIPTION: Descubre la auténtica comida casera argentina con la mejor experiencia, calidad y precio. ¡Te invitamos a visitarnos y disfrutar de los sabores que te harán sentir como en casa! Nuestro compromiso es brindarte una experiencia culinaria excepcional, donde cada plato refleja la pasión y el sabor de la cocina nacional. Ven a saborear lo mejor de Argentina en cada bocado.

NAME: Revire Brasas Bravas
DESCRIPTION: Revire es una gran Parrilla Argentina,en el corazón de la ciudad, sobre la Av.Corrientes a pasos del obelisco porteño.Donde podras disfrutar de exquisitos cortes de carne premium, pastas, ensaladas. Vinos exclusivamente seleccionados, excelentes tragos clasicos y de autor.Es un lugar ideal para disfrutar de buena gastronomia,en cualquier momento del día.

NAME: Brasserie La Petanque
DESCRIPTION: La Petanque, authentic French Brasserie with traditional French cuisine, onion soup, steak tartar, duck confit, beef bourguignon, salmon tartar, profiteroles, tatin tart and of course the best creme brulee in Buenos Aires.

NAME: Los Salones del Piano Nobile
DESCRIPTION: Located in the Palacio, these magnificent salons serve breakfast, small dishes, and elegant snacks throughout the day with special emphasis on afternoon tea. The rooms conserve their original painted “boisery” and offers a fireplace, and an elegant combination of low and high tables.The magnificent outside terrace, accessible through both exits of the Piano Nobile Salons as well as the Oak Bar, enjoys magnificent views over the landscaped garden of the Palace. The total capacity for indoor dining is 43 seats; outdoor dinning area is 30 guests.

NAME: Cantina Sunae
DESCRIPTION: Te invitamos a viajar por el Sudeste Asiatico a traves de sus sabores, aromas y colores. Con la cocina a la vista, la chef Christina Sunae y su equipo, preparan deliciosos platos de Filipinas, Tailandia, Vietnam, Indonesia y Malasia, respetando las tecnicas tradicionales y utilizando ingredientes frescos especialmente seleccionados. Pedidos y reservas desde nuestra pagina web. Aceptamos Visa o MasterCard (credito y debito), transferencia bancaria o efectivo. Si estas a un radio de 20 cuadras te llevamos el pedido sin cargo. Abrimos de martes a domingo de 12:30hs a 23:30hs. Humboldt 1626, Palermo.

NAME: Sacro
DESCRIPTION: Plant based food of the world. SACRO invites you to travel around the world through flavors serving dishes from the 5 continents.

NAME: Javi's Parrilla Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Abrimos nuestras puertas en Marzo del 2018. Nuestro objetivo es brindar grandes momentos a través de nuestra cálida antención y platos con sabores únicos. Vení y sentite parte de nuestra familia!

NAME: La Tablita
DESCRIPTION: Gourmet products store and new flavors!! Wide variety of Cold Cuts and Cheeses, Traditional, Handmade, from the different regions of our country. Selection of imported products. Carefully chosen, for its unbeatable flavor and quality, arriving with all its freshness at your table. Tasty skewers, marinated cheeses, spreadable dips, marinades, etc. Tables or box of cheeses and cold cuts, for an excellent meeting. Own elaborations of Cheeses and cold cuts that you will only find in our house. A constant search for flavors to surprise you with. own jewelry!!! Through more than 37 years of experience, we have managed to gather the best products, the best producers and, above all, develop our own products, in a constant search to improve ourselves. You will be surprised to feel involved in a new experience of flavors, making your visit not only a pleasant acquisition of delicacies, but a moment where you would like to take everything with you and visit us again soon.

NAME: Una Cancion Coreana
DESCRIPTION: Traditional Korean Restaurant in Buenos Aires' Korean Town. Our main dishes are: Bulgogui, Bossam, Samguetang, CheYuk BokUm, Jin Mandu, Kalguksu, Nokdu Bindetok, Kimchi Jjigue, Dwen Jang Jjigue, Yuk Gue Jang, Mandu Guk, Chung Guk Jjang, Dulke Sujebi, Dwen Jang Kalguksu Summer Special Dishes: Mul Neng Myon and Bibim Neng Myon
GENERAL_LOCATION: Avenida Carabobo 1549, Entre Saraza y Balbastro, 1406

NAME: St. Regis Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Walking into St. Regis Restaurant´s large Winter Garden-style dining room, guests are greeted by warm, soothing golden and peach tones complemented by crisp withe table linenes, dark wood accents and sophisticated nuances. Large windows overlooking the city centre provide an additional draw. At breakfast they welcome the inviting sun, while in the evening they offer an enchanting glimpse of the twinkling city lights.Nature is intelligent, the food market is our inspiration and dictates our creations. NAME: Nuestro Secreto
DESCRIPTION: A major social event in Argentina, the asado (an open-fire barbecue) marks a time when friends and family gather around a traditional outdoor fire pit and spend an afternoon catching up. It is as much about tradition and being together as it is about food. It all begins with the coal; made from hand-picked woods of local tree varietals, each one providing a unique flavour. Cooking whole animals is quite common at the asado, but there is always plenty of variety to choose from - embutidos, meats, red wine and salads. With a casual eclectic backyard esthetic, Nuestro Secreto transports guests to a "secret garden" urban retreat within a bustling cityscape. Typical courtyard decorations abound, with porous stone floors, the grill and clay oven, even a cross on the wall. Outdoor-style furniture made of wood, glass and iron lends an antique but fresh look. All of the tableware is made locally in Mendoza, with exclusive designs by Aji Diseno available for special occasions. What is most unique about this space, however, is that the roof and walls are made of glass and can be opened to create an entirely al fresco space, perfect for stargazing on clear nights. Our Sunday menu features a variety of dishes typically served among families on the weekend. And since our menu is designed to resemble the most-read newspaper in Buenos Aires, it will look to passersby like restaurant patrons are all relaxing with the Sunday paper.

NAME: Elena
DESCRIPTION: When simplicity is truly authentic, it conveys the superb quintessential spirit of the product. This is what we aimed to create while designing Elena's menu. We place absolute importance on the search to find every impeccable ingredient. Proud believers of the farm-to-table philosophy, our iconic charcuterie and cheese platters - paying homage to the Argentine picada - are locally sourced, carefully selected and coming from the country's best farms. The Argentine beef, a driving influential force throughout the entire menu, undergoes the old method of dry aging the meat, aging the beef properly in a highly controlled environment to provide a steak with the utmost quality where the bursting flavors are concentrated and achieve the perfect texture. We pay tribute to our grandmother's cooking with hearty dishes like pastas and osso buco. Through unconventional cooking techniques using a char-broiler and rotisserie spit grill, our food achieves a distinct ideal consistency. At Elena, we carefully and purposefully have thought out every last detail: from the water which is purified and filtered in house, the bread basket which includes homemade sourdough made from our own starter, the elegant coffee cups, and even down to the best sugar and flour for our coffees accompanying petit four. Elena has its roots deeply entrenched into the heart of the local culinary scene. And, from here, conquers the entire world.
