You will be able to enjoy your meal without unpleasant surprises, to take away or to taste on site.

NAME: Pur' - Jean-Francois Rouquette
DESCRIPTION: Niché au sein du Park Hyatt Paris-Vendôme, palace contemporain de la Place Vendôme, PUR’ est le restaurant multi-récompensé de Jean-François Rouquette. Avec une étoile Michelin et 17,5 au Gault & Millau, il y propose une approche délicate et instinctive de la gastronomie française. Très expérientiel, PUR’ – JEAN-FRANCOIS ROUQUETTE propose de vivre le ballet d’une brigade le temps d’un dîner à la carte, en 6 ou en 9 services. Depuis la rotonde ou confortablement installé sur les épaisses banquettes tendues de velours clair, le restaurant promet une vue imprenable sur sa majestueuse cuisine ouverte. En rejoignant la « Table du chef » (4 à 6 convives), d’aucuns s’offrent l’exclusivité de l’avant-scène, avec un accès exceptionnel à la création culinaire. Toujours très conviviale, l’ambiance du restaurant reflète la philosophie de son chef moderne, amoureux des beaux produits, et porté par le partage et la transmission. Chef pâtissier : Narae Kim / Chef sommelier : James Barnett
GENERAL_LOCATION: 5 Rue de La Paix, Park Hyatt Paris, 75002

NAME: Akabeko Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Chef Yasuo Nanaumi vous invite pour une expérience culinaire inoubliable, dans un restaurant fusion français et japonais en plein cœur du 7e arrondissement de Paris. Composé de deux étages, le restaurant propose une ambiance chic, moderne et chaleureuse. Au rez-de-chaussé un long comptoir et au 1er une salle cosy pour vous accueillir.

NAME: Assanabel Paris
DESCRIPTION: Assanabel Paris, les restaurants où notre spécialité est la délicieuse cuisine libanaise créée avec ingéniosité et passion inspirée des plus belles saveurs du Liban. Depuis 1988, nous prenons soin d’innover en fonction de vos goûts tout en préservant tradition et qualité. Venez donc découvrir la cuisine du pays du cèdre chez le meilleur restaurant libanais à Paris !

NAME: Bistro Chez Pradel
DESCRIPTION: Depuis 1897, le restaurant français Chez Pradel brille au cœur du 11ème arrondissement de Paris. Située dans le quartier emblématique de Bastille, cette brasserie allie tradition et modernité. Séduisant ceux qui chérissent la gastronomie française dans un cadre convivial, elle demeure une véritable institution. Dans une atmosphère chaleureuse, Chez Pradel se révèle être une institution incontournable pour les gourmands en quête d'authenticité.

NAME: Il Etait Un Square
DESCRIPTION: Notre restaurant est spécialisé en burgers et tartares. La particularité de nos burgers : la crème de fromage. Nos burgers et tartares sont réalisés avec une viande bovine (Aubrac rustique) issue d'élevages traditionnels français. Nos buns boulangers sont bio. 21h30 (derniere reservation)

NAME: Da Giuseppe
DESCRIPTION: Fresh and authentic Italian products. Long-lasting artisanal pizza dough made in our local using a balanced mixture of Italian flours, homemade natural sourdough, Himalayan pink salt, ensuring lightness, aromas and digestibility. Fruits and vegetables from the market. DOP “Denominazione di Origine Protetta” cheeses and cured meats cut to order preserving taste and freshness.

NAME: Assanabel Saint-Germain
DESCRIPTION: Assanabel Paris, les restaurants où notre spécialité est la délicieuse cuisine libanaise créée avec ingéniosité et passion inspirée des plus belles saveurs du Liban. Depuis 1988, nous prenons soin d’innover en fonction de vos goûts tout en préservant tradition et qualité. Venez donc découvrir la cuisine du pays du cèdre chez le meilleur restaurant libanais à Paris !

NAME: Habile.
DESCRIPTION: La couturière et le marmiton. Ça pourrait être un conte d’Andersen. C’est juste HABILE. un point c’est tout. Papa pique et maman coud, Éric, c’est le chef, Camille, c’est le patron. Un beau roman, une belle histoire, une romance d’aujourd’hui, ils se sont rencontrés sur l’autoroute du kif et ne l’ont jamais quittée. À l’angle de la rue de Lancry et de la rue du Château d’Eau, HABILE. est une maison à leur image. Un restaurant, d’abord. Un endroit où l’on fait à manger pour restaurer, pour faire du bien, pour faire le bien. Trois ingrédients, bons, propres et durables, trois fois tout plutôt que trois fois rien. Et qu’il se passe quelque chose dans l’assiette, que l’ennui tombe. Betterave, framboise, noisette, chouchou indétrônable, ou chou-fleur, croûton, citron, ça pulse mais ça tient en équilibre. Aller à l’essentiel, épurer, toujours se poser la question : « qu’est-ce qu’on enlève pour que ce soit meilleur ? ».

NAME: Bistrot Kinzo
DESCRIPTION: French and Japanese fusion. Fresh products and a menu that evolves with the seasons. The owner Edward Uchiyama was the Head Chef at the Intercontinental hotel Marceau, worked for Joel Robuchon and at the Four Seasons George V hotel. Come and experience a Journey to Japan and France with our 6 course Tasting menu and wine paring.

NAME: Pizzamore Paris
DESCRIPTION: Bonjour! À la recherche d'une authentique expérience italienne au cœur de Paris? Ne cherchez plus, rendez-vous chez Pizzamore, situé dans le charmant quartier de Montparnasse : 14e arrondissement. Notre pizzeria vous offre une expérience gastronomique 100% italienne avec des pâtes fraîches, des pizzas gourmet et des desserts traditionnels. Que vous souhaitiez dîner sur place, vous faire livrer ou emporter, notre emplacement privilégié près de la station de Montparnasse facilite la dégustation des saveurs italiennes tout en séjournant à Paris. Nous avons hâte de vous accueillir.

NAME: B.Better
DESCRIPTION: B.BETTER is a 100% Vegetal and 100% Gourmet restaurant. A complete offer, a top location and reasonable prices make B.BETTER, a unique place to rediscover street-food in a vegetal version in the heart of the capital. The recipes are inspired by the seasons and the ingredients we love. B.BETTER products are homemade, made to order and sourced as much as possible from local agriculture. A new concept, which we hope will make it possible to democratize the vegetable diet on a daily basis, while reducing our environmental impact. Strive for the best and respect our planet without forgetting to have fun! "Nobody's Perfect, Be Better." Erika & Lucas (founders of B.BETTER)

NAME: Chefs a Table
DESCRIPTION: Restaurant semi-gastronomique où il fait bon s’arrêter pour déguster une cuisine variée, originale et bien maîtrisée. Les produits frais sont à l’honneur dans notre établissement. L'équipe Chefs à Table vous attends pour partager un agréable moment.

NAME: Boutary
DESCRIPTION: Boutary is a chic and trendy "boutique bistro" with traditional French roots but a modern and affordable approach to gastronomic cuisine. High-end festive delicacies prepared by an expert chef and a short but exceptional selection of wines, champagne and vodkas are offered at reasonable prices. Caviar is one of the house's specialities: although not compulsory, we suggest you try a sampling or a small caviar dish to make your experience at Boutary truly unique.

NAME: Pizzeria Arrivederci
DESCRIPTION: Smart pizza place in 5arrondisement. Here you can taste real Italian pizza with all fresh productos... Just taste it and you travel to Italy!!!

NAME: Petit Boutary
DESCRIPTION: Dans une rue calme des Batignolles, dans une atmosphère de bistro moderne, notre Chef Kazu vous accueille à sa "table du Chef". Laissez vous surprendre par ses menus du jour, renouvelés à chaque saison...

NAME: The Frog at Bercy Village
DESCRIPTION: THE FROG AT BERCY VILLAGE is situated in an historic Parisian wine chai. It has open beams, limestone walls and a split-level interior, with two charming terraces. The magnificent English custom-designed and manufactured microbrewery is a main feature in this pub & produces 10,000 pints of our six original craft beers each week.

NAME: Il Grano
DESCRIPTION: Family-friendly pizzeria-trattoria with delivery and take-out services open 7 days a week available at www.restaurantilgrano.com. Specialties of fresh artisanal pasta and Roman pizzas (pinsa romana which is the ancestor of Neapolitan pizza). 100% home cooking including bread and desserts. The restaurant offers a wide view of the open kitchen, possibility of eating on the terrace.

NAME: 114 Faubourg
DESCRIPTION: La brasserie étoilée Récompensé par une étoile au guide Michelin, le 114 Faubourg est devenu la brasserie chic du Tout Paris. L’escalier en fer forgé participe à l’ambiance élégante et chaleureuse du lieu tandis que la cuisine ouverte rend l’espace si convivial. C’est dans un esprit de famille que l'équipe du 114 Faubourg accueille ses convives. En coulisses, la brigade supervisée par Eric Frechon vous régale.

NAME: Gosier
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Gosier! A friendly restaurant proposing a delicate seasonal cooking. Enjoy the surprise of our audacious pairings of our small plates to share, allowing you to vary your gustatory pleasures. No limit for treats, the menu is renewed every two weeks, for always more delights! The wine menu is as attractive. You will find untypical wines, or more classical ones, organic, bio-dynamic, and also natural wines, all coming from French regions, and carefully selected. Come and discover our coups de coeur of the moment!

NAME: Frog XVI
DESCRIPTION: FROG XVI is situated in the 16th arrondissement, one of the capital's most cosmopolitan quarters, popular with tourists and Parisians alike. FROG XVI is stylishly decorated whilst conserving the warmth and conviviality of an English pub. We're proud to boast a magnificent microbrewery and a bar/restaurant on two levels.

NAME: Alleudium
DESCRIPTION: "Keiichi SHINOHARA arrive en France en 2003 après 10 ans de service auprès de Chefs japonais à Tokyo, JAPON. Chez Alleudium, le Chef vous propose une cuisine instinctive et spontanée qu’il compose au gré des saisons. Inventive, sa cuisine sans ambiguïté devient un style ou chaque aliment pris est traité avec une perfection de cuisson, de texture et de saveur. Une touche japonaise dans la cuisson ou dans l’assaisonnement suffisent à émerveiller nos papilles. Une vision contemporaine de la cuisine française, savamment servie dans des plats où règnent l’harmonie et l’équilibre…"

NAME: Frog & Underground
DESCRIPTION: Frog & Underground is based in the famous "grands boulevards" district. The pub, once the french beer factory, has kept its original feel with its exposed brick walls and factory style decoration... Try out our genuinely good burger and our great graft beer.

NAME: Comptoir Gourmet
DESCRIPTION: Dining bar and delicatessen in the historic district of the Marais in Paris suggesting discovering products of countries come from Italy and from France. The amateurs, the regular customers of the district and the curious find themselves in a friendly and warm atmosphere to taste a selection of delicatessen, cheeses and products specially were selected for their authenticity. Our purpose is to make you discover the traditional products of the various countries in their quality of origin and their authentic taste. Beyond the cooking of the Grands Chefs, we want to offer to all these small craftsmen and producers the opportunity to make you share and appreciate the excellence of them produced. Our ambition is to make you participate in the rediscovery of the talents and the know-how of the producers.

NAME: Alix et Mika - Tartares sur mesure
Chez Nicos
DESCRIPTION: Chez Nicos est une crêperie, avec crêpes sucrées dessert,galette sarrasin pour salé et Paninis à emporter. Option VEGAN friendly

NAME: Terra Mia
DESCRIPTION: Gastronomy Of The Naples Cuisine

NAME: Poni
DESCRIPTION: Dans notre établissement, vous pouvez déguster de délicieux repas sans avoir à attendre longtemps votre repas. Nous nous réjouissons de votre visite. Nos clients apprécient notre bistrot pour la fraîcheur et la qualité de ses plats. Testez par vous-même et laissez-vous convaincre. Notre offre vous inspirera. Vous pouvez vous installer au soleil dans notre sublime espace et profiter de l’été avec vos amis. Notre bistrot climatisé vous accueille pour passer un moment agréable peu importe la température extérieure. Un excellent bistrot pour déjeuner Vous serez ravis par nos recettes françaises et variées préparées par nos cuisiniers à votre attention. Notre excellente cuisine s’accompagne d’une vaste gamme de plats et de boissons délicieuses. Savourez les excellents plats du terroir, les plats régionaux variés ou les excellentes salades, créés avec passion par nos chefs de cuisine. Notre tiramisu et notre confiture délicate vous séduiront pour le goûter. Passez nous voir pour un petit-d

NAME: Alliance
DESCRIPTION: Le restaurant Alliance, c’est avant tout une belle histoire. Celle d’une complicité aussi percutante qu’évidente entre Toshitaka Omiya, chef japonais originaire d’Osaka, et Shawn Joyeux, autodidacte du service et passionné par le vin (700 références à la carte). En novembre 2015, le duo inaugure cette première adresse, dans une rue discrète du 5ème arrondissement, à quelques pas du boulevard Saint-Germain.

NAME: TATA Burger
GENERAL_LOCATION: 54 Rue Sainte Croix de la Bretonnerie, 75004

NAME: L'Orangerie
DESCRIPTION: LOrangerie offers a refreshing, intimate experience thanks to its interior design by Pierre-Yves Rochon. LOrangerie restaurant has an intimate atmosphere overlooking the famous Marble Courtyard. Chef David Bizets menu exemplifies the traditional French contemporary cuisine of elegance, refinement, femininity and respect for nature. Crowned World Champion of the "Hare a? la Royale" championship in October 2016, he achieved one Michelin star in February, just eight months after the restaurants opening. Awarded Great Chef of Tomorrow by the Gault & Millau Guide one month later, he then received the prize of Best Meat or Poultry Dish by the Lebey Guide before being crowned Revelation of the Year by the Pudlowski Guide.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 31 Avenue George V, Four Seasons Hotel, 75008

NAME: Can Alegria Paris
DESCRIPTION: Ancien cabaret où chantait Piaf à ses débuts, le restaurant Can Alegria poursuit l’histoire. Restaurant & bar, l’adresse chante la cuisine méditerranéenne et exotique, sert de bons vins et propose des cocktails originaux. Toujours dans la joie de vivre. Niché au cœur de Pigalle, ce lieu de partage a été pensé par la décoratrice Élodie Ricord. Le cadre chaleureux, combinant matières naturelles et couleur bleue rappelle la méditerranée et permet un voyage inédit à Paris. Le chef Marc-Antoine Colonna propose des plats qui ressemblent au lieu : une cuisine créative, avec une influence espagnole, qui change au rythme des saisons.

NAME: Mache
DESCRIPTION: Mâche, restaurant créé par Vincent Geraud comme un éternel mouvement basé sur la convivialité et la prise en compte de notre planète ; un lieu vivant où la cuisine du chef Michaël Gamet s'inspire des saisons et de ses nombreux voyages... Une créativité centrée sur l'accord, l'assaisonnement et les condiments, vision partagée par une équipe jeune et passionnée. Des goûts francs et osés, parfois surprenants, parfois réconfortants, mais toujours superbement accompagnés par une sélection de vins nature par Mathias Fouré, responsable en salle, amoureux du métier et des bonnes quilles

NAME: Granite par Tom Meyer
DESCRIPTION: Granite est le nouvel établissement du Groupe Eclore par le chef Tom Meyer, associé à Stéphane Manigold. Lieu vivant faisant la part belle aux matériaux naturels et organiques.

NAME: Les Barioles de Maud Paris 9
DESCRIPTION: Le seul endroit à Paris pour découvrir et déguster des bariolés !! La cuisine de Maud est 100% maison avec des produits frais et de saison, les bariolés sont des délicieux petits plats ou desserts colorés au naturel pour donner envie d'en croquer :) Vous pourrez déguster des bariolés lors d'un brunch en semaine ou un brunch le week-end, d'un déjeuner (bowl déjeuner), d'un dîner ou même d'un after-work ! En ce moment, le bariolé "Pomodoro" vous attend : tomates rôties, mozzarella, pesto de basilic et croûtons maison, dans sa jolie coque rouge croustillante... L'équipe de Maud vous attend tous les jours avec le sourire :)

NAME: Le Faham by Kelly Rangama
DESCRIPTION: Cuisine traditionnelle gastronomique aux influences ultra-marine, inspirée par la Réunion et les Dom-Tom, la Cheffe Kelly Rangama s'imprègne des plats traditionnels de son enfance à la Réunion et de ses voyages sur les 9 départements d'outre-mer durant son émission culinaire "voyages et délices".

NAME: May Bay
DESCRIPTION: Situé à Vincennes, au pied du métro Saint Mandé (L1), Mây Bay - Restaurant vietnamien végan végétarien- vous propose de savoureux plats repris ou réinventés dans la tradition culinaire Asiatique. Le restaurant inscrit quotidiennement à sa carte quatre entrées, plats et fabriqués sur place à base d'ingrédients frais et durement sélectionnés. Nous ajoutons à chaque service une entrée, un plat et un dessert du jour associant ainsi découverte à l’offre de fond soigneusement élaborée Nos plats sont également disponibles en livraison !

NAME: Origines
DESCRIPTION: After 5 years and one Michelin Star at Les Climats, Julien Boscus opened his own restaurant. Based on sourcing of the best french products his cuisine is a real experience of the authentic french cuisine. Wine list with over 500 references awarded with 2 Glasses « Best of Award of Excellence » by Wine Spectator

NAME: Nectar
DESCRIPTION: Découvrez une gastronomie immersive, où l'expertise se marie à la créativité, offrant une expérience polysensorielle, rebelle et contemporaine, dans une atmosphère collective. Le collectif Nectar croit fermement que la cuisine doit être une célébration, offrant aux convives un moment de découverte et d'expérimentation. Nous considérons que chaque bouchée doit être une expérience sensorielle, c’est pourquoi nous mettons notre dévouement pour créer un spectacle olfactif ainsi qu’une explosion de saveurs dans chaque assiette.

NAME: Le Comptoir Boutary
DESCRIPTION: Cuisine de marché et Vins de caractère

NAME: Publisher - Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Gastro Pub, Draught beers. At Publisher, you can enjoy our own beer, directly brewed in Paris, discover our huge shelf of spirits from all around the world, and eat very fine food. Come and discover our varied menu and a choice of delicious daily dishes! Our staff will welcome you as if you were at home and suggest you atypical dishes from the Publisher's kitchen. Let's enjoy fresh cocktails, french wines, and abnormal products

NAME: Bustronome Paris
DESCRIPTION: Aboard a double-decker bus converted into a restaurant, guests will enjoy a friendly welcome and a wide variety of dishes in a fashionable setting. The BUSTRONOME : a Parisian invitation to rediscover some of the City of Light's most beautiful locations while enjoying fine French cuisine. This singular journey combines a visual experience with a treat for the taste buds; Paris residents and tourists alike can indulge their love of culture while savouring good food.

NAME: Le 27 Gourmand
DESCRIPTION: Situé au coeur du quartier des Batignolles, à deux pas de la gare Saint-Lazare, de la place de Clichy ou encore du théâtre Hébertot et de l'Européen, depuis maintenant 23 ans, Valérie et Nicolas vous accueillent avec grand plaisir pour vous proposer une table d'exception. Nous mettons au centre de notre priorité votre satisfaction en vous proposant un cadre chic et moderne, ainsi qu'un service personnalisé. Vous dégusterez de la cuisine du Sud Ouest préparée avec des produits français d'excellente qualité tels que Magrets et Confit de Canard, Foie Gras de Canard, desserts Maison. Nous organisons tous vos évènements midi et soir.

NAME: Zincou Vins & Tapas
DESCRIPTION: Zincou is both a wine and tapas restaurant. The chef offers a gourmet French cuisine to share as tapas. We select fresh and local products as much as possible in order to put forward the "French terroir". About the cellar, there is a selection of more than 40 wines served by the glass. We propose different types of wine such as organic, biodynamic, or nature ones.

NAME: La Table De Colette
DESCRIPTION: Une cuisine savoureuse dans le respect de la planète, voilà le pari de La Table De Colette. Avec le potager comme principale source d’inspiration, mais pas que.Venez découvrir les émotions gastronomiques de la cuisine écoresponsable de Josselin MARIE, tout en réduisant votre empreinte carbone. Nous vous proposons des menus en 3, 5 ou 7 temps, à l'aveugle afin de vous proposer le meilleur de la production française. En tant que breton, le Chef ne peut pas faire l'impasse sur la pêche et pour les grands gourmands le menu en 7 temps comporte une séquence autour de la viande. Nous avons fait le choix d'accueillir tous les bons vivants, pour cela nous nous adaptons à un maximum de régimes spéciaux (vegan, végétarien, sans gluten, sans lactose).

NAME: Restaurant L'INITIAL
DESCRIPTION: Opening Times Lunch | Wednesday to Saturday 12.00pm to 1.30pm Dinner | Tuesday to Saturday 7.00pm to 9.00pm

NAME: Didon.
DESCRIPTION: Cuisine française bistronomique, de partage et au charbon de bois. Produits de saison, plats végétariens et végans aussi.

NAME: La MiN
DESCRIPTION: Place to eat, drink and speak

NAME: Le Village Russe
DESCRIPTION: Tous les Vendredi et Samedi soirs de 20h à 7h, les Dimanche de 20h à 5h au 18 rue Paul Klee 75013 Paris, retrouvez votre resto-club cosy préféré ! Supers plats, karaoké, et le meilleur de la musique US saupoudrée de Caribbean Vibes et d'AfroBeat toute la nuit ! C'est ici qu'il faut être ! Dîner-spectacle-clubbing, excellente ambiance et magnifiques souvenirs 200% garantis !

NAME: Au P'tit Curieux
DESCRIPTION: We offer simple, yet sophisticated and elegant fare, created from the freshest products, to delight the eyes as well as the discriminating palate. Please note that our restaurant is not suitable for children under 8 years old.

NAME: Azur Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Café restaurant en plein coeur du 8ème arrondissement, à deux pas des champs Elysée proposant des brunch healthy toute la journée, ainsi que des plats saint, colorés et savoureux.

NAME: Skykitchen
DESCRIPTION: Chef de cuisine Alexander Koppe is a dyed-in-the-wool Berliner who enjoys exploring new culinary horizons. Koppe Style is a modern, Michelin-starred style of cuisine with a French foundation, an Asian touch and a shot of Berlin Prenzlauer Berg, where the culinary master has his roots. Top quality and a laid-back vibe are also reflected in the stylish ’60s atmosphere with spectacular views of Berlin. Delightful service and professional wine accompaniment are provided courtesy of Barbara Merll, Maître of the Year 2017, and her team.

NAME: Hasty Pastry
DESCRIPTION: PIDAZA & PIADINA "Is the new kind of healthy flatbread" Pidaza is a flatbread baked in northern Italy according to a family recipe that works completely without animal fats, eggs, milk and is very thin. There are two varieties to choose from - one with wheat flour and cold-pressed grape seed oil and one with spelled flour. It is covered with various fresh, high-quality and natural ingredients, such as with mozzarella, avocado, tofu, fresh vine tomatoes or cooked ham, salami, tuna and much more. Our Pidaza is prepared on a special plate without fat, fresh and live for you. How it's goes! First you choose a Pidaza, then the size and finally the covering you want.

NAME: La Gondola Due
DESCRIPTION: Daily fresh fish: sole, turbot, Sashimi tuna, bream, shrimp, swordfish, calamaretti, Giant Gamberoni, salmon ect. Best steak from Argentina (Black Angus Rind beef) Calf: calf filet, calf liver (Bahlmann-Kalb Germany) the best

NAME: Restaurant Bieberbau
DESCRIPTION: Bieberbau at Durlacher Str. 15 in Berlin-Wilmersdorf is part of a former studio and dwelling house. Built 1893/94 by Wilhelm Walther for the sculptuor Richard Bieber, it was nearly completely destroyed by a firebomb during World War II. Only the rooms and decoration of what is now the restaurant survived. The stucco ornamentation you can admire here have been created by the most advanced students and trainedcraftsmen of the principal and owner. He maintained a plasterer's and sculptuor's studio. The decorations depict different motives from mythology and rural life. They show advanced technical skills. The premises in their organic design provide an insight into the stuccateurs' craftmenship unique for Berlin around the turn of the twentieth century. They offer a unique spatial experience the qualitiy and complexitiy of which were out of the ordinary. In the backyard of the house there were several studios, amongst others those of the expressionist work group ,,Die Brücke" (,,The Bridge"). Between 1910 and 1913 Max Pechstein and Ernst Ludwig Kirchner worked here.

NAME: Seaside
DESCRIPTION: Experience the mix of nordic freshness and californian coolness in a lively atmosphere of a fish market. At Seaside at the Gendarmenmarkt a daily changing selection of Fish and Seafood is waiting for you in our fresh fish bar. We bring the sea into the city! All our dishes are made of the best and freshest ingredients, and are without any additives. We are looking forward to SEA YOU SOON!

NAME: 100 Gramm Bar
DESCRIPTION: Gastro & cocktail bar - delicious ukraine / russian dishes, fantastic home-made vodka infusions, honest drinks and cool cocktails. Great vibes and awesome guests! Follow us on Instagram & Facebook for more news!

NAME: Ristorante A MANO
DESCRIPTION: Seit 2011 begrüßt das A MANO seine Gäste mit exquisiter italienischer Küche und einer einzigartigen mediterranen Atmosphäre. Das Restaurant hat sich in kürzester Zeit in Berlin fest etabliert und gilt heute als Hotspot für Genießer. Was uns auszeichnet, ist nicht nur die herausragende Kulinarik, sondern auch unser engagiertes Team. Wir bieten nicht nur professionellen Service, sondern schaffen auch eine herzliche und persönliche Atmosphäre, in der sich jeder Gast wie ein geschätzter Teil unserer A Mano-Familie fühlt. Unsere erstklassige Lage am Strausberger Platz in Berlin-Mitte, nur einen kurzen Spaziergang vom Alexanderplatz entfernt, ermöglicht es unseren Gästen, authentisches italienisches Flair zu erleben. In einem stilvollen und gemütlichen Ambiente können Sie mediterrane Köstlichkeiten genießen. Unsere umfangreiche Auswahl an Speisen und Weinen lässt keine Wünsche offen und garantiert ein unvergessliches kulinarisches Erlebnis in der deutschen Hauptstadt.

NAME: Cafe Couscous - Vege
DESCRIPTION: Fresh and selfmade mediterranean food. We serve breakfast, lunch, dinner. Try our selfmade couscous variants! Vegetarian and vegan dishes in Berlin-Mitte.

NAME: Restaurant Facil
DESCRIPTION: The FACIL, Berlin's oasis of culinary culture, offers a refreshing combination of elegant lightness and pure luxury, modernity and understatement. The restaurant treats diners to the very best cuisine and it has an easygoing feel. The service is excellent and you have the chance to relax and escape from the stresses and strains of everyday life. The core of the FACIL philosophy is the lightness of being. In culinary terms, the food will melt on your tongue. The restaurant offers a selection of natural cuisine which is both unpretentious and ingenious.

NAME: 26 Shibuya
DESCRIPTION: 26 Shibuya - Ein Stück Japan in Berlin ………..Dieses Ambiente haben Wir vom Shibuya aufgegriffen und im Prenzlauer Berg in Berlin etabliert. Wir bieten die Kombination aus Essen und Lifestyle mit saftigen Grillspezialitäten , auf denen Wir höchsten Wert auf Regionalität und Qualität legen . Unsere frischen und erstklassigen Sushi - Sashimi Gerichte sind ebenso reichhaltig und Perfektion gekrönt wie im fernen Japan . Die ideale Ergänzung für diese Gaumenfreunden sind unsere hochkarätigen Sake direkt von Japan importiert. Dieses Gourmeterlebnis wird durch unser modernes , klassiches Ambiente abgerundet .

NAME: Ristorante Peperoncino
DESCRIPTION: 2009 erfüllte ich mir in Berlin mit Peperoncino meinen großen Traum. Gemeinsam mit meiner Frau Ewelina verwöhne ich nun jeden Tag aufs Neue die Gaumen meiner Gäste mit allem, was die mediterrane Küche zu bieten hat: Hausgemachte Pasta, frischer Fisch, Wurst, Fleisch, Antipasti und saisonales Gemüse kommen bei uns auf den Tisch. So wie ich es von meiner mamma gelernt habe. Die Familie, der Fußball und auch das Essen sind uns Italienern heilig. Denn Essen ist ein Genuss, es geht nicht einfach nur darum, satt zu werden. Eine gelungene Mahlzeit braucht Zeit, gute Gesellschaft und Frische. All das finden Sie in der Trattoria Peperoncino. Lassen Sie sich von mir und meiner Frau in den Süden Italiens entführen und von unseren hausgemachten Köstlichkeiten verführen.

NAME: Burger Turm
DESCRIPTION: WELCOME Burger Turm is waiting for you with its delicious flavors which are prepared with fresh products of the season and that create flavor consistency! With the belief that a new start every season and a new beginning every new happiness, Burger Turm hosts warm meetings and pleasant times with its menu and comfortable decoration where you will feel the family warmth in every frame. Life is better with Burger.

NAME: La Tia Rica
DESCRIPTION: La tia rica, close to Savignyplatz offers chilean gourmet food and wine. Apart from excellent Chilean specialities we offer a nice atmosphere and large selection of Chilean wines

NAME: Hackethals
DESCRIPTION: Saturday closed!

EBERT Restaurant & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Im Herzen Berlins, nahe des Kurfürstendamms liegt das in dritter Generation familiengeführte EBERT Restaurant & Bar. Ein Restaurant zum Wohlfühlen, eine Bar zum Entspannen und immer etwas Neues, damit es nicht langweilig wird. So könnte man das EBERT Restaurant & Bar in einem Satz beschreiben. Bei uns erwartet Sie eine ehrliche Küche mit Pfiff. Unsere jahreszeitlich wechselnde Speisenkarte bietet Spezialitäten der klassischen Küche, Berliner Küche und beliebte Fischgerichten. Und auf unserer Tageskarte präsentieren wir saisonale Spezialitäten und Angebote des Marktes.

NAME: Maison Umami
DESCRIPTION: Als Homage an ihre Mutter und der Liebe zum fünften Geschmackssinn gründen die Geschwister das Restaurant Umami. Heute ist das Maison Umami eine Restaurantkette bestehend aus drei Restaurants und eine der bekanntesten asiatiatischen Gastlokale im berliner Raum. Sei ein Teil unserer Familie - fühl dich wie zu Hause und genieße das Essen! Es erwartet dich ein Wurmloch in die asiatische Kultur der 1950er.

NAME: Lorenz Adlon Esszimmer
DESCRIPTION: Following the opening of the hotel in 1907, the restaurant was immediately successful in setting new standards for the culinary world. The most famous recipes of that splendor of time remain on the menu, which are still savored by connoisseurs today. The Lorenz Adlon Esszimmer is not only reminiscent of that time of tradition, luxury, and grandeur - today the restaurant remains a trendsetter that indulges guests with culinary delights, served with genuine passion.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Unter Den Linden 77, Hotel Adlon Kempinski, 10117

NAME: Kurpfalz-Weinstuben
DESCRIPTION: The Kurpfalz Weinstube are a traditional wine tavern With German and regional cuisine. The focus is on German - in particular Pfälzer - wines With great vintage depth and high bandwidth. The wine taverns invite you to the daily enjoyment of food and drink. The Schoppenweinkarte offers more than 40 open wines and the wine cellar holds 1050 different bottles of wine.

NAME: La Cantine d'Augusta
DESCRIPTION: La Cantine d'Augusta is a french Cheese and Wine Restaurant. We have selected for you the best products from France. You will be able to taste rare and exclusive products in Berlin in a warm atmosphere. We are waiting for you to enjoy a nice and friendly moment together. See you also for Brunch every Friday, Saturday and Sunday. A bientôt.

NAME: Leibhaftig
DESCRIPTION: Bavarian Tapas and own crafted beer

NAME: MontRaw Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: MontRaw opened in January 2018 as a Mediterranean club restaurant in Prenzlauer Berg, Berlin. It is relatively small and comfortable, can host up to 40 guests during winter and almost double of that during summer due to the huge terrace. The price range is from medium to high. The concept of the restaurant is «Fine Casual Dining», which is based on the following values: * high level of service and exceptional hospitality * * top quality products and exclusive creative dishes * * unique modern interior design that make a visit special * * is thought as a place for returning customers that feel at home * At MontRaw guests can spend quality time, perhaps with a glass of wine with colleagues, relatives and friends. MontRaw is open, friendly, lively. It a perfect place for exclusive event organization and can be booked for special occasions, such as celebrations, presentations, weddings and so on.

NAME: Umi Vegan
DESCRIPTION: Vegan Vietnamese and Japanese restaurant.

NAME: Focaccino
DESCRIPTION: Italian restaurant with a strong tendency of Sicilian cuisine, family environment and at the same time discreet and romantic. The constant presence of the owner guarantees the best service and quality. If you want to spend an evening with Sicilian specialties purely, then do not hesitate to visit us, we look forward to our simple and sincere kindness.

NAME: Flamingo Fresh Food Bar
DESCRIPTION: Close to the Brandenburg Gate & the Museums-Island you can enjoy fresh salads, homemade soups, a changing daily menu, fancy sandwiches and yummy cakes in our modern and cosy bistro. A friendly team, great coffee- and tea specialities, fresh juices plus a funky selection of soft drinks & wines are waiting for you!

NAME: Dae Mon
DESCRIPTION: Dae Mon, located between Monbijoupark and Hackescher Markt, has been a culinary hotspot in the middle of the city since 2016. "open minded cuisine" is the philosophy from the owner Stefan Reinhardt, that chef Raphael Schünemann implement in an avant-garde restaurant with an open kitchen. Cosmopolitan and open minded: true to this culinary concept, the young team offers a bold combination in the dishes, with influences from Europe, Japan and Korea, and even looking beyond its horizons. Never dogmatic, always curious and above all, fresh and tasty. Our affords have even been rewarded by the Guide Michelin. An absolute highlight for connoisseurs is the Dae Mon Menu, which includes 8 sophisticated courses, each with wine accompaniment at the highest level.

NAME: Vedang - plant burger (Alexa)
DESCRIPTION: Vedang - The Future of Fast Food

NAME: Vedis
DESCRIPTION: We offer you the entire culinary diversity of the Indian subcontinent. Our cooking style involves both elements from the north of the country and hence the Himalayan region and the southern tip of India. Besides a number of specialties from chicken, lamb and duck, you may also look forward to delicious fresh fish dishes. Especially popular are the speacialties from the Tandoori grill. Our comfortable and cozy Restaurant can be found in Prenzlauer Berg, or more precisely in the Schönhauser Allee 142 in Berlin. Only a few meters from the Eberswalder Straße, you can dine at the epicenter of Berlin's nightlife and can stop directly in one of the many bars after dessert. Many of our guests, however, chose it in Vedi's so good that they even order the same one or another cocktail. Enjoy our round the clock Happy Hour cocktails from € 4.90 In the event that "your drink is not on the card, we are happy to provide any drink individually prepared''.

NAME: Bantabaa
DESCRIPTION: Authentic West African Cuisine from Gambia and Senegal, located right in the heart of Berlin-Kreuzberg. Also offers exciting street food variations to go. Plenty of vegan and gluten free options available. Comfortable seating outside (spring until autumn) and inside. Has a catering service for birthdays, parties and company events. Usually no reservation required, but recommended.

NAME: Stadtsalat
DESCRIPTION: STADTSALAT. REAL FOOD. REAL PEOPLE. Health and well-being come from the foods people eat. What that food contains and how it is prepared are therefore crucially important. That‘s why we create salads and bowls prepared fresh from scratch every single day. Real Food for Real People. We seek to build the perfect destination for both.

NAME: Salamat
DESCRIPTION: nordirakische und arabische Küche Bezahlung nur in bar oder mit deutscher EC-Karte. Payment accepted only in cash or with German debit cards. NO CREDIT CARDS!

NAME: Taverna Athene
DESCRIPTION: Griechische klassische Taverna mit freundlichem Service und ehrlicher Küche. Jetzt neu! mit wechselnder Tagesempfehlungen Familienbetrieb seit 1984.

NAME: Goji
DESCRIPTION: Das GOJI Berlin bietet authentische kantonesische Küche im Herzen Schönebergs. Neben den traditionellen Speisen, wie den bekannten Dim Sums, werden auch neue kulinarische Gerichte angeboten. Tauchen Sie mit uns ein in eine Welt voller Geschmackserlebnisse und erleben Sie ein Stück Südchina in Berlin.

NAME: Marrakesch Lounge & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Willkommen in Marrakesch Ihr exotischer Zufluchtsort in die Welt authentischer Shisha-Aromen und exotischer Cocktails! Heben Sie sich mit unseren Signature-Mischungen und Live-Unterhaltung ab. ✨ Buchen Sie Ihren Tisch und machen Sie Ihre Nächte unvergesslich!

NAME: Viet Checkpoint
DESCRIPTION: Erleben sie den Zauber von Vietnam im Herzen Berlin- Besuchen Sie unser neues Vietnamesisches Retro Restaurant in Berlin Mitte.

NAME: Heising
DESCRIPTION: Keine EC- oder Kreditkartenzahlung möglich. No credit card payment available. Ab 18:00h geöffnet. Open every day at 18:00h

NAME: Happies
DESCRIPTION: ***we are right now moving locations and gonna reopen in february 2024!*** we do handmade steamed fluffy buns with different fillings, sauces, toppings & lots of L.O.V.E.

NAME: Night Kitchen Berlin
DESCRIPTION: Night Kitchen serves modern Mediterranean dishes, designed to share with friends, from an open kitchen in a warm, rustic and inviting atmosphere. With roots in the lively gastro scene of Tel Aviv, Night Kitchen has captured the hearts of Berlin with the colourful, flavourful kitchen and unique location, hidden in a beautiful courtyard. "We don't serve, we host!"

NAME: Bistro Ribelle
DESCRIPTION: Breakfast, Business Lunch, Coffee & Cake, After Work. Every week a new, small and fine lunch menu, whose dishes are prepared with love and passion and high quality, natural and fresh ingredients. Always a vegetarian or vegan dish is on offer. Fresh egg dishes, warm panini and yogurt in the morning, homemade cakes and biscuits in the afternoon.

NAME: Sucre et Sel
DESCRIPTION: Homemade French cuisine in the heart of Berlin. Delicate Breakfast Menu until 1pm - Delicious Lunch Menu from 12pm - 4pm.

NAME: Trattoria La Bruschetta
DESCRIPTION: La Bruschetta ist ein kleines, gemütliches, familiengeführtes Restaurant. Für besondere Anlässe verfügt das Restaurant über einen Große Raum im Untergeschoß. Wir freuen uns auf Ihren Besuch und wunschen Ihnen einen angenehmen Aufenthalt. Lassen Sie sich in unserem Restaurant verwöhnen und fühlen Sie sich wie zuhause - Buon Appetito!!!

NAME: Schnitzelei
DESCRIPTION: The place to go for a good Schnitzel. The name of the restaurant says it all. There is a really good choice of Schnitzel. The restaurant also caters for vegetarians with a parmesan risotto Schnitzel. The good traditional Austrian fare goes down well with the general public. Start off your meal with a selection of starters offering all kinds of delicacies. The staff are great. So too are the rectangular lamps on the walls which are even used as candleholders. The wine selection is very good.

NAME: Tiergartenquelle
DESCRIPTION: Berliner Kneipenkultur seit mehr als 80 Jahren: Frisches Bier vom Fass, typische Berliner Gerichte und deutsche Klassiker aus Topf und Pfanne. Deftig, lecker, einfach gut! Von April bis September öffnet bei schönem Wetter unser Biergarten auf der anderen Straßenseite (Selbstbedienung).

NAME: India Club
DESCRIPTION: The INDIA CLUB Restaurant serves an authentic north indian cuisine, that claims to be best in Germany. Head chef Manish Bahukhandi is one of the most striking representatives of the indian “rustic cuisine” and had last cooked at the 5 Star Hotel “The Claridges” in New-Delhi. He has been engaged in the indian top restaurants and hotels like “The Oberoi” in New-Delhi and the “Taj Mount Road” in Chennai. He will bring his hand selected team of specialty chefs: one for Curry dishes and another one for Tandooris. Fundamental for the indian cuisine are the authentic Tandoor-oven made from clay, where bread, meat and vegetables are cooked. Following the traditionally indian cuisine, INDIA CLUB will renounce on beef and pork but we therefor offer chicken, lamb, duck, fish and seafood. Poultry and lamb are from highest organic quality, and humane treatment of animals. They exclusively come from our agricultural Gut Vorder Bollhagen of the Jagdfeld family near the Baltic Sea.

NAME: Schnitzelei
GENERAL_LOCATION: Chausseestr. 8, Hinterhof erreichbar über: Chausseestr. 8 oder Novalisstr. 11, 10115

NAME: Ottenthal Restaurant & Weinhandlung
DESCRIPTION: Arthur Schneller, the proprietor, combines both the traditional and contemporary cuisine of Austria with a mixture of simplicity and finesse. Amongst our specialities one can also find a variety of vegetarian dishes that have the Austrian nuance of sweet and picant. We cook, braise and bake all dishes recent with preferably local and/or organic products!

NAME: YOSOY Tapas Bar
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to "YOSOY" the Spanish Tapas-Bar in Berlin Mitte. Tapas strongly belong to the daily life in Spain and contain all the small appetizing cold and warm spanish food from which we are offering a choice. The origin of Tapas lies in Andalusia and is closely connected with a GLASS of sherry or wine. One says that the piece of bread, the slice of ham or the cheese which was put as a "lid" on the sherry or wineglass, was put around to retain the strange aroma in the GLASS, that's the origin of the Tapa-culture in Spain. In addition, the pleasure and the way of life came naturally to lean against a bar and to talk to friends, strangers, the family or the landlord of this and that having a small lunch and a glass of sherry or wine and lose the whole time of the day. Hopefully, we have created such a comfortable place with our Tapas-Bar.

NAME: Namaste
DESCRIPTION: Namaste Restaurant is an exciting new concept in casual dining: The Menu combines Indian cuisine and a rich heritage of Punjab hospitality, resulting a tempting selection of delicious, wholesome food and beverages served in a warm and sophisticated atmosphere.

NAME: Red Lion Kloten
DESCRIPTION: Das einzige Restaurant in Kloten, das eine grosse Auswahl von asiatischen Spezialitäten und gleichzeitig frische und kreative Sushi anbietet. Im Sommer geniessen Sie Ihr Essen im idyllischen Garten-Restaurant.

NAME: Hotel Restaurant Frohsinn
DESCRIPTION: restaurant near from airport, a wonderful garden, a bar, a lounge, a hotel, bowling lanes; all these you'll find in the hotel restaurant frohsinn 5 min from airport and 15 min from zurich. With our kitchen quality, our first-class price performance ratio, ours separate- dining rooms, our open and friendly atmosphere and our charming hotel rooms, we are a popular adress since 60 years in the 3. generation.

NAME: eCHo Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: The eCHo restaurant fully commits to the tradition of the Swiss cuisine. Everything is prepared according to original recipes and the dishes are presented with flair and creativity. All products are fresh and originate from the region. Enjoy the atmosphere combining tradition and modern styles. Welcome to an authentic experience.

NAME: elmira fine dining
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to elmira, where we redefine fine dining - warm, informal, transparent, seasonal and regional. With us, you pay in advance to experience an unforgettable evening and leave at the end as if you had been at a friends house, without paying, of course. You will be surprised how calm and relaxed your experience with us will be, despite the open kitchen. Our outstanding team will take plenty of time for you and your companion to make sure you spend a unique evening with us.

NAME: Restaurant Weisses Rossli
DESCRIPTION: Das Weisse Rössli setzt auf die frische, französisch-mediterrane Küche von Mathieu Bacon, welcher von Gault&Millau mit 14 Punkten ausgezeichnet wurde. Die Gerichte sind leicht, ehrlich und ohne Schnick-schnack. Die Basis dafür stellen saisonale Grundprodukte von hoher Qualität, welche ausschliesslich im Rössli verarbeitet werden. Feine Weine aus Italien und der Schweiz runden das kulinarische Angebot ab.

NAME: Route twenty-Six
DESCRIPTION: Savor the genuine steak flavor in our route twenty-six steakhouse in the trendy district Zürich West. Our specialities are Swiss ribs, burgers and special cuts such as tomahawk and flank steak, which our chefs carve live at the table. All restaurant guests park 3 hours free of charge in the Sheraton underground car park.

NAME: Zunfthaus zur Waag
DESCRIPTION: Hospitality in the heart of Zurich: Zunfthaus zur Waag. A warm welcome to the Münsterhof (pedestrian zone) - a beautiful historic town square and the jewel of the Zurich city center. One great place to wine and dine and celebrate in the stylish atmosphere of the old city is the Zunfthaus zur Waag, directly facing the Fraumünster church with its famous Chagall windows. Discover an authentic piece of Zurich's history for yourself and take delight in our hospitality given to you in a house dating from 1315 and steeped in history.

NAME: King's Cave Grillrestaurant
DESCRIPTION: Enjoy excellent specialties from the grill (our house specialty is the entrecôte baked with herb butter) and a strong wine. In the King’s Cave Restaurant you dine in an incomparably regal ambience. Candlesticks, mirrors, cellar bar, wine cellar and fireplace complete the authentic style. We serve the fine entrecôte in Central 1 on Sundays, Mondays and every day at lunchtime. We look forward to your visit.

NAME: YEN'S
DESCRIPTION: Established in 2011, YEN'S Sushi & Asian Cuisine welcomes guests within Switzerland but also all over the world. We are a family company with passion and joy in every single way and proudly present new highlights and dishes you will love. With a hearty WELCOME !

NAME: Bianchi
DESCRIPTION: The fish restaurant Bianchi is a joint-venture of the families Bianchi and Bindella. In an inviting and comfortable ambience on the Zurich Limmatquai, fresh fish are served. An elegant restaurant dedicated to the pleasure of enjoying and meeting at the table.

NAME: The Artisan Kitchen and Urban Garden
DESCRIPTION: The Artisan - Kitchen & Urban Garden is named after the teams appreciation for artisanal growers, suppliers and producers and the community gardens that we share with local residents. The Artisan is a lively neighbourhood restaurant, a green oasis in Zürich, Wipkingen. A place where everyone can meet to share beautiful moments and enjoy great food with friends or family, every season of the year in a relaxed and informal setting. They serve simple, thoughtful soul food, which has been made with care from fresh, natural and wholesome ingredients. Honest cooking with international flair, locally inspired by the nature from their own garden and the surrounding farms, forests and fields.

NAME: Restaurant & Bar O
DESCRIPTION: At Hotel Sternen Oerlikon you will find the well-known Restaurant & Bar "O". At Restaurant & Bar "O", you can expect high-quality products, a varied menu and warm hospitality. In addition to our classic dishes and regional specialities, our kitchen team works ceaselessly to create unforgettable and delicious dishes. The creative daily menus are just as popular with our guests as the elegant atmosphere of the restaurant in Zurich Oerlikon.

NAME: Walliser Keller The Swiss Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: The Restaurant is open. To us, "Swiss Alpine cuisine" means bringing a portion of the "Swiss mountains" to you at lunchtime or in the evening. The rustic cellar vault brings to mind a typical wine cellar in the vineyards of the Valais. We put the aroma of the Swiss Alps on your plates. The original cheese fondue comes to you in eight different variations, as dictated by Valais tastes. And when your meat is brought to you on a hot stone, you know it will be cooked exactly as you want it. Of course, our menu also includes the classics; "Bauernbratwurst" sausage with onion sauce, and – naturally – Zurich "Geschnetzeltes" (stir-fried veal) served with rosti. Taste Tinu's crispy chicken basket: It's tender and succulent, with a mild spicy flavour and very, very tasty! In summer, we also serve all these delights on our delightful terrace beside the pedestrian zone. Have we whetted your appetite? We look forward to seeing you!

NAME: Marcellino Pane e Vino
DESCRIPTION: Very nice little restaurant with fresh italian/mediterrean Food. The restaurant offers a cozy romantic garden and is not far from the city center. You reach us with Tram no 11 to the station Hedwigsteig.

NAME: Restaurant Swiss Chuchi
DESCRIPTION: Whether in the open air of the bustling Niederdorf pedestrian precinct or in the quaint Swiss ambience of the restaurant: Enjoy what your heart desires – from the Adler Special fondue, through Raclette to the Waadtländer fondue. From Alp-herder’s macaroni through Capuns to Zurich ragout with roesti. From the first fondue parlour in the old town of Zurich to the number one address for Swiss cheese and meat specialities. The Swiss Chuchi restaurant attracts both locals and people from far and wide who appreciate good food. No matter if you want to try the famous cheese fondue (we offer 9 different variations), a melting Raclette, or another Swiss specialty such as the Zurich-style veal fricassée, we are the place to be for lovers of the Swiss cuisine.

NAME: Dapur, Indonesian Plantbased Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: From January 2022: TAKE AWAY only, and groups on request. *** Authentic Indonesian plantbased food. Friendly staff and beautiful ambience. Located 5 minutes walk from Oerlikon train station.

NAME: Maison Manesse
DESCRIPTION: WHITE. BLACK. FOOD. MOOD. FINE. DINE. ROCK. ROLL. EAT. MEET. SUPER. DUPER. Unerwartete Kreationen und unverschamte Desserts, die die Stadt noch nicht gesehen und geschmeckt hat. Die frei untereinander kombinierbaren Gange und Gerichte folgen keinem Gesetz ausser der Unvorhersehbarkeit und demjenigen, das sie den Geschmack eines anspruchsvollen Publikums treffen sollen, das sich fur ein Dinner gerne Zeit lasst. WELCOME. AT. MAISON. MANESSE.

NAME: Raclette Factory - Rindermarkt
DESCRIPTION: When modernity meets tradition in the Raclette Factory, a kind of Swiss "Coolture 2.0" arises. The Raclette Factory is shaped by fair prices, high quality and lots of heart blood. ​ From the gourmet to the vegetarian, everyone should find something for themselves. We appeal to young urban, vegetarians, workers, quicklunchers, night owls and tourists. ​ The decoration and interior design is «Alp-chic», inviting and simple. Modern yet rustic. With a nice cup of tea in hand, our guests can look forward to refined Raclettes in dozens of varieties. At the same time, we are always looking forward to seasonal events. We mainly focus on regional products and suppliers.

NAME: Schweizerhof Bar
DESCRIPTION: Discover our Schweizerhof Bar with fashionable drinks, selected wines and exclusive delicacies – ideal for interesting conversations as you unwind in a laid-back atmosphere with live music. From 10:45am on, our bartenders will serve you little delicacies and prepare your favourite drinks.

NAME: Iberia Tapas
DESCRIPTION: Enjoy our delicacies with modern tapas and a varied menu with Mediterranean specialties. At lunchtime we spoil you every day with a variety of fine tapas menus.

NAME: The Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: The Restaurant serves fresh and innovative gourmet cuisine created by our Chef Fine Dining, Heiko Nieder, in a stylish atmosphere. The gourmet restaurant has been awarded 19 GaultMillau points and 2 Michelin stars and is one of the most highly rated restaurants in Zurich. Come and sample a surprising and seemingly endless array of flavours and enjoy an unforgettable evening at the Michelin restaurant.

NAME: Differente Hotel Krone Unterstrass
DESCRIPTION: The ‘Differente’ restaurant and bar uses only high-quality, seasonal and local produce for its dishes. We pride ourselves on our Mediterranean dishes and Swiss specialities. Our unique tartare creations are also very popular. We take pleasure in providing perfect service. This is one of our top priorities. Food that is flambéed, filleted and carved at the table will make your meal a memorable occasion. The ‘Differente’ restaurant invites you to lunch or dinner in a stylish and friendly ambience. Our menus range from classic Mediterranean dishes to Swiss specialities and also include our renowned and popular tartare creations. Our seasonal specialities leave nothing to be desired. We have refined vegetarian dishes on the menu too. Hot meals are also served in the afternoon and evening until 22.00.

NAME: tibits
DESCRIPTION: tibits bietet ein reichhaltiges Buffet mit uber 40 leckeren und saisonal wechselnden vegetarischen und veganen Salaten, heissen Gerichten, Suppen, Sandwiches und Desserts an. Frisch und hausgemacht - fur alle, die gerne geniessen.--------tibits offers up a rich buffet with over 40 tasty and seasonally changing vegetarian and vegan salads, hot dishes, soups, sandwiches and desserts. Fresh and homemade - for all who like good food.

NAME: Jules Verne Panoramabar Zurich
DESCRIPTION: Best Cocktail Bar with the most amazing romantic view over the city of Zurich. We do not take reservations!

NAME: Restaurant La Soupiere
DESCRIPTION: Indulgence yourself at the highest level in an elegant atmosphere. Enjoy finest French cuisine and regional specialties for lunch and dinner, prepared by our chef Martin Fencz: delicious starters, fresh fish, mix grilled dishes, seasonal menus and enticing dessert creations await you! Leave the hectic everyday life behind you and enjoy lunch or dinner at our Restaurant La Soupière. Our Maître d’Hotel - Helmut Stadlober - and his team will pay attention to your wishes and requirements and offer a perfect coordinated service at any time.

NAME: Orsini
DESCRIPTION: Savour exceptional Italian fine dining at ORSINI. Led by award-winning Consultant Chef Antonio Guida, ORSINI offers authentic flavours in an intimate and sophisticated setting.

NAME: Hiltl Dachterrasse
DESCRIPTION: The green oasis above Zurich's roofs On the first of September the Hiltl Dachterrasse on the PKZ WOMEN at Bahnhofstrasse 88 in Zurich opens its roofs. The restaurant offers healthy delight with its loved Hiltl Buffet and Take Away in a stylish ambience. As a comfortable café and an elegant bar it invites you all day long to high quality coffee and tea specialties and tasteful cocktails. All this is located on two big rooftops with a view to the lively Bahnhofstrasse in the middle of Zurich. The Hiltl Dachterasse is an oasis in the city and a perfect location for a little shoppingbreak.

NAME: Restaurant Heugumper
DESCRIPTION: The Heugümper restaurant opened in 1996 in one of the oldest buildings in the city. In a central location between Paradeplatz and Münsterhof, in the heart of Zurich, we will spoil you in a classic, modern ambience with market-fresh, Mediterranean-Asian cuisine and exquisite wines. Thanks to our warm service, you will also feel completely at home at family celebrations, company events and weddings! Our elegant club bar on the upper floor is also available for this purpose.

NAME: Tamarind Hill Indian Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Dear customers, Our goal is to bring global flavors to the local community by introducing a modern approach to Indian cuisine. Our menu features bold and distinct flavors that showcase the unique blend of cuisines found throughout India. We use locally grown seasonal produce and herbs to prepare our sauces, spice blends, and desserts daily. We are committed to using the highest quality meats, seafood and fish. We are excited to share the vibrant flavors and exciting combinations of contemporary Indian cuisine found only at TAMARIND HILL and look forward to having you as our guest. At THE TAMARIND HILL, we understand that some dishes never fall out of flavor & palatable fashion. Should you not find any of your choice dishes on this listing, our chefs will be more than happy to accommodate your needs & requests meats. Should you want them cooked to your individual spice levels or preferences please inform the floor staff.

NAME: Hiltl
DESCRIPTION: According to "Guinness World Records" Hiltl is the first vegetarian restaurant in the world. The company was founded in 1898 by Ambrosius Hiltl and is now run by the fourth generation of the Hiltl family. It offers around 500 dishes and includes, in addition to the a la carte restaurant and Hiltl buffet, self-service and takeaway, a bar-lounge, a club, a cooking studio and a shop...

NAME: Sign Eat & Drink
DESCRIPTION: Willkommen im SIGN eat&drink - Ihrer Oase der Sinnlichkeit seit 2016. Entdecken Sie unsere atemberaubenden Gerichte, die perfekte Balance zwischen Schweizer Traditionsrezepten und internationalen Gaumenfreuden. Jede Speise erhält bei uns einen Extra-Touch, der Ihre Geschmacksnerven verzaubert. Lassen Sie sich von unseren preisgekrönten, handgefertigten Desserts verwöhnen, kreiert von unserem Patissier. Wir bieten gluten- und laktosefreie Optionen sowie vegane Verführungen, die Sie lieben werden. Unser charmantes Ambiente mit stilvollem Design und gemütlichen Innen- und Außenplätzen ist die perfekte Kulisse für Ihr kulinarisches Erlebnis. Während Sie in unserem sorgfältig ausgewählten Weinangebot stöbern, kreiert unser Barmann Edu den perfekten Drink für Sie. Ob Sie eine intime Versammlung oder eine lebhafte Feier planen, mit Platz für bis zu 30 Personen und erstklassigen Audio- und Lichtinstallationen haben wir die passenden Räumlichkeiten. Besuchen Sie uns Montag und Samst

NAME: Tadka Indisches Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Tadka is the first authentic Indian restaurant In Zürich. Set amidst the centre of West Zürich district, we offer diners a vast array of speciality dishes from India’s northern region. Our unique menu of Tandoori, Chicken, Lamb, Sea food, and vegetarian preparations have become favourites amongst the discerning customer. Diners can also enjoy views of our wonderful beer garden. This along with our relaxed interior has earned Tadka its reputation as one of the best Indian restaurant in Zürich.

NAME: Yamas
DESCRIPTION: In unserer Weinbar verschmelzen regionale Produkte und authentische griechische Weine zu einem wahren Geschmackserlebnis. Lass Dich von uns auf eine ganzheitliche Genussreise entführen, bei der Gaumenfreuden und Wohlbefinden Hand in Hand gehen. ***Mittags ausser Samstag nur Take-Away und Selfservice*** YAMAS - "zum Wohl"

NAME: Restaurant My Place
DESCRIPTION: Selfservice restaurant offering freshly prepared food on the daily. The warm buffet is open from 11:30 AM to 2:30 PM. We offer meals from the large salad bar and selected warm dishes starting from 11:30 AM until 8:00 PM. Breakfast is available starting at 8:00 AM. Visit us at the 3rd floor of the My Stop Motorway Service Station.

NAME: Hummerbar
DESCRIPTION: Meeresfrüchte, Austern, und Hummer. Auf der Rückseite des Hotels St. Gotthard weist die imposante, rote Türe den Weg zur Hummerbar. Bis heute wurde die Originaldekoration bewahrt. In unserer Hummerbar tauchen Sie ein, in eine Welt in der sich die Kontinente treffen und wo Service und Küche gross geschrieben wird. Von Frankreich bis nach Amerika kreieren wir Variationen von Französischer Küche und Maine Lobster.

NAME: Pizzeria Azzurro
DESCRIPTION: Original Italian Pizza, just like in Napoli! We also offer glutenfree and vegan options. High quality ingredients and a very thin crust make your pizza experience unique. Visit us and enjoy the best Pizza of Zurich!

NAME: Restaurant Oberes Triemli
DESCRIPTION: We offer, from an efficient and well-run kitchen, a first-class cuisine, served in adiscreet setting and an atmosphere of quality and distinction. Please ask, without obligation, for our wide selection of menus for gala occasions. The following different styles of rooms are at your disposal in our house. On the first floor, suitable for seminars and festive Occasion: Truebenbachstube with terrace, Schneiderstube On the ground floor, equally suitable parlours and pups for festive gatherings: Hofstetter Saali, Metzger Stubli, Country - style tavern, Triemli Saloon Wheelchair accessible.

NAME: La Pasta
DESCRIPTION: Homemade pasta...

NAME: Steakhouse Bahnhof
DESCRIPTION: Das ist offenes Feuer, rote Glut, perfekt gegrilltes Fleisch und feiner Fisch. Ursprünglichkeit. Doch das Restaurant Steakhouse Bahnhof bietet mehr. Das Team um Urs Koffel steht seit über 17 Jahren für Leidenschaft für bestes Essen, hochwertige Produkte und perfekten Service. Hier verbringen Sie und Ihre Freunde oder Geschäftspartner wertvolle Stunden in ungezwungener Atmosphäre. Ob beim Businesslunch oder zum Dinner.

NAME: Ban Song Thai
DESCRIPTION: Thai Restaurant est. 1995, Since same owner. No MSG. A la carte evenings: exclusively bio beef, Mangrove sustainable shrimp, bio porc. Only best quality products.

NAME: El Mosquito Bodega & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Das El Mosquito ist der sonnigste Ort in Bremgarten. Wir empfangen dich im echten Ambiente einer mexikanischen Bodega. Bei uns tanzen nicht nur der Charro und die Escaramuza zur Musik der Mariachi. Beliebte Hauptspeisen aus unserer Küche sind Fajitas, Burritos und Nachos. Unsere Daiquiris und Margaritas sind weitum berühmt! Wir verwenden authentische Produkte und frische Zutaten. Aus dem Saft der Herzen von blauen Agaven wird unser Tequila hergestellt. Den Daiquiri mixen wir mit bestem Rum. Viele Sorten mexikanischer Biere findest du auf unserer Karte. Stolz sind wir auf unser El Mosquito Hausbier, ein besonders feines Swiss Blond, welches unsere Bierpartner, die Brauerei Chopfab, für uns braut. Unser El Mosquito Hauswein ist schwer, aber unkompliziert. Wir freuen uns auf deinen Besuch mit Freunden in unserer Bodega & Bar und im Sommer auch auf unserer Terrasse.

NAME: Rolli's Steakhouse Kloten
DESCRIPTION: Gerne machen wir Sie darauf aufmerksam, dass wir KEINE durchgehend warme Küche anbieten ACHTUNG: Warme Küche Montag-Freitag: 11.00 - 14.00 Uhr/17.00-22.00 Uhr Samstag: 17.00-22.00 Uhr

NAME: Linde Weiningen
DESCRIPTION: Die Linde Weiningen ist seit 1946 ein Traditionshaus in der dritten Generation und bekannt für gut bürgerliche Küche, Wild- und Metzgete-Spezialitäten, kulturelle Anlässe und für freundlichen Service. Das Haus Linde besteht aus einem Restaurant, Stübli, Säli, Event-Saal, Weinkeller, Catering/Partyservice und einer Sommerterrasse.

NAME: Drei Stuben
DESCRIPTION: Ein charmantes Quartierrestaurant mit warmer Atmosphäre und lauschiger Gartenterrasse das traditioneller Flair mit dem heutigen Zeitgeist vereint Wir servieren zugängliche und zeitgenössische Gerichte, die mit Sorgfalt aus frischen, natürlichen und gesunden Zutaten zubereitet werden. Eine ehrliche, produktorientierte Küche, inspiriert durch unsere Wertschätzung für traditionelles Handarbeit und für regionale Produzent:innen, die im Einklang mit der Natur arbeiten.

NAME: Cantinetta Antinori
DESCRIPTION: Cantinetta Antinori is one of the most typical Italians on a high level thanks to its location on Zurich's Bahnhofstrasse, the world-famous family brand Antinori, the charm of the old town house, the simple cuisine of Tuscany and the rich wine range of Marchesi Antinori.

NAME: Furtbachli
DESCRIPTION: Herzlich willkommen im Furtbächli, Ihrer Insel für Genuss im Zürcher Furttal. Lassen Sie den Alltag hinter sich: Bei uns sind Sie zu jeder Gelegenheit willkommen und finden stets den passenden Rahmen – ob zu Kafi und z’Nüni, fürs Mittagessen unter Kollegen oder zum Business Lunch, zu einem feinen Dessert am Nachmittag, zu einem z‘Nacht im gediegeneren Rahmen oder gar für Ihr feierliches Festbankett. Hier sind alle Menschen von morgens bis abends herzlich willkommen! Qualität steht bei uns – neben authentischer Gastfreundschaft – an erster Stelle: Freuen Sie sich auf frisch zubereitete saisonale Spezialitäten, herzhafte Klassiker und auserlesene À-la-carte-Gerichte – gutschweizerisch und mit Liebe, Zeit und frischen Zutaten zubereitet. Gerne empfehlen wir Ihnen dazu einen Wein aus unserem sorgfältig zusammengestellten Sortiment.

NAME: Hotel Mamma Osteria
DESCRIPTION: In Italien ist sie eine Institution: Die Osteria. Denn hier trifft man sich, sitzt zusammen und geniesst das Leben. In einen stilvollen Rahmen, der dennoch authentisch ist. Und bei einem guten Essen, das mit hochwertigen Produkten und traditionellen Rezepten begeistert. Was das Geheimnis einer echten Osteria ist? Ganz einfach: Viel Herzblut. Und Leidenschaft. Und diese Passione können Sie auch bei uns jeden Tag erleben: Denn das Hotel Mamma ist der schnellste Weg nach Italien.

NAME: Restaurant Adlisberg
DESCRIPTION: Grüne Wiesen, frische Luft und sonnige Momente – das idyllische Restaurant Adlisberg liegt in einem der schönsten Naherholungsgebiete von Zürich und nur wenige Minuten vom Stadtzentrum entfernt. Im gemütlichen Restaurant servieren wir Ihnen authentische Zürcher und Schweizer Spezialitäten, mit viel Liebe und aus lokalen Produkten zubereitet. Eine herzliche Atmosphäre sowie persönlicher und zuvorkommender Service stehen bei uns an erster Stelle. Wir freuen uns auf Ihren Besuch! Das Restaurant Adlisberg ist ein Betrieb der Segmüller Collection.

NAME: Luca2
DESCRIPTION: Dear Guest we have holidays from the 7.1.23 to the 16.1.23 Have a nice Christmas time and a happy new year Luca²

NAME: Restaurant und Zunfthaus Weisser Wind
DESCRIPTION: Restaurant und Zunfthaus Weisser Wind Zürich. Gemeinschaft geniessen. Unsere herzhaften Gerichte haben ihren Stammplatz auf der Speisekarte. Dazu bieten wir saisonale, abwechslungsreiche Spezialitäten und vegetarische Speisen an. Zum Highlight werden wir unsere Saucen entwickeln - eine leckere Zutat, die seit dem 14. Jahrhundert in Zürich traditionell zum Essen gehört. Küchenchef Jean Ghrabi und sein Team werden sie neu interpretieren – als flüssiges, verbindendes Element zwischen den Zutaten auf dem Teller. Neben den klassischen Getränken finden Sie bei uns eine handverlesene Auswahl guter Weine. Menschen, gutes Essen und Kultur. Willkommen Zuhause. Wir verbinden, was uns wichtig ist: Restaurant und Zunfthaus, hauseigene Spezialitäten, Kunst- und Kulturbühne. Dafür knüpfen wir an die 700-jährige Historie des Hauses an und beseelen seine Zimmer jeden Tag aufs Neue mit unseren Geschichten rund um Speisen, Getränke und Kultur. Wir sind Klimaneutral da uns Nachhaltigkeit wichtig ist.

NAME: Samses
DESCRIPTION:
GEBEN SIE DOCH MAL MIT UNSEREM ESSEN AN.

Verleihen Sie Ihrem Anlass eine einzigartige und spezielle Note und bleiben Sie Ihren Gästen angenehm in Erinnerung:

mit einem Catering vom Samses. 

Fragen Sie uns einfach an, gerne stellen wir Ihnen ein individuelles Catering nach Ihren Wünschen zusammen. 

Natürlich alles rein vegetarisch oder vegan.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Anfrage: info@samses.ch

NAME: Carlton Restaurant & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Das bekannte Carlton Restaurant & Bar an der Zürcher Bahnhofstrasse kombiniert gekonnt hochstehende Kulinarik mit grenzenlosem Wohlbehagen. Küchenchef Philipp Heering zaubert mit seinem Küchenteam zeitlose und klassische Gerichte internationaler Herkunft mit 15 GaultMillau Punkten. Kombiniert mit den edelsten Tropfen aus dem eigenen Weinkeller mit über 1000 Positionen – ein einmalig sinnliches Erlebnis! Die Carlton Bar bietet den optimalen Rahmen für genussvolle Drinks am Feierabend oder feinen Kaffee. Kreative Cocktails, delikate Apéros und angenehme Musik bieten den perfekten Mix für entspannende Momente. Das Carlton ist ein Betrieb der Segmüller Collection.

NAME: Metropol
DESCRIPTION: In the center of Zurich, surrounded by Limmat, lake of Zurich and the famous Bahnhofstrasse, you meet in one of the most historical and beautiful new baroque premises of Zurich.The METROPOL restaurant surprises with its daily changing business lunch and seasonal, international highlights for gourmets.The selection of cocktails and international drinks in the METROPOL Bar equally seduces "Connaisseurs" and "Cosmopolitans". Enjoy the most beautiful moments of the day - and meet the Zurich society in our bar.

NAME: Restaurant Le Dezaley Zurich
DESCRIPTION: At the foot of the Grossmünster-Church, the most important landmark of Zurich and near the Limmat river, our restaurant *Le Dézaley* has been open for more than 120 years. The restaurant Le Dézaley stands out with its modern freshness and a traditional Swiss-style concept, in the heart of the largest city in Switzerland. The variety of our offer ranges from Vaudois house specialties to Swiss national dishes to international, Mediterranean and seasonal cuisine. Our aim is to offer high Swiss quality and first-class service. The restaurant Le Dézaley is known for its traditional Swiss cheese fondue, which is of excellent quality right up to the last bite.

NAME: Fiskfelagid - Fish Company
DESCRIPTION: A TRIP AROUND ICELAND OR THE WORLD? THE CHOICE IS YOURS. What to eat in Iceland? If this question troubles you then let our chef’s take your taste buds on a trip AROUND ICELAND, without ever leaving your table. The chef’s will assemble creative blends of food from land and sea, with a daring choice of spice from all corners around the island. The AROUND ICELAND is the most popular meal at the Fish Company, but there is one other that comes close in popularity, the trip AROUND THE WORLD. AROUND THE WORLD is a cruise around the globe, where the spices and herbs of the world are used to transform the local fish and meat into dazzling pieces of exotic cuisine. Both have to be experienced, so make the most of your trip to Iceland and visit the Fish Company. Let our waiter’s guide you along culinary craft, expertly crafted by our fine team of chef’s, for a voyage your stomach will never forget.

NAME: Tjoruhusid
DESCRIPTION: Tjoruhusið is a fish restaurant in Isafjorður, Iceland. We only serve whatever's fresh out of the ocean on a given day, so there's no menu to speak of, but during high season we usually offer a buffet of everything good for dinner, while lunch tends to be a la carte. For dinner, we generally do two separate seatings, at 6pm and 8:30pm, although we try to be flexible if possible. Do note that we are for the most part closed during wintertime (from early November 'til Easter, usually), and then that our openings in the early spring months tend to be sporadic. We advise anyone intending to dine with us to call ahead to ensure we are open. Any special needs (lactose/gluten/etc) should be noted in advance. Tjoruhusið does not operate a Reykjavik location and is not at all affiliated with any Reykjavik restaurant, regardless of what some of them might be claiming.

NAME: Gott
DESCRIPTION: GOTT is a healthy and creative family restaurant in the Westman Islands that uses only fresh and healthy ingredients. All sauces, stews, soups and cakes are prepared from scratch on site. Every morning we pick up fresh fish directly from the local fish market. The owner Sigurður Gíslason, a former member of the Icelandic national team of chefs and his wife Berglind Sigmarsdóttir run and own the restaurant GOTT. They have also published two best-selling cookbooks in Iceland and one of them was published and translated into German. Our couple's third book "GOOD DISHES" was published in October 2016 where you can find recipes from our popular menu.

NAME: Sushi Social
DESCRIPTION: Opened at the end of 2011 and a hot favourite in the Reykjavik restaurant scene, Sushi Social - samba & grill offers a deliciously unique take on homegrown ingredients, using Iceland's freshest flavors with Japanese and South American influences. The menu offers a great selection, tempting smaller courses, traditional and "Juicy- Sushi" , amazing steaks and sweet desserts. If you can't decide what to go for, the Icelandic feast is a perfect solution - six courses form an incredible taste experience that includes the national aperitif 'Brennivin' and an Icelandic Skyr for dessert. Fabulous chili mojitos and a gorgeously eclectic interior are the icing on the cake at Sushi Social. Hand- carved Brazilian curios and some 50 pretty Japanese birdcages complement the contemporary lines and gentle feel of the place.

NAME: Mama Reykjavik
DESCRIPTION: Mama is a restaurant/community space where we will provide amazing quality food, music,​ and art, gatherings and events that are intended to uplift and bring positive vibration to the center of Reykjavik

NAME: Black Crust Pizzeria
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Black Crust! We’re a new and exciting pizzeria in Vík, Iceland! We make delicious sour dough and black crust pizzas! See you there!

NAME: Bjargarsteinn mathus
DESCRIPTION: On Snaefellsnes peninsula, in the harbour area of Grundarfjördur town, stands a small house named Bjargarsteinn. The house was transported 140 kilometers from Akranes town to its current location, where it has a new role as a restaurant. Bjargarsteinn's menu caters to both local and international taste buds and will include seasonal dishes that are bound to be a delicious treat for all food connoisseurs.

NAME: LOA Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Lóa Restaurant, located at Laugavegur 95, we reimagine dining with a revolutionary NO MENU experience. Our commitment extends beyond culinary freedom; we stand for sustainability, championing a zero-waste policy. Every dish, a fusion of Mediterranean flavours and Icelandic freshness, showcases our dedication to authenticity and excellence. Join us for a unique culinary journey, where creativity knows no bounds, and waste is left behind."

NAME: Reykjavik Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: Family owned and run restaurant in the heart of Reykjavík. Cosy and relaxed atmosphere with traditional Icelandic quality food and personal service.

NAME: Himalayan Spice
DESCRIPTION: At Himalayan spice, we believe in cooking and serving quality food that starts the journey from your eyes and ends in your stomach giving the feeling of satisfaction and happiness. We bring you the taste of Himalaya by fusing spices, love and fresh ingredient. Himalayan Spice believes in bringing you the best food from scratch to the table, inspired by the freshness from Himalayas and aroma from highland of Nepal. We do have a Gluten free options in the menu for you.

NAME: Forrettabarinn
DESCRIPTION: Forrettabarinn offers a range of appetizers and desserts of various sizes. The menu focuses on fresh, Icelandic ingredients with a Southern European influence. It also offers a range of vegetarian dishes and a choice of four-course set meals. The bar offers a good range of beers, locally brewed along with international brands. Wine is offered by the glass and the colorful cocktail selection is carefully crafted by their skilled bartenders. Don’t miss the happy hour from 16 – 18 every day with special offers on draft beers and the house wines. Forrettabarinn opened in 2011 and is owned and run by chef Róbert Ólafsson. He has extensive experience dating back to 1994 and has worked in hotels and restaurants all over the world, including Iceland, Germany, USA and France. The restaurant’s interior is modern with minimal Scandinavian influence. It is decorated with artworks, high ceilings and an open kitchen. The main bar is crafted from timber from the old harbor.

NAME: Lamb Street Food
DESCRIPTION: Lamb Street Food draws much inspiration from Iceland's rich gastronomic past. Here you'll find the happy marriage of high quality Icelandic ingredients and age-old culinary traditions from the Far East. Quintessentially Icelandic with a taste for world cuisines - all on one plate. Lamb Street Food works closely with Icelandic farmers and producers who supply only the highest quality ingredients.

NAME: Svarta Kaffid
DESCRIPTION: A tiny, family owned soup restaurant in the heart of Reykjavik. We are proud to be the first and the original "soup in bread" restaurant in Iceland. We've been serving soups in bread for over 20 years amd we love it. Please note: We do not take reservations, ever - but swing by and we will do our best to fit you in with smiles on our faces! :)

NAME: The Steakhouse
DESCRIPTION: A five story concrete building that once housed offices on the upper floors and a metalwork company on the ground floor, now is the home of restaurant The Steakhouse on the ground floor, the four floors above are now apartments. The old harbor area of Reykjavik has in the last couple of years, changed in to a real gem where various cuisines, museums and arts and crafts have replaced the metalworks and fisheries. The newest addition is STEIKHÚSIÐ, which simply means „The Steak House”. The name is a deliberately this simple and descriptive, the aim is to be the only steakhouse you think of after the first visit. The heart of Steikhúsið is the coal oven from Mibrasa and the soul is our own way of tendering meat for at least 28 days. Those who seek for something purely Icelandic won’t be disappointed, Steikhúsið also caters to those who want the best of Icelandic lamb and fish.

NAME: Narfeyrarstofa
DESCRIPTION: Narfeyrarstofa restaurant and café is the oldest operating restaurant in Stykkishólmur. It’s a family business and is open all year round. Narfeyrarstofa’s menu features inventive dishes served artfully in the beautiful surroundings of the restaurant, where utterly charming views from the premises bring life to the atmosphere. There is a strong emphasis on creativity in the kitchen, and it is safe to say that craftsmanship is held in high regard, as the ingredients are of the finest quality and sourced locally wherever possible. Narfeyrarstofa’s chefs prepare all ingredients from scratch, and the kitchen makes use of a powerful meat processor as local meat is prepared in different ways for the various dishes on the menu. From the restaurant there are views over Breiðafjörður bay’s “natural pantry”. Ingredients from there are on the table every day, exceptionally fresh. Blue mussels from Breiðafjörður are always on offer when in season. The menu also has a selection of hamburgers, proclaimed to be “the real deal”, “juicy” and “even better than búllaburgers” by our guests, who come back for them again and again! Our wine menu is unusually diverse and features specially selected wines of various types. The restaurant is in a two-storey house built in 1906 in the heart of Stykkishólmur, by the old church that towers over Aðalgata. There is room for 70 people indoors, and it’s also possible to sit outside when the weather’s nice. The atmosphere at Narfeyrarstofa is warm and welcoming, and the staff and the owners do everything they can to provide outstanding service to their guests.

NAME: Rostin Restaurant
DESCRIPTION:
Röstin Restaurant is located only 15 min away from Keflavik airport and 20 meters from the shore with fantastic ocean view and a balcony. 
During summer time You can enjoy spectacular shows of playful humback whales and in winter time the explosion of Northern lights :)
There are two lighthouses on the premises, museum and campsite. 
We serve Seafood, fresh local fish and local meat, quality hamburgers, grilled chicken, homemade creamy Fish Soup, and lots more at a very reasonable price. We also have vegetarian and very tasty vegan dishes :) plus gluten free options.
You can't miss our dessert and selection of local beers :))))
