Rostin restaurant is an exeptional place in Iceland!
Romantic :) Cosy :) full of real flowers, perfect for couples, families and big groups. 
And we can promise You that when You enter Rostin you will be delighted :))))))

NAME: Suour-Vik
DESCRIPTION: RESTAURANT, CAFÉ & BAR Family owned and women run business, started in 2013 with the renovation of a beautiful historical house in Vík. We offer fresh meals made with love and local ingredients. The restaurant is located in an old and charming farm house on the top of a hill with amazing view of the ocean, town and surrounding mountains. Experience our warm welcome, homey atmosphere and delicious food, treats and drinks! Follow us on social media for more information!

NAME: Icelandic Street Food
DESCRIPTION: Have you ever left your grandmother's house hungry? NOBODY LEAVES HUNGRY in Icelandic Street Food. Starting at 11:00-23:00 in the night: Traditional Icelandic Fishermans Favourite with bread on the side. Traditional Icelandic Shellfish Soup Bread Bowl option. Traditional Icelandic Lamb Soup - Bread Bowl option. Grandmother's traditional Cake & Pancakes. Media : Reykjavik Grapevine BEST CHEAP EAT RESTAURANT 2018 & 2019. AMERICAN AIRLINES IN FLIGHT TELEVISION THE TIMES THE GUARDIAN - Best Reykjavik Street Food in Iceland

NAME: Stukuhusid
DESCRIPTION: Stúkuhúsið is a lovely café situated in the center of Patreksfjörður. The café focuses on offering good quality coffee as well as a range of home-made pastries, sandwiches, salads, soups and a meal of the day composed of the freshest available fish and/or seabird.

NAME: 101 bistro
DESCRIPTION: Feeling hungry? Stop by for great food for moderate prices. We offer you a pleasant experience accompanied by * excellent pizzas prepared in a traditional wood fired oven * excellent fish and chips made with fresh fish from the ocean *tasty Mediterranean specials *juicy burgers. See you in 101 Bistro!!!

NAME: Papa's Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Restaurant with delivery and takeout, sportsbar. Low prices, the number one place where locals come to. low price'd. Local Cod, fresh from the fishery every day.

NAME: Krost
DESCRIPTION: Kröst is a modern gourmet Grill and Wine bar at the Hlemmur Food Hall in downtown Reykjavík. Big selection of wine by the glass and food made from seasonal local ingredients.

NAME: Messinn
DESCRIPTION: Messinn is a small seafood restaurant, located in the heart of Reykjavík. We specialize in fresh seafood that we offer for lunch and dinner, every day of the week. Messinn's specialties are without a doubt our fish pans, in which we serve freshly cooked fish, along with butter-fried potatoes and vegetables that melt in your mouth. Come and enjoy eating delicious and crunchy fresh fish in a cosy environment. We look forward to seeing you.

NAME: Matarkjallarinn - Foodcellar
DESCRIPTION: The Food Cellar is a Grill & Cocktail bar situated in an 160 year old building in the center of Reykjavík. We like to think that Food is for your body and music is for your soul. Brasserie is the style of food, focusing on icelandic finest ingredients. The bar has good selection of fine cocktails put together by our outstanding bartenders.

NAME: Hlemmur Matholl
DESCRIPTION: Iceland's first food hall offers a selection of nine diverse and ambitious restaurants housed in an old bus terminal. At Hlemmur Matholl, guests can enjoy a relaxing atmosphere and grab breakfast, lunch, and dinner to suit all tastes. Included in the food hall you have the option of a bakery, a coffee house, pizza parlour, taco stand, Vietnamese sandwiches, authentic lasagna and four very good restaurants with lots of great options. Follow your taste buds and eat with the locals in the downtown area of 101 Reykjavik.

NAME: Skal!
DESCRIPTION: SKÁL! is a bar & restaurant located in Hlemmur Foodhall in Reyjavík. Known for it’s take on combining seasonality, high quality food and drinks in a casual setting at fair price point. Run by three friends, Björn Steinar - saltmaker from Saltverk, Gísli Grímsson and chef Gísli Matt (founder of the highly acclaimed Slippurinn in the Westman islands). In drinks we serve natural wines, locally brewed beers & in-house made kombucha. A good selection of Icelandic dishes from seaweed flakes, beef tartar, spicy cauliflower and smoked carrots to dishes like arctic char with mash, lamb ribs with rhubarb BBQ & skirt steak with herb butter and desserts like vegan chocolate mousse with liqourice salt and blueberry granita. SKÁL!

NAME: Smidjan Brugghus
DESCRIPTION: Brewpub with a view over the brewing equipment. Good place if you like grilled burgers, BBQ Ribs, Hot Wings, cocktails and craft beer. Kitchen open between 12:00 - 21:00

NAME: Kjarr Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: "Restaurant in Kirkjubæjarklaustur. Simple and honest food. Using local and high quality ingredients."

NAME: Midgard Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Restaurant. Bar. Accommodation. Adventure Tours. Everyone is very welcome to eat at Midgard Base Camp Restaurant, travelers and locals alike. Midgard's café, bar and restaurant are open daily with extensive hours. Our Midgard chefs ensure that all ingredients and dishes are made to be energy giving, healthy and tasty. Join us and other locals at the Base Camp in the evening and profit from the daily happy hour everyday from 5 to 7pm. After a long day out in the wild, choose until 9pm from our dinner a la carte menu - all dishes are typical Icelandic but with an international twist. End the day with a local draft beer or a Midgard Mule in our cozy lounge. We are looking forward to welcoming you at our "extended " home!

NAME: Verbudin 66 Hrisey
DESCRIPTION: A small, family run restaurant with a fusion of traditional and international cuisine. Fresh fish, straight from the pier as well as Burgers, cakes and coffee. During the winter we are only open on weekends.

NAME: Kasbah Cafe Reykjavik
DESCRIPTION: Authentic Moroccan restaurant serving traditional homemade Moroccan food like tagines, couscous bastilla, briouates, soups, a variety of Moroccan salads and homemade cakes along with the famous Moroccan mint tea all served by our staff traditionally dressed. We have a nice outside area by the Reykjavik Old Harbor. A great atmosphere that will make you travel to Morocco! Read about our history here: https://grapevine.is/icelandic-culture/food/2019/07/04/eat-the-kasbah-a-chic-new-cafe-that-brings-morocco-to-reykjavik/

NAME: Country Hotel Anna
DESCRIPTION: Country Hotel Anna, which is listed on Trip Advisor, was originally just a restaurant - it's at the same location.

NAME: Kaffi Lara - El Grillo Bar
DESCRIPTION: We are closed for the winter season. Thanks for a great season. See you all again in 2024 - around easter. Cheers The El Grilló family

NAME: Sker Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Restaurant in the heart of Ólafsvík that offers various food options that make your taste buds dance. We look forward to see you !

NAME: Einsi Kaldi
DESCRIPTION: The restaurant Einsi Kaldi is located on the ground floor of Hotel Vestmannaeyjar. The house itself is a historic place, where a lot of establishments have been located, such as a cinema, a soda factory, a printshop and later on it was used as a storage building. The house collapsed during the volcano eruption of 1973 but was rebuilt again in 1975. The owner of the restaurant Einar Bjorn Arnason ,,Einsi kaldi", local man, born and raised in Vestmannaeyjar, enjoys greatly to put his magic and imagination into delicious seafood-dishes and for that he is renowned. His interest in working with fresh fish is not really surprising since he is so close to one of our richest fishing grounds, which gives him the opportunity to obtain fresh products from the boats daily. He actually puts a great emphasis on obtaining his products locally, such as cliff- and seabirds along with various herbs picked on the Island. During the summer Einsi kaldi, and his team offers a diverse menu from lunchtime to evening, seven days a week. At lunch the emphasis is on light and fresh dishes, such as soup, meet and of course fresh Icelandic fish and Danish Open Sandwiches. In the evening variety is the name of the game and you can choose everything from appetizers to sumptuous meat and fish dishes, something for all tastes.

NAME: Fjorubordid
DESCRIPTION: Fjorubordid (Fjöruborðið - The seashore) restaurant is in the small village of Stokkseyri with 560 residents but over 50.000 customers pr year, only 10 minutes from Selfoss. Selfoss is the capital of the southwest, the golden circle, Þingvellir (Thingvellir) Gullfoss, Geysir, Seljalandsfoss, Skogafoss area. Just 44 minutes from Reykjavik and 75 minutes from Keflavik airport you can enjoy a wonderful afternoon of Reykjavik, Golden circle, Glaciers, Waterfalls and Northern lights. We are on the way to Vík (Vik), Vatnajokull and Skaftafell. Our langoustines are world famous and the langoustine soup is magical. It is suitable for numerous occasions and happy moments on ordinary days, but Fjöruborðið takes no responsibility for consequences or stirring adventures that could result from ingesting it. It has a will of its own and, as such, it is risky for those who don't want to venture beyond the average. Come and enjoy, summer or winter, Stokkseyri will become your adventure.

NAME: Bryggjan Grindavik
DESCRIPTION: Bryggjan Grindavik, is both a small cozy Cafe on the groundfloor facing the Harbour, and "Netagerðin" a full-service restaurant on the second floor. The Cafe is open all year round, and the Netagerðin Restaurant will full operation from May 1, 2022.

NAME: Bastard Brew & Food
DESCRIPTION: Bastarð Brew & Food is situated at Vegamótastígur 4 in downtown Reykjavík. We offer a few of our own beers as well as dozen of beer from other breweries on draft and a good selection of bottled beer. We make ambitious craft cocktails where we do our own refreshing twists on classics like the Moscow Mule and Aperol Spritz. The kitchen is open from 11:45AM to 11PM every day. It has courses like flatbreads with a variety of different toppings, mini tacos, burgers, chicken Louisiana style, cheese and charcuterie platter and more. Happy hour from 4-7PM every day and DJ spins from 10PM Thursday to Saturday.

NAME: 3 Frakkar
DESCRIPTION: The restaurant Þrir Frakkar, was opened on March 1. 1989 and has been run by the chef Úlfar Eysteinsson and his son Stefán Úlfarsson until 2016 when Úlfar retired. The chef. Stefán Úlfarsson, have continuously placed emphasis on fish courses and the restaurant has become well known for its delicious fish fare. Other specialities on the menu include whale meat and sea bird entrees.

NAME: Cafe Loki
DESCRIPTION: Homemade Traditional Icelandic Food in the heart of Reykjavik. We specialise in classic home style Icelandic cuisine, just like our mom and their moms used to make it. Iceland is famous for fresh fish and our delicious lamb that roams free during the summer. Our selection of classic dishes and tasting platters covers almost everything you need to taste, from the famous meat soup to the exciting fermented shark and rye bread ice cream. Located across the street from Hallgrímskirkja church in downtown Reykjavik you will find Kaffi Loki. A traditional Icelandic home style restaurant serving classic Icelandic cuisine. Quality food prepared on location, wonderful employees and friendly prices.

NAME: Harry's Seafood & Grill
DESCRIPTION: Harry's Seafood & Grill Restaurant (former Salt - Kitchen & Bar) is a family run restaurant specialized in serving quality Icelandic seafood and lamb. We also offer three course set menu. Opening hours: 17:00 - 22:30/23:00

NAME: Englendingavik Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: We put emphasis on creating a relaxed and cozy atmosphere to go with the spirit of the old buildings by the Bay. As for food, we focus on locally sourced ingredients. The restaurant has a one-of-a-kind view of the sea, with its islands and rocks, teaming with bird life. The terrace extending south of the restaurant gives a good shelter from the north and north-eastern breeze.

NAME: Gamla fjosid
DESCRIPTION: The Old Cowhouse is a warm and welcoming family restaurant. That takes pride in offering fresh products from local area. All the meat on the menu is 100% free range and unprocessed, straight from the farm! Fresh vegetable from our garden. We bake our own bread with wheat and barley from our neighbours at Þorvaldseyri. COME JOIN US FOR AN AUTHENTIC ICELANDIC EXPERIENCE

NAME: Matur Og Drykkur
DESCRIPTION: Our menu features classic dishes that have been passed down from generation to generation, all prepared with locally sourced ingredients. Our chefs take pride in their craft, carefully selecting the freshest ingredients to create flavourful dishes. Our menu is designed to be experienced and enjoyed in a relaxed atmosphere, and our staff is always there to provide friendly service.

NAME: Sjavarpakkhusid
DESCRIPTION: With stunning views over Stykkishólmur harbour, the restaurant specialises in expertly made, locally sourced and seasonal food, accompanied by a good selection of beers and wines. We are extremely proud to work with local fishermen, farmers and breweries who provide us with the very best materials. Sustainability and locality are very important to us; we try our hardest to ensure that we are able to produce high quality and delicious food while keeping our environmental impact as low as possible. Breiðafjörður is a treasure trove for food lovers, why would we need to look anywhere else!

NAME: BRASS Kitchen&Bar
DESCRIPTION: Brass kitchen and bar serves; Breakfast buffet from 7:00-10:00 every day. Kitchen and Bar is open from 14:00 -22:00 every day. Happy hour every day from 14:00-18:00

NAME: Olverk Pizza & Brewery
DESCRIPTION: // On opening nights our kitchen stops taking food orders at 21:ö0. // Ölverk Pizza & Brewery is located in Hveragerði, small town 30 minutes away from Reykjavík. Our specialties are wood-fire baked pizza, good variations of beer that comes from our own micro brewery and hot sauces.

NAME: ROK Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: ROK is a fine casual restaurant focusing on serving high quality food in a friendly relaxed environment.

NAME: Islenski Barinn
DESCRIPTION: Authentic Icelandic home cooking with a modern twist. Superb selection of Icelandic dishes, ranging from the most traditional courses to Icelandic takes on burgers and hot dogs. This family run gastropub is also proud to stock the world’s best selection of Icelandic beers, liqueurs and spirits.

NAME: Ishusid Pizzeria
DESCRIPTION: Ishusid Restaurant Pizzeria offers various selection of thin stone baked pizzas, Fish&chips, Lobster Soup and other dishes, using high quality local ingredients. Among other things, the famous local lobster (langoustine) and the Icelandic cod. The restaurant welcomes you with a nice atmosphere in a beautiful surrounding overlooking the harbour in Höfn.

NAME: Klausturkaffi
DESCRIPTION: Klausturkaffi is located in the former home of the writer Gunnar Gunnarsson. It is a mansion built in 1939 and donated to the Icelandic nation in 1948. Now a cultural centre in memory of the writer. Opening hours of the restaurant are: April, May&Sep. 11:00-17:00. June-August 10:00-18:00. Focus on local food.

NAME: Kaffi Krus
DESCRIPTION: Lovely restaurant and Cafe in Selfoss.

NAME: Slippurinn
DESCRIPTION: WE ARE OPEN FROM MAY-SEPTEMBER We are proud to mention that in October 2015, Slippurinn was ranked as Iceland's second best restaurant according to the White Guide / Best restaurants in the Nordics. Slippurinn is a family run eatery by the harbour in a 100 year old building that once housed a machine-workshop that served the old shipyard. It's casual, friendly and excellent quality. Our philosophy is simple and honest, we cook our food from scratch using the best ingredients in season. We get most of our vegetables from farmers on the south coast and we go next door to the fish market to get the freshest fish possible. We grow our own herbs and salads and forage the island for wild herbs and seaweeds. Our unique cocktails made from local herbs are a must try! The highly ambitious kitchen is run by chef Gísli Matthías Audunsson. Indiana his sister, is the general manager and bar manager and mom Katrín is the front of house.

NAME: Gandhi Indian Restaurant & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Gandhi the Indian restaurant is situated at Bergstaðastræti 13, in the center of Reykjavik. The restaurant is cozy and romantic with an authentic, Indian atmosphere.

NAME: Kaffi Ilmur
DESCRIPTION: Breakfast, brunch, coffee, homebaked cake, a la carte menu, fishsoup, various salads, traditional lambsoup.

NAME: Fludasveppir Farmers Bistro
DESCRIPTION: Farmers Bistro is located in the beautiful surroundings of Flúðir which has been a popular destination for domestic and foreign tourists as there is always great weather here. The municipal area is home to 800 people, smack dab in the middle of the Golden Circle Farmers Bistro was founded by Georg and Emma in order to offer food from the region. Georg operates two firms; Flúðasveppir, the only mushroom farm in Iceland and one of the largest horticulture farm called Flúða-Jörfi. Flúðasveppir produces both white and chestnut mushrooms, and at Flúða-Jörfi, we grow bell-peppers and tomatoes in greenhouses. At Georg’s farm, Hvítárholt, Flúða-Jörfi also cultivates cauliflowers, broccoli, cabbage, red cabbage, kale and carrots outdoors. We also grow the fresh herbs used at Farmers Bistro. We all know what mushrooms are, but not everyone knows how they grow. Our hallmark is to introduce and promote our bell-pepper and mushroom cultivation.

NAME: Hygge restaurant & bar
DESCRIPTION: We Have An Amazing View Where You Can Enjoy The Best Local Products You Can Get In The Area, In A Fusion That Combines The Tradition With The Modern In An Exceptional Way, Our Menu Changes According To The Fresh Products We Can Get In The Day.

NAME: Von Mathus & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Family run restaurant by the harbor In Hafnarfjordur city. - Icelandic cuisine, seafood. - Great cocktails and atmosphere. - 50 seat restaurant, reservations are recommended.

NAME: Sjavargrillid Seafood Grill
DESCRIPTION: In 2010 a young chef from Húsavík, was awarded Chef of the year 2010 in Iceland. The young chef, Gústav, spent months traveling around Iceland looking for the real taste of Iceland, along the way he found a few things that are key items of the interior of the restaurant. Take a look at our menu, it will be our pleasure to fire up the old grill when you honor us with a visit.

NAME: Hofnin
DESCRIPTION: Hofnin has a beautiful seaside view overlooking the harbour.

NAME: Arabian Taste
DESCRIPTION: Authentic Syrian and Arabic food restaurant. You will experience the best Syrian and Arabic food in Iceland made fresh, with a lot of love and care. We are always open to any feedback, and if you did not like our food let us know so we would redeem and compensate it for you. Life is tasty... but Arabian Taste is tastier ...

NAME: Cafe Gardurinn
DESCRIPTION: You can enjoy our homemade vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free dishes, soups and treats at our place or take-away. Situated on Klapparstígur in the heart of the city centre, our little cafe offers homemade vegetarian and vegan dishes and treats. You can eat in our peaceful surroundings or order to take-away

NAME: Old Iceland Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: We are a family run restaurant with Icelandic home cooking. Our specialty is on seafood and Icelandic lamb. We also offer a choice of three or a five course set menu OPENING HOURS: Lunch: 11:30 - 15:30, Dinner: 17:00 - 22:00

NAME: Frederiksen Ale House
DESCRIPTION: Family run Bar/Restaurant in Reykjavík. At Frederiksen Ale House we pride ourselves in passionate cooking and personal service, we got Happy hours and/or activities everyday. Feel free to stop by for a beer or two. Love The Frederiksen family

NAME: Tapas Barinn
DESCRIPTION: TapasBarinn is an extremely lively restaurant where Spanish tapas tradition meets the freshest Icelandic ingredients. It is located in a cellar at Vesturgata 3 in Reykjavik's central. The menu at TapasBarinn offers over 50 different meat, fish and vegetable dishes so you can take your time and experiment various flavour combinations. A must try is the Icelandic gourmet feast which is a great way to taste the best of Icelandic produce in one meal. The restaurant has been open since the year 2000 and has become a local favourite. It has the only kitchen in Reykjavík that is open 23:30 on weekdays and 01:00 on weekends. The breezy atmosphere and the Spanish effects in the decorations make TapasBarinn ideal for an enjoyable evening, a true ray of sunshine in downtown Reykjavík.

NAME: Kopar
DESCRIPTION: THE HARBOUR The fresh and energetic atmosphere of the old harbour is part of the experience when you dine at Kopar. You can enjoy the view of the Esja mountain, a symbol of Reykjavik, while you watch the ships come into the harbour after a day at sea. THE FOOD At Kopar we choose local products, both from land and sea to create an adventurous menu! Traditional and old methods and recipes meet modern and new ingredients, giving dishes a surprising twist. For exemple, Kopar was the first restaurant in Iceland to serve Icelandic rockcrab. THE DRINKS Surprise and seductive are the keywords at the bar. Traditional cocktails meet new waves of the cocktail world. You can enjoy a pre-drink on our terrace by the harbor or sit outside after dinner with coffee and cognac. We have a cozy bar lounge with a swing where you can enjoy your drinks inside as well. The pride of the bar is the Icelandic fisherman’s Collection, a wall with an incredible selection of cognac and whiskey.

NAME: Strondin Pub Vik
DESCRIPTION: Ströndin Pub Vík is a modern pub where you can come and relax after a long day of exploring beautiful Iceland. Because of our great location just a few meters from the world-famous Black Sand beach, you can watch sun setting down behind spectacular Reynisdrangar pillars while enjoying a delicious locally sourced meal accompanied by a refreshing drink. Our team will always do an extra step to make you feel comfortable

NAME: Moss Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Serving exquisite reinventions of Icelandic cuisine, Michelin-starred Moss Restaurant occupies the highest point at Blue Lagoon Iceland and offers stunning views of the volcanic horizon

NAME: Bryggjan Brugghus
DESCRIPTION: Bryggjan Brugghus is a high quality restaurant and brewpub located by the old harbor with a brewery, cocktail bar and wine room. The restaurant first opened in 2015 and has since been a leader among craft breweries in Iceland. The kitchen, under the direction of Hjálmar Grétarsson, conjures up grilled steaks to share, fresh seafood and starters that play with the taste buds. Bryggjan's Brewery Hall seats up to 90 people and is suitable for groups, meetings, conferences and concerts. Table bookings are desirable but not necessary

NAME: Rauda Husid
DESCRIPTION: Enjoy wonderful food in a historic building in the quaint seaside town of Eyrarbakki. A 45-minute scenic drive from Reykjavik, less than 15 minutes from Selfoss, and your gateway to the south coast. So stop by for a bowl of hearty soup on your way out or a feast fit for royalty on your way back to your accommodation after a day of sightseeing. The historical and relaxing atmosphere at Rauda Husid welcomes you to enjoy excellent food, such as delicious lobster/langoustine and fish direct from the fishermen, Icelandic lamb and other dishes along with good wine and personal service.

NAME: Kol Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: The Restaurant is situated at Skolavordustigur 40 in Reykjavik. The design concept is a mixture of warm modern Icelandic feel with international touch wherein furniture of designer Tom Dixon play the main role. The restaurants is on two floors with an open kitchen and a wieldy bar. The restaurant is divided into spaces with cozy leather couches and has a variety of different table settings. The cuisine is feel good comfort food with a twist on classic cuisine. The menu offers a variety of starters, salads, fish, steaks and desserts. The head chef, Sævar Lárusson is a young ambitious chef who has gathered years of experience at Reykjavík‘s best restaurants, working along side many of the country’s most renown chefs. The restaurant centers around a bar where the country's best cocktail bartenders serve craft cocktails from the best ingredients available and are offering an ambitious cocktail list.

NAME: Fish House | Bar & Grill
DESCRIPTION: We are a family owned restrauant , we love good food and great music. Freshly prepared seafood in classic Icelandic style. Our motto is "Eat fish and live long, Eat fish and love strong".

NAME: Strikid
DESCRIPTION: Strikið restaurant is located in the centre of town, offering a splendid over the fjord and the new Cultural and Conference house Hof. During summer meal can be enjoyed on the sheltered terrace adjacent to the restaurant.

NAME: Ingolfsskali Viking Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Ingólfsskáli is a family run restaurant that offers great food in a one of a kind environment. We specialise in authentic traditional Icelandic cuisine and pride ourselves on the quality of our food and our traditional Icelandic hospitality. We try to source our food from nearby farmers in order to assure the quality of our ingredients and to support our local community. Some of the dishes we serve is even comprised of ingredients we fish or hunt our selves! So please give us a visit and enjoy a truly unique viking dinner that you will tell stories about for a long time.

NAME: Beccafico Kitchen Bar
DESCRIPTION: Homemade sicilian kitchen made with love and passion. Come to enjoy our dishes and we will promise you that you won't regret it! Davide and Orazio are waiting for you.

NAME: Relish Restaurant & Pool Bar
DESCRIPTION: Variety is the spice of life, as they say. This is no truer than at Relish Restaurant & Pool Bar. The Relish kitchen offers a wonderful selection of culinary treats. So much so that you will be spoilt for choice. Located in the bay of San Antonio, you can enjoy gorgeous sea views across the bay while you indulge yourself with a delicious cocktail or some amazing food. Whether you fancy a day around the pool or a restaurant experience. Relish has it all. You can be transported to Europe, Asia, The Americas and Africa while enjoying a selection of dishes from the World Tapas Menu. Each tapas has been carefully thought out to offer you an exciting range of flavours. The Hearty Mains menu includes a selection of familiar dishes that will leave you feeling satisfied. If you want to go to burger heaven you need to try one of the Relish Homemade Burgers, amazing burgers, all very different, all offering something really special. Make sure you book early for one of our Sunday Roasts

NAME: Ajo Blanco Vermuteria Ibiza
GENERAL_LOCATION: Carrer de Fray Luis de León 9, 07800

NAME: The Rider Corner
DESCRIPTION: Freestyle Gourmet Burgers, made with Love! Healthy and yummy poke bowls and salads, tapas to share around a cocktail or beer for a great time with friends or family.

NAME: Ca La Nina
DESCRIPTION: 40 años entre fogones es una buena carta de presentación. Esos son los años q Julito, el chef de Ca la Nina lleva a sus espaldas. Cocina mediterránea con toques asiáticos y sudamericanos servidos en formato tapa, gran variedad de paellas, sangría , ensaladas y postres caseros es lo que encontraréis en este negocio a pocos metros del mar.

NAME: Empanadas Malvon
DESCRIPTION: Desde el primer bocado se nota que las empanadas argentinas de Malvón recién horneadas son diferentes a todas las que has probado antes. ¿Que por qué? Súper fácil: en Malvón elaboramos a mano cada una de tus empanadas y nos encargamos de cuidar los detalles para hacer que cada bocado sea una fiesta de sabor. Si las has probado ya, sabes de qué te estamos hablando; si no ¿a qué estás esperando?

NAME: Vanilla Beach Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: WELCOME TO ​VANILLA BEACH IBIZA A bar & restaurant, unique because of its location and as precious and special as our guests. We look forward to welcoming you with culinary highlights and the best view of the beautiful Mediterranean Sea. Our cuisine is down-to-earth, authentic, Mediterranean and at the same time international in every facet. Enjoy the view and the stylish ambience with a cool drink, unique cocktail creations and good music. Vanilla Beach Ibiza is a lifestyle concept that combines the Ibizan attitude to life on the Balearic Islands with the unique atmosphere of sun, wind and sea. The entire Vanilla Beach Ibiza team is looking forward to making your visit unforgettable.

NAME: The Prince Albert
DESCRIPTION: 99 Gins - the biggest selection of Gins on Ibiza. We are a family-run restaurant and bar located in beautiful Es Canar, Ibiza. Our menu is full of wholesome homemade meals, we are especially known for our great Fish & Chips, hamburgers, and Pizzas. But our menu is full of great meals. We are also known for our great Gin selection, stocking 99 gins as well as a nice selection of Single Malt whiskies. We look forward to seeing you.

NAME: Salvaje Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: Salvaje Ibiza is synonymous with spectacle, originality and fun. The nights here are full of attractive shows, Mediterranean fusion cuisine and some of the best cocktails in Ibiza!

NAME: CasaPiedra Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: CasaPipedra Restaurante is located in a typical old ibithencan farmhouse made by stonewalls, in the heart of the magic island, it is located between mountains and the sea. Right at the entrance to Cala Llonga. In our special environment we high quality natural products handled with great care. Mediterranean and Vietnamese cousine. We offer as well, a sushi menu. We have not got stoves, all our cuisine is made in a charcoal oven called Josper, giving to the product an exceptional and exquisite flavour.

NAME: Loveat Ibiza
REVIEW_TAGS: decided to give it a try

NAME: Junglebowls
DESCRIPTION: Junglebowls is a concept of healthy food restaurant. Many kinds of bowls, homemade drinks, acai bowls, poke and salads are our best in aor friendly environment close to the beach of Ibiza city.

NAME: Donde Marian Y Miguel
GENERAL_LOCATION: Carretera de Es Canà, km 2, BAJO, 07840

NAME: Ca n’Esmeralda
GENERAL_LOCATION: Carrer de Oviedo, Esquina con Carrer Des Caló, 07829

NAME: ANIMA MIA Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: Ristorante Italiano nel cuore di Playa d'en Bossa ( Ibiza ). Nella nostra struttura ritroverete i sapori del bel paese grazie ai prodotti importati di altissima qualità. Le nostre pizze Napoletane cotte in forno a legna. Cocktail bar nelle ore serali con drink ricercati effettuati da nostro Bar tender. Vieni a trovarci per una cena romantica o un ritrovo con gli amici. Vi aspettiamo!

NAME: Sushimi
DESCRIPTION: Sushi and fusion asian restaurant and delivery in San Antonio (IBIZA). Eat with style in a young and eclectic place or take it all with you.

NAME: Sa Cova
DESCRIPTION: "SA COVA Located in the heart of the old town of Ibiza, Sa Cova has an intimate terrace, with a view overlooking Dalt Vila and its cathedral, Inside there is, The open kitchen and a bar under the cave . an Selected Wines & Drinks Menu that accompanies this traditional and modern cuisine. Perhaps one of the best kept secrets of the old city. The Chef offers a short menu that matches the market and the season. he handles perfectly and harmonizes the most avant-garde techniques with the traditional ones, you can find the classics of the French tradition, with South-americas influences, uniting with the Mediterranean aromas that the island offers. Only open for the dinner service Sa Cova welcome you every-nights in Season."

NAME: Restaurante Pyrenees
GENERAL_LOCATION: Castelló 4 Cala de Bou, Sant Josep, 07829

NAME: El Bistro de Stephan San Antonio Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: Mediterranea Bistro with French Savoir-faire. Large choice of traditional and originale tapas. Steakhouse. Fresh fish .The restaurant is situated in a quit street close the church. Wine bar.Cocktails.Homemade sangrias.

NAME: Yenuina - Laboratorio de Pasta
DESCRIPTION: Laboratory of fresh pasta, restaurant and cocktail bar. We produce different types of fresh pasta served with delicious sauces from italian tradition. Vegetarian and meat starter also on the menu to accompanied our selection of cocktails and wine.

NAME: Restaurante Soleado
DESCRIPTION: Aline y Philippe han traído la cocina francesa con acentos provenzales siempre en constante innovación. Una carta original y refinada con acentos mediterráneos que pone en valor los productos de temporada El restaurante Soleado es conocido por su ubicación privilegiada a la orilla del mar situado en el recién reformado paseo de Figueretas, a pocos metros del centro de Ibiza. La terraza es literalmente un balcón abierto al Mediterráneo, desde donde se goza de una magnífica vista a la isla de Formentera. El ambiente romántico, relajado y amistoso es el reflejo del trabajo de Aline y Philippe durante más de 20 años en la isla. Es una experiencia que, sin duda, tiene que vivirse en primera persona.

NAME: El Passadis Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: Il ristorante è aperto tutti i giorni dalle 20:00 alle 01:00 in una delle strade più caratteristiche dell'isola. Piatti mediterranei, pesce, carne, piatti vegetariani e vegani, cuochi fantastici cucineranno per te. Non vediamo l'ora di vederti!
GENERAL_LOCATION: Carrer de la Mare de Deu 6, 07800

NAME: Bebel
DESCRIPTION: We are pleased to present the opening of a new seafood restaurant in Ibiza. Bebel will offer a new concept, a new idea about serving seafood, until now, never seen in Ibiza. Our strenghts will be the variations of raw and cooked starters of high quality ibiciencan fish. This is how “Bebel” Anzio - Ibiza is born. We’ll wait for you in Carrer de Jaume I, 4 Ibiza. (Next to Plaza del Parque). Thank you

NAME: Savannah Beach Club
DESCRIPTION: Savannah opened it's doors for the first time back in 1997. Over the years Savannah has enjoyed countless stunning sunsets. In recent years Savannah has become a prominent feature on the world famous Sunset Strip. With it's laid back and funky attitude, Savannah is the grown up sibling of the more famous Mambo. Open from 10am through until the early hours, the day time menu and the new Asian cuisine has something for everyone. The large seafront terrace next to the sparkling Mediterranean is the perfect spot to start your day with a comforting Full English while indulging in the laid back Summer chill. Breakfast is served until 1PM. As the crowds gather for sunset we recommend pre booking your seafront Sunset tale to enjoy the magical atmosphere as the sun sinks into the ocean.

NAME: FEEL IBIZA Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Romantic Restaurant with Fusión italo mediterránea kitchen, amazing pizzas cooked to perfection in the wood fired pizza oven, fresh homemade pasta prepared in the exhibition kitchen, also propose variety meals like starter, salad, pasta, vegan dish, fish, meat, dessert and much more... Everything in the big terrace with a lot of different cocktails. The kitchen is open until 1:00 am. perfect place for be with your love or with your friends, or your family, for eating, drinking and relaxing on the best atmosphere !!!

NAME: Es Terral
DESCRIPTION: Family type bistro by Consultant Chef Matthieu Savariaud and Sandra Aseijas. Recommended by Michelin Guide Spain, Lonely Planet Guide, Petit Fute and Gambero Rosso among other international food related websites and blogs. We strive to provide relaxed but attentive service, fresh selected products. Organic and locally produced vegetables and fresh daily market cuisine. Please get in touch for specialized consultancy, cooking lessons or Reservations.

NAME: Restaurante Sa Finca
DESCRIPTION: We have an extensive menu. Belgian dishes and a menu of exotic meats unique on the island (kangaroo, bison, zebra, crocodile,...) Apart from being able to enjoy something different our restaurant is a typical Ibizan country house of more than 400 years old with panoramic views of the mountain and bay of Santa Eulalia del Río (Ibiza).

NAME: La Gaia by Oscar Molina
DESCRIPTION:
La Gaia es el restaurante insignia de Ibiza Gran Hotel. Con el chef Óscar Molina al mando de los fogones, el cual se inspira en el producto local de Ibiza con una gran presencia del Mediterráneo para llevar a cabo sus creaciones culinarias que componen un menú degustación único en la isla.
Gracias a su propuesta gastronómica y a su excelente servicio en sala, el restaurante cuenta una Estrella MICHELIN y dos Soles Repsol que garantizan una experiencia inolvidable.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Paseo Juan Carlos I, 17, Ibiza Gran Hotel, 07800

NAME: The Beach Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: A restaurant, cocktail bar and perfect chill paradise is located directly on the shoreline in a hidden cove of San Antonio Bay. The ultimate destination for locals and visitors alike to spend carefree afternoons and memorable nights against the Mediterranean Sea. Guests can enjoy the luxurious, oversized white plush sun beds dotted around the venue and individual sun loungers are available on the beach. The venue has an Ibiza chill soundtrack by daytime and laid back live DJ´s during the evenings. Above the restaurant is a beautiful terrace overlooking the bay with an indoor space making it a perfect choice for private events and private dining experiences. The Beach Ibiza is available for full private hire and non-exclusive events.

NAME: Street Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: In addition to special burgers, our take away menù develops itself with some typical italian dishes and some street appetizers, which you can enjoy wherever you want. Our dishes are the result of our love for the tradition of the italian kitchen. With a selection of the best ingredients, we aim to give to our customers a unique experience, tasty n' easy!

NAME: Mundo Street Food
DESCRIPTION: Restaurant style street food, introducing your tastebuds to mouthwatering flavours that will take you on a journey around the world!

NAME: Lagom Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: Restaurant where you can delight your senses and have an unforgettable experience. You can also enjoy delicious dishes of your own creation, with a gastronomic proposal inspired by Mediterranean-Tropical cuisine.

NAME: Can Berri Vell
DESCRIPTION: Can Berri Vell built by the end of the 17TH century at the main square of the beautiful village of Sant Agusti you will find this old rural manor house of Can Berri Vell with respect the antique building we created for you a perfect palce where you will find in rare tranquility an exisit menu. Can Berri Vell is the ideal atmosphere for good talks among friends.

NAME: Ausonia Pizza Bar
DESCRIPTION: Welcoming atmosphere, good for families, groups and couples. Italian culinary tradition, high quality products.

NAME: Brunchit - Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: Join the brunch fever! Brunchit es un imprescindible para los amantes del brunch en Ibiza: ¡visítalo sin reserva! Disfruta todos los días del mejor café ecológico, pan de masa madre y variedad de tostadas (aguacate, huevos benedictinos, salmón, tomate...), pancakes salados y dulces, ensaladas y bowls exóticos llenos de color, hamburguesas y más ¡Con opciones veganas y vegetarianas! También smoothies eco naturales, cócteles... En Brunchit la comida es mucho más que un plato y creamos una experiencia: un lugar al que siempre te apetece volver. Creemos en la calidad de los ingredientes y confiamos en proveedores locales para tener un impacto positivo en las ciudades. ¡Disfruta la Experiencia Brunchit!
GENERAL_LOCATION: passeig alamera 16, Santa Eulària des Riu, Eivissa, 07840

NAME: Kasbah
DESCRIPTION: Located near the end of the sunset strip of Sant Antoni de Portmany, Ibiza, Kasbah is the heart of authentic Mediterranean dining, offering a unique culinary experience. Serving traditional Spanish-inspired cuisine with a pinch of adventure, Kasbah features tapas and classic selections to savor and share overlooking the beautiful Calo des Moro. Voted Ibiza’s Excellence Award by Tripadvisor.

NAME: Liberty's American Diner
DESCRIPTION: Family run American / British restaurant established in the year 2000. Serving the best British Breakfast followed for lunch / dinner Jack Daniel coated baby ribs, or if you think you can handle it try the pounder burger challenge, not that hungry go for a healthy salad or a spicy Tex Mex Fajita. And then wash it down with a cool refreshing cocktail or an ice cold beer. You wont leave hungry, our meals are big and our prices are small, so give us a try.

NAME: Es Virot Restaurante
DESCRIPTION: Es Virot vuelve esta temporada con nueva ubicación! Es Virot is back this season with a new location! Join us on facebook for news Es Virot Ibiza

NAME: Bizan
DESCRIPTION: The philosophy at BIZAN is simple: Everyone who walks through our doors is either already a friend, or will be. By embracing that theory, BIZAN knows that every guest will have great service, delicious food and hopefully, will know that whenever they walk into BIZAN that they are coming home. To ensure that that philosophy saturates our restaurant, Lourdes and Markus have hired the best team. In addition, by having a professional Chef, who knows that he has a handle on the culinary pulse of the island by offering regional favorites.

NAME: Bar Dona Ana
DESCRIPTION: We are open May to October, everyday 9.00am until Midnight.Food served 9.00am until 5pm NOT IN THE EVENINGS! We serve traditional English breakfast with an option to create your own breakfast, Italian made Pizzas, Homemade Burgers, Wraps, Toasties, Baguettes, Jacket Potatoes, Salad Platters, our famous white chocolate cheesecake and lots more. We have on draught, John Smiths Smooth, Guinness, Thatchers Cider, Carling & Peroni. We have a beer deal Monday to Friday 5pm until 8pm, pint of local larger 2.20€, Half 1.10€!!! For sports fans, we have 4 giant HD TV's showing all your sporting events!We hope to see you at Bar Dona Ana in the port of Santa Eulalia, Ibiza

NAME: Urban Lounge Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: We are the perfect venue to Dine, Drink and Dance in the Bay of San Antonio. The only house music venue in the area with a live DJ every night playing the best house and current Ibiza anthems. Chill on our terace in a lounger or dance the night away in our nightclub. Modern American style cuisine served from mid day till 11 pm but burgers and kebabs available till 5 in the morning.

NAME: Buah Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: Magnificent chiringuito on the beach. Sofa area. Infinite bar with spectacular views of the sea. Natural juices with fresh fruit for the mornings and more than 60 cocktails for the evenings. Home cooking, with market produce and Asian and Mexican airs.

NAME: Can Nuts
DESCRIPTION: In Can Nuts we offer breakfasts, various tapas with the best cold meat of the island, meals at noon and homemade hamburgers and drinks at night. Tuesday closed. Kitchen open up to 23:00hs.

NAME: Restaurante Sa Soca
DESCRIPTION: Sa Soca Restaurant is built on an old family estate, with wonderful views of the Benimussa mountains from our terrace in summer and with the warmth provided by our fireplace in the dining room in winter. We are proud to be a small, traditional restaurant. Our parents, Antonia and Andrés, opened the doors of Sa Soca in May 1976 with great enthusiasm and with the intention of creating a small family business that would be a meeting point for friends and family and where they would feel at home. This intention remains nowadays. At present, the restaurant is runned by their children, Alicia and Andrés. We try to follow our parents’ teachings but also to improve them day by day. We are proud of our food and service but, above all, we are proud of our customers. In the beginning the restaurant only offered traditional Ibiza dishes, but today we combine the culinary tradition of Ibiza with the dishes of the Mediterranean cuisine in general and we always work with fresh and quality products.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Carretera 803 Eivissa Sant Josep km 18, Km 18, 07839

NAME: Can Jesper
DESCRIPTION: Bar - Restaurant on a prime location, right off the beach. A little sanctuary just a few steps from the bustling promenade, with a view to die for! Can Jesper offers a bar inside, with a cosy atmosphere and a nice little dining area with lovely decoration to make you feel right at home. A wide selection of beers, cocktails and spirits and top notch, no nonsense food where simplicity makes all the difference. Friendly staff and friendly prices.

NAME: San Martino
DESCRIPTION: Discover San Martino experience. Our aim is to provide great quality, authentic Italian food at sensible prices. With all our fresh produce sourced locally, and using the finest ingredients and traditional recipes from Naples, we're sure you will be able to taste the difference here. Traditional Neapolitan Pizza, delicious pastas, colorful salads, gorgeous desserts... There is going to be something here that represents our promise of quality and it's got your name on it!
GENERAL_LOCATION: Paseo Maritimo, Local 8, Edificio Cruz del Sur, 07840

NAME: el Local
DESCRIPTION: "el Local" es un restaurante en el centro de Ibiza, dónde encontrarás comida mediterránea fusionada con recetas de muchas partes del mundo. Nuestra carta está inspirada en las casas de Italia, España, América Latina, Estados Unidos, Medio y Lejano Oriente. La pasión por nuestra cocina, alimentada por ésta mezcla cultural en constante evolución, nos permite dar a nuestros platos un enfoque contemporáneo.

NAME: Retro Gusto Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: Retro Gusto was founded in 2013 by Valentina, always ready to welcome you with a big smile, and the Chef Martina, who strives to satisfy everyone,s culinary desire. Together they have given life to project, taking care of every detail & creating a homely atmosphere. Retro Gusto will surprise you with its colourful vintage interiors & will exite your taste buds with its delicious homemade dishes. The philosophy is to use always the best quality, locally sourced fresh ingredients; giving life to a menu where every dish has been carefully planned by the experienced & friendly team. From early hours of dawn you can enjoy delicious and complete breakfasts accompanied by fantastic coffees, natural healthy juices, smoothies and cakes; all made by our chefs with so much love. Continuing our day serving homemade dishes that recall the infamous Mediterranean Italian cuisine, satisfying our customers at any time. ​

NAME: Restaurante Manila
DESCRIPTION: A beautiful place,with homemade food and always fresh.your oasis of tranquility and wellness.

NAME: Tapas Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: Situated just outside the hustle and bustle of San Antonio, slightly off the beaten track, you will find "La Finca Escondida", the hidden farmhouse, that is Tapas Ibiza. This charming reformed finca with a large alfresco dining area and garden is hugely popular with tourists and locals alike, due to it’s quality of food, outstanding service, romantic setting, and beautiful ambience. You will find a large range of small dishes designed for sharing, from more traditional classic Spanish tapas dishes to flavoursome dishes inspired by flavours from around the world. From the in-house classics that people return for time after time, to exciting and innovative dishes that are chefs are constantly creating, there literally is something for everyone. If you haven’t been to Tapas before we recommend two to three dishes per person, although it can be very hard to pick just a couple. With so many delicious dishes to choose from, you might just have to book another visit.

NAME: The Wild Asparagus
DESCRIPTION: Atop a hill lies nestled a place where friends and families state their taste and feasts of fun sustain the grace of joyful mingling and of praise. That's the Wild Asparagus, since 1968.

NAME: POM Thai Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Authentic thai cuisine, bringing sweet, salty, sour and hot flavors straight from Thailand to Ibiza. The menu offers flavorsome selection of thai dishes with an authenticity and freshness that surpasses expectations, and an extensive wine list. Terrace and pool in a beautiful and peaceful garden. ABIERTO

NAME: La Luna Nell'Orto
DESCRIPTION: At La Luna Nell'Orto we offer the best Mediterranean cuisine where creative dishes, homemade fresh Italian pasta and tasty grilled meat and local vegetables are the main attraction of our menu. The essence of the unique flavor of our dishes lies in the homemade elaboration of our foods, using quality local produce and our own garden to supply our pantry.

NAME: Pizzaman
DESCRIPTION: It's been already 9 years that we are offering traditional Italian food in this beautiful island Ibiza. We have also large varieties of gluten free food, f.e. pizzas, pasta, fresh pasta, hamburger, desserts.. Come and try it in our renewed restaurant of let us bring it straight to your door.

NAME: Es Mercat Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: Es Mercat is born from the product. We want to reclaim the fruits and vegetables of our land, the delicacies of our sea, the love we profess for the Iberian pig, the tireless search of our wineries to make the most exquisite broths, the Sunday aperitif with friends around the vermouth , the habit of eating sharing each dish and the pleasure of having a beer well spilled one sunny morning. We are the meeting point between kilometer zero and seasonal produce, freshly caught, freshly picked, from producer to plate, always fresh, always wild. Market cuisine, simple, direct and understandable by all, a first-rate product, well pampered and uncomplicated. Es Mercat is the modern tradition.

NAME: Peter Pan Ibiza
GENERAL_LOCATION: Calle de la mare de Déu 78, 07800

NAME: Monkey Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: Monkey Ibiza est une expérience gastronomique intemporelle, un équilibre entre élégance et simplicité, inspiré par le Monkey Paris, haut lieu de la gastronomie parisienne. Avec son cadre idyllique en bord de mer et sa vue imprenable sur le coucher de soleil, notre restaurant est l'un des endroits les plus prisés de l'île et vous fera perdre toute notion du temps.

NAME: Restaurante Rasca Lobos
GENERAL_LOCATION: Avda. Vicent Serra 25, Sant Jordi De Ses Salines, 07817

NAME: Mumak
DESCRIPTION: Un restaurante con espíritu tropical en diseño y sabores. Una decoración fresca, exuberante, llena de energía y colores que también se reflejan en nuestro menú, donde encontrarás platos de Tailandia, Mexico, Jamaica, India o Perú... todo con un toque exótico y cocina non-stop. Además, ofrecemos desayunos internacionales, healthy y no tanto ;) zumos frescos, riquísimos cocteles, una extensa carta de gin tonics y buenos vinos... Todo disfrutado en nuestra terraza chill con vistas al mar Mediterráneo.

NAME: Ohana Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: Ohana Ibiza es un restaurante que ofrece gastronomía mediterránea inspirada en la cocina hawaiana. Ofrecemos platos creativos y deliciosos que satisfacen todos los gustos, incluyendo opciones vegetarianas y veganas. Nuestro objetivo es brindar una experiencia gastronómica memorable en un ambiente elegante y relajado. ¡Te esperamos en Ohana Ibiza!

NAME: Restaurante El Limonero
DESCRIPTION: Excellent terrace with swimming pool to enjoy our paellas, fideuas, fish proposals and very fresh salads. The desserts are delicious but what about the cocktails? At night you can enjoy a special, cozy and quiet atmosphere. It's a pleasure to have dinner with relaxed ambient music and let the breeze do the rest, just close your eyes and imagine... Will be enough for you just imagining it? Come, visit us and see it by yourself.

NAME: Mariner Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: Mariner is a restaurant where you'll feel the purest essence of the island. At the foot of Ibiza’s castle, you will enjoy our product cuisine made with care, with a personalized and friendly service. We have a wonderful terrace with a privacy environment where to relax or cheer according the moment.

NAME: O Galego
DESCRIPTION: The restaurant will be close until April.

NAME: The Kitchen 62
DESCRIPTION: The Kitchen 62 reinvents the artisan burger with fresh flavors and locally sourced ingredients. The experience offers a first quality service. From our potatoes from ibiza crops to our fresh national veal chopped daily by our chefs. This includes the use of meats, local cheeses, homemade sauces, and freshly baked bread to make the burger a unique experience.

NAME: Caos Ibiza
DESCRIPTION: Are you in search of a healthy culinary option in Ibiza that will delight you with every bite? Your search is over! We invite you to discover the extraordinary Caos Ibiza restaurant in Santa Eulalia. Our oven cooking methods are the key to preserving the freshness and natural flavors of the carefully selected ingredients we use every day. Each dish you'll find on our extensive menu is designed to provide you with a unique gastronomic experience and satisfy your taste buds. From delicious and nutritious options to culinary creations that awaken your senses, at Caos Ibiza you'll find a variety of dishes that will allow you to enjoy healthy eating to the fullest. Every bite will be an explosion of flavors and textures that will transport you to a world of sensations. Don't wait any longer, come and let yourself be captivated by the magic of Caos Ibiza. We look forward to providing you with the best food experience in Ibiza!

NAME: S Mari Cocina Bar
DESCRIPTION: Gastronomy, tradition and avant-garde with the best raw materials and local ingredients of Ibiza.

NAME: El Toro Steak House
DESCRIPTION: El Toro combines american and mediterranean cuisine and offers a wide variety of exquisite meat,such as Ribeye and Tomahawk steaks, in addition to impressive appetizers like Feta cheese with honey and potato Twisters. You can try different selections of meat like, Charolais and Black Angus, and acknowledge the importance of special stocking and, cared transport and slaughter of the animal through the flavour and texture of your meal.

NAME: Efisia Greek Fine Dining
DESCRIPTION: Our restaurant is sheltered from the evening breeze in an alcove of rough-hewn stone. In tribute to our guiding philosophy, Efisia is named after the Greek word physis, the philosophical term for ‘nature’. As one of the top tables on the island, Efisia offers a gourmet menu in the Relais & Châteaux tradition, pairing a culinary experience with luxurious atmosphere.

NAME: Fiki Fiki Asian Peruvian Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Flavors from exotic distant lands, bibed aromas that travel the mind, dishes full of emotions. In the sea-front Fiki Fiki Asian Peruvian Restaurant, it is where Asian cuisine meets Peruvian cuisine in a unique culinary miracle.

NAME: PAARU Japanese Gastro Bar
DESCRIPTION: Located in Atlantica Holiday Village Rhodes, De Luxe area. After 21.00 only adults are allowed. Here you will find fresh, local and seasonal bar dishes inspired by Japan. Paaru is a Gastro Bar- and an experience - not quite like any other. Leave your expectations at the door and put yourself in our Chef Hands, bartender cocktails and fine tunes.

NAME: Victory Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Welcome To Our Restaurant.We do Everything To Be Happy And Have A Good Time To Our Restayrant!your Happiness Is Our Happiness!

NAME: Konstantin Restaurant Cafe
DESCRIPTION: In the year of 1999 Konstantin Restaurant was built in an idyllic location in Kalathos village,on the south part of Rhodes island,only 6km from the renowned village of Lindos. With a view of the village of Kalathos,on the side of Atrium Palace Hotel,we will endeavour to create beautiful moments of relaxation and great gastronomic variety for you . Taste our cuisine with fresh products which to a large extent are coming from the restaurant’s own garden and from Rhodian producers. Enjoy your meal with a bottle of wine from our wine-cellar where you can find a variety of red,white,rosé or sparkling wines and Champagnes from Greece,France, Italy and America, which are kept in special temperature-controlled wine cabinets. Finish your meal with delicious sweet dishes, ice cream or a nice aromatic coffee and tea. We would be pleased, to welcome you in the restaurant “Konstantin” giving us the chance of making your stay on the island of of Rhodes even more enjoyable. Georgiou Family

NAME: Tomata Corfiot Cuisine Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: "At Tomata we celebrate Corfian food which is the epitome of Mediterranean cuisine. Best enjoyed with friends/ family many of our dishes are generations-old family recipes that we present in a modern way with new textures. Corfian cuisine is designed to share, a tradition that we, in Tomata, encourage you to follow. We are cooking limited portions of our dishes daily using the best local produce available to us and we are constantly renewing our menu ( on daily basis ) introducing new local dishes and flavours to our guests. Kali Orexi"

NAME: Blue Bay A la Carte Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Our Blue Bay Restaurant has brought home one of FNL’s Best Restaurant Awards for 2023. Our restaurant’s award winning culinary experience ranks it amongst the top 204 Restaurants across Greece. For those looking for an extraordinary dining experience in a cool and cozy ambiance under the stars. A delightful menu awaits you for a true fine dining experience, breaking the boundaries of international cuisine. Located at the Atlantica Imperial Resort (adults only).

NAME: Phoebus
DESCRIPTION: Pescatarian wine bar

NAME: Ginger A La Carte Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Located in the Atlantica Imperial Resort. For those looking for an extraordinary dining experience in a cool and cozy ambience. The imagination of our experienced A la Carte chefs always keeps a surprise for our guests. Located in the Atlantica Imperial Resort (adults only).
GENERAL_LOCATION: Λεωφόρος Αθηνών, Atlantica Imperial Resort and Spa, 851 02

NAME: Nostos
DESCRIPTION: Dear costumers we would like to inform you that we do not keep reservations from social media or emails or messages. Thank you so much!

NAME: Gypsy Jungle
DESCRIPTION: GYPSY JUNGLE with Greek Shushi, Tapas & Cocktails and amazing Acropolis view. Welcome to the Jungle

NAME: Mylos A La Carte Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: One of the selected Aegean Cuisine Restaurants & Awarded with Greek Cuisine 2023. Exploring the Greek kitchen with an added modern twist, Mylos (Windmill) offers a local touch to your evening dining experience. With a view across the Mediterranean Sea and Tsambika Mountain in the backdrop, our chefs offer the most traditional, locally sourced dishes, giving you a true Greek experience in the most ambient of atmospheres. Located at the Atlantica Imperial Resort (adults only).

NAME: Stavros Traditional Grill House
DESCRIPTION: Μπορειτε να κανετε κρατηση στο τηλεφωνο η γραφοντας μηνυμα στο WhatsApp.όλα μας τα κρεατα είναι φρεσκα και ψηνονται σε καρβουνο το κρασι ειναι δικης μας παραγωγης βρισκομαστε σε ενα ομορφο μερος του νησιου

NAME: Roda Park Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: "RODA PARK TRADITIONAL GREEK RESTAURANT Since 1987 our award-winning restaurant has been offering visitors to Roda, Corfu excellent food in a warm friendly atmosphere. Roda Park is a relaxed restaurant with homemade food and a family atmosphere. It is run like a family home where Voula (my wife), Harrys, Leonidas and I, Kostas, together with all our staff, work hard every day as a team to make sure everything runs smoothly to serve you, our visitors and also have time to chat. We will help you explore the different Greek flavors and products and also the local wines. We love to help you understand our everyday life as Corfiots and how to explore the many sights on this lovely Greek island."

NAME: Abibayio
DESCRIPTION: Φιλόξενο, οικογενειακό και με την αίσθηση «καφενείου της παλιάς Αθήνας» το Αμπιμπάγιο στεγάζεται σε ένα νεοκλασικό κτίριο στον πεζόδρομο της Ηρακλειδών στο ιστορικό Θησείο και κάτω από την σκέπη της Ακρόπολης. Με μενού που προσφέρει δημιουργική μεσογειακή κουζίνα με αφορμή την Ελληνική γη και θάλασσα, χρησιμοποιώντας ειδικά επιλεγμένα αγνά προϊόντα και πρώτες ύλες απ’ όλη την Ελλάδα.

NAME: Crepa and You
DESCRIPTION: It is a friendly environment restaurant that provides Uniq recipes Mojito. Homemade recipes for Waffle, Crepes, Smoothies, Milkshakes, Slush Drinks and more. Each type of crepe has its dough taste and recipe as it is prepared with love and imagination. Smoothies and milkshakes fruits are primarily from our BIO Garden, Greek yogurt is homemade too. Our biggest concern is our customer's and the quality we provide.

NAME: Happy Blender
DESCRIPTION: Happy Blender is a vegan restaurant/juice bar located at Monastiraki flea Market in the center of Athens, Greece Enjoy your breakfast, brunch, lunch and dinner with our fresh and homemade open toasts, vegan eggs, buddha bowls,salads, burgers, plant based pizzas,Açai bowls, superfood smoothies,juices, raw sweet treats, ice cream

NAME: Rakomelo
DESCRIPTION: Rakomelo is a seaside tavern with a beautiful view at a romantic spot. Even though it is not a gourmet, it serves homemade, simple, delicious food inspired by the Cretan tradition with fresh, seasonal ingredients. A friendly environment and good for children who can spend hours watching the fish swim in the crystal clear waters of the bay

NAME: Nomad Mediterranean Gastronomy
DESCRIPTION: Nomad is an atmospheric restaurant in the heart of the medieval city. It serves dishes of Mediterranean cuisine of high gastronomy!

NAME: Magnolia Mediterranean Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Creative dishes, inspired by the Greek and Mediterranean cuisine. Flavorsome dishes prepared with fresh quality products that guests can savor on our terrace in view of the wonderful coastal scenery. Lovers of the rich Mediterranean and Greek cuisine are welcome to dine and enjoy a variety of local and regional specialties from the à la carte menu designed by Chef Dimitrios Makryniotis.

NAME: Chasapotaverna Kakarantzas
DESCRIPTION: It all began in 1950, when Vaggelis Kakarantzas opened a chop-house in the village of Koukli, Ioannina. Thanks to the fresh, local meat and vegetables, the authenticity of the recipes and the picturesque place, it became the "delicious secret" of the region. From 1975 on, his sons, Thanasis and Nikos, took the bit reins, continuing a successful tradition of local, honest, authentic food.

NAME: To Chasapaki
DESCRIPTION: Steakhouse restaurant with jazz mood, premium meat selection, burgers and tasty comfort food! Run by passionate butchers and chefs!

NAME: Restaurant Kostas
DESCRIPTION: Come enjoy our delicious Greek & International cuisine with high quality, fresh ingredients. Every Saturday Greek night with live music, dance and more!

NAME: Caravin Wine & Wanderlust
DESCRIPTION: The Wine Caravan. Two women with passion for wine, travel and adventure, meet and their vision takes shape. We are Leoni and Anna, two women with passion for wine, travel and adventure. Through our page we would like to project our vision and our love for unpretentiously nice food of our place and our aesthetics for life. We enjoy traveling as well as discovering new destinations, cultures of indigenous tribes and their culinary habits. When we’re not running around and finding some free time, then all roads lead to a trip. Our message is: “Get off your feet away from the chair, the couch, the desk. Leave the cell phone, tablet, computer and go outside. See the colors of nature. Breathe fresh air. Lead an amazing life! Make this passage through life, the most exciting adventure.” This is the journey for us. This is Caravin. This is life.

NAME: Parthenon Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: A family friendly restaurant in the centre of Kalamaki. Plenty of choice on the menu, (but please note the items listed on the photos of the menu may change). Staff are busy yet attentive and will do anything to help you. Sunday is Greek night so make sure you see one of the guys and they will book you in (walk ins still welcome).

NAME: Mantarini Roastery & More
DESCRIPTION: Mantarini is now the ideal culinary destination of the city, creates and offers dishes of high aesthetics with excellent quality. The menu is made up of delicious burgers, the classic Gyros, steaks , cool salads, desserts even cocktail evenings! We invite you to a new special experience combining traditional flavors with modern gastronomic trends. #mantariniroastery

NAME: Ono by Marouli
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Ono by Marouli in Rhodes! We're all about delicious vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free eats. Whether you're here for breakfast, lunch, or dinner, we've got something special for you. Our menu is a mix of Mediterranean favorites and modern twists, all made with love and fresh ingredients. Craving a coffee ? We offer a variety of plant-based milks to make your drink just right. Our vibe is laid-back and friendly, perfect for a casual meal or a relaxing drink.

NAME: Palatium
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Palatium Restaurant Tsilivi Palatium combines the best raw material, specialized staff and accommodation in a beautiful and relaxing environment.

NAME: Petrokofino
DESCRIPTION: We are a family restaurant, our chef is our mother and she make homemade food and sweets. Try some traditional appetizers and delicious salads with greens from our garden..,! We are waiting for you to feel the Cretan hospitality!

NAME: Katsaboo Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Katsaboo Restaurant is a brand new gastronomic destination in Santorini, a spot where one can enjoy authentic Santorinian cuisine with a modern twist in a sophisticated environment by the elegant beach pool with Volcanic black rocks, along with the exceptional, personalized services that have put Calm Collection at the top of our guest’s preferences as a hospitality establishment in Santorini. Behind the creation of Katsaboo is George Katsipis his passion for outstanding hospitality, whose never –ending strive is to welcome guests to a wholesome Santorini experience. Of course, the delicious, authentic tastes from his family recipes had to be included, and the obvious next step for Katsaboo was to launch a restaurant that would encapsulate local gastronomy the way we see it, with our family’s passion for good food, local homegrown ingredients and superb tastes.

NAME: The Red Lion Bar and Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: The Red Lion bar & restaurant was established in 1999 and is located at the end of beach road (150 meters from Malia’s main beach). Our authentic, slowly smoked B.B.Q. in our custom offset smoker is undoubtedly the highlight of our restaurant. Dry aged steaks and homemade burgers are also top favourites, while the menu has influences from all over the world. BEER, LOVE & B.B.Q. - We are not sure whether B.B.Q. was created for beer, or beer for B.B.Q. Following this motto, beer also has a very special place in our menu. With 4 homemade, craft beers of our own recipe to serve straight from our microbrewery fermenters, as well as 50 beer labels from the best local and international brewers, our organized food pairings elevate the B.B.Q. experience. Open May - October, all day, every day for breakfast, coffee, lunch, dinner and drinks.

NAME: Nymfes Bar
DESCRIPTION: Ακόμα και στις διακοπές χρειαζόμαστε κάποιες στιγμές ένα διάλειμμα. Για να δροσιστούμε, να χαλαρώσουμε, να αναζωογονηθούμε, να απολαύσουμε ένα ελαφρύ γεύμα. Στο μπαρ, δίπλα στην πισίνα, θα τα βρεις όλα αυτά και ακόμα περισσότερα. Απόλαυσε χυμούς φρέσκων φρούτων, δροσιστικά ποτά, τοπικά αναψυκτικά και υπέροχα σνακ. Και για τις στιγμές, που θέλεις κάτι πιο ιδιαίτερο, μια ποικιλία από εξωτικά κοκτέιλ σε περιμένει να την εξερευνήσεις.-- Τα σνακ σερβίρονται 12:30 - 17:30.

NAME: Street Food Zakynthos
DESCRIPTION: At Street food we offer you some tasty Greek Street Food like: Pita gyros, souvlakia, burgers and much more... All our foods are made with fresh ingredients mixed with love and passion! We would love to welcome you all at our food truck, see you soon!

NAME: Porto Bello Karpathos
DESCRIPTION: Visit Porto Bello an Italian Restaurant in St. Nikolaos Beach, Spoa Karpathos. Porto Bello is not an ordinary Italian restaurant and the reason for this is that you can first swim in the crystal clear water of the near beach of St. Nikolaos and then, taste not only delicious pizza and pasta but also fresh fish and crabs. Greek salad and much more authentic Karpathian cuisine. The quantity of the portions will definitely satisfy you and we are sure you will enjoy the Porto Bello Experience. Note that, this restaurant is a favorite place for the locals also who really appreciate the good food and excellent service. Welcome!

NAME: Monte Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Cafe creperie,ewerything home made ice creams chocolate waflle croasants and more...

NAME: Archontiko
DESCRIPTION: Traditional Cretan/Greek/European cuisine based on the best quality materials, that you can taste in a cozy atmosphere a few meters away from the city center at Kitroplatia beach, our restaurant is on the sea and provides high quality dishes from fresh organic ingrediens and fresh cretan fishes

NAME: Le Ciel Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Le Ciel Weddings & Events in Santorini is a new exciting venture created by a Think Tank of experienced professionals. You can find us on the top level of the Santorini Caldera in Imerovigli. The view of Santorini, the volcano, and perhaps the most magical sunset in Greece, is stunning.

NAME: A Little Taste Of Home
DESCRIPTION: Let's travel! Visit different beautiful corners of our planet by savoring their dishes here! Every place on earth is filled with happy moments and mind-blowing flavors. Food is one of the best indulgences in life, a discovery, a delight to the palate, and a learning experience. Every country has wonderful foodstuff, which is unique, either because of the way it is made or because of where it grows. We choose some of these for you to taste, favorites from around the globe. We are proud to prepare for your global food journey, with dishes full of history and stories. Our food is: Nutritious, healthy & wholesome - home food made with care Made with fresh & flavorful ingredients – we prepare daily Simple– you know what you are eating and is well described for you Relish a friendly service in a relaxing environment. Tells us your favorite food and we will make it for you and your friends.

NAME: Alazonia Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: The Alazonia Restaurant honors the Greek and Mediterranean cuisine, blending traditional recipes with contemporary elements and techniques. Using a table d'hôte menu, guests have an element of surprise on a daily basis, pairing meals with local wines or signature cocktails. With views of the Aegean blue sea, Rhodes town in the distance of it, or in a peaceful garden's terrace, the Alazonia restaurant is here to satisfy the senses. Our dress code is important in order to provide a pleasant atmosphere for all our guests. During Dinner time, please refrain from wearing athletic clothing, sport uniforms, or ripped clothing. A smart casual dress code is required for ladies & gentlemen during dinner.

NAME: Moon Spinners Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Keep the Sea to your left from Elounda main Square, we are about 500 meters down on left towards the causeway.

NAME: Tholoto Brunch & Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: «Tholoto» restaurant at Kontohori, Thera, is a cozy place, specially arranged for adults and kids alike.Our menu consists of dishes from the Greek and Mediterranean kitchen, prepared with love and passion from pure local products.

NAME: Thes "Greek Creative Cuisine"
DESCRIPTION: Thes ''Greek Creative Cuisine'' opened it's doors on July of 2019. This was the start for our gastronomic trip. Our mission was and still is to open our "big house", a warm restaurant that serves Greek Creative Cuisine with the best hospitality. The deceptively easy dishes earn their place with the choicest cuts of meat imported from Ireland. The vibe? Grown up, relaxed, playful. The setting? An opulent room you'll feel at home in, only better. In how many places can you get a perfectly cooked rib-eye steak with immaculate flavour, crisp triple cooked chunky chips? Notice the words "perfectly" and "immaculate". No, there are not many restaurants with the courage to deliver a menu based on the very sound theory that less is more; that a good kitchen is much better off cooking steak rather than mucking around with all manner of fashionable, cheffy malarkey. So, we take our hats off to our fantastic team, for helping us bring The Venue Sreakhouse to Barcelona. Come and join us at The Venue where there's always a warm welcome!
