Just to your liking and its fusion cuisine homemade dishes, it proposes paradigmatic creations of its Mediterranean international cuisine, such as baked picaña, chicken seriaki with soy and honey, chicken lasagna, cod pil pil and Portuguese, Sirloin with boletus sauce, squid to the mustard and meat pie with yucca and mozzarella, among others. It also offers shakes and detox juices, desserts such as cupuaçu mousse with galician seaweed gelatine and strawberries, smoothies, detox juices and Amazonian fruit juices.

NAME: Rosi La Loca
DESCRIPTION: Awesome Spanish CRAZY Tapas Bar in the middle of Madrid, good prices, excellent food, for all kind of people. Come and visit us!

NAME: Vegan Temple Bar
DESCRIPTION: We offer a large variety of vegan options so you never have to worry about your diet while visiting Amsterdam. We offer a varied breakfast menu with Vegan Pancake, Vegan Waffles, Vegan English breakfast and more. A wonderful and animal friendly start of the day. For lunch and dinner we offer a variety of Vegan Burgers, Vegan Bowls and Loaded Fries. Also perfect for a late night snack. This all while enjoying a good beer or cocktail. When will we see you?

NAME: Teppanyaki Restaurant Sazanka
DESCRIPTION: Embark on a culinary journey where ancient Japanese traditions meet modern gastronomic delights at Teppanyaki Restaurant Sazanka. Our skilled chefs, under the leadership of Chef de Cuisine Kazuki Onodera, will artfully prepare a variety of meat, fish and vegetarian dishes right before your eyes, using a sizzling hot iron griddle at your table. This dining experience blends tradition and innovation in a delightful ambiance.

NAME: Ku Kitchen & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Ku Kitchen & Bar opened in 2014 and has been a buzzing bar and restaurant ever since. Located on one of the prettiest streets in Amsterdam, the Utrechtsestraat. We have weekly changing specials and classics. Sushi, wagyu burgers and lots of vegetarian options.

NAME: Gartine
DESCRIPTION: In the middle of the busy city centre (close to Spui) of Amsterdam you can enjoy a quiet and delicious breakfast, lunch or high tea at Gartine. We have place for a maximum of twenty-four people. Our products come directly from our own kitchen garden! We support the foundation ‘Adopteer een kip’ and work with organic eggs. On our menu you can find authentic regional products that meet the criteria from the Slow Food organisation.

NAME: Sorel's Bar & Lounge
DESCRIPTION: Discover the “go to” Bourbon bar in the Amsterdam City Centre known for their local partnerships and activities. Enclosed in the Amsterdam Marriott Hotel, Sorel’s Bar & Lounge features an interior and menu inspired by Local crafts, Bourbon & Cocktails. This unique bar experience is strongly influenced by a relationship with local distilleries, sampling their products and co-operating in activities. At Sorel’s Bar & Lounge we are masters of our craft; we offer you the best sandwiches, burgers & local delights with a “bourbonized” twist. Sorel’s is the ideal destination to meet, work, socialize and unwind!

NAME: Day's StoneGrill 1870
DESCRIPTION: DAY'S StoneGrill 1870 is a steakhouse where you can go for lunch and dinner. The pieces of meat come from all over the world, such as Argentina, New Zealand and Canada. The menu specializes in grill dishes as in steaks, burgers and seafood. We also have a lot of vegan options. You can choose a side dish with every entree from DAY'S StoneGrill 1870, such as French fries, rice or vegetables. At DAY'S StoneGrill 1870's bar, all kinds of beer, wines and spirits such as vodka, rum and whiskeys are served. Here you have the option to grill as in 1870. We prepare all meat dishes perfectly from the kitchen and you can grill it at the table. If it's a nice, sunny day, you can enjoy your meal outside on the covered patio.

NAME: Graham's Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: Fine dining chefs tasting menu in a relaxed atmosphere with choice of 3-6 dishes on tue, wed, and Thursday on friday and Saturday 5 or 6 courses. With a european wine list and well thought out matching wines. A very personal touch will make it a night to remember. We have a full vegetarian menu and can cater for most dietary restrictions/allergies but please mention when booking. Thanks. Graham

NAME: Midtown Grill
DESCRIPTION: Expect a fine dining experience in one of Amsterdam's top steakhouse restaurants at Midtown Grill. Our expert chef showcases high-quality cuts of meat from around the world. Must try: the Weekend Brunch!

NAME: Restaurant Mont Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Fine dining restaurant in Amsterdam. Gastronomic French cuisine situated in the city center de Pijp.

NAME: Sherpa Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Sherpa Restaurant, founded in 1989 in Amsterdam, is the first Nepalese and Tibetan restaurant in the Netherlands. We also serve several signature Indian cuisines. Traditional cooking in Nepal, Tibet, and India is an art and requires years of experience. Nepalese cuisine consists of mainly curries and rice and prepared with mild spices and herbs. Similarly, Tibetan dishes consist of various Momos (dumplings) and noodles and prepared mainly with Himalayan herbs. Furthermore, Indian dishes consist of various Curries, Tandoori, Biryani, Naan, and Roti. All our dishes are freshly prepared in order to offer you an authentic taste and freshness. Please don't hesitate to ask us about your special choices.

NAME: Lumbini Indian & Nepalese Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Are you looking for an Indian and Nepalese restaurant in the center of Amsterdam? Then take a look at Lumbini Restaurant! We have always believed that Indian and Nepalese cuisines are all about the fine balance between sweet, sour, Pungent and spicy food. To get this balance right, we have the dishes being prepared by professional chef. We do everything in the proper manner to ensure that you get to experience the authentic appetizers, Tandoori grill and Curries.
REVIEW_TAGS: indian food i have ever had

NAME: De Royal Chophouse
DESCRIPTION: A Quality Steak House and BBQ Grill Restaurant in Amsterdam is a dining establishment that specializes in serving high-quality cuts of beef cooked to perfection on a wood-fired grill. We offer one of the best Lamb chops, Beef Spare Ribs, Japanese Wagyu Fillets, Canadian Fillets, Argentinian Fillets, New-Zealand Fillets The menu features a wide variety of steaks, including filet mignon, as well as a selection of BBQ ribs. The restaurant also offers a variety of side dishes, including sautéed vegetables, mashed potatoes, and mac and cheese, to complement the main courses. The staff is friendly and attentive, and they are happy to make recommendations and help guests choose the perfect steak or BBQ dish. The restaurant is also known for its excellent selection of wines and craft beers. Whether you're in the mood for a classic steak dinner or a hearty BBQ feast, a De Royal Chop House Steaks and BBQ Grill Restaurant in Amsterdam are sure to satisfy you.

NAME: Truffle Boutique
DESCRIPTION: Like the name suggests we serve everything with truffle. Sandwiches, salads and grilled cheese all with fresh shaved black truffle. On Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays we are also open for dinner.

NAME: Restaurant Adam
DESCRIPTION: Having dinner in Adam is a carefree indulgence of surprising dishes in an intimate fine dining restaurant. An evening where everything is as it should be. The warm welcome that instantly makes you feel at home. The culinary dishes, pure and full of flavour. The wine pairing is perfectly in tune with the delicious food combinations.

NAME: Utrechtsedwarstafel
DESCRIPTION: AN EXPERIENCE. Within strolling distance from Theatre Carré there is the stage of Hans Verbeek and Esther van Meerten, the two culinary artists from restaurant Utrechtsedwarstafel. Their performance is a ballet of wine and food. Indulge yourself with the culinary compositions by Esther the Chef and the wines of Sommelier Winemaster Hans. This is the best restaurant dining experience in Amsterdam. An adventurous evening

NAME: Hearth
DESCRIPTION: Plant-based Restaurant- Audio Bar. Contemporary plantbased restaurant presenting playful takes on worldwide traditions and serving them with humor, colours and creativity. In the old houses HEARTH was a fireplace made of stone used for heating and cooking. It was the vital center of the house and its most important feature. Our purpose is to create a warm and creative space where people can hangout and connect. We serve fusion plant-based dishes uniquely created in house by our chef. We host live jazz event and listening session with local and international talents. KITCHEN CLOSES AT 22 WEEKDAYS AND 22:30 WEEKEND

NAME: The Pantry
DESCRIPTION: The Pantry has been in Amsterdam since 2000. A real Amsterdam family business where you can get acquainted with home-made dishes from Dutch cuisine in a cosy, homely atmosphere. Step inside The Pantry restaurant in Amsterdam. Take a seat in our classic Dutch restaurant where enjoyment has no limits. Enjoy traditional, home-made Dutch dishes. Our team welcomes you warmly and hospitably to our restaurant with a homely Dutch atmosphere, filled with Amsterdam friendliness. In our restaurant, we make time for our guests. We can show you where to go in Amsterdam. Ask us for our insider tips! We’ll treat you to a mini-lesson in Dutch. These are useful phrases when ordering a snack and drink during your restaurant visit. • Good day = Goedendag. • How are you? = Hoe gaat het? • Enjoy your meal! = Eet smakelijk! • Thank you = Dank u wel. • Please = Alstublieft. • Good bye = Tot ziens. • Have a nice day = Fijne dag.

NAME: Vermeer
DESCRIPTION: Vermeer Amsterdam is the restaurant of 1* Michelin Chef Chris Naylor. In the kitchen of Vermeer, Chris experiments with the products that he receives from local farmers daily. This results in robust dishes with pure and clean flavours.

NAME: Bistrot des Alpes
DESCRIPTION: A complete Alpine experience and French refined cuisine Decorated like a French Alp chalet, Bistrot des Alpes offers a complete Alpine experience. Chef Thibault prepares typical French Alp dishes and a menu inspired on the French kitchen. You can taste in Bistrot des Alpes the Cheesefondue, Raclette and Tartiflette or our more refined seasonal menu based on the French gastronomie.

NAME: Bollywood Foodbar
DESCRIPTION: Enjoy Your food @ Bollywood as a really Movie Star!! Cozy place with nice ambiance. Furthermore free Parking!

NAME: Restaurant Zaza's
DESCRIPTION: Restaurant Zaza’s, owned by Susie Roche from Ireland, opened its doors in May 2003 in the heart of “De Pijp”, Amsterdam’s Latin Quarter and hot spot for socialising. Susie and her team – Chef Cook Dave, Jasper, Noury, Ijsbrand, Rachael and Marina have a passion for their work and share a love of good food and great service. Zaza’s is a small, intimate restaurant with just 12 tables, serving an International menu of fresh, homemade culinary delights with influences from France, The Mediterranean and Asia which changes with the seasons. The theme “Absolutely Fabulous” (taken from the well-known English comedy series) is about enjoying life to the full and above all having fun. So whether it’s a business dinner, an “Ab Fab” evening to remember, starting with a glass of Champagne (‘Darling!’) or simply relaxing and making yourself at home with a glass of wine…… Zaza’s welcomes you! fabulous darlings!

NAME: The Yeti - Nepali & Indian Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Authentic Nepali and Indian cuisines in Amsterdam city centre. A brand new restaurant with a team of experienced and excellent people in the hospitality business.

NAME: Mondi Amsterdam New-West Caribbean Cuisine
DESCRIPTION: Come and experience the unique fusion of Caribbean and French cuisine, signature cocktails, and live entertainment. Our friendly staff will ensure you have an unforgettable time

NAME: Eastwood Beer & Grill
DESCRIPTION: Have a drink, meal or bite. Whatever you feel like. Be surprised, come and visit us to see how we change our breakfast and lunch restaurant into a more intimate Beer & Grill restaurant. Grilled on our broiler, we serve meat, fish and vegetarian dishes. Straight from the tap or bottle, brewed in Amsterdam or somewhere else, we serve local and international beers matching with the dishes on the menu. Reservations can be made via our website.

NAME: Brasserie SenT
DESCRIPTION: In de keuken van Brasserie SenT staat the big green egg (houtskooloven) centraal. Het vlees is heerlijk mals met een unieke rooksmaak. Daarnaast serveren wij klassieke verse gerechten en goede wijnen per glas tegen scherpe prijzen. Wij spreken onze talen dus graag tot ziens in SenT!

NAME: Bridges
DESCRIPTION: Award-winning restaurant Bridges focuses mainly on fish, with a surprising à la carte and Chef's menu. Chef de Cuisine Raoul Meuwese describes his dishes as "Classic traditional French dishes, but with international influences and a modern twist". A unique feature of Bridges is the Chef’s Table. In the heart of the kitchen, you can take a look behind the scenes with a party up to 6 people and enjoy the magic of the kitchen brigade in the heat of the moment. For private events, Bridges also provides a private dining experience, where you can enjoy an intimate dinner in the comfort of your own private space, with cocktail station and a selection of specialty whiskeys. The private dining is suitable for parties up to 12 people.

NAME: Pesca
DESCRIPTION: Verwacht geen traditioneel restaurant als je de deuren bij Pesca opent. We hebben alle oude regels overboord gegooid: geen menu’s of wit linnen. Het draait bij ons om de ervaring op de vismarkt, als gast participeer je in ons concept en kies jij zelf je vis en bijgerechten uit! Op de vismarkt hebben we een dynamisch prijsbeleid. Gedurende de dag gooien de visverkopers de prijs van de vis omlaag om zo de vis uit te kunnen verkopen. Op deze manier voorkomen wij onnodige verspilling. Het wisselende aanbod op de vismarkt is afhankelijk van de dagelijkse levering, seizoengebonden beschikbaarheid en weersomstandigheden! Welkom bij ons Theatre of Fish! Are you ready for the show?

NAME: Mr. Meat Steakhouse
DESCRIPTION: MR. MEAT I have gained experience in different flavors to make the best. It has been my greatest passion to provide the best to You. While presenting my unique flavors, I also considered your comfort and created delightful places. All you need to do is to just enjoy yourselves! Let's Meat Here!

NAME: Bhatti Pasal
DESCRIPTION: Bhatti Pasal Authentic Nepalese Restaurant in the heart of Amsterdam. Bhatti Pasal is a stone’s throw from Leidseplein, Rembrandtplein, Koningsplein and The Dam Square, serves gratifying authentic Nepalese food. Bhatti Pasal are small eatery in narrow alleyway of Nepal, which serves authentic and delicious Nepalese food. Due to the limited seating in our restaurant, we do not take any reservations, we serve on 1st come 1st serve basis.

NAME: Ashoka - Amsterdam Centrum
DESCRIPTION: Fine Dining with a Refined Concept Serving the finest Indian and Nepalese cuisines since 2013, Ashoka is ranked as the best Indian and Nepalese restaurant in Amsterdam. Our refined service, combined with caring and gracious hospitality, offers soulful Indian and Nepalese cuisines at a fair price in a cozy and beautiful restaurant in the heart of Amsterdam. Enjoy and experience the amazing flavors of India and Nepal in our one-of-a-kind restaurant, housed in a monument warehouse located in the historical heart of the city. Ashoka is just a stone's throw away from Amsterdam Central Station. The famous Dam Square and Amsterdam’s leading department store, De Bijenkorf, are within walking distance – only 600 meters from our doorstep. Visit us and let us surprise you!

NAME: Ciel Bleu Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Soaring above Amsterdam’s rooftops, step into a calm and composed realm of fine dining at Ciel Bleu restaurant. Situated on the 23rd floor of Hotel Okura Amsterdam, Ciel Bleu holds two Michelin stars for its international cuisine led by chefs Onno Kokmeijer and Arjan Speelman. Attentive, amiable staff are on hand to welcome and guide you through the seasonal menus showcasing the creations of Ciel Bleu’s world-class chefs, alongside exclusive vintages from the award-winning wine list. For a rare glimpse into the workings of a two Michelin-starred team, reserve the Chef’s Table overlooking the heart of the kitchen.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Ferdinand Bolstraat 333, Hotel Okura Amsterdam, 1072 LB

NAME: PIQNIQ
DESCRIPTION: PIQNIQ: for your breakfast, lunch & high tea in the Jordaan area in Amsterdam. PIQNIQ refers to a variety of small dishes of which you can choose from, just like a picnic in the country. At PIQNIQ you are invited to choose from our variety of small sweet & savory dishes and enjoying them in our nice natural restaurant..At PIQNIQ we serve breakfast, lunch, coffee and tea with sweet bites, fresh juices, smoothies, a quality glass of wine and cold beers. You can also order for a special treat at the office or to take with you to the park or on your boat tour. Take a look at our website for the different possibilities and the menu. We are closed during the corona crisis ut hope to be open soon. Daily from 09.00 am. till 05:30 pm.

NAME: Bollywood Indian Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Bollywood is Halal Indian Cuisine with bar and is located at very prime location in Amsterdam, You will get an unforgetable experience in our restaurant. We keep it simple and ensure you will treated as a star. Come to Bollywood and Dine Like a Star!

NAME: JuiceBrothers
DESCRIPTION: At JuiceBrothers, our goal is to create quality cold-pressed juice that is nutritious and delicious as hell. Our young and thirsty team makes all juices fresh daily, using a method of cold-pressing that locks in the maximum essential vitamins, minerals and enzymes, and preserves the natural flavors of the produce. Using organic fruits and vegetables, and other natural ingredients, JuiceBrothers creates the tastiest, healthiest recipes. These immunity- boosting, antioxidant-rich, anti-inflammatory blends nourish and promote overall well-being.

NAME: The Seafood Bar
DESCRIPTION: Our location on the Ferdinand Bolstraat is right in the middle of the creative and trendy neighbourhood The Pijp. Take a break from exploring the city and enjoy a bite or one of our fish- or seafood dishes in our restaurant.

NAME: Restaurant Vinkeles
DESCRIPTION: Restaurant Vinkeles is een unieke bestemming in het centrum van Amsterdam. Gevestigd in een verzonken 18e eeuwse bakkerspand is het de perfect locatie om te genieten van het vakmanschap van Jurgen van der Zalm en zijn team. De keuken, vaak omschreven als ‘spannend, bescheiden en verfijnd’, is internationaal van kleur, maar wordt gekenmerkt door Franse kooktechnieken. Restauant Vinkeles is sinds 2023 bekroond met een tweede Michelin Ster.

NAME: Kroegtijger
DESCRIPTION: De Kroegtijger (roughly translated: café tiger/ frequenter of a café) is a traditional Dutch brown café turned modish hangout. Tucked away in the historic heart of Amsterdam, among the city's infamous red-lit windows and Chinese food joints, De Kroegtijger is a warm and welcoming bar with a small-town, unpretentious feel. It's the ideal destination for anyone out on their own, for sharing a drink with close friends, or for celebrating a special occasion. Showcasing unique aspects of local culture, De Kroegtijger serves all your usual favorites, as well as a superb selection of micro brews and indie offerings. Want a next level cocktail? Or an authentic Dutch 'kopstootje'? The owners'll get your drinks flowing, dim the lights and turn up the music!

NAME: Arendsnest Dutch Beer Bar
DESCRIPTION: Did you know there are more than 400 breweries in Holland? In Proeflokaal Arendsnest we only serve beers from Holland. We are proud to say we have 50 beers on draft and more than 100 beers on bottle. In the heart of Amsterdam on Herengracht 90, we have been serving our special Dutch beers for more than 20 years now. Beer lovers from all over the world recognize us for our love and expertise in Dutch beers and our employees love to tell you more. The bar has an intimate settingand also includes a terrace along the canal (Due to new Government corona measures, we have changed our closing hours for the time being. Every day we close the doors at 9 pm and no more guests will be allowed. The guests that are still present can still enjoy their beers but must make sure they have left the bar by 10 pm. We ask for your understanding an co-operation and let's hope we can enjoy a beer together again soon under normal circumstances).

NAME: Dope
DESCRIPTION: A real Italian pizzeria in Amsterdam in one of the most popular neighborhoods 'de Pijp'. Classic, vegan, vegetarian & gourmet pizza.

NAME: Heart-Garden Waffles & Coffee
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Heart-Garden. We serve the best freshly baked waffles of Amsterdam with over 35+ toppings to choose from. We have classic waffles, vegan waffles and even gluten free waffles. See you soon!

NAME: Ava Cyril
DESCRIPTION: Welkom bij Ava Cyril, het Italiaanse restaurant, steak- en pizzarestaurant in het hart van Amsterdam. Met een kleurrijke en gezellige sfeer voelt u zich hier meteen thuis. Onze muren zijn versierd met bankbiljetten uit verschillende landen en bierviltjes met aardige woorden. Geniet van onze specialiteiten, Italiaanse gerechten, steaks en pizza's, terwijl u ontspant onder sfeervolle verlichting. Bij Ava Cyril bieden we u een betaalbare culinaire ervaring in het epicentrum van de Amsterdamse vakantieganger!

NAME: Meat&Greek
DESCRIPTION: What you can expect is, that WE are specialized in the one and only traditional Greek Gyros. Meat&Greek stands for homemade products fresh made on daily bases. Selected suppliers, local fresh ingredients from the highest quality, meat or vegetarian and tasty bread from our Greek artisan baker.

NAME: Sir Hummus
DESCRIPTION: Sir Hummus brings the real Hummus experience to Amsterdam. We serve Hummus in the traditional way – as the main dish, with lush toppings, sides and fresh pita bread. Served just like in streets of Jerusalem - our Hummus is warm, super fresh and fluffy, nothing like the commercial spread you can get at the supermarket. The secret behind our delicious Hummus is sourcing the highest quality ingredients, and a careful 24 hour cooking process. No compromises and no shortcuts.

NAME: Restaurant Semai
DESCRIPTION: Great variety of meals for Vegetarians & Vegans.

NAME: The Good Companion
DESCRIPTION: In the middle of Amsterdam's Jordaan quarter you will come across a cosy seafood restaurant. Seafood with a twist that is... Because we do not only serve a mean classic Fish and Chips (our speciality) but we also offer a variety of mussel dishes, oysters, ceviche and a whole sea bass of high quality and sustainably sourced fish. All dishes that we like to call: Comfort Seafood. To top it all of we serve a whole bunch of unique drinks. Come along for dinner or just have a few drinks with some small fingerfood dishes.

NAME: The Seafood Bar
DESCRIPTION: Our second restaurant was recently renovated and is located in the heart of the city centre of Amsterdam.

NAME: Rob Wigboldus Vishandel
Palmyra Syrian Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Palmyra, nicknamed city of thousand columns , is a Syrian archaeological site located in the government of Syria . We want to give you a taste of our culinary Syrian cusine with real authentic dishes made by our experienced Syrian cook Ibrahim Shamoun

NAME: Omelegg - De Pijp
DESCRIPTION: Highly rated, one of a kind breakfast and lunch spot mainly serving omelettes and egg dishes in Amsterdam.

NAME: Spectrum
DESCRIPTION: Spectrum is an internationally dynamic kitchen with proud Dutch heritage. Chef Sidney Schutte and Restaurant Manager Cas Kratz have the ambition of bring joy, goosebumps and a stillness in time which comes from the sheer appreciation of flavors. Dining at Spectrum is about using your senses, understanding your palate. Our dishes are familiar yet intriguing, curious yet understandable, controversial yet comforting. Spectrum is taking that fascinating sense of taste and subjecting it to the innovation of flavor and texture.

NAME: Nader Grill Steakhouse
DESCRIPTION: Delicious grilled meat and fish

NAME: De Margaritabar
DESCRIPTION: Experience the flavors of Latin America through delicious cocktails and food.

NAME: Restaurant Ambassade
DESCRIPTION: Come in for a delicious breakfast, lunch and/or dinner in our beautiful Restaurant Ambassade - part of the Ambassade Hotel - situated on the Herengracht canal in the center of Amsterdam. Enjoy international cuisine with a French base while being surrounded by colorful paintings from famous CoBrA artists. Or, have a seat on our canal view terrace! At Restaurant Ambassade, the emphasis lies on fresh, seasonal, artisanal, and local products. The kitchen of Restaurant Ambassade offers a delicious and versatile à la carte menu and wine list. The team of Restaurant Ambassade looks forward to welcoming you!

NAME: The Cottage
DESCRIPTION: The Cottage is a cosy little all day pub with a British inspired menu packed with comfort food classics.

NAME: Greenwoods Singel
DESCRIPTION: The first all day breakfast / brunch restaurant in Amsterdam. Founded in September 1988. Greenwoods Singel is proud to be the original destination for all your breakfast, brunch, lunch and tea desires. On our all day menu you’ll find your English breakfast and brunch classics along with some fantastic lunch options. Of course with plenty of vegetarian and vegan dishes to choose from. Don’t forget the traditional English cream tea with freshly made scones. A pure joy! Situated on the Singel canal in a traditional Amsterdam neighborhood close to the Anne Frank House and Dam Square and just up the canal from the Jordaan . The cute outside terrace gives that real Amsterdam vibe where you feel like a local. So enjoy your Full English Breakfast or homemade burger whilst sipping on a homemade drink or coffee. Environmental message : We feel that it is important that Greenwoods does all it can to be as environmentally responsible as possible. To this end we have taken a number of measures

NAME: Grand Cafe 1884
DESCRIPTION: The building in which Grand Café 1884 is located, called "de Zeevaart", has opened its doors in November 2017. The Grand Café / Restaurant with a beautiful terrace overlooking the IJ serves as a meeting place and as a perfect location for lunch, drinks or dinner. We are open 7 days a week. Our visitors mainly mention the excellent cuisine and delicious dishes and the professional and friendly service. Something that we are very proud of and in which we want to continue to exceed ourselves.

NAME: Miri Mary
DESCRIPTION: Unforgettable, innovative Indian brunch, dinner and cocktails in Amsterdam. Come join us for a memorable dining experience.

NAME: Cuddle
DESCRIPTION: Cuddle Pub is located 5 Min walking from Amsterdam Central station, Where you can have the best Cocktails in Amsterdam, We server the cocktails and Food with Passion and high quality. In Cuddle Cocktail Bar, You can enjoy Fajitas, Tacos and Best Hamburger in the center of Amsterdam. You must pop in at Cuddle Pub to get a Cuddle and Enjoy Food, Drinks and Cocktail. You can also request your own Song from our Staff to feel Home and Passionate with Your Food and Drinks. We have wide rage of Beer Selections, Grolsch, Heinehen, La Chouffe, I P A Vedett, and Grembergen from Tap and many other Brands of Beer and Spirits! Eat & Drink & Cocktails & Enjoy Nice Music with Cuddle

NAME: Jaspers
DESCRIPTION: Franse/Internationale keuken van dinsdag tot zaterdag geopend in de avond. Drie gangen menu, uit te breiden tot zeven gangen. Met zo gewenst bij passend wijnen. French/International kitchen, open from tuesday till saturday evening. Three course menu, up to zeven courses. Pairing wines available.

NAME: Staring at Jacob
DESCRIPTION: Cozy neighbourhood cafe serving original American brunch. Nice sunny terrace.

NAME: Sizz - Indian Cuisine
DESCRIPTION: We at Sizz are delighted to bring an authentic Indian experience to you. The concept of SIZZ is suitable for every occasion. A dinner for two, with a small group of friends, with colleagues or with family? Choose a comfortable place in the restaurant with a view of the open kitchen and see where it all happens.

NAME: Restaurant Verena
DESCRIPTION: A nice and cosy restaurant that serves authentic Italian Cuisine. It is a family business and it serves fresh and home-made products.

NAME: The Chupitos Club
DESCRIPTION: The Chupitos Club in Amsterdam’s buzzing hub is the perfect place to eat, drink and dance until deep in the morning. Create dazzling magical moments with your party rock crew and enjoy a full night out with a concatenation filled with unique experiences without missing a single shot! Enter the extravagant world of The Chupitos Club

NAME: Pastai
DESCRIPTION: Love Live Eat! Traditional and contemporary Italian food. Every month new seasonal dish on the menù.

NAME: Senses Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Senses is een fine dining restaurant voor fijnproevers in het centrum van Amsterdam waar chef-kok Renaud Goigoux, souschefs Joonas Karjalainen en Daniel Matei hun inspiratie en creativiteit in een chef's menu creëren, geïnspireerd door de Japanse keuken, Nederlandse seizoen producten met een Franse flair. Het team streeft ernaar hun ecologische voetafdruk te verminderen door producten per fiets te laten bezorgen, voedselverspilling en het gebruik van plastic tegen te gaan, te recyclen, te werken met duurzame producten en zich te richten op meer plantaardige opties. Door het selecteren van de beste seizoens- en duurzame producten uit de Noordzee en Nederlandse bodem, met een focus op groenten en zeevruchten, streeft het team ernaar de beste kwaliteit van eten en service aan hun gasten te bieden met de bedoeling bewustzijn te creëren over duurzaamheid. Maak een keuze uit het wisselende 3 tot 6 gangen Chefs menu. Laat je leiden door de vijf zintuigen en ga op ontdekkingsreis.

NAME: Sefa Grill Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Turkish Restaurant. Halal Home Made

NAME: Frens Haringhandel
DESCRIPTION: Frens Haringhandel is one of the remaining traditional Fish shops in the centre of Amsterdam. You can try the famous Dutch Herring or a broad selection of other traditional dishes with us. Find us at Koningsplein, near the Flower market and the shopping area "Kalverstraat" and "Kalvertoren".
GENERAL_LOCATION: Singel t/o 468, Koningsplein (near Flower Market), 1017 AW

NAME: Onze Zaak Amsterdam
DESCRIPTION: In het mooiste steegje van Amsterdam vind je Onze Zaak. Een nieuw restaurant waar je vanaf 12:00 terecht kan voor een fijne lunch, een hapje en een drankje met zon rond borreluur en een spetterend diner of bruisende borrel aan onze prachtige bar.

NAME: Serre
DESCRIPTION: Serre restaurant offers a versatile culinary experience within the hotel. Whether it’s a morning coffee, a delightful lunch or a leisurely dinner, Serre welcomes you throughout the day. The charming summer terrace offers the perfect backdrop for outdoor dining and afternoon beverages. Led by Chef Bram Postel, Serre proudly holds a Michelin Bib Gourmand, a testament to its commitment to offering high-quality cuisine at moderate prices.

NAME: Taj Indian
DESCRIPTION: Gespecialiceerd in Noord-Indiaas keuken met Tandoori oven, curry, vegatarisch, birriani's en speciaal brood uit klei-oven. Ook hebben wij speciaale toetjes en dranken.

NAME: Blue Pepper Restaurant And Candlelight Cruises
DESCRIPTION: Royal Indonesian Rijsttafels and Candlelight Dinner Cruises for food connoisseurs and business groups of up to 200 guests.

NAME: Greenwoods Keizersgracht
DESCRIPTION: Greenwoods is Amsterdams original all day breakfast / brunch and lunchroom, founded in 1988 and still leading the pack. You can find us just off Leidsestraat – near the flower market at Keizersgracht 465. Serving classic dishes all day – proper full English, authentic eggs benedict on muffins, vegetarian breakfast, salmon royale, shakshuka, our big breakfast burger and American pancake breakfast. As well as many other great and unique dishes. Vegan – Vegetarian – Gluten free – Lactose intolerant – we do all we can to make sure we have something for everyone. There are no walls at Miss T’s Kitchen—just a roof held up by tree-like posts decorated with red fairy lights. “No walls” describes the real Miss T, too.
