Catch the most stunning sunset views in Jamaica and relax to the sights of Seven Mile Beach in the distance. Our guests love our farm-to-table food concept, and we are proud to maintain our popularity. Our chefs prepare a wide variety of fresh and local dishes, from the traditional Caribbean to seafood, steak, pizza, international and vegetarian cuisine. We cater to dietary preferences of all sorts and look forward to accommodating your specific needs. We are open daily from 7 am until 9 pm, serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Happy hour is daily, when the sun illuminates the sky for sunset, between 5 – 6 pm.

NAME: Ciao Jamaica
DESCRIPTION: Casual fine dining restaurant in Negril, Jamaica featuring Italian Cuisine with Jamaican/Caribbean influence, also offering authentic thin-crust stone fired Pizza for delivery, take out or dining. Free hotel pickup and return. Open Tuesday-Sunday 2:00 PM until 10:00 PM. (closed Mondays)

NAME: Bushbar
DESCRIPTION: Breakfast/brunch, Lunch, And Dinner

NAME: PG’S Toscanini Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: PG’S Toscanini Restaurant, is pretty much a continuation of the well known Toscanini Italian Restaurant which was closed in May 2019. We open here at our new location in October 2019, with Chef PG, former chef of Toscanini and the whole compliment staff. We still offers Italian/Mediterranean Cuisine with our own touch of Jamaican flavour. Homemade Pappardelle Fettuccine Pastas, Focaccia Bread, Herb and Garlic Butter, Soup, Sauces and desserts, Tiramisu, Profiteroles, Chocolate Sauce, Bomba Gelato and Crepe. Fresh Fish, Lobster and Crab straight from the sea. Great Wine Selection from across the World to choose from. Vegetarian and vegan dishes are available. A Comfortable, Spacious, Relaxing Atmosphere with Professional, Courteous Staffs awaits you. WELCOME TO PG'S TOSCANINI RESTAURANT.

NAME: Tacbar
DESCRIPTION: A fusion of Mexican, Caribbean food and lifestyle at the historic Devon House nestled in the heart of Kingston.

NAME: Just Natural
DESCRIPTION: Just Natural is a picturesque family owned and operated vegetarian restaurant which had been located on the West End Road in Negril since 1998 and has recently relocated near the lighthouse on Hylton Avenue. A lush tropical garden surrounds you as you enjoy your meal. All plants were meticulously planted by their father when the restaurant originated. Light jazz is played throughout the restaurant. Just Natural serves vegetarian and seafood dishes and Ital food (Rastafarian friendly). Theresa says that the house specialties are "Jamaican breakfasts and French toast for breakfast, tuna melts, veggie burgers and conch salad for lunch and grilled lobster and vegetarian lasagna in the evening." Just Natural often host weddings on the premises. OPEN 7 DAYS A WEEK!! Monday to Saturday 8am - 9pm Sunday 8am - 8:30pm

NAME: Jack Sprat
DESCRIPTION: Jack Sprat is a restaurant that’s really about community—it’s where the village comes to hang out. It’s considered the headquarters of eating and drinking in Treasure Beach. And the jerk crab is off the charts.

NAME: Quality's Sea Breeze Restaurant and Bar
DESCRIPTION: Located across from Mary's Bay on Negril's West End, Quality's Sea Breeze Restaurant and Bar is the place for authentic Jamaican cuisine! Specializing in seafood, Sea Breeze will give you the true taste of Jamaica! Their menu consists of breakfast, lunch and dinner. Our roadside bar is a great place to people watch, grab a cold drink and enjoy an easy and relaxing afternoon or evening!

NAME: Coletta's Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Small restaurant across the street from Rooms on the Beach.

NAME: Bourbon Beach Jamaica
DESCRIPTION: Hotel, Bar & Restaurant where you can relax, enjoy one of the best sunsets in the world, have an ice cold drink & listen to some great music 7 nights a week, all on the beach! (Monday, Thursday & Saturday are live reggae and we have a DJ the other 4 nights playing a variety of music)

NAME: Flag City
DESCRIPTION: Best Spot on 7 mile beach for all your needs. Beautiful people, Delicious Fresh local catch grilled to your liking and plenty of Cold Red Stripe!! Water sports booked right here too. This is the chill place to be in Negril!

NAME: Evita's Italian Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Set in an authentic 1860 Historic Gingerbread House, overlooking Ocho Rios, Evita's opened in 1989 and has established a reputation for great service, ambiance, decor, view and excellent Italian and Jam-Italian 'fun' creations. All food is cooked to order. Celebrities keep frequenting Evita's as they really enjoy it's romantic atmosphere and, also appreciate, 'value for money'....Occasionally there is live entertainment, usually, a 'guest star' appearance.

NAME: Canoe Bar
DESCRIPTION: Live entertainment every Monday and Thursday evening duringf season!!! Great happy hour 4-6pm with lots of 2 for 1 drink specials! Candlelit dinner on the sea! Great breakfast- try the canoe eggs and the caremleized banana french toast! Excellent snorkeling!

NAME: Pablo's Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Open 7am to 10pm Real Jamaican fresh Come and be treated like family. The fried chicken leaves you happy.

NAME: Sharkies Seafood Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Beachside restaurant with a casual relaxing atmosphere, a hit with locals and tourists as well. The most popular restaurant on the north coast.

NAME: Pier - 1 On The Waterfront
DESCRIPTION: Pier 1 is Montego Bay's most pulsating open-air Seafood Restaurant, Bar and Entertainment Center that has been in operation since 1986. It is located on a picturesque peninsula in the heart of the bay allowing diners the perfect view for watching the cruise liners disappear into a brilliant sunset. Our restaurant is well known for its fusion of the intoxicating Jamaican Flavors by offering a wide variety of seafood dishes including the Pier 1 Lobster, our famous Coconut Shrimp and the Grilled Mahi-Mahi to name a few. For the lovers of the land, our menu captures the best of the Jamaican cuisine. From our perfectly Grilled Beef Tenderloin to the island favorite of Braised Oxtail, our vast menu has something for everyone. Like with our dishes, our four signature nights have found a way to fuse Jamaicans and Visitors by offering a unique entertainment package. Star Struck Wednesday Pier Pressure (Friday Night Party) Seafood Sunday- Grooving on the Pier Karaoke Mondays

NAME: Shark's
DESCRIPTION: Small family-run restaurant, Shark, the dad, his wife and two little boys.

NAME: The Best in the West
DESCRIPTION: Jamaican restaurant and bar that is famous for its jerk chicken and a wide variety of seafood and other local meals. Great place to eat with a relaxing ambiance, great food, great music and great people.

NAME: Red Dragon
DESCRIPTION: Great local place. Best Jerk Pork in town. Highly recommended. This should definately be listed!

NAME: Rick's Cafe
DESCRIPTION: OUR STORY BEGINS with the opening of Rick's Cafe by its founder, Richard Hershman, in April 1974. At the time, Negril was a sleepy fishing village with little development. It lacked many modern amenities such as electricity, telephone and hot running water. Our beautiful little cliffside location was originally owned by a local doctor, the son of the first Governor General of independent Jamaica. RICK’S CAFE was the first public bar and restaurant of its type on the West End Cliffs, offering an alternative to Negril's majestic seven mile beach. From the beginning, Rick's Cafe boasted an unrivaled view of the sunset from its naturally formed cliffs. Over the years, visitors and locals alike have designated Rick's Cafe as Negril's premier gathering spot and our sunsets have become a Jamaican tradition.

NAME: EITS Cafe
DESCRIPTION: An exquisite dining experience awaits you. Located at 17 Mile Post, Newcastle in the hills above Irish Town,just two miles above Strawberry Hill and below the Blue and John Crow Mountains and Holywell National Park, Jamaica is EITS "Europe in the Summer" Restaurant and Cafe. EITS provides you with a diverse and outstanding fusion of Jamaican and European cuisine to please every palate.From the farm to the fork . EITS incorporates Produce, Salad Greens and Herbs from the Food Basket Farm into all delectable dishes.The scent of freshly brewed Blue Mountain coffee tickles the senses and you can't resist the temptation for a one of a kind coffee based beverage with a homemade authentic Jamaican dessert to complete the meal.Dining at EITS is a truly memorable experience that will leave your taste buds craving for more....

NAME: Jimmy Buffett's Margaritaville Ocho Rios
DESCRIPTION: Where it’s always 5 O’Clock Roll down the cruise ship pier of Jamaica’s northeastern shore to the welcoming Margaritaville Ocho Rios located in Island Village. Feel the rhythm of the island wash over you as you enter the pulse of Ochi’s vibrant beachside day life and electric nightlife. Caribbean flavors and American favorites paired with drinks that flow just as freely as Dunn’s River Falls. Sun-drenched outdoor spaces and friendly faces at every turn. Banging beats and bars with in-pool seats. Here, the hardest choice you’ll have is where to stretch out with a cold one. Chill out at our swim-up bar, soar above the main bar from our 60-foot waterslide or get down in the white sand at our all-day beach party. From intimate drinks for two to 2 am shots with the crew, at Margaritaville Ocho Rios in Island Village, it’s always 5 o’clock.

NAME: Marguerites
DESCRIPTION: An elegant and sophisticated 5-star, dining experience on the edge of the Caribbean Sea, specializing in an assortment of fine wines and fresh seafood,creatively prepared.

NAME: Vinne's Bar N Grill
DESCRIPTION: The best jerk chicken in negril we serve goat porc fish lobster n chicken good price good food

NAME: Round Hill Dining
DESCRIPTION: Dining options at Round Hill include The Grill, Seaside Terrace, and the Ralph Lauren Cocktail Bar, complimentary AfternoonTea as well as private in-villa dining. Guests may also enjoy light snacks and refreshments beachside at the Beach and Pool Bars. Guests who book a complete villa can enjoy meals catered and served by their personal villa staff. Under the helm of Chef Martin Maginley, the modern Caribbean cuisine-inspired menus showcase the freshest ingredients sourced from the resort’s newly-expanded organic garden to create dishes such as the classic Oxtail Ravioli with Caribbean Lobster Ragout and Appleton Rum Cream Sauce. New, creative menu items focus on the authentic, exotic flavours of Jamaica. Children menus are available.

NAME: Wilkes Cuisine Seafood Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: We are small and unique, we cater for all your needs.We do functions weddings,banquet you name it, we also do fruits and Vegetable carvings. Cocktails, lunch, dinner after dinner drink, Our capacity maximum 40 seated. We offer Live cooking show. Free Cooking lessons with Chef Nigel, Place to dine Sea View area, Bar View or back View. Wilkes is the place to dine we offer local and international cuisine. Italian cuisine.. Caribbean cuisine. American Cuisine . cake and pastry. Coffee and tea..

NAME: Zimbali's Mountain Cooking Studio
DESCRIPTION: FOODIES- Rise Up -This Tour is for you! Zimbali's "Farm to Table" Cooking Show is more than a Meal- it's an Experience! Only 30 minutes from Negril, this 5 Star Retreat + Organic Farm is one of the most unique places in Jamaica. Tour the Farm, then Return to the specially designed Cooking Studio for an Authentic Demonstration using the Foods & Fruits of the Season. We offer our Dinner Show Monday- Saturday at 5pm. The 5 Course Dinner is $105/prsn and includes: Welcome Drink, Farm Tour, 5 course meal + bottle of wine/ couple. We also offer roundtrip transport from your hotel in Negril for +$20/prsn. Pickup time is 4pm. Wednesday & Friday we also have our African drummers perform- a real touch of Culture ;) Enjoy dishes such as: fish, shrimp, chicken; Vegan/vegetarian, Gluten free are welcome. Reservations are Mandatory as space is limited. Zimbali Requires a deposit for parties of 6 or more; we accept Visa/Mastercard, or Paypal. Dress casual w/ comfortable shoes for the farm

NAME: Belinda's
DESCRIPTION: This lady is an institution. She has a barbecue on the bank of the Rio Grande river at Port Antonio. You can only reach it by bamboo raft! I'm serious. You can google Belinda's Rio Grande Port Antonio and it will come up. This lady cooks the greatest spicy crayfish and fried chicken ever. Look at my profile- I've eaten all around the world, I'm not joking. I ate their today and it broke my heart to see other tourists rafting by and not taking their lunch there because they didn't know about it. This lady needs a break and Tripadvisor can help. Not out of sympathy, but just great food

NAME: Christopher's
DESCRIPTION: At Christopher's we don't just feed appetites - we feed souls. Our signature restaurant serves up locally sourced gourmet fare on an open-air veranda with ocean-view tables.Christopher's acclaimed Chef Conroy specializes in original dishes that capture the essence of Jamaica: callaloo with Scotch bonnet drizzle, pimento-smoked beef tenderloin, translucent plantain chips, curried goat ravioli and, of course, grilled lobster. Conroy's dishes embrace the freshest local ingredients and the bounty of the Caribbean. You can watch local fishing boats deliver the catch of the day or join the chef in selecting fruits, vegetables and herbs from the resort's lush gardens. Start your day with our Island Breakfast - handmade muffins and a succulent fruit plate. In the evening dress up or down for a dining experience called "by far one of the best that the island has to offer."

NAME: The Boardwalk Village Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: The Boardwalk Village is Negril's newest attraction located on our world famous seven mile white sand beach.This beach front Jamaican shopping village boasts newly added rooms, lobster grill, shops and a restaurant with two dining rooms, two bars, and a boardwalk patio perfect location to grab one of our many delicious drinks and to soak up the sun.Guests at The Boardwalk Village have access to our beach area and water trampoline. Other water sports activities are also available.

NAME: Pepper's Jerk Center
DESCRIPTION: Jerk chicken

NAME: Le Vendome
DESCRIPTION: We pride ourselves with the quality of our products, producing everything from our breads, pizzas, pastries, ice creams, fresh fruit sorbets, salad dressing, fish fingers, hamburgers etc. Using only the freshest and finest quality goods, vegetables and fruits from our very own farm, no additives or artificial coloring, as we are as concerned about our guests health as our own (we eat here every day). Our meals are a blend of Jamaican and French cuisine representing the nationalities of the owners. Alongside our diverse “a la carte menu”, we prepare a daily house special “five course gourmet menu” in which we truly experiment, using fresh Jamaican products prepared with a French flair and a dash of Jamaican spice. Our restaurant Le Vendome has received great recognition from both locals and Internationally discerning diners. Again our staff are constantly praised for their caring and attentive services and engaging smiles, garnering a reputation for quality in both cuisine and service.

NAME: Indies 957
DESCRIPTION: Informal beach dining with views of the ocean. Breakfast, lunch & dinner served. Jamaican and international cuisine with complete wine list.

NAME: Rocky Mountain Flatbread Main Street
DESCRIPTION: We are an award winning casual family restaurant serving house made soups, salads, flatbread pizzas, pastas & desserts to live for. Our restaurant is nut free and we all of our dishes do have gluten wise options. We are open for brunch, lunch and dinner daily. We are proud to use lots of local produce, Ocean Wise seafood & local free range meats.

NAME: Alouette Bistro
DESCRIPTION: Fabulous, Fun, French Bistro in the heart of Downtown Vancouver. Offering French Breakfast, Brunch, Lunch, Happy Hour and Dinner, 7 days a week.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 567 Hornby St, in the Hotel Le Soleil, V6C 2E8

NAME: Teahouse in Stanley Park
DESCRIPTION: The Teahouse Restaurant is located at Ferguson Point in Stanley Park. The stunning views at this romantic spot, has earned The Teahouse the title of ‘Best Sunset in the City’. Along with the scenery, Teahouse offers delicious, West Coast cuisine using fresh, local ingredients. A scenic drive into Stanley Park, brings you to Ferguson Point. Stop in for a bite to eat, enjoy a glass of wine and indulge in the longest sunset in the city.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 7501 Stanley Park Dr, Stanley Park, V6G 3E2

NAME: Hydra Estiatorio Mediterranean
DESCRIPTION: Located in the EXchange Tower atrium, Hydra offers quality Mediterranean dishes such as salt baked whole fish, vine ripened tomato salad and lamb chops served straight from the grill. Hydra Estiatorio will deliver you to the sun-kissed hills and aquamarine waters of Greece. The stylish ambiance of this space is perfect to enjoy throughout the day and in to the evening, ideal for groups. Hydra offers a friendly, fine dining service experience. Join us!

NAME: Seaside Provisions
DESCRIPTION: A place for friends to share the very best of the coast: Small plate tapas and regional creations, sourced locally and perfected for your table, morning meals and midday brunches of enduring quality, bespoke cocktails of enduring style and substance, and excellent company into the late hours of the night. Warm, welcoming, and full of energy from open to close.

NAME: Marcello Pizzeria
DESCRIPTION: Serving the community since 1999. Marcello's is the best choice for an authentic Italian experience. We combine old world Mediterranean warmth and sunny decor with an inviting atmosphere that appeals to everyone. Owner and chef Marcello Lombardo has a love of Italian food and a pedigree to match. Born in Palermo, Marcello owned a restaurant on the Adriatic Riviera before moving to Vancouver in 1983, where he's been serving authentic classic Italian dishes and wood burning oven pizzas for more than 30 years. Our famous Neapolitan style wood burning oven is the face of the Sun God of the Mediterranean - a symbol of prosperity. It is the show piece of our restaurant and the place where our delicious pizzas come to life. We are famous for our handmade gnocchi. Our pastas and sauces are also made fresh daily. We recommend you try our fried calamari, our Palermo by night pizza or our four cheese handmade gnocchi. Have a drink. Order a meal. And enjoy life like an Italian.

NAME: Fanny Bay Oyster Bar & Shellfish Market
DESCRIPTION: Fanny Bay Oyster Bar & Shellfish Market is in the heart of Vancouver's stadium district. We bring the freshest shellfish from our farms directly to the table, along side other sustainable seafood. We are perfect for pre and post game/concert drinks and food, an amazing seafood dinner, or bringing something home from our retail section. Come in and enjoy a plate of perfectly shucked oyster.

NAME: The Sandbar Seafood Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: The Sandbar Seafood Restaurant is located in Granville Island beside the Public Market. Their unique patio is under the Granville Street Bridge, overlooking False Creek. Enjoy sushi from Chef Hoshi’s Sushi Bar, open all week from 5:00pm onwards. Nightly, The Sandbar offers live music in the lounge. Featuring a variety of local brew, the Sandbar is an exciting place to listen to live music, enjoy fresh tapas and meet great people.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 1535 Johnston Street, Creekhouse #102, Granville Island, V6H 3R9

NAME: Sula Indian Restaurant, Commercial Drive
DESCRIPTION: 'Award winning Indian restaurant in Vancouver, BC. At Sula Indian restaurant, we serve authentic Indian food prepared using traditional methods of cooking. We are about staple Indian curries, tandoori breads and Indian rice preparations served in an Indian inspired indoor garden style seating.

NAME: Glowbal
DESCRIPTION: A Vancouver institution celebrating 20 years. Glowbal is one of the most popular West Coast, Steak and Seafood restaurants in city. Outstanding food paired with a great atmosphere, a comfortable setting and memorable service, after all this time, we have remained true to our roots by treating you as a welcomed guest in our home.

NAME: AnnaLena
DESCRIPTION: AnnaLena is a Tasting Menu focused restaurant located steps from Kitsilano Beach and a short walk from Downtown Vancouver, British Columbia. The restaurant was opened by Chef Michael Robbins and Operations Manager Jeff Parr in 2015. Awarded as one of En Route’s Top 10 New Restaurants in its opening year and consistently named as one of Canada’s Top 100 Restaurants, AnnaLena continues to grow and evolve. In June 2020 the restaurant decided to focus exclusively on offering a multi-course set Tasting Menu, focusing on seasonal local farms and suppliers, highlighted by thoughtful wine pairings and unique cocktails. We currently offer seating in the dining room and at the bar. Bookings become available 30 days in advance online through Resy. Please contact the restaurant directly through phone or email with any dietary requests before making your booking. We are unable to make any menu accommodations within 48 hours. We look forward to having you in for dinner.

NAME: Five Sails Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: The Five Sails offers award winning cuisine & personalized service in this spectacular waterfront setting. Our award winning culinary team offers their take on modern classics with European influences in an elegant, upscale fine dining room set against the natural backdrop of Vancouver's inner harbour with breathtaking views of the local mountains, Stanley Park and Lions Gate bridge. Experience our seasonal a la carte menu with the option to include Sommelier, Ramon Fresneda's selected pairing of wines to best complement the menu. The Five Sails Team is honoured to be recognized with the 2018 Les Clefs d'Or Silver Service Award voted by Vancouver's concierges as their favourite restaurant to recommend to their guests! Level R - Pan Pacific Hotel @ Canada Place
GENERAL_LOCATION: 999 Canada Place, Level R - Pan Pacific Hotel, V6C 3E1

NAME: Blue Water Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Blue Water Cafe is Vancouver's definitive destination for seafood, widely known for its excellence in celebrating the extraordinary flavours of BC. Consistently awarded "Best Seafood Restaurant" in Vancouver and recognized for its unparalleled service, an evening at Blue Water Cafe is truly an unforgettable experience.

NAME: Cardero's Restaurant & Live Bait Marine Pub
DESCRIPTION: Cardero’s Restaurant in Coal Harbour offers spectacular waterfront dining right in the marina. Enjoy tasty wok dishes to share, fresh seafood, an extensive wine list, and much more. You can dine and watch as their talented kitchen team prepares your food from their open kitchen. The Live Bait Marine Pub features live music Sunday through Thursday from 9:00pm, a great place to grab a bite and pint and enjoy some tunes with friends!

NAME: Miku
DESCRIPTION: Miku Vancouver, a Michelin Guide Recommended restaurant, specializes in Aburi, or flamed-seared, sushi, which was developed nearly a century ago in Japan. The act of applying fire directly to sushi enhances the natural flavors and textures of the fish, creating a new and exciting culinary experience. Miku owner Seigo Nakamura innovated the Aburi concept by crafting specialty sauces using non-traditional Japanese ingredients to pair with each type of fish. The light sear from the binchotan (Japanese bamboo charcoal) caramelizes the sauce, releasing a smoky aroma and bringing out the finest flavors in each piece of Aburi sushi. Miku Restaurant is within walking distance from the Pan Pacific Hotel, Canada Place, Fly Over Canada, Cruise Ship Terminals, and Sea Bus.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 70-200 Granville St, Corner of Canada Place and Howe St, V6C 1S4

NAME: Black + Blue
DESCRIPTION: Black & Blue emanates luxury and sophistication. The Golden Age of hospitality-from juicy steaks to tableside Caesar salads combined with gracious & crisp service. Be prepared to enjoy a classic cocktail, peruse the notable wine list and bask in the sumptuous decor. A striking Himalayan Rock Salt "Wall" houses an extensive selection of prime cuts available from Wagyu to US & Canadian Prime. Join us for lunch, happy hour and dinner.

NAME: Atlas Steak + Fish
DESCRIPTION: ATLAS steak + fish is a flirtatious and modern twist on the iconic North American steakhouse. Sip and savor in our warm and casually elegant ambiance as we serve you with our stylish approach to hospitality and remarkable cuisine. Selecting the finest ingredients, exploring global flavors, showcasing unique cooking techniques, and engaging table-side service are all elements that speak to our commitment in crafting a truly distinctive dining encounter.

NAME: Lupo Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Modern Italian cooking emphasizing quality and value. Lupo Restaurant located at the entrance to Vancouver’s famous Yaletown area. Theatres, Concert and sporting venues all within a short walk.

NAME: Freshslice Pizza
DESCRIPTION: Freshslice Pizza Granville location is conveniently situated on Granville Street between West Broadway and West 8th Avenue. We are only a 5-minute walk from the Granville Loop Park and a 13-minute walk to the False Creek Community of Granville Island. We are located near many coffee shops, financial institutions, and public transit stops.

NAME: Fable Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: Local food brought in daily and prepared fresh for service. Defining Canadian cuisine.

NAME: Bacchus Restaurant & Lounge
DESCRIPTION: Dear Valued Traveler, At Bacchus Restaurant & Lounge, we are practising Thoughtfulness, Kindness & Mindfulness. We are also applying guidelines and recommendations from the Government of British Columbia that include increased levels of sanitizing throughout the property; physical distancing; masks, gloves & temperature monitoring of employees; continuous training & education for employess and more. Do not hesitate to reach out to me personally to further discuss our protocols.

NAME: Cora Breakfast & Lunch
DESCRIPTION: Visit our 25 seat curbside patio (seasonal), private courtyard patio (seasonal), or 16 seat heated year round patio! Cora Robson serves amazing breakfasts and lunches in a warm and family atmosphere with 158 seats inside! Choose from a wide selection of eggs, crêpes, pancakes, waffles or French toast dishes with mountains of fresh fruit. Reservations accepted on weekdays, first come first served on holidays and weekends.

NAME: Italian Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: Old World charm with a new world vibe. Italian Kitchen is a restaurant that specializes in fresh simple ingredients & daily hand made pasta-creating the ultimate in creative and classic Italian cuisine. There is no better way to cement a friendship or conclude a day then by having great food, wine & service. Join us for lunch, happy hour, dinner, after work cocktails and brunch on weekends.

NAME: Salmon n' Bannock Bistro
DESCRIPTION: We are Vancouver's only Indigenous restaurant. We specialize in wild fish, free range game meat and of course bannock, freshly baked daily. We use traditional ingredients that we prepare and present in a modern way. In our small casual bistro everyone is welcome as they are. In the spirit of First Nations' traditions, our intention is to provide a gathering place where the focus is on the people and the food. Please be aware that we love celebrating the seasons, so our menu changes regularly and without notice. Inez (Nuxalk Nation), Owner.

NAME: Parker Rooftop
DESCRIPTION: Your new favorite rooftop destination in Vancouver. Perched 120 feet above the city, offering fabulous beverages and international bites.

NAME: Seasons in the Park
DESCRIPTION: Poised in Queen Elizabeth Park at the highest point in the city, and overlooking the exquisite quarry gardens, Seasons in the Park Restaurant is a local landmark in a class of its own, having set the standard for distinctive regional cuisine and exceptional service in Vancouver for almost 20 years. Centrally located and just a 10-minute drive from the Vancouver International Airport and Vancouver’s downtown core, this glass-wrapped restaurant features stunning views of Vancouver’s shimmering city skyline, the North Shore Mountains and Pacific Ocean. With innovative, seasonal dishes, the menu highlights West Coast and Pacific Rim influences and delivers clean, fresh, simple dishes. For private events Seasons in the Park offers four unique rooms, each boasting unparalleled views. Seasons in the Park is the quintessential Vancouver dining experience; simply the very best the Pacific Northwest has to offer.
GENERAL_LOCATION: West 33rd Avenue & Cambie Street, Queen Elizabeth Park, V5Y 2M5

NAME: Joe Fortes Seafood & Chop House
DESCRIPTION: In keeping with the reputation of the man whose name we adopted, Joe Fortes Seafood & Chop House has achieved legendary status in Vancouver. For 34 years, Joe Fortes has consistently earned and maintained its reputation as an award-winning Vancouver restaurant. Guests from the world over have come to expect a dynamic culinary experience in this San Francisco styled seafood grill that always delivers more - more hospitality, more variety and more buzz. This iconic Vancouver restaurant is conveniently located just off of bustling Robson Street. Joe Fortes is where locals and visitors alike come to enjoy the food in town, complemented by an award-winning wine list that boasts over 300 wines, and a uniquely personal level of service and hospitality. Quality, service and reputation - that's the stuff that we are made of. And that's what you can look forward to experiencing on each and every visit to Joe Fortes Seafood & Chop House. We look forward to serving you.

NAME: The Keg Steakhouse + Bar - Alberni
DESCRIPTION: Whether you're dining around our table or yours, make every occasion a special one. Visit our website to book your table or order takeout online.

NAME: Forage
DESCRIPTION: forage connects diners to local fishers, foragers and farmers. We offer the best in local craft distilleries, breweries and wineries. Our service is designed for sharing many plates family style. So choose as many as you like, share some delicious food, and enjoy the best of what BC has to offer.

NAME: Ancora Waterfront Dining and Patio - False Creek
Gotham Steakhouse & Cocktail Bar
DESCRIPTION: An American style steakhouse and cocktail bar featuring tender steaks and stiff drinks. Gotham features soaring ceilings, sumptuous leather and velvet upholstery, private dining rooms, an award-winning wine list and exceptional service.

NAME: The Keg Steakhouse + Bar - Dunsmuir
DESCRIPTION: Whether you're dining around our table or yours, make every occasion a special one. Visit our website to book your table or order takeout online.

NAME: L'Abattoir Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: L'Abattoir is located in the center of Gastown between historic Gaoler's Mews and Blood Alley. The restaurant was built in the 19th century and is the site of Vancouver's first jail. Originally buttressed to the city's main butchery and meat packing district, the name L'Abattoir pays homage to the neighbourhood's colourful past. Chef/Owner Lee Cooper is dedicated to highlighting the finer points of eating and drinking in L'Abattoir's informed but informal setting, with his French-inspired Pacific North West fare. L'Abattoir is open daily for dinner with weekend brunch every Saturday & Sunday.

NAME: SURA Korean Cuisine
DESCRIPTION: Sura Korean Royal Cuisine Restaurant Vancouver Located in the heart of Downtown Vancouver, find the award-winning Korean restaurant, SURA. Glimpse into the true culinary art of Korean Royal Cuisine, SURA has been delivering excellent Korean dining experience to connoisseurs of great food in Vancouver since 2008. While appreciating the interior that weaves a modern aesthetic through Korean traditional atmosphere, you can expect the fineness of sophisticated authentic yet contemporary Korean cuisine by our master chef Sang-jo Han. SURA is moving into its sixth year with a flourish: the restaurant has received its third Vancouver Restaurant Awards from Vancouver Magazine and reviews continue to extol its delights. Our commitment to authentic Korean Royal Cuisine makes SURA the ideal dining destination for Vancouverites and visitors alike and our attentive staff will ensure that your event is memorable. You will enjoy what the best korean restaurant in Vancouver has to offer.

NAME: Cockney Kings Fish & Chips (Burnaby)
DESCRIPTION: Cockney Kings is a family owned and operated restaurant serving the community with brilliant fish and chips since 1965! When you dine here, you're not just a customer, you're family! We know fish and chips. Thats what we do best!

NAME: Brix & Mortar Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: A Yaletown icon for 20+ years, Brix & Mortar features a unique, glass-covered courtyard that is the centerpiece of the upstairs dining area and is popular for small weddings and events. Downstairs offers a second, completely renovated outdoor patio illuminated by seven-tier glass chandeliers, providing guests with a city-dining experience. The menu features modern Canadian cuisine with subtle French, Italian and Asian influences and locally sourced ingredients. Accessible from both Homer and Hamilton St., Brix & Mortar offers 228 seats, with 80 situated over two outdoor patios, including the iconic outdoor courtyard-a favourite for hosted events and weddings. The downstairs space has undergone an exciting redesign, creating a fine-dining room suitable for any occasion or appetite.

NAME: JOEY Burrard
DESCRIPTION: Instead of just one chef, we have a whole team of celebrated Executive Chefs bringing you an experience you can’t get anywhere else. We believe in handcrafted, locally and globally inspired menu offerings. With 27 JOEY Restaurant locations across Canada, Washington and California, our award-winning and inventive culinary and hospitality teams are ready to serve a cosmopolitan tribe of patrons in modern, warm and lively environments.

NAME: Trattoria Park Royal
DESCRIPTION: EVERY NEIGHBORHOOD NEEDS A TRATTORIA! Located at Park Royal South, this is a home-cooking hang out. Our ingredients are simple and fresh – just what Italian food should be.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 757 Main Street, Park Royal South, V7T 0A5

NAME: Absinthe Bistro
DESCRIPTION: Absinthe Bistro offers modern and classic french cooking on Commercial Drive - Open for Dine in, Patio and take away

NAME: Arms Reach Bistro
DESCRIPTION: The Arms Reach Bistro, established in 2004, in the heart of Deep Cove, offers a tasteful west coast style cuisine with a unique flare. Open at 11am seven days a week, we serve breakfast, lunch and dinner. Come down and join us, relax and relish in the spectacular waterfront view.

NAME: Chambar
DESCRIPTION: "An unpretentious fling with fine dining."

NAME: Hawksworth Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: A celebration of Vancouver’s cultural diversity and natural environment Hawksworth Restaurant showcases ingredient led, contemporary cuisine that demonstrates the highly skilled technique and relentless drive for perfection that has become Chef David Hawksworth’s trademark.Glamorous and elegant, yet relaxed and welcoming with warm and attentive service, Hawksworth Restaurant is located in the heart of the city at Georgia and Howe Streets within the legendary Rosewood Hotel Georgia.Open for breakfast, brunch, lunch and dinner, with in bar dining menus and its own private room, Hawksworth can deliver an array of dining experiences from power breakfasts to after-work drinks, to formal gala events.

NAME: Free Bird Table & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Food for the hungry, drink for the thirsty, and comfort for the traveler. Southern classics with a west coast heart.

NAME: 75 West Coast Grill
DESCRIPTION: Located in the heart of Richmond at the Vancouver Airport Marriott Hotel, 75 West Coast Grill continues to be one of Richmond's most popular lunch and dinner destinations. Offering a comfortable business-casual setting by day and elegant candlelit dining at sunset, 75 West is sure to wow you and your guests.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 7571 Westminster Hwy, Vancouver Airport Marriott Hotel, V6X 1A3

NAME: Boulevard Kitchen and Oyster Bar
DESCRIPTION: An Uncompromising Standard Of Excellence Vancouver’s Boulevard Kitchen & Oyster Bar provides a distinctive showcase for the celebrated culinary vision of Executive Chef Roger Ma and redefines the fine art of dining with subtle, unexpected and playful approaches to cuisine, service and style. With an innovative approach that blends a respect for the past with a celebration of the present, Ma’s seafood-focused menu is grounded in classical technique and training, while artfully infusing casual West Coast flair and creative hints of his international influences. From the all-star, front-of-house team led by Director of Operations JP Potters to the acute attention to detail in design to the understated elegance of Ma’s cuisine, Boulevard has set forth an uncompromising standard of excellence that is sure to excite both food-savvy Vancouver residents and visitors alike. From the stylish dining room, seated oyster bar and craft-cocktail and champagne bar to the vintage-style lounge, priv

NAME: CinCin Ristorante + Bar
DESCRIPTION: Now open for dine-in! Wood-fired Italian-inspired cuisine crafted in rhythm with the seasons. If take-away is your preference, the chefs from Toptable Group in Vancouver have collaborated to bring a new concept to you during these unique times. Toptable2U Vancouver is a take-away menu of housemade provisions, prepped meal kits for at home cooking, and farm-to-table produce selections curated for the home kitchen. We believe that the souls of our restaurants can be found in their kitchens, and this philosophy lives on as Toptable Group brings our kitchens to yours. We hope that our offerings bring a little joy around the table until we meet again. View our entire Toptable2U Vancouver menu for pick-up and delivery options at toptable2u.com.

NAME: Nightingale
DESCRIPTION: Simple seasonal family-style dishes, from pizza and pasta to veggie salads and share plates.

NAME: Frankie's Italian Kitchen & Bar Vancouver
DESCRIPTION: Frankie's Italian Kitchen & Bar offers traditional, simple and fresh Italian meals based on family recipes with the flavours of southern Italy as well as newly inspired Italian dishes in a contemporary but classic setting. The menu offers a wide selection of fresh house-made pastas and traditional comfort fare. The bar offers classic cocktails and the wine list is focused on well represented and down-to-earth British Columbia VQA wines and imported Italian wines. Frankie's, true Italian, family food & friends. Close to Rogers Arena and BC Place Stadium.

NAME: Tacofino
GENERAL_LOCATION: 15 Cordova St W, Enter Via Blood Alley Square, V6B 1C8

NAME: Spicy 6 Fine Indian Cuisine
GENERAL_LOCATION: 1116 Robson St, Robson at Thurlow, V6E 1B2

NAME: The Flying Pig Yaletown
DESCRIPTION: We refer to our restaurant as a "nouveau Canadian Bistro"... offering a simple, seasonally inspired menu with fresh, local ingredients at a great value. Our open concept kitchen brings the Chef to your table, delivering a memorable overall dining experience.

NAME: CRAFT Beer Market- False Creek
DESCRIPTION: CRAFT Beer Market is a premium casual restaurant with a passion for fresh local food and great craft beer. Launched in Calgary in 2011, the CRAFT movement has been spreading ever since, bringing our special recipe of sophisticated comfort food, unique craft beers and active community involvement to new cities every year.

NAME: Orto Artisan Pasta
DESCRIPTION: Orto is the result of the dynamic partnership between Mother and Son duo Brigitte and Steeve Raye. who are back on the restaurant scene with their latest concept: artisan pasta and Italian inspired food. Between Brigitte's warm hospitality and Steeve's exceptional food, Orto is sure to become a family favourite. The restaurant boasts a beautiful urban garden and patio for the hot summer's days.

NAME: Peaked Pies
DESCRIPTION: Australian meat pies, sweet pies, breakfast pies, coffee and dessert.

NAME: Hy's Steakhouse & Cocktail Bar Vancouver
DESCRIPTION: Hy's has been Canada's premier steakhouse since opening in 1955. Hy's offers guests the finest Canadian Prime beef, fresh seafood and delicoius takes on traditional steakhouse cuisine. With professional service in a warm, relaxed atmosphere, Hy's has been a part of important occasions and memorable meals for more than 65 years.

NAME: Ask for Luigi
DESCRIPTION: Ask for Luigi is a casual and intimate Italian-inspired restaurant, specializing in fresh hand made pasta.* The service is family-style: all dishes are meant for sharing and food arrives to the middle of the table, as it is ready. The antipasti usually arrive first, with pasta dishes close behind. We also have an amazing house made gluten free options available daily. All menu items are available for dine-in or take-out.

NAME: Sula Indian Restaurant, Main Street
DESCRIPTION: Sula Indian restaurant - Main street is a new venture by Sula indian restaurant which is present at Commercial drive. This outlet will be more focused on serving traditional Indian seafood cuisines especially rooted in South India. Similar to Sula's commercial drive restaurant, their will be options of vegan, dairy free and gluten free dishes.

NAME: JOEY Bentall One
DESCRIPTION: Instead of just one chef, we have a whole team of celebrated Executive Chefs bringing you an experience you can’t get anywhere else. We believe in handcrafted, locally and globally inspired menu offerings. With 27 JOEY Restaurant locations across Canada, Washington and California, our award-winning and inventive culinary and hospitality teams are ready to serve a cosmopolitan tribe of patrons in modern, warm and lively environments.

NAME: Osteria Savio Volpe
DESCRIPTION: Osteria Savio Volpe is a restaurant styled after the classic osteria - rustic fare in the Italian tradition of freshness and regionality, using groceries gathered in the nearby lakes, oceans, farms and fields. Everything is prepared in the simplest, most flavourful way; pasta is handmade fresh every day – fatto a mano in casa – and meat, poultry and fish are kissed by smoke over the wood-fired grill and rotisserie. And of course, a long list of friendly Italian wines and old world coffee to inspire conversation and good cheer among friends, family and strangers alike. Above all else, Osteria Savio Volpe celebrates liveliness, warmth and hospitality.

NAME: Hariyali Express Indian Cuisine & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Sleek restaurant offering Indian fare, including vegetarian options, plus a bar. Specializing in healthy, fresh & sustainable Indian food practices. Modern interior, a peaceful atmosphere to dine and relax.

NAME: MeeT in Gastown
DESCRIPTION: Comfort food and crafty drinks! Good food for your mood with vegan and gluten-free options. Can't wait to MeeT ya.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 12 Water St, Inner Courtyard, Gastown, V6B 1A5

NAME: Dasha
DESCRIPTION: Discover an unforgettable pan-Asian dining experience in the heart of Downtown Toronto. Brought to you by Honeycomb Hospitality, DASHA will provide an unparalleled culinary experience and sophisticated entertainment all in one. Our menu highlights the depth of techniques, flavours, and inspirations, found throughout Asian cuisine. At Dasha, we respect the traditions found throughout these cuisines and take influence and inspiration from them, while tying it in to our own culture in the Downtown Toronto community. Dasha is a place to celebrate, enjoy, indulge, and discover. DASHA reinvents the experience of karaoke in stylishly crafted private rooms. Each room is designed with comfortable leather seating, high-quality sound equipment, and extravagantly themed decor. Or, check our our speakeasy nightclub, Judy's Music Lounge, on the weekends. The night is yours!

NAME: Rodney's Oyster House
DESCRIPTION: Rodney Clark has been offering oysters to the masses in Toronto since 1987. Our selection changes daily, but we carry on average 12-18 different varieties from around the world. We also strive to offer the finest in fresh seafood, sourced from sustainable fisheries - as we work primarily with fresh product, you'll have to come down and see what's coming through our doors this week.

NAME: Miku
DESCRIPTION: ABURI Restaurant's first East Coast flagship is situated in Toronto's harbourfront at Bay and Queens Quay. With over 7000 square feet of dining space, a raw bar, sushi bar, and spacious patio, Miku Toronto brings contemporary upscale dining and design to the Southern Financial District. Expanding east from roots in Vancouver, ABURI Restaurants and Miku Vancouver are known both locally and internationally for the innovative concept of Aburi Sushi. Combining traditional Japanese flavours and techniques with local, East Coast elements to create a truly unique dining experience. Miku Toronto's menu focuses on Aburi Sushi as well as fresh seafood, respecting the natural flavours of the ingredients while adding a signature Aburi twist. Japanese and European inspired desserts made in house by our pastry team create the perfect ending to the culinary experience. The restaurant also hosts an extensive wine, sake, and cocktail list to pair with all dining occasions.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 105-10 Bay St, at Queen’s Quay, M5J 2R8

NAME: Goodfellas Wood Oven Pizza
DESCRIPTION: Goodfellas is a fully licensed restaurant concept that specializes in the preparation of authentic Neapolitan-style wood oven pizza, salad, and Italian inspired dishes. Our traditional home made recipes are created with a rustic Italian "backyard" flavour only found south of Rome. More than just a pizza, Goodfellas it's an exceptional food experience to be shared with family or friends. Whether it's a quick lunch or an evening out, Goodfellas will romance you with our exclusive Italian wines and dishes that made southern Italy infamous!!

NAME: C'est What?
DESCRIPTION: Toronto's best choice in craft beer and comfort food can be found in the casual, charming cellar of a historic building in the St. Lawrence Market area. Featuring the biggest selection of Canadian craft brews on tap, an all Ontario VQA wine list, art, indie music, board games, and pool tables, C’est What has true local flavour. As the city's original craft beer and wine restaurant C’est What has consistently preached from the book of local and since first opening it’s doors in 1988 and is a proud Canadian cultural ambassador. Founder George MIlbrandt says: “We believe that if it's worth doing, it's worth doing well. It is our passion for what we do that keeps us showing up for work every day. Well, that and the beer.”

NAME: Rasa
GENERAL_LOCATION: 196 Robert St, Entrance on Harbord Street, M5S 2K7

NAME: Benares
DESCRIPTION: Finest Indian Restaurant in Downtown Toronto

NAME: Richmond Station
DESCRIPTION: Richmond Station is a stopping place, a bustling neighbourhood restaurant in the downtown core. We are committed to delicious food and excellent hospitality.

NAME: Spring Sushi
DESCRIPTION: Spring Sushi is centrally located in the Heart of Downtown Toronto at Yonge & Dundas Square. Here you can enjoy All-You-Can-Eat Sushi as well as a wide range of dishes including Teriyaki, Grilled Beef Ribs. A full service bar and a fantastic Roof-Top-Patio overlooking Yonge & Dundas. Yes you can see the CN-Tower from our patio! We have private booths and long tables for large parties!

NAME: Adega
DESCRIPTION: Adega welcomes you to taste one of the oldest and most diverse cuisines in the world. At Adega (meaning wine cellar), we have taken old recipes and cooking techniques and matched them with modern flavours and other complementary styles of cuisine. Some dishes need no refining at all and are served in their authentic form. Adega’s specialty is seafood and they source it from all over the world: fresh fish from Portugal & Azores Islands, Canadian Maritime Lobster, Norwegian Cod, Tunisian Octopus, and Thai Tiger Shrimp.

NAME: Harriet's Rooftop
DESCRIPTION: Take in the most expansive views of vibrant Toronto from Harriet's Rooftop at 1 Hotel Toronto. Harriet's luxurious rooftop space has been decorated with reclaimed and sustainable materials throughout, creating a vibe that's both lively and cozy. On the rooftop, guests can choose from light bites made from seasonal ingredients, as well as wellness cocktails prepared with fresh juices. And for those looking to kick it up a notch, the lounge also offers craft cocktails and bottle service.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 550 Wellington St W, Suite C, M5V 2V4

NAME: Perfect Chinese Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Perfect Chinese Restaurant is the ultimate delicacy since 1984 and the benchmark for Toronto seafood and Cantonese restaurants. We are open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, providing various delicacy Chinese food and fresh seafood, including lobster, king crab, Vancouver crab, and different fresh fish, and dozens of high-quality dim sum.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 4386 Sheppard Ave East Scarborough ON Canada, M1S 1T8

NAME: Chiado Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Chiado is the creation of Albino Silva, one of North America’s leading chefs and restaurateurs. The critically acclaimed Chiado Restaurant is a beautiful blend of old-world charm and timeless elegance. Silva’s “Progressive Portuguese” cuisine has been praised for its bold flavours and creative presentations that will indulge you in the ultimate dining experience. Silva and his professional team are the perfect fit for corporate events and private functions as well as catering in patron’s homes. Unsurpassed personal attention and bespoke menus designed under the watchful eye of Silva and his well-trained staff are the hallmark of the Chiado experience

NAME: 1 Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: 1 Kitchen Toronto serves up fresh, local, and sustainably sourced farm-to-table cuisine. The restaurant is a zero-waste operation, which spotlights the team's commitment to preserving the beauty and bounty of nature. And then there's the bar, where cold-pressed juices form the base of cocktails. The wine list highlights unique and iconic selections - many biodynamic or organic - you'll also find handcrafted cocktails and Bluestone Lane coffee. Light-filled and open, 1 Kitchen Toronto has a built-in feeling updated for today, in a glass-walled conservatory-like space with a vaulted wood ceiling and curved trusses hung with greenery. It's a place that's comfortable by nature, where you can eat mindfully and eat well, and savour the flavours that come straight from the Garden Pavilion.

NAME: Casa Madera
DESCRIPTION: The first location in Canada, from famed restauranteurs Noble 33, welcomes patrons into an immersive dining experience. Casa Madera's diverse menu is one that speaks to Noble 33's core tenants - serving inventive, bold flavours built on sustainable, organic fare, using only the freshest ingredients coupled with a diverse array of vegan and gluten-free options. Enjoy chef-driven selections that celebrate the culinary traditions of Mexico and the Mediterranean while DJs play alongside talented performance artists. Casa Madera's cocktail program also includes an extensive non-alcoholic and low-proof selection.

NAME: Moxies
DESCRIPTION: Book your next cocktail party, business dinner or special event with us! Our fully enclosed patio is private and can accommodate up to 50 people. We also offer banquet rooms for larger events. We are located on Dixon Road at the base of Sandman Signature Hotel – minutes away from Toronto's Pearson Airport. Come enjoy a delicious lunch, dinner, or late-night meal and choose from a wide variety of steaks, burgers, pastas and seafood! Executive Chef Brandon Thordarson has crafted delicious dishes like the mouth-watering Chipotle Mango Chicken and crowd pleaser such as our Calamari and Dry ribs that’ll be sure to please the entire party. Whether hitting the links at Royal Woodbine Golf Club, taking a stroll at Mimico Creek, or enjoying one of Etobicokes many local attractions, Moxie’s will be waiting for you with great Daily Drink Specials and a newly renovated indoor patio. Come join us for an amazing dining experience.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 55 Reading Court, Sandman Signature Hotel, M9W 7K7

NAME: Estiatorio VOLOS
DESCRIPTION: Fresh, healthy flavours and emphasis on beautiful presentation please both the appetite and eyes at Volos. Modern twists on traditional Greek dishes and Greek twists on local Canadian ingredients create a contemporary culinary experience rooted in authenticity. The restaurant sources the highest quality local produce, superior quality cuts of meat and the best fish, delivered daily. Like the menu, the interior plays with different Greek elements and motifs. Natural wood and stone combined with artful and ambient lighting lend a seductive and comfortable atmosphere.We invite you to enjoy the Volos experience.For groups larger than 8 guests, please call (416) 861-1211.

NAME: ALO RESTAURANT
DESCRIPTION: Hospitality [hos-pi-tal-i-tee] Origin: French; Hospitalite; The quality or disposition of receiving and treating guests and strangers in a warm, friendly, generous way. Alo [‘a.lo] Origin: Latin; Alui altum; To nourish, cherish, support, sustain, maintain and keep. It is our intention to get back to the roots of hospitality. We want each and every guest to feel welcome in our home, and that home is ALO. A destination for classically prepared, meticulously thought out French food and service. This no-nonsense approach to fine dining with our combined experience working behind-the-scenes at some of the world’s best restaurants has led us to this point. We welcome you to ALO. Chef Patrick Kriss & General Manager Amanda Bradley

NAME: Scaramouche Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Scaramouche has long been celebrated by customers and critics for its unwavering commitment to making each dining experience a memorable one. Chef/owner Keith Froggett's sophisticated cuisine is presented simply with care and attention to detail. The service underscores that philosophy: unobtrusive and respectful. The restaurant affords a stunning nighttime vista of the downtown Toronto skyline. These components and more make Scaramouche the singular destination it is. And the reason that the restaurant is consistently ranked as one of the city's best for more than three decades.

NAME: Hy's Steakhouse Toronto
DESCRIPTION: Hy's has been Canada's premier steakhouse since opening in 1955. Hy's offers guests the finest Canadian Prime beef, fresh seafood and delicoius takes on traditional steakhouse cuisine. With professional service in a warm, relaxed atmosphere, Hy's has been a part of important occasions and memorable meals for more than 65 years.

NAME: The Keg Steakhouse + Bar - Dixon Road
DESCRIPTION: Whether you're dining around our table or yours, make every occasion a special one. Visit our website to book your table or order takeout online.

NAME: Auberge du Pommier
DESCRIPTION: A modern French fine dining restaurant, Auberge du Pommier exudes quiet confidence, reflecting our commitment to culinary excellence and inspired service. Constructed around the rustic vestiges of two 1860’s woodcutters’ cottages, Auberge du Pommier combines country charm with contemporary sophistication and style. Featuring wood-burning fireplaces in winter and lush, floral terraces in summer, it is a welcoming, refined retreat from the city.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 4150 Yonge St, Yonge Corporate Centre, M2P 2C6

NAME: Queen Mother Cafe
DESCRIPTION: The Queen Mother Cafe has been a hub for good food, drinks and company on Queen St West since 1978. Torontonians and visitors to the city know it for the flavourful global comfort food it serves, with a slant towards Lao-Thai cuisine. The long granite bar draws regulars over smart cocktails and a friendly wine and beer list. The Queen Mum is also famous for the wide selection of enticing desserts on show in its vintage display fridge. The back yard garden patio is an oasis in the heart of the city offering shelter and refreshment on sultry summer days.

NAME: Kinka Izakaya Original
DESCRIPTION: An Izakaya is a Japanese-style pub and what we strive for at KINKA IZAKAYA is an authentic Izakaya with great food and drinks in an unique atmosphere. Our goal is to serve each and every one of our guests happiness as they experience a "truly authentic Japan".

NAME: Evviva Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: We are here to serve joy and celebrate new beginnings! That joy consists of fresh and preservative-free breakfast dishes, signature brunch cocktails and other alcoholic drinks, friendly customer service with a smile, and a cozy and cheerful atmosphere. We are the perfect setting for coffee catch-ups, business lunches, and special celebrations! Good is not always expensive! Since 2010, we focus on high-quality food with a blooming interior design to bring you the best breakfast, lunch, and brunch experience.

NAME: Lady Marmalade
DESCRIPTION: Inventive breakfasts & globally inspired lunches served in a bright, art-filled space. Known for it's delicious Eggs Benedict, Lady Marmalade also has numerous vegetarian and gluten free options.

NAME: Patria
DESCRIPTION: Patria "The Homeland " Patria is a restaurant born out the idea of the lifestyle and soul of the Spanish culture. A country rich in tradition of dedication to artisanal cuisine and wines displayed in the Boquerias and Tapas bars throughout each region. The menu will be an authentic representation of the rustic styles, sourced from the highest quality of available products from Spain and Ontario. The wines have been selected to compliment the vast diversity in cuisine, and promote the finest producers the country has to offer.

NAME: The Senator Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Located in the heart of downtown in close proximity to theatres and hotels, the historic Senator is the most renowned restaurant in Toronto. At the Senator, we prepare and serve fresh, high-quality honest-to-goodness food to lovers of good food. We offer traditional breakfast and lunch as well as upscale contemporary dinners with a selection of fine wines and traditional cocktails in both our main floor restaurant and upstairs in the Top of the Senator. Reservations for dinner are recommended.

NAME: STK Toronto
DESCRIPTION: STK is a unique concept that artfully blends the modern steakhouse and a chic lounge into one, offering a dynamic, fine dining experience with the superior quality of a traditional steakhouse. STK distinguishes itself by emphasizing the social experience and taking a vibe-driven approach to fine dining. Every venue has a DJ to create an infectious, high-energy atmosphere and the sleek environment is designed to encourage guests to interact and mingle. Ultimately, STK aims to define the modern dining experience complete with incredible food, world-class service and the perfect ambiance.

NAME: Library Bar
DESCRIPTION: Literary greats are famous for reinvention. Experience the next golden age of cocktail culture. A timeless meeting place that remains the undercurrent of Toronto's metropolitan character, Library Bar returns as the famed cocktail den cloaked beyond a secret corner of the illustrious Fairmont Royal York hotel. Throughout the bar's evolution as the city's coveted martini institution, Library Bar personifies the fabled legacy as the electric space where such walls can divulge tales from the night we met to the fervent thrill in closing the deal.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 100 Front St. West, Fairmont Royal York, M5J 1E3

NAME: Ruth's Chris Steak House
DESCRIPTION: Ruth's Chris Steak House specializes in serving USDA Prime steaks, each seared to perfection, finished with butter and freshly chopped parsley, and served sizzling on a 500-degree plate. We invite you to join us in Toronto, ON!
GENERAL_LOCATION: 145 Richmond Street West, Hilton Toronto, M5H 2L2

NAME: Lee Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Susur Lee's stylish eatery for creative Southeast Asian & French cuisine meant for sharing. Located at 497 Richmond Street West.

NAME: The Keg Steakhouse + Bar - Mansion
DESCRIPTION: Whether you're dining around our table or yours, make every occasion a special one. Visit our website to book your table or order takeout online.

NAME: George Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Since opening in 2003, GEORGE Restaurant has established its place as an acclaimed culinary destination, and is known today as one of the best fine dining experiences in the country. Led by Executive Chef Lorenzo Loseto, GEORGE has recently been included in Canada's first installment of the Michelin Guide. Situated in downtown Toronto on Queen Street East and located within a restored 1850’s chocolate factory, GEORGE serves as a central location for dinners, corporate events, weddings, cocktail receptions, and more. Heritage building features and an eclectic mix of contemporary artwork provide a stunning backdrop, complementing Chef Loseto's vibrant fare. GEORGE guests can choose from an à la carte tasting menu or Chef Loseto's signature Chef's Choice tasting experience, customized according to each guest's preferences. With our team of trained sommeliers, we can recommend the best matches to pair with Chef Loseto's cuisine, many of which can be ordered by the glass.

NAME: Kamasutra Indian Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: In India, it is a widely held belief that guests should be treated like Gods. At Kamasutra Indian Restaurant, this norm is at the heart of every guest experience. Located on picturesque Bayview Avenue, Kamasutra has become a local favorite due to its beautiful décor, flavorful cuisine and consistent customer service. Newly renovated, the restaurant, offers a warm and welcoming atmosphere that is perfect for both romantic dates and family dinners. The consistently excellent customer service comes in the form of customizable spice levels, food sensitivity accommodation, courteous staff and a diverse menu that is sure to please all. Beyond the restaurant dining experience, this Leaside jewel offers delivery and takeout, and event catering. A visit to Kamasutra will quickly justify its numerous “Best Indian Restaurant” awards from Rogers Media and Toronto Life

NAME: Blu Ristorante
DESCRIPTION: Modern italian cuisine.

NAME: Aroma Fine Indian Cuisine
DESCRIPTION: Aroma Fine Indian Cuisine is located in the heart of Toronto's entertainment and theatre district and offers an authentic and memorable fine dining experience. Our elegant dining room is the ideal atmosphere for an intimate dinner for two or for any group event. Having gained invaluable experience in India's 5-star hotels, our chef will tantalize your taste buds with an extensive menu of meat and vegetarian dishes. Our team of professionals coupled with a delectable cuisine and beautiful ambiance will make for the most enjoyable affair.

NAME: Olde Yorke Fish & Chips
DESCRIPTION: Classic British Fish & Chips served in our traditional pub atmosphere. At Olde Yorke we are proud to be the third generation with over 70 years of experience. From our fryer to your table, Olde Yorke welcomes you to enjoy a great shared family tradition. Dine in or take-out

NAME: Planta
DESCRIPTION: Under Chef David Lee, PLANTA is dining as it should be - an unguilty pleasure. Created in 2016, PLANTA is a celebration of delicious and innovative plant-based cuisine served in a beautifully designed space, without pretension and with an overflow of good vibes. PLANTA Toronto features signatures like the PLANTA Burger, Ahi Watermelon Nigiri, and Bang Bang Broccoli while expanding plant-powered horizons with pizzas, pastas, sustainably crafted cocktails, and more. PLANTA reimagines and reinvents plant-based dining, providing flavorful (and fun) proof that the power of plants can change the world.

NAME: Cafe Boulud Toronto
DESCRIPTION: Located in the flagship Four Seasons Hotel Toronto, Café Boulud provides a French dining experience linked to Chef Daniel Boulud’s roots from Lyon, France. Café Boulud offers the atmosphere of a French brasserie with its retro-modern design by Martin Brudnizki. Rotisserie spits in the kitchen allows the simultaneous cooking of meat, fish, poultry and vegetables. The menu features French classics and non-traditional items, which can be paired with the perfect bottle by wine director, Julie Garton. The dining room is warm and inviting and the restaurant is located in Toronto’s iconic Yorkville neighbourhood.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 60 Yorkville Avenue, Four Seasons Hotel Toronto, M4W 0A4

NAME: Hair of the Dog Restaurant & Pub
DESCRIPTION: An upscale neighbourhood pub and restaurant on Church St, across from the old Maple Leaf Gardens, Hair of the Dog was recently voted one of the best patios in the city and best pub downtown by Toronto’s Now Magazine. It’s a downtown hot spot and a great place for dinner and drinks before dancing or brunch on the weekends. The food is amazing, the portions are generous, and the attention to quality and consistency means your meal is always DELICIOUS.Award winning – Hair of the Dog has been voted the best place for a quiet drink and the best place to have a first date. And according to our staff, it’s a great place to dump someone!

NAME: Cactus Club Cafe First Canadian Place
GENERAL_LOCATION: 77 Adelaide Street West, 1 First Canadian Place, M5X 1C1

NAME: Azure Restaurant & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Under a canopy of glass, offering views of the Toronto cityscape, Azure Restaurant is a showcase of contemporary Canadian cuisine inspired by the rich culinary tapestry that is at the heart of our city. ideally located steps from Toronto’s biggest attractions.

NAME: The Queen and Beaver Public House
DESCRIPTION: A charming Gastropub offering scratch-made and authentic British cuisine and a curated selection of Draught Beers, Cask Ales, and Wine and Spirits in the heart of Downtown Toronto. Perfect for Lunch, Brunch and Dinner we also offer our beautiful upstairs Den for a more relaxed and convivial setting for drinks and socializing. In the warmer months, we have two outdoor licensed seating areas included a wonderful rooftop Terrace. We hope to see you sooon!

NAME: Sassafraz
DESCRIPTION: Set in an array of Victorian rowhouses, Sassafraz has evolved through the decades to become a magical space in the heart of historic Yorkville. The iconic little house and its romantic interior make it one of the most stunning restaurants in Toronto

NAME: Cibo Wine Bar
DESCRIPTION: Cibo Wine Bar brings authentic rustic Italian flare blended with a vibrant nightlife is sure to become the new hot spot in the stylish King West neighborhood of Toronto.This Italian eatery and wine bar, created by the Liberty Entertainment Group, offers traditional Italian fare in a relaxed and inviting atmosphere. The attention to detail is flawless and the food delicious.The menu offers guests a true taste of Italian cuisine, featuring both traditional classics and modern staples. Like the food, the space itself is warm and inviting with stone + glass walls, rustic wood finishes, exposed brick and butcher block table tops. This rustic elegance makes Cibo ideal for a casual relaxed meal yet sophisticated enough for a special night out.

NAME: Fresh on Spadina
DESCRIPTION: We think the perfect way to end your shopping trip at Square One Shopping Centre is getting lunch or dinner at Fresh Kitchen + Juice Bar Hurontario. There's nothing like energizing, craveable vegan food and drinks to help you recharge after you got your steps in. Join us in restaurant or get your plant-based faves for takeout.

NAME: Ki
DESCRIPTION: ki (n. pref. Japanese) pure; undiluted; raw Sushi, Sake, modern Japanese restaurant + bar in Downtown Toronto At Ki, chefs prepare dishes in both the open principal kitchen and at the sushi bar. Your server can guide your experience, offering sushi, cooked items, Saké and wine pairings, or simply answer any questions you have. Choose the modern Japanese experience that is right for you. the Sushi Bar The sushi bar provides great entertainment as you watch expert sushi chefs performing their magic. With twenty seats available, it is a dynamic and interactive place to enjoy not just sushi, but Ki's full menu offering. the Restaurant On either side of our cocktail bar are two raised dining areas surrounded by ponds looking out onto Bay Street, the heart of the Toronto Financial District. The lively ambiance of the bar is very much a part of the experience when you choose this part of the restaurant. For a quieter, more intimate setting, Ki has dining areas surrounding the sushi bar.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 181 Bay Street - Brookfield Place, Wellington Tower, M5J 2T3

DESCRIPTION: Whether you're dining around our table or yours, make every occasion a special one. Visit our website to book your table or order takeout online.
