GENERAL_LOCATION: 202 Davenport Rd, Just east of Avenue Rd, M5R 1J2

NAME: JOEY Eaton Centre
DESCRIPTION: Instead of just one chef, we have a whole team of celebrated Executive Chefs bringing you an experience you can’t get anywhere else. We believe in handcrafted, locally and globally inspired menu offerings. With 27 JOEY Restaurant locations across Canada, Washington and California, our award-winning and inventive culinary and hospitality teams are ready to serve a cosmopolitan tribe of patrons in modern, warm and lively environment.

NAME: Donatello Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: We are thrilled to have you back! Please reserve your spot on our nice Patio and In Door Dinning ! Hidden among the romantic street lights of ELM street, just off the rush of Yonge and Dundas is a quaint Italian restaurant, Donatello. A family run establishment with an intense focus on providing a high quality fine dining experience. This elegant downtown fine dining restaurant is a treat for fans of authentic Italian cuisine served in a welcoming atmosphere. On warm summer nights, the action at this busy restaurant spills onto a front terrace and romantic rooftop patio.

NAME: Eggspectation
DESCRIPTION: At Eggspectation, we're committed to innovation and achievement. Surpassing your "eggspectations" is what inspires us to be extraordinary. We strive to give you the best possible food quality and service while maintaining a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere. Welcome to what we call "le cirque des oeufs," an all-day experience.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 483 Bay St, Bell Trinity Square South Tower, M5G 2C9

NAME: Carisma
DESCRIPTION: CARISMA prides itself on being one of Toronto’s Best Italian Restaurants and remains a favourite amongst its long-standing loyal clientele. Owners Michael, Margi and daughter Monica, are not new to the restaurant scene. With a long history of being in the business, including restaurants such as Barolo and Il Mulino, Carisma offers the same authentic Italian food and quality service they are known and loved for. After spending 8 years on King Street East, Carisma has relocated to 15 Toronto Street. Only steps away from its original location, Carisma is now able to accommodate more than ever with two private rooms, a larger dining space and separate bar area. Carisma is described in one word is what the Italians like to refer to as “accoglienza”, the epitome of hospitality, a warm welcome that only comes with experience, heart and lots of Carisma! Together with the whole Carisma Family, We look forward to welcoming you to our new home and making new memories together.

NAME: Ramen Isshin
DESCRIPTION: Ramen Isshin means One Heart One Ramen and we bring a true authentic Ramen to the city of Toronto.

NAME: Toca
DESCRIPTION: We welcome you to taste Italy at TOCA! Enjoy a new authentic Italian Trattoria menu. Our restaurant in Toronto, Ontario features prosciutto freshly sliced on-site, pasta finished in large parmesan wheels, traditional digestifs and a dedicated Cheese Cave. Buon appetito.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 181 Wellington St W, The Ritz-Carlton, M5V 3G7

NAME: The Keg Steakhouse + Bar - Esplanade
DESCRIPTION: Whether you're dining around our table or yours, make every occasion a special one. Visit our website to book your table or order takeout online.

NAME: Sportsnet Grill
DESCRIPTION: Sportsnet Grill offers the ultimate sports dining experience with floor to ceiling windows delivering remarkable views looking into the Rogers Centre. A sports-themed restaurant, Sportsnet Grill is a fun, casual and contemporary space that is a perfect gathering spot for sports fans to meet up and enjoy watching games year round. Located at 1 Blue Jays Way, inside the Marriott Hotel just steps east of Rogers Centre Gate #15 or west of Gate #1 and directly above left field.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 1-1 Blue Jays Way, Toronto Marriott City Centre Hotel, M5V 1J4

NAME: The Carbon Bar
DESCRIPTION: Where fun-loving aficionados, gourmands and bon vivants meet to share un-pretentious snacks, plates and platters delivered with impeccable hospitality in a space inspired by the storied past of a rock'n'roll discotheque, an upstart TV station and a media giant's studio.

NAME: La Castile Steak & Seafood
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2179 Dundas St E, just off Highway 427, L4X 1M3

NAME: Little Anthony's
DESCRIPTION: Little Anthony's is a casual, energetic and affordable downtown osteria serving soul-satisfying Italian cooking.Claim a sunny table next to the restaurant’s grand windows and enjoy a quick lunch; meet friends for a specialty cocktail or Italian beer and a snack or two at the comfortable, convivial bar; host clients in the twelve-seat boardroom or an event in the spacious private dining room; or settle into the banquets and enjoy a leisurely dinner with a bottle of wine from the reasonably priced, wide-ranging list. LA's attentive staff and Italian cuisine are ready for you.

NAME: SOTTO SOTTO Ristorante
DESCRIPTION: Using only the freshest ingredients Sotto Sotto offers a considerable menu of simple classics and traditional creations. To start there is an abundance of wonderful salads and antipasti. Pastas are available as a second or main course dish. Main courses feature veal, beef, seafood and poultry and there are also "risotto for two" options. We also serve delicious gelati and desserts including homemade tiramisu made in the time honoured traditional style of the Rocca family.

NAME: Landing Group
DESCRIPTION: Kellys Landing has cemented itself as a casual premium restaurant catering to both corporate and social diners alike. Steps away from Union Station, Scotia Bank Arena, Rogers Center and the Royal York Hotel. Our large screen TV is perfect for watching the game while our retractable roof welcomes a breeze on those warm summer days. We are looking forward to hosting you.

NAME: Cluny Bistro
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Cluny Bistro! We're Distillery District's entry into the wonderful world of French inspired food with a modern twist. With a fun, casual atmosphere featuring vibrant music and breathtaking design, we're not your parent's French Bistro! We offer our guests an exciting, non-pretentious menu reflective of France's modern food movement. The menu begs you to share items with the table, allowing you to try the many amazing flavours presented. Cluny's Patisserie will indulge you with our house-made macarons and homemade bread still warm from the oven. We hope you visit Cluny Bistro not only to savour our magnificent food, but also to enjoy the whole dining experience as a vibrant social event. We look forward to serving you soon!

NAME: Loose Moose
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to the new Loose Moose, featuring a brand new menu and the largest draught beer selection in downtown Toronto. Since pouring our first pint in 1989, a lot has changed at The Loose Moose. And yet, so much has remained the same. Our space is different, but our address isn’t. Our business has grown, but we’re still independent. And now, even with the most draught beers downtown, we’re no beer snobs. Never have been. Never will be. After all, staying true to yourself is how you make new friends - and keep old ones. Anyone who’s stopped by The Loose Moose to unwind after work, watch the game or make a night of it will tell you the same.

NAME: El Catrin
DESCRIPTION: Located in the Distillery District, El Catrin is an authentic Mexican eatery with a lively vibe and fun staff. We serve authentic traditional and modern Mexican cuisine with an ambitious wide-ranging tapas-style menu. The menu allows you to sample a variety of different flavours and textures from the diverse regions of Mexico.The cocteles (aka cocktails) are off the hook. We have the best margaritas in the city. And Canada's largest mescal and tequila bar with over 120 different labels. With a stunning hand painted 20'x60' mural and one of the best patios and cocktails lists in the city, El Catrin is sure to be a hit.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 18 Tank House Lane, Distillery District, M5A 3C4

NAME: Fran's Restaurant & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Fran's is a family-owned and operated Toronto institution known for its home-style cooking and warm, welcoming atmosphere. Operating since 1940, Fran's is famous for several comfort dishes, most notably the Banquet Burger, which original founder Fran Deck created. Other diner classics that remain a tradition include Fran's famous chili, award-winning rice pudding and homemade apple pie. Fran's serves a wide selection, including generous all-day breakfasts, housemade burgers and steaks - and don't forget to ask us about our vegetarian options. Welcome home to Fran's!

NAME: Copper Kitchen & Bar
DESCRIPTION: c o p p e r kitchen, bar & rooftop UBUD’S ROOFTOP DINING EXPERIENCE Authentic Ethical Inspired Ubud is like nowhere else, and Copper Kitchen, Bar & Rooftop reflects that. Our dining options are an authentic and inspired blend of the flavours that have always brought people to Ubud and what those ingredients mean to us. Food that embraces the depth of International-Asian culinary traditions and the skill and élan using locally grown and ethically sourced produce. Our food is thoughtful, featuring authentic and natural dining options with a generous amount of produce coming from our own earth-friendly farm in Tegallalang, Bali's regional pastures, oceans and forests. The fare embodies our sensibility of keeping things ethical and inspired while paying homage to Ubud’s surroundings. Our Beverage program is inspired by the thorough approach of the old world using a combination of exotic ingredients and refined techniques of the past.

NAME: El Patio Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: All-day dining offering à la carte international cuisine to "Culinary Escapades", a market-style buffet dinner service for all tastes that allows you to travel around the globe.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Kawasan Wisata ITDC Lot 1, Melia Bali, 80363

NAME: chai of the Tiger (Indian Street food) - Jl Bisma
DESCRIPTION: Indian street food - Tapas Style! A unique dining experience that brings the vibrant flavors of Indian streets right to your plate in a comfortable, clean environment. Our menu, though compact, is a carefully curated selection of Indian street food classics, and some riffs of our own each dish an explosion of taste and tradition! Our mouth-watering snacks are made with fresh ingredients and authentic Indian spices that will leave you craving for more. From our famous samosas to our delicious chai, we have something for everyone! Come visit us today and indulge in the flavors!

NAME: Seminyak Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: Seminyak Kitchen offers extensive selection of local favorite, Asian to International dishes where our talented chefs showcase their skills right in front of your eyes in our live open kitchen. On top of that, our well trained and attentive team will make sure you have a memorable dining experience right in the heart of Seminyak.

NAME: Kulkul Beach House
DESCRIPTION: Kulkul, a chic yet laid-back beach house, has newly reopened that offers best views to the Indian Ocean on the exotic Nusa Dua Beach. Kulkul provides a relaxed atmosphere and also offers cabanas by the swimming pool. The all-day menu and cocktails focus on zero-waste dining and inventive menus made with locally sourced ingredients. Encouraging guests to lounge around all day and evening, Kulkul is the perfect destination to experience Bali's serene spirit by the beach.

NAME: Kepitu Restaurant at The Kayon Jungle Resort
DESCRIPTION: The Kepitu Restaurant at The Kayon Jungle Resort is set in the right hand side of the property, 360 degrees magical view. Open for breakfast, lunch and dinner offers wide variety menu such as complete Vegetarian, Western, Indonesian to local Balinese. The Children below 15 years old, senior citizen/people who are having mobility issues, drone, durian are not permitted at our Kepitu Restaurant at The Kayon Jungle.

NAME: Sakura Japanese Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Tokyo fish Market vibes in the best Japanese Restaurant in Bali. Offering premium quality fish sashimi, sushi. Experience the most popular teppanyaki show in town or have fun with family in the private tatami room.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Jl. Raya Nusa Dua Selatan, Kawasan Pariwisata ITDC Lot. 1, 80363

NAME: Sleeping Gajah Kitchen & Lounge
DESCRIPTION: The open- air restaurant with 70-seating capacity offer you a panoramic view over the hill and the natural sound of Unda river. With casual and relaxing dining approach for breakfast, lunch and dinner, we aim to please your palettes with quality cuisine. We offers wide range of dishes such as general Indonesian, Western, highlighting our Signature dishes.

NAME: Ivy Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Ivy is a cozy place serving fresh, healthy & tasty food that fuels your mind and body, made from the freshest, local produce.

NAME: Dapur Usada
DESCRIPTION: Dapur Usada offers the concept of IndoVedic food, fusing the ancient principles of Ayurveda with modern local plant based cuisine. Our name Usada refers to the Balinese concept of natural plant medicines, and is another aspect that is fused into our offerings. Our food has a mix of Indian, Indonesian and modern flavors. It will make your body feel nourished and your tastebuds delighted. We place the highest emphasis on sourcing sustainable and pesticide free ingredients, delivered fresh to us from our friends in the mountains every morning. Our friendly team looks forward to welcome you!

NAME: Arcadia Restaurant Ubud
DESCRIPTION: Where nostalgic charm mixes with modern delights to create one-of-a kind experiences. Opens daily from 11am - 11pm.

NAME: Kaukau Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: The name of KauKau is inspired by Coco or coconut shell, a staple ingredient for many dishes in Bali and a tree commonly found around Bali, symbolizing respect and gratitude to the universe. At Kaukau, the presence of coconut expands on the menu, creating elegance in authentic Indonesian dishes with a lot of complex seasoning. This all-day dining restaurant, located on the ground floor, takes culinary inspiration from Indonesian cuisine. Kaukau definitely lives up to your expectations for dining and drinking options if you’re looking for an exquisite experience. It brings a fantastic blend of flavours and cultures to its tables. What makes the dishes stand out is the inclusion of fresh ingredients, local produce that make them delicious and irresistible. Open daily for breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, and dinner from 7 AM to 10 PM.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Jalan Katik Lantang, Arkamara Dijiwa Resort, 80571

NAME: Dining Corner Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Dining Corner at Kayumanis Ubud is a stylish restaurant positioned high over a river valley that blends seamlessly into the encompassing woodland. Open for all day dining, it serves an exquisite menu of Thai, Indonesian and contemporary Western fare prepared using the freshest possible ingredients. Every dish is a flavorsome journey that brings culinary perfection to the rural outskirts of Ubud. The food and ambience of this uplifting venue truly pays homage to all of the senses. Table settings are positioned next to a decorative pool on an open-air deck to capture the splendor of the surrounding landscape. With versatile seating options for up to 32 guests, the Dining Corner is open daily until late and is suitable for intimate dinners as well as small social gatherings under the stars.

NAME: The Power of Love - Samabe Cave Dining
DESCRIPTION: Tucked away at Nusa Dua Beach that can only be accessed from lift or staircase, Samabe Bali Suites & Villas showcases a romantic decoration with thousand lit candle. The private waiter will drag the seats to allow the guests to sit on the wooven rattan chairs with round table in front of them. The table is covered with white and turquoise clothes with red roses petals spread on it. Then, they will see the best thing about the dinner which is the marriage of turquoise ocean view and dark blue sky that they can enjoy while pampering their taste buds with delightful cuisines

NAME: Waroeng Bernadette, Ubud
DESCRIPTION: Waroeng Bernadette brings an iconic Indonesian dishes in the heart of Ubud. A place where you can taste the famous Indonesian Rendang that everyone talks about! Our menu is full of our childhood favorites, from starters – corn fritter, mains – signature rendang, oxtail soup, rawon, and a lot more options also available for vegan. Everything is homemade in the traditional style and from fresh ingredients. Selamat Makan, Waroeng Bernadette

NAME: Pala Restaurant & Rooftop Bar
DESCRIPTION: Set in the midst of a long pool within the main gardens, Pala Restaurant features live cooking stations with an extensive array of local and international cuisines. Located on the second floor of the restaurant, a sophisticated rooftop bar is offered as an addition to the venue, providing an ideal space for all-day relaxation with friends and family. Once the sun goes down, guests are invited for dinner under the night sky, uncovering the secrets of the stars. Restaurant Policies: - Please note that we may not be able to accommodate your requests for specific seating. - Dress code is Resort Chic: no sleeveless tops, board shorts or flip-flops for dinner time only. - For our guests’ convenience, the holding time for the tables will be 15 minutes from reservation time, and the table will be released automatically if the determined time has been reached. - Menu availability is subject to change without notice. Please contact the Restaurant for further details.

NAME: Sorrento Mediterranean Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Mediterranean cuisine for dinner with an exceptional choice of wines. Exclusive à la carte and buffet breakfast for The Level guests.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Jl. Raya Nusa Dua Selatan, Kawasan Pariwisata ITDC Lot. 1, Melia Bali Indonesia Hotel, 80363

NAME: The Cafe
DESCRIPTION: The Cafe offerings are designed to suit the most discerning guests. Each station is dedicated to preparing authentic cuisines from selected regions, ranging from fresh sashimi, oysters, and sushi rolls in the Japanese corner, Chinese barbequed ducks and pork, tasty tom yum goong and Thai salads at the Southeast Asian station, exotic butter chicken and naan from the Indian section, to a la minute pastas at the Western corner. The dessert section is abundant with chocolate fondues, homemade ice cream and sorbets, heavenly cakes and mousse. Aesthetical use of scale, screening and materials are combined to create an impressive yet approachable restaurant that welcomes guests to an intimate and relaxed resort environment. A place where guests may enjoy delectable meals in the restaurant and outdoor area looking over the lush landscape with large swimming pool and Indian Ocean views.

NAME: Prego
DESCRIPTION: Regarded as a popular Italian Restaurant in Bali, this lively eatery will be the perfect place to bring the entire family for a delicious meal of authentic Italian fare. It will be an inviting space that entices the senses with a colourful decor and the aroma of food being cooked in an open-concept kitchen. From freshly baked bread and pizzas to home-made pasta dishes topped with classic sauces, the entire menu will be filled with tempting options for those in search of Authentic Italian Restaurant in Bali. Even for just a gourmet coffee and dessert or a late night glass of wine, everyone will feel welcome at Prego! Sunday Brunch is available every Sunday from 12.00 am to 4 pm. Discover the all-you-can-eat Italian fiesta such as Antipasti Table, Bruschetta Bar, Italian Deli, Seafood on Ice, Tuscany Kitchen, Bistecca Di Fiorentina, Pizza Bar, Pasta Lab, The Grill, Dolce - Our Sweet Treats & Gelato Cups and so much more.

NAME: Soleil
DESCRIPTION: Soleil, the seaside restaurant of The Mulia, Mulia Resort & Villas - Nusa Dua, Bali offering Mediterranean and Pan-Asian cuisines. Specialized in delectable dishes with a Mediterranean touch, as well as exotic cuisines from Indonesia, Vietnam, and Thailand. Our internationally acclaimed chefs at Soleil are prepared to pamper your senses. Facing the magnificent view of the tranquil Indian Ocean, the two elegant marbled dining areas with outdoor spaces are adorned with warm and inviting interiors.

NAME: Daily Social Bali
DESCRIPTION: Located on Jalan Pantai Kuta, this pool-front dining venue serves a majestic view of the famous Kuta Beach and its sunset. Daily Social Bali is a perfect gathering place to celebrate special occasions with family, friends, business networks, and the community that features six interactive hubs ranging from the Asian Comfort to Seafood Bar.

NAME: Ikan Restaurant & Bar
DESCRIPTION: The quiet, meandering coast of Nusa Dua just welcomed a thrilling addition into its neighborhood. Having undergone a complete revamp, Ikan at The Westin Resort Nusa Dua, Bali offers a one-of-a-kind destination to dine, drink and savor life at its best. With its beachfront location, the open-air restaurant and bar is highly visible from afar due to its contemporary island look. Ikan’s thatched roof, tactile furniture and locally inspired design elements offer two different experiences during the day and the night. A casual eatery by day and an elevated dining destination by night, Ikan serves fresh seafood and Indonesian-inspired cuisine by the beach.

NAME: Ely's Kitchen Ubud
DESCRIPTION: Ubud, Bali, and Indonesia are famous for their amazing cuisines. Their use of exotic spices, fresh produce, and diverse culinary heritage tells a story in its every bite. For those looking to try it, look no further than Adiwana Unagi Suite’s dining venue: Ely’s Kitchen Ubud. Aside from Indonesia, this restaurant also features other Asian cuisines.

NAME: Izakaya by Oku
DESCRIPTION: Inspired by the award-winning OKU Japanese Restaurant Jakarta, Izakaya by OKU emphasises bringing out the best of its creations, in a dynamic and convivial atmosphere. This Japanese restaurant in Bali offers a bistro-chic setting and an open-kitchen dining experience, where guests and the chefs interact for deeper enjoyment. The elaborately crafted dishes consist of the finest ingredients, combined with the latest composition techniques to serve a truly tasteful and artistic piece of art on a plate. In accordance with the recent advisory announced by the government of Bali, issued on 08 January 2021, please be informed that our dining facilities operate with limited seating capacity and all venues close at 22:30 every evening until further notice.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Jl. Raya Nusa Dua Selatan, The Apurva Kempinski Bali, 80361

NAME: DAVA Steak & Seafood Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Located next to AYANA Villas lobby, DAVA offers exquisite wines, freshest seafood and the finest prime steak set against stunning, elevated ocean sunset views. Our menu features elevated steakhouse classics such as 21 days of Himalayan salt aged Stockyard Kiwami Wagyu Beef and Grilled Canadian Lobster. DAVA is also available for a la carte breakfast exclusively for villa guests.

NAME: Lotus Asian Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Southeast Asian restaurant accompanied by a traditional Balinese cabaret interpreting all the mythical stories of Bali.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Kawasan Wisata ITDC Lot. 1, Hotel Melia Bali Indonesia, 80363

NAME: Kuta Social Club
DESCRIPTION: Perched high above the palms, Kuta Social Club is Bali’s most exclusive rooftop pool club, where fun and flavour collide – and the party has always just begun. Go on – make a splash. Toast the sunset. Drink the view.

NAME: Village Square-Wok Wok
DESCRIPTION: Wok Wok hits the spot with its mouthwatering menu of Indonesian comfort food. Indulge in dishes showcasing flavors from around the archipelago, including Balinese favorites whose rich blend of spices will leave your taste buds tingling for more.

NAME: Boy'N'Cow
DESCRIPTION: Boy’N’Cow is an industrial dry-aged meat boutique and cocktail lounge that delivers quality produce from scratch, using only the finest ingredients from across the globe. We LOVE meat and specialise in dry-aging all of our beef right here on site. With a share-style menu, handcrafted cocktails, and upbeat atmosphere, Boy’N’Cow combines tasty, honest food with the ultimate dining experience.

NAME: Ketela Eatery & Lifestyle
DESCRIPTION: Ketela is an eatery in Batubolong, Canggu with focus on healthy lifestyle. All menus are designed to be sustainable, tasty yet wholesome with plenty of vegan friendly options. Set amongst beautiful, organic & sustainable bamboo structure, designed by award winning architect Mr. Ketut Arthana of Arte Architect, at Ketela you will surely relax your mind, body and spirit whilst enjoying delicious food and refreshing beverage. Make Ketela the highlight of your visit to the beautiful & vibrant Canggu.

NAME: BKeto Bali
DESCRIPTION: Fresh, healthy cuisine awaits at Bketo Bali, a wellness inspired eatery overlooking the garden and pool at Blue Karma Dijiwa Seminyak. Our Executive Chef seeks out premium local ingredients to create low-carb, high-flavor Keto dishes that are low in carbohydrates and high in flavor. Bketo Bali offers seating outdoors on a covered patio that overlooks the pool and tropical lawn or indoors where the atmosphere is cool and quiet. The decor includes hand-carved wooden furnishings, plush cushions, and striking Indonesian artworks. At Bketo we specialize in ketogenic cuisine. The vibrant dishes are loaded with vegetables, proteins, and healthy fats to provide the maximum amount of nutrients without unnecessary starches and carbohydrates. Each dish is layered with flavor and supremely satisfying. The Bketo kitchen is open from morning to evening with a wide array of options to suit all tastes. Fuel up for the day with fruit salad, eggs just the way you like them, and coffee. Light bites i

NAME: St Tropez
DESCRIPTION: "St. Tropez is Temporarily Closed" St. Tropez is Temporarily Closed for business. A new and exciting project is coming. Enjoy Finns Platinum Bar and other dining areas at our beautiful, beach-front venue. Stay tuned for exciting developments. Thank you for your understanding and support. Finns Management

NAME: Banger Place - Pizza x Art x Love
DESCRIPTION: Discover Banger: Classic Italian Cuisine with a Modern Twist! Banger is the go-to spot for young and energetic individuals seeking a captivating Italian dining experience fused with a modern touch. Our menu features traditional Italian dishes crafted with innovative flair, including wood-fired pizzas, refreshing salads, irresistible desserts, homemade lasagnas and delightful array of breakfasts. But Banger is more than just a restaurant; it's a vibrant bar where you can enjoy signature cocktails, good music, and a lively atmosphere. Step into our eclectic space blending Baroque elegance, graffiti, and pop-art vibes. Join us at Banger for an unforgettable fusion of classic Italian flavors and contemporary excitement!

NAME: Senja Bar & Resto
DESCRIPTION: At Senja bar & resto, orchestrating your culinary delights our Chef brings passion and perfection to his specialities. His personal approach to hospitality has made his one of the best-loved characters and his passion for the food combined with the freshest and purest produce has made his extraordinary cuisine. The views will take your breath away at lunchtime when a panorama of the Ubud’s lush gr

NAME: Cretya Lite
DESCRIPTION: The Taste of Asia

NAME: Waroeng Bernadette
DESCRIPTION: Waroeng Bernadette brings an iconic Indonesian dishes in the heart of Seminyak. A place where you can taste the famous Indonesian Rendang that everyone talks about! Our menu is full of our childhood favorites, from starters – corn fritter, mains – signature rendang, oxtail soup, rawon, and a lot more options also available for vegan. Everything is homemade in the traditional style and from fresh ingredients. Selamat Makan, Waroeng Bernadette
GENERAL_LOCATION: Jl. Kayu Aya No.17, Kayu Aya Square Oberoi, 80361

NAME: HQ Uluwatu
DESCRIPTION: New Concept of Bar & Restaurant in Pecatu - Bali

NAME: Grazing on the Green
DESCRIPTION: MEDITERRANEAN DINING ON THE LAWN - Unique to Finns VIP Beach Club; enjoy a picnic on the manicured ocean front lawn. Picnic set up including blanket and pillows available open from Wednesday until Sunday from 3 PM!

NAME: Cretya Sunset
DESCRIPTION: Day Club and Restaurant with greenery ricefield and sunset view in Ubud.

NAME: Tanah Liat Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: A pottery atelier and cooking lab by day, Tanah Liat transforms by evening into an arts-and-crafts inspired restaurant focusing on experiential food highlighting Bali-sourced fresh seasonal seafood & plant-based cuisines.

NAME: Sushi Bar Bali
DESCRIPTION: Savour the flavours of Japanese in Canggu and tuck into a dish of ocean fresh fish while enjoying sunset views and a sake or two! Sushi Bar chefs are transforming the freshest seafood into some of the most amazing Japanese cuisine. With over 15 years experience from The Caymans to Ritz Carlton, these guys are well versed in the delicate art of sushi and no strangers to Tempura or Sashimi! The Sushi Bar offers some of the best Japanese food in Bali. Dine alfresco style by one of Finns many bars and pools and select from one of the most comprehensive sushi menus in Bali with a Japanese inspired cocktail or sake to wash it down! Lunch or dinner, for the best of Japanese in Canggu, stop by and try The Sushi Bar where fresh seafood is certainly the order of the day!

NAME: Mumbai Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: Savour the rich, flavoursome, authentic flavours and fragrances of India fresh from our tandoor oven. Watch as our Chefs prepare your chosen Indian dishes from the open kitchen. Featuring favourites such as, Chicken Tandoori, Chana Dal and Rogan Josh, using the freshest ingredients and the most fragrant spices to tantalise your taste buds.

NAME: Asri Dining By Samanvaya
DESCRIPTION: Samanvaya is proud of their culinary philosophies and paddock to plate food offerings. Seasonal, organic and locally sourced where possible, we even offer guests the opportunity to discover the local food markets with our chef. From traditional Indonesian dishes to European inspired delights, we aim to cater to all tastes and requirements. Children under the age of 10 years are welcome at our establishment until 6pm nightly. After this time our restaurant is only open to guests over the age of 12 years. We also ask that if children are in the restaurant prior to 6pm that they are not disruptive to other dining guests. Dogs: we only allow dogs to be in the garden of our restaurant and all dogs must be on a lead and kept at the diners table

NAME: Pasir Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Mediterranean Oasis in the Heart of Ubud

NAME: Lion X Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Lion X is a contemporary Chinese restaurant with innovative tastes and stunning yet discrete design features. Enjoy handmade daily fresh Dim Sum lunch and dinner of Cantonese and Szechuan heritage cuisine with a modern twist.

NAME: Sateria Beachfront Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Visit the best beachfront restaurant to enjoy cuisine that transports you to the shores of the Mediterranean. Lunch and dinner service comes with chilled sangria, grilled seafood, hearty salads and pasta, all accompanied by a great live band.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Jl. Raya Nusa Dua Selatan, Kawasan Pariwisata ITDC Lot 1, Meliá Bali, 80363

NAME: Stones Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: A vibrant open kitchen design brings excitement to classic European-style cafe dining, while live cooking stations provide theatrical flavors to the delightful offering of tantalizing menus served inside this popular restaurant in Bali.

NAME: Fire
DESCRIPTION: Savor the complex flavors of dry-aged, flame-cooked meat and sizzling seafood at our iconic Seminyak hotspot. Inspired by Bali's striking Kecak dance, FIRE is an indulgent grill restaurant beloved for its playful twist on the island's mysticism. Sit back and survey a phenomenal wine list under the light of a fireball chandelier.

NAME: Naughty Nuri's Seminyak
DESCRIPTION: Inspired by Nuri’s simple beginnings as a roadside warung in Ubud, the new restaurant brings a taste of Bali, Nuri’s iconic combination of delicious ribs and martinis to a whole new locale. The new restaurant draws on the original, with a smoking outdoor grill and a rustic vibe but with seats for 130, even more carnivores can devour Nuri’s generous rib slabs marinated in the top secret sauce. We're open for dine in, take away and delivery.

NAME: Melali Ubud Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: From its prime street-front position, Melali Ubud serves up a colourful menu of modern food inspired by fresh ingredients that have been sourced and prepared with integrity. From generous salad and smoothie bowls to catch-of-the-day seafood, protein-rich legumes and red meat in moderation, every dish is a celebration on a plate bursting with natural goodness. Styled to reflect a carefree summer patio, Melali Ubud caters to 40 people with a choice of indoor and outdoor seating options.

NAME: Simply Social
DESCRIPTION: Simply Social is a brand-new eatery and bar located on the main street of Ubud with views out towards the alluring hustle and bustle Ubud Raya street, where unique traditional culture meets modernity. Bringing in fresh flavors from all over the world, all these delightful cuisines from native, Asia, and international-inspired will tempt your palate for a sensational journey of taste. Our food philosophy is simple - to present super fresh and delectable gourmet meals to you in a spirit of sharing and abundance. Nestled within the extraordinary vibes of Ubud, Simply Social enhances the distinctive offerings of Ubud which are known to be quirky but exclusive, wellness and vigorous, and all these attractive results of melting pots of all unique individuals and culture around the world whilst maintaining its true self. Simply Social is your ultimate one of a kind noteworthy eatery and bar to experience all these hypes. Unveil fun vibes and savor fresh flavors at Simply Social!

NAME: Scusa Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Serving exquisite layered flavors and bright aromas that Mediterranean cuisine is famous for, Scusa offers relaxed dining in the breezy terrace lounge surrounded by white and blue accents reminiscent of the islands around the Aegean Sea. Join us for a melodic Gin and Tonic Soiree at SCUSA every Wednesday to Sunday at 18:00 - 22:00.

NAME: Roosterfish Beach Club
DESCRIPTION: Roosterfish Beach Club is located at Pandawa Beach, one of the most famous and beautiful beaches in Bali. With a large beachside pool flanked by bamboo cabanas and sun loungers, a restaurant and a bar, live DJs and entertainment Roosterfish Beach Club offers a great beach day out for everyone. Our beach-inspired menu is served all day long, featuring a selection of bites, salads, grilled meats and fish, wood-fired pizzas, local favorites and fun desserts.

NAME: Ambar Ubud Bar
DESCRIPTION: Ambar Ubud Bar encapsulates the vibrant essence of Bali, creating a symphony of flavors through our exquisite Japanese fusion gastronomy and expertly crafted cocktails. As the signature sunset of Ubud, Bali paints the sky, immerse yourself in the experience with our mixologist’s curated selection of cocktails, each one a masterpiece in its own right. Our dining offers a tantalizing journey into Japanese fusion, promising an indulgence for the senses. To complete your experience, our daily live jazz performance infuses the atmosphere with infectious energy, ensuring that every moment at Ambar Ubud Bar is filled with liveliness and unforgettable memories.

NAME: The Grumpy Butcher
DESCRIPTION: Smoke & Grill Restaurant

NAME: Bondi Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Bondi Restaurant offers modern international dining featuring the freshest ingredients to create tantalizing dishes enjoyed from morning through until night. Visit the showcase display featuring daily fresh baked bread, croissants, donuts, brownies, cookies, cruffins, cakes, tartlets and more. All day dining options include fresh salads, a comprehensive grazing section, amazing wood fired pizzas, and a selection of platters designed with sharing in mind. Bondi is all about freshness and flavor, utilizing fresh, locally sourced ingredients where possible.

NAME: Kepitu Restaurant At The Kayon Resort
DESCRIPTION: KEPITU is taken from the Banjar next to the resort, The Restaurant is set in the eficentrum of the resort with 180 degrees view over the pool and jungle landscape creates and ambiance perfect for an iced cold beer and cocktails. Designed with Kayon shaped using iron wood, bamboo and Alang-Alang Grass roof creates a Truly Ubud atmosphere. The lunch menu is light and healthy, a mixture of sandwich and salads. In the evening the menus are mixed western, Asian and Signature Kepitu menu with Balinese Royal setting and with weekly Balinese Culture diner program for a truly Ubud Experience. Incorporate with the floating sky roof deck dining space with The Kumbakarna Statue setting, Kepitu is the favorite and romantic dining venue The Children below 15 years old, senior citizen/people who are having mobility issues, drone, durian are not permitted at our restaurant. We gladly accept reservations for dining experience at Kepitu Restaurant to avoid for disappointments

NAME: DONBIU
DESCRIPTION: Open for breakfast and dinner, DONBIU is a relaxed Balinese-inspired restaurant where guests can enjoy a range of themed buffets with traditional local cuisine and an array of international favourites. Live acoustic or cultural performance take place on Themed Buffet Dinner.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Jl. Padma no. 1, Padma Resort Bali, 80361

NAME: Boneka Restaurant at The St. Regis Bali Resort
DESCRIPTION: From the vantage point of Boneka, the spectacular views at sunrise might entice guests to enjoy a fresh, A la carte breakfast early in the day. Prepared fresh, the menu includes premium ingredients such as lobster egg omelet and fine selection of sashimi. In addition to our signature egg nouvelle, lobster ragout filled egg shell; our chefs walk around and offer their personal and special creations. An extension to the scrumptious breakfast experience at Boneka, our special Sunday Brunch features A la carte breakfast favorites of Wagyu Beef Steak and Eggs, Lobster Egg Omelet, along with sumptuous lunch options

NAME: Ohana Restaurant, Bar & Kidsparadise
DESCRIPTION: Open Space Restaurant With Huge Supervised Playground In The Garden

NAME: Tablespoon Ubud
DESCRIPTION: Europe and Asia has a long relationship when it come to food, dated back to introduction of spices to western world. Tablespoon was born to showcase culinary relationship between European and Asian. Indulging our guest with comfort European and Asian Dishes made using locally sourced ingredients from the highland and sea of Bali.

NAME: Monsoon Bali
DESCRIPTION: Bali's Only Genuine Party Dining Experience We have changed the game, introducing a unique experience of dining and entertainment never seen before in Bali. Take part in Bali’s only genuine party dining and let us embark you on a mouthwatering journey around the world with an extraordinary selection of 6 different cuisines, each crafted to perfection.

NAME: Uma Tiki Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: A mix of Bali Aga classic touch and the rustic modern art, Korurua Dijiwa Ubud presents a unique simple dining experience by the street side of Junjungan village where the beauty of art coincides with the purity of tradition has to offer. By its name, Uma Tiki upholds a beautiful image for the guardian of family heritage. Open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Dine in a beautiful open-air space surrounded by uniquely “ours” mural artworks, adjacent to Dewi Danu splash dipping pool to unwind the mind, body and soul. At night, candlelight contributes to a unique ambience across the night breezes. The Uma Tiki restaurant revives wide ranges of modern Indonesian local dishes, while incorporates elements of diverse cuisines of neighbouring countries. The menus are distinctively designed to feature our signature healthy & natural ingredients cuisine, sourced from the locally produced with many innovative fusion combinations.

NAME: Crystal Blue Ocean Grill
DESCRIPTION: Expect a warm welcome and personalized service from the staff. the Crystal Blue Ocean Grill is located atop the cliff against the Indian Ocean. This al-fresco restaurant is a perfect spot for your lunch after the beach or pool day while enjoying the light meal or suitable for your special dinner occasion.

NAME: Ankhusa Restaurant Ubud
DESCRIPTION: Ankhusa is originate of Ganesha’s weapon. Became a symbol of prosperity and fertility. Ankusha has eco-luxurious setting that accentuates the beauty of the menu and nature. The menu, which has an array of Balinese Food, Indonesian Food, international food is designed to give optimal nutrition for the guest aimed to nurturing the body with an array of local cuisine signature like the roasted duck, chicken satay and fried rice.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Jl. Raya Desa Kenderan No.88X, Aksari Resort, 80571

NAME: Blou Cafe Canggu
DESCRIPTION: Blou Café Canggu is open to anyone who would like to dine with us. Everyone is welcome in our signature restaurant that offers indoor dining, and outdoor dining overlooking our beautiful swimming pool.

NAME: Backstage Food Theatre
DESCRIPTION: A chic all-day dining restaurant celebrates freshness in its offerings and various live stations with chefs on the show. Backstage features wide selections of local and international favorites on its sumptuous buffet for Bali’s coolest breakfast experience. Backstage is located inside the Renaissance Bali Nusa Dua Resort.

NAME: Sukun Restaurant Kuta
DESCRIPTION: SUKUN RESTAURANT KUTA is a casual open-plan Indonesian Cuisine venue in a tropical setting. It has a laid-back summer vibe designed by Made Wijaya featuring fun wall cut-outs, colorful mosaic tiles, and a sky-inspired ceiling fitted with quirky light fixtures. There is space for up to 80 guests with clusters of designer table settings arranged for couples as well as small groups. Sukun Restaurant celebrates the diverse flavors of the Indonesian archipelago with a menu driven by island-fresh produce and seasonal specialties. A generous full breakfast table d'hôte is served every morning followed by home-style regional cuisine with a modern twist throughout the remainder of the day. With its carefree appeal, the restaurant provides the perfect spot to sit and escape Bali's heat. Thirsts are quenched with energy-boosting juices from the bar, along with a choice of favorite cocktails, cold beers, or spirit mixes. Open daily from 7 am to 11 pm for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

NAME: Bisma Valley
DESCRIPTION: At Bisma Valley, we believe in providing a haven where guests can relax, unwind, and connect with nature. Our bar lounge embraces the beauty of Ubud’s landscape, and we aim to provide a space where you can escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life, even for just a few moments.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Jl. Bisma, Ubud, Kec. Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, 80571

NAME: Padi Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Padi Restaurant is an ideal setting to allow you to relax, unwind and witness the beautiful emerald-green rice terraces of Sebali village. Come and enjoy our lunch, afternoon tea, happy hours, dinner and romantic candle lit dinner. We also offer Balinese cooking class to give you an experience of Balinese life and culture. Our master chef prepares a wide selection of modern Asian cuisine combined with refined list of wines and special cocktail to complement each meal. Located on Level 2, with a magnificent view of rice terraces and coconut trees, guests may enjoy the food and beverage selections from Padi Restaurant; both indoor – in the comfortable restaurant and bar – or outdoor by the pool. Savour local and international delights at Padi Restaurant and bar which offers a casual and contemporary ambience for guests to enjoy lunch or dinner with family and friends.

NAME: Tangi Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Set in our tropical dining hall with a striking view of Mas’ lush jungle, Tangi Restaurant offers world-class vegan soul food that will nourish your body, mind, and soul. Tangi is derived from one traditional herb used for medication in Usadha. Myrtle leaves and fruit contain a unique combination of organic compounds and nutrients that make it an interesting dietary addition as an herb and an invaluable source of essential oil. Locally sourced, exceptionally delicious, carefully thought, scrupulously prepared, and beautifully presented, our cuisine promises an unforgettable dining experience while giving health benefits. Tangi restaurant will bring you an exceptional experience by presenting Balinese cuisine from around the world, and sourcing authentic plants.

NAME: Kabana Ubud
DESCRIPTION: Kabana welcomes you to Indonesia’s most prominent Jungle Pool Club. With four different levels and eight swimming pools, it’s an invitation to celebrate life in Ubud’s majestic jungle and nature. The pool Club will be welcoming guests with multiple food and beverage outlets cascading down the natural contours of the ravine to a river below. It will be a place for all kinds of celebrations, with various exclusive events with some of the world’s best DJs.

NAME: Tropical Temptation Beach Club
DESCRIPTION: Nestled on the foreshore of Melasti Beach, one of the most well-known beaches in Bali. An immersive bamboo structure was specifically designed by locals to our Balinese heritage rooted in artisanship. Uninterrupted views of Melasti’s spectacular beach offer a dramatic view. As the sun gives way to the moon, find a fresh and invigorating ambiance and sink into the comfort of a daybed or sofa with an aperitif or a signature cocktail, served with locally inspired food as a live daily DJ sets the mood for reveling.

NAME: Botanist Restaurant Ubud
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in globally inspired fare and wellness cuisine at the Botanist Restaurant at Blue Karma Dijiwa Ubud. Our innovative chef sources local ingredients and superfoods to create divine dishes for all meals of the day. Specialty dishes include health-boosting moringa and matcha creations, along with additional offerings from the land and sea. Step into the open-sided setting of Botanist Restaurant and you find yourself in a charming rustic chic space awash with natural wood and Indonesian artworks and textiles. Settle in at a table or on one of the comfortable sofas and let the gentle breezes wash over you. Start the day with a fresh fruit juice and a vitamin-packed smoothie bowl. Lunchtime offerings include silky soups, matcha seared salmon, and crisp and colorful salads. Stop by in the evening for hearty BBQ pork ribs, pasta or vegetarian curry. Pair your meal with our house-made kombucha, a cold cocktail or a glass of wine. Our menu is designed to cater to all types of dietary

NAME: Wild Vegan
DESCRIPTION: Vegan Restaurant based on medicinal food

NAME: Kemukus Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Join our culinary journey at Kemukus Restaurant, a casual dining convenience with nothing but the warmth of Balinese heritage. Kemukus name is taken from Sanskirt word means ‘dining together’. Joglo Sunset Bar Comfortable cushions on floor matched with solid table make the time spent at the bar effortless. Get your favourite mix from our talented bartender and savour the m

NAME: Kwee Zeen
DESCRIPTION: Immerse yourself in the lively and aromatic atmosphere of Kwee Zeen, the all-day dining sensation at Sofitel Bali Nusa Dua Beach Resort. This 160-seat Pan Asian restaurant celebrates the vibrant street food culture of Southeast Asia and international favourites. Start your day with an extensive breakfast buffet, savour a delightful à la carte lunch, and embark on a culinary adventure with themed buffets showcasing Indonesian, Indian, Chinese, Singaporean, Thai, and Japanese cuisines. Indulge in a variety of noodles, ramen, Udon, Soba, Sushi, and Sashimi. Experience the excitement of live cooking stations featuring satay, robatayaki, teppanyaki, tempura, pots, Chinese and Japanese steamships. A highlight of the restaurant is the fire pit, where whole lambs are expertly carved. Join us at Kwee Zeen for a warm and flavourful dining experience that will satisfy all your culinary cravings.

NAME: Kepitu Restaurant at The Kayon Valley Resort
DESCRIPTION: A signature restaurant at The Kayon Valley Resort Ubud, Kepitu Restaurant is set in the resort’s epicenter with an uninterrupted 180 degrees view over the Kayon swimming pool and tropical jungle terrain. Its unique shape design using ironwood, bamboo, and Sirat Roof creates an idyllic Ubud atmosphere for either long lunches, afternoon cocktails, or romantic dinners. The lunch menu is a light and nutritious selection of sandwiches and salads. The dinner menu is Western, Asian, and Signature Kepitu dishes in a Royal Balinese setting. Opt for the weekly Culture Diner program for an authentic Ubud experience, or reserve a romantic dinner for two on its floating sky roof deck with The Kumba Karna Statue setting.

NAME: Reef Beach Club
DESCRIPTION: Nestled in an expansive beachfront setting of Nusa Dua and surrounded by tropical gardens, Reef Beach Club offers a laid-back venue with a relaxed, fun, and family-friendly environment. A spectacular scene, this venue is equipped with its iconic 42-m infinity pool, cabanas, sun-loungers, sunbathing spots on the golden–exclusive beachfront, watersport activities, and indoor-restaurant setting. Charcoal-grilled flavor captures the essence of Bali’s tropical ambiance, featuring premium – succulent meat and sizzling seafood. In addition to the eclectic options, 30 selections of Rosé and a refreshing line of elevated cocktails are offered, each uniquely created by the talented sommelier and mixologists. As the sun beats down on the shores, the dynamic feel is transformed into a romantic ambiance with bonfire and live music performance in the background under the stars. Reef Beach Club is a vibrant venue suited for individuals, couples, communities, and family alike.

NAME: Rempah-Rempah
DESCRIPTION: Rempah-Rempah Restaurant offers the experience of luxury dining of a five-star resort in Bali with Asian, Mediterranean, and Balinese cuisine. The ocean view highlights the tranquil ambiance of the restaurant. A buffet style meal is only available for breakfast and special event.

NAME: Akasa Jumeirah Bali
DESCRIPTION: Cliffside restaurant offers flame-grilled with an Asian twist. With stunning views of the Indian Ocean, AKASA serves up a refined menu of Asian-inspired grills cooked over aromatic wood.

NAME: Cucina
DESCRIPTION: Experience the newly revamped Cucina at Sofitel Bali Nusa Dua Resort, where an invigorating new look awaits. Led by Italian head chef, Chef Patrizia Battolu, the culinary team introduces a relaxed yet vibrant atmosphere and a zero-waste concept uniform. Step into the grand entrance, elegant bar areas, and the new mozzarella pizza bar with a unique copper “beech” oven. Every element of Cucina harmoniously blends warm colours, Italian cuisine, and music, evoking a sense of nature through its interior design. Don’t miss the magnificent Cucina Brunch, curated by Chef Patrizia Battolu and her team, available every Sunday from 11am to 3pm. This extraordinary culinary experience brings together a fusion of cuisines, featuring an array of Italian,

NAME: GENJI Teppanyaki & Japanese Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Authentic Japanese restaurant serving bestTeppanyaki & Sushi in Nusa Dua Bali, where culinary excellence meets the art of teppanyaki and a delightful à la carte menu. Discover the sizzle of our teppanyaki grill as our skilled chefs masterfully prepare your meal right before your eyes, creating a mesmerizing dining experience filled with flair and flavor. Alternatively, explore our à la carte menu, offering a diverse selection of Japanese culinary treasures, from fresh sushi and sashimi to richly flavored ramen and succulent teriyaki dishes. At Genji, you'll embark on a gastronomic journey through the exquisite flavors and traditions of Japan, all set in a contemporary and inviting ambiance. Whether you choose the interactive teppanyaki experience or the à la carte delights, expect a symphony of taste that will leave you craving more. Genji presents all of your favorite Japanese specialties in the naturally dining room, Teppanyaki tables, sushi bar or private Tatami Room.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Jl. Pantai Mengiat, Ayodya Resort Bali, 80363

NAME: Sa'Mesa Canggu & Seminyak
DESCRIPTION: Sa'Mesa (The Table) is an award-winning experience dining Restaurant which combines authentic, traditional Italian recipes with a modern twist. Book a seat for dinner and enjoy around 15 - 18 delicacies from the kitchen served family-style over several courses in an unseen Dinner Experience. A new culinary experience created by food lovers for food lovers. A mix between Grandmother's Table, Fine Dining Kitchen & the craziest night out ever. Experience Dining at its finest. PS: FREEFLOW Limoncello every night!

NAME: Air Cafe & Lounge
DESCRIPTION: An intimate open restaurant shaded by Banyan tree and surrounded by lush tropical gardens. Our Chef creates signature that highlighted by local freshest ingredient and material. Banyan Bali all day dining experience will enrich your culinary experience in the island of Gods.

NAME: AKAR by K Club Ubud
DESCRIPTION: Akar - which translates to root in English, will reconnect you to the greatness of what mother earth has to offer through modern and elaborated dishes and cocktails. Celebrate tasteful, colorful, and festive dishes with locally sourced organic and fresh products. Our Chef Wayan will enchant your palate with charcoal-fired grilled meats, veggies, and seafood. We are happy to use these techniques to offer you new gustatory experiences. The restaurant is delighted to ensure that all menu options meet your wants and needs and offers various dietary possibilities.

NAME: Hai Ri Zen
DESCRIPTION: "Hai Ri Zen" is a "Small Plate Restaurant" allowing for choice and variety. As a guide the size of each serving is larger than a traditional entree but smaller than the usual main course. Our chef recommends two to three courses plus a desert." It is truly unique with it’s natural bamboo style architecture. The venue is chic and offers a spectacular and uninterrupted views of Mount Agung and the turquoise blue ocean.

NAME: The Ratip Coffee Shop & food
DESCRIPTION: Local restaurant that feeds food for tourists who travel and vacation on Nusa Lembongan, the price of food is very affordable. We serve breakfast, lunch and dinner with a variety of Indonesian food, Asian Food, Western food, Vegetarian, Grill and fresh juice and coffee shop menus.

NAME: Edesia, Crowne Plaza Today New Delhi Okhla
DESCRIPTION: Relish the world on a plate at the all day dining restaurant Edesia. A live show kitchen experience or an intimate poolside dinner, a buzzing hop to the bar with your tribe or the fun alfresco vibe- you decide! Savour the best of international delicacies and regional cuisines prepared with utmost care and hygiene. We are open for Takeaway. For Home Delivery, type Edesia on your Swiggy or Zomato app.

NAME: Dakshin
GENERAL_LOCATION: Sheraton New Delhi Hotel, 1st Floor, District Centre, Saket, 110017

NAME: K3
DESCRIPTION: Referred to as the dining phenomena of the city, this all-day diner is our expertise to bring the food theatre to you. At any of the meal hours, you could see our Chefs in action at the three live kitchens and choose from an array of dishes from Mediterranean, Asian and Indian Cuisines, all prepared by our 3 Master Chefs and their teams.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 4 Lobby Level Asset Area, JW Marriott New Delhi Aerocity, 110045

NAME: NYC
DESCRIPTION: Timing: 24/7 Buffet Breakfast: 6.30 am -10.30 am Buffet Lunch: 12.30-3 pm, Buffet Dinner: 7 pm - midnight Offering a vibrant 24/7 dining experience, NYC is a global cuisine maven offering fabulous buffet breakfast, lunch, dinner and an a la carte menu featuring dishes from across the world. Every date is a new experience at NYC as the restaurant takes guests on a new culinary passage as the theme changes every day throughout the year. NYC's interactive show kitchen and cooking stations make the dining experience more immersive and remarkable. Options at NYC Offering freshness, NYC has introduced a special spread of salad/ raw food bar, designed for the health conscious. Salad platters and individual pre-portioned salads are displayed for both vegetarians and non-vegetarians separately. The under counter refrigerator at the salad bar holds salads for replenishments and has an action station to toss the salads fresh.
GENERAL_LOCATION: National Highway 8, Radisson Blu Plaza Hotel, Delhi Airport, Near Mahipalpur Extension, Block R, Mahipalpur Village, 110037

NAME: Viva - All Day Dining
DESCRIPTION: Viva -All day dining is a vibrant and lively place featuring cuisines from around the world; serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner in a show kitchen style contemporary setting. The large glass window panes add life to the restaurant during the day and the restaurant's subtle lighting makes it the ultimate place to dine in the evenings. The culinary offerings are complemented by the warm and attentive service of our staff.

NAME: Thyme
GENERAL_LOCATION: National Highway 48, Rajokri Rd, D Block, 6:Samalkha, 110037

NAME: Infinity
DESCRIPTION: With an abundance of natural light Infinity offers a relaxing and refreshing ambience. Located on the lobby level, this all-day dining restaurant offers an extensive buffet featuring International delicacies along with the best of local cuisine. The ala carte menu has an Italian flair and will entice your 5 senses. Focused on carefully choosing only the freshest ingredients, the creative recipes of Infinity translate the Italian cuisine at its best - simple and bursting with flavour.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 13 B, Mayur Vihar Phase 1, District Centre, 110091

NAME: Adrift Kaya New Delhi
DESCRIPTION: ADRIFT Kaya is born out of a decade-long love affair between Chef David Myers and the awe-inspiring city of Tokyo. Inspired by the traditional izakaya restaurants that are found throughout Japan, ADRIFT Kaya is a culinary experience that invites guests not just to dig into Chef Myers’ playful and flavor-forward cuisine, but to also embark on a special journey that will take them straight to the buzzing alleyways of Tokyo. The menu may be inspired by tradition but it is defined by Myers’ modern Californian food philosophy. You can expect seafood & meat that has been carefully selected for its quality and origin. For the perfect finishing touch, you can choose between an array of fine wines, Japanese craft beer and a specially curated cocktail list.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Asset Area 4, Hospitality District, Near Indra Gandhi International airport, Near Indra Gandhi International Airport, 110037

NAME: Tamra
DESCRIPTION: Our international cuisine restaurant, Tamra is a vibrant, lively, and fun space suited to all types of dining occasions, offering a blend of modern culinary styles. Our experienced and passionate chefs dish out a repertoire of authentic South East Asian cuisine as well as Indian and European fare. Tamra takes the culinary experience to another level with its exciting “world on your platter” concept.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 19 Ashoka Road, Shangri - La's - Eros Hotel Level One, 110001

NAME: Mosaic
DESCRIPTION: This multi cuisine restaurant serves international cuisine through Set Menu and a la carte options ranging from Indian, Italian, Chinese and Western delicacies. It offers a casual yet elegant ambiance. You can reserve your private dining area also.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Sector 10 Lobby Level Crowne Plaza, Twin District Centre, Rohini, 110085

NAME: Encalm Prive
DESCRIPTION: Prepare to immerse yourself in a world of indulgence and high-class comfort at Encalm Privé, the latest luxury airport lounge for business class travelers at the Delhi Airport. Behind the glass walls of this oasis of opulence, lies a sanctuary meticulously designed to offer passengers an exceptional and stress-free experience, where extravagance meets convenience.

NAME: Savannah Bar
GENERAL_LOCATION: National Highway 8, Near Igi Airport, Mahipalpur, Radisson Blu Plaza Delhi

NAME: The Great Kabab Factory
DESCRIPTION: The glorious taste of kababs made from age old recipes is the allure of this iconic restaurant, located at the lobby level of the Radisson Blu Plaza Delhi. Avant-garde interiors combined with the well-known classic menu, filled with delicious kababs and breads, make it an irresistible treat.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Lobby Level Radisson Blu Plaza National Highway 8, Mahipalpur Village, 110017

NAME: Kheer at Roseate House
DESCRIPTION: Kheer brings exquisite Indian cuisine par excellence teamed with the best street food offering an experience that marries traditional cooking with luxurious fine dining. Nestled on the first floor, Kheer is designed by Noriyoshi Muramatsu and can host over 250 guests. The restaurant is divided into four prominent areas – the live kitchen, the dining area, a mixology bar and a chic lounge.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Roseate House, Asset 10 Hospitality District Aerocity, 110037

NAME: La Piazza
GENERAL_LOCATION: Ring Rd, First Floor, Hyatt Regency Delhi, Near Fire Station, Bhikaji Cama Place, 110002

NAME: The Corner Lounge & Bar
DESCRIPTION: The Corner Lounge & Bar - Perfect Place for conversations, being an ideal choice for casual luncheons, refreshing cocktails and late night evening meal
GENERAL_LOCATION: Mayur Vihar Phase - 1, Crowne Plaza, Lobby Level, District Centre, 110091

NAME: Polo Lounge
GENERAL_LOCATION: Hyatt Regency, Ground Floor, Ring Road, Bhikaji Cama Place, 110066

NAME: Pluck
DESCRIPTION: As the name suggests Farmer’s Basket at Pluck is a dynamic place where food is talked about almost as enthusiastically as it is consumed. An innovative concept, wherein we bring the marketplace into the restaurant with a philosophy of “YOU CHOOSE, WE COOK“. Guests can select a wide range of fresh & organic raw materials and ingredients for dishes on their own, select the cooking & cuisine style – Indian, Asian or Continental and our team of culinary experts will cook sumptuous dishes as per their preference – taste, spices, preparation etc. In our endeavor to promote ‘LOCAL’ growers and agriculturalists – A high proportion of the produce used in the dishes is sourced directly from our own 5000 sq. ft. kitchen garden, the local farmers, small-scale artisan producers and harvest traders; alongside regional specialties from around the world.

NAME: Yi Jing
DESCRIPTION: Yi Jing draws inspiration from the essence and meaning in its title. ‘Yi’ means ‘to change’ and ‘Jing’ refers to ‘the classic’. It presents a cuisine philosophy that combines simplicity with contemporary interpretations from across the diverse regions of China. The menu repertoire celebrates dominant culinary traditions from Sichuan and Hunan provinces, incorporating traditional cooking techniques and unique ingredients in refreshing and inventive ways. The highlights of this pan Chinese culinary line up are the intricately handcrafted dimsums, deftly pulled handmade noodles, barbecued specialties, immersive tastes from the wokery and delectable desserts that are comforting and adventurous at the same time. Enjoy the vibrant environs at Yi Jing, custom curations at the restaurant’s private dining rooms and this unique culinary journey.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Sheraton New Delhi Hotel, District Center Saket, Saket, 110017

NAME: L'Osteria Bella
DESCRIPTION: L 'Osteria Bella at Holiday Inn New Delhi International Airport is bright, colorful, packed with cozy seating, quirky wall art, and a Mediterranean vibe. Featuring Italian food, the menu offers a great choice from a selection of pizzas, pasta and grills; and the gelato cart for those with a sweet tooth.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Aerocity Access Rd, Holiday Inn New Delhi International Airport, 110037

NAME: Kiyan, The Roseate
DESCRIPTION: Kiyan at The Roseate New Delhi is the resort’s all day world cuisine restaurant serving predominantly European, Indian and Thai. The restaurant is set amidst Isfahan columns surrounded by royal blue water bodies. Discover masterpieces on every platter that offers you the ideal ‘Farm to Table’ concept with fare from select organic, home grown vegetables from our 2 acre farm and free range meat. Each dish on the menu has been handcrafted by our expert chefs.

NAME: Grappa, Shangri-La Eros New Delhi
DESCRIPTION: "Ciao" from the Capital City Elevating the capital’s nightlife scene, the ace mixologists at Grappa whip up some of the finest Italian-inspired barrel-aged cocktails, negronis and inventive cocktails that are simply whimsical. The menu is a gourmet makeover to the existing trend and focuses on small and tantalizing bites that are authentic, simple and fresh.

NAME: The Hangar Lounge & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Hangar Lounge and Bar offers a unique dining experience with its aviation-themed ambiance, featuring captivating interiors adorned with miniature airplanes and aircraft parts. This distinctive setting provides a wonderful culinary journey paired with exceptional service standards. The restaurant's extensive menu ensures a memorable dining experience, where each dish is crafted to perfection. Hangar Lounge and Bar stands out as a captivating destination where the love for aviation meets extraordinary dining.

NAME: Suruchi Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Suruchi is an authentic Rajasthani and Gujarati Thali Restaurant situated in New Delhi.It also serve Punjabi Thali & Mumbai snacks. It is a Award winning Restaurant serving the food lovers for more than 1 decade. If you are a food lover you can't miss this Restaurant while in Delhi.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Ground Floor 15a 56 Ajmal Khan Road, Opposite Lane to Roopak Store, Ajmal Khan Road, 110005

NAME: CIA Call it Asiian
GENERAL_LOCATION: Narmada Shopping Complex 13 - 16 Alaknanda Road, Opposite Don Bosco School, 110002

NAME: TK's Oriental Grill
GENERAL_LOCATION: Bhikaji Cama Place, Ring Road, Hyatt Regency, 110066

NAME: Del, Roseate House
DESCRIPTION: DEL is inspired by the aero code for Delhi and is an all-day bistro with changing menus at every meal time. With a seating capacity of 132 the bistro offers a choice of both indoor and alfresco dining option along with a posh private dining room that can accommodate up to 18 persons and opens to a sky lounge ideal to host corporate and social gatherings. DEL also houses a swanky bar, live cooking stations that would serve Continental and Chinese cuisine along with a Sushi island. A select salad station, cold spread counter followed by Indian fare and dessert buffet stations complete the place.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Del, Roseate House Asset 10, Hospitality District, Aerocity, 110002

NAME: Quoin
DESCRIPTION: Quoin is a modern sports bar and an urban hangout where you can find distinctive flavours of your favourite brew, mood-setting music and fresh locally produced mouth-watering bonne bouche & savouries that come together to provide you an experience like no other. At Quoin, guests can enjoy their favourite drinks round the clock. With an ‘Always Game On’ philosophy, similar to a signal to play in a sports match, Quoin is always ready to entertain the sports lovers by screening their favourite matches. With games like Foosball, Pool, a virtual real-life golf simulator and many board games. Guests can undertake many drinking challenges and games at Quoin. Golf simulator welcomes all the golf lovers to experience the real golfing at Quoin. They can practise, play and train or choose to solo or group golfing while enjoying their favourite food or sipping a drink.

NAME: Sampan - The Sky Lounge
DESCRIPTION: Media Leisure TestimonialHOW TO REACHTemprature: 32 C / 90 FHome> Sampan, New DelhiDiscover the true flavours of Asia at the all new SampanIt’s a sight to behold the moment you step inside Sampan at The Suryaa New Delhi. A panoramic view of Delhi shining under the stars spellbinds every visitor to this address of authentic Pan Asian cuisine in the heart of South Delhi. As you walk in you are greeted by a small cluster of tall Bamboo plants. The impressive interior of the restaurant is ready to cast its spell on you. The rich wooden texture on the walls and ceilings are highlighted by Oriental style custom crafted artifacts. Chinese letters are cleverly used as motifs at the open kitchen and the entrance door.The dim yet clever lighting adds an ethereal charm to the entire space. 3 different seating arenas, the formal table set up, the luxurious lounge seating with couches and sofas and a discrete private dining area would again amaze you with their contemporary elegance.While the ambience eases you with its warmth, the vast selection of popular and not-so-well-known culinary treasure promises an unforgettable experience. The new menu is dotted with the best from China in terms of remarkable Cantonese, bold Sichuan, traditional Mandarin, new-age Shanghai and Beijing cuisines. The South-East Asian section offers lesser known jewels from Myanmar like the delicious Monhinga, Mandalay curries and the Panthé. The Thai selection is extensive with robust Massamans, the hung lay from north and the Penang style seafood and commercial styles from Bangkok. Relish the East Asia with Vietnamese Popiah, Indonesian Sambals, Malay Rojak and the Japanese Hitoku with the universally popular Singaporean chilli crabs. The Japanese selection is an aesthetic collection of Ceviche style Sashimi, Chirashi sushi, Hina Matsuri Bentou, Tendon to a Macha-Misu. The teppan station plays a host to skilled chefs tossing anything from Foie gras, Prawn Cabrera to Uzura quails apart from the Somen and the Udons. A range of exclusive seafood like a Halibut, Black Cod, Scallops, and Blue Fin Tuna has been incorporated to occupy a pride of place.The show kitchen houses a versatile dumpling steamer to dole out scrumptious Har Gaws, Sui Mai, Bao and Tibetan momos. A duck rotisserie is now a part of the fleet to dish out a heavenly Beijing duck for the connoisseurs. A live sushi counter is another feather in the cap. To add a Delhi touch to the truly oriental fare, a dedicated page on ‘Local favourites’, a fusion of Chinese and local flavours, has been included to serve the local palate.
GENERAL_LOCATION: The Suryaa Hotel, 12th Floor, New Friends Colony, The Suryaa Hotel, New Friends Colony, 110065

At the time, Hanoi’s restaurant scene lacked the concept of small sized restaurants that offered a casual fine dining service with outstanding attention to detail. The Gourmet Corner arose from great aspirations and our ambition to set a new trend in Hanoi’s restaurant scene. Chefs create truly authentic Vietnamese food using the freshest, finest and highest quality of ingredients. The resulting menus combine tradition with innovation. However, our ambitions do not stop at serving classic iconic Vietnamese cuisine. We go one-step further and create an exclusive selection of signature dishes inspired by our young and talented Head Chef. Please visit our website to read more about our stories ;)

Here, every detail, every dish tells intriguing stories and ignites curiosity about the diverse culture of the S-shaped country. Ultimately, it is a hopeful aspiration for the beautiful cultural essence of Vietnam to leave a lasting impression on international travelers. Where flavors and traditions blend to create a unique cultural experience.

The talented mixologists will impress you with exquisite crafted cocktails or a full wine collection while you curl up in sofas, cushioned seats or high chairs, enjoying the sunset or the city lights and the music telling you to relax. NAME: Cai Mam Vietnamese Restaurant 2
DESCRIPTION: From north to south, from urban to rural areas of Vietnam, Cai Mam" is a very familiar object. For each family, "Cai Mam" appears twice in everyday; at lunch and at dinner. "Cai Mam" is a round tray used to contain objects, especially food. In the past, "Cai Mam" was made of wood. Today, the majority of "Cai Mam" trays are made of aluminum or stainless steel. During a meal, everyone in the family gather round “Cai Mam" with various and delectable food. It is the time for the family to care of each other, to share and to show solidarity. An indispensable cultural feature of Vietnamese tradition; at each "meal invitation", before eating, younger people invite the elders to show their deep gratitude with appreciation of the parents. Meanwhile, elders will nod affectionately, and the whole family will begin a meal in a fun atmosphere. What could be more touching than a New Year dinner, people reuniting with loved ones around the familiar "Cai Mam", and enjoy tasty homeland dishes.
