The concept addresses both operator and guest demands for local content in food, culture and setting, and maintains a 60% global versus 40% local ratio in all key aspects. Key appeals include the good food, affordability, comfort, efficient service and a fun, convivial environment. OPEN aims to be a Social Epicenter wherever it is located and to build a strong customer base and loyalty in the local community, thereby increasing hotel guest retention as well. The OPEN team is friendly, caring and knowledgeable. Diversity is respected and valued, among staff and guests.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 12 สุขุมวิทซอย 2, 10110

NAME: New York Steakhouse
DESCRIPTION: Year after year, New York Steakhouse earns its reputation as Bangkok’s best, and for good reason. Offering unmatched, personalized service and featuring the finest cuts of meat, New York Steakhouse stand in a league of its own. Featuring a dining room and décor meticulously designed to evoke the classic ambiance of a New York-style steakhouse, the atmosphere is unparalleled. We offer imported cuts sourced from Australia, Japan, New Zealand, and the United States, alongside local options and a tantalizing array of fresh seafood. Whether you’re seeking an unforgettable evening out or hosting a business dinner, New York Steakhouse is the epitome of elegance and is consistently recognized as an award-winning steakhouse, ensuring an impressive dining experience.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 4 สุขุมวิทซอย 2, โรงแรมเจดับบลิว แมริออท, 10110

NAME: SKIRT
DESCRIPTION: Where Fire meets Flavor SKIRT, where culinary excellence meets the art of fire and flavors. Our innovative concept revolves around the grill and wood fire, bringing a twist to your dining experience. At SKIRT, we believe in the power of fire and smoke to elevate flavors to new heights. We take pride in the art of aging where time plays a key role in unlocking the secrets of flavor. Our premium proteins, such as carefully selected prime cuts of beef, are given the time they deserve to reach the peak of tenderness and taste. With a dedication to quality ingredients, locally line caught fish and sustainably sourced meat and seafood grace our menu, ensuring a fresh and delectable experience. Our choice of vegetables is influenced by the seasons, with a focus on organically grown produce whenever possible. We cater to diverse dietary needs, with plant-based cuisine given distinct attention and care. Lunch last order 14:00 Dinner last order: 21:30
GENERAL_LOCATION: 21 Ocean Way, W Singapore - Sentosa Cove, 098374

NAME: Blu Kouzina Siglap
DESCRIPTION: A restaurant born out of the love of sharing a hearty meal with friends, spiced with quality olive oil and good wine. Since 2010, Blu Kouzina is recognised as one of the oldest Greek restaurants in Singapore. We are committed in bringing Greece to you by offering quality Mediterranean cuisine, great Greek wines and unique Hellenic products.

NAME: The Mind Cafe - Mega Outlet
DESCRIPTION: Board games cafe since year 2005 .We bring people together to play card games and board games over good food and drinks

NAME: Loulou - French Cuisine & Wine Bar
DESCRIPTION: Nestled into the vibrant Keong Saik Road, LouLou – French Cuisine & Wine Bar is a destination with a unique character. Loulou’s signature style from lunch through dinner and until late night cocktails is complemented by an authentic food menu that derives from the essence and tradition of South of France & Mediterranean cuisines. Enjoying a brunch, lunch or dinner at LouLou – French Cuisine & Wine Bar is like being invited in the home and to the table of an epicurean “bon vivant” from the French Riviera. The food at LouLou is sophisticated, yet generous and authentic while the atmosphere is convivial. Our Kitchen team strive to bring the best and freshest ingredients to the table, sharing generosity & conviviality of the French Riviera.

NAME: Avenue Singapore
DESCRIPTION: An intimate and sophisticated hideout, AVENUE Lounge is tucked away in the heart of The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands with its own stylish entrance along Bayfront Avenue. It is an elegant space that evokes the opulence of a lavish penthouse apartment, for those seeking a more intimate venue for a lavish night out. AVENUE Lounge brings to the table both classic and original, bespoke cocktails like The Sunny Island and Dancing In The Dark, and an enticing bar bites menu featuring Truffle Waffle Fries, Tuna Tartare Tacos and Wagyu Sliders. Engage in games and experiences such as a mini bowling alley, vintage arcade pinball and skee ball machines, a pool table, and top of the line Funktion One sound system. Expect a variety of different music genres on the different operating nights, catering to music lovers of all genres, from R&B, hip hop, to open-format mash-ups and more. The lounge also has its own rotation of resident DJs as well as feature guest artistes from around the world.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2 Bayfront Avenue, Basement 3, Marina Bay Sands Singapore, Entrance Via Level 1, 018972

NAME: Cappadocia Turkish & Mediterranean Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Located in Arab Street, CAPPADOCIA TURKISH & MEDITERRANEAN Restaurant is a purveyor of fine mediterranean dining from esteemed Turkish Chefs. CAPPADOCIA TURKISH & MEDITERRANEAN located in famous Kampong Glam. Since then, CAPPADOCIA TURKISH RESTAURANT has been serving both quality interpretations of classic dishes and daring new ventures into the uncharted territories of food.

NAME: Entre-Nous creperie
DESCRIPTION: ENTRE-NOUS creperie is a family run restaurant specialized in savoury and sweet crepes from Brittany (north-west part of France). Opened in october 2008 by a French couple. Their aim was to deliver crepes as traditional as you can find in Brittany. The crepes can be made of buckwheat or wheat flour ( certified from Brittany )and salted baratte butter is used to cook them on the spot on special pans called 'Biligs". You can choose from an extensive choice of homemade fillings. You can accompagny your meal by four different apple ciders served in the traditional "bolee". Homemade Soup,starters, ice-cream, quiche and desserts are also on the menu. The restaurant in a nautical theme can accomodate up to 30 guests ( for private events) inside and 13 in the al fresco area.

NAME: Anatolia Restaurant SG
DESCRIPTION: Turkish , Lebanese, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern food , vegetarian, vegan, gluten free options, halal

NAME: Dolcetto
DESCRIPTION: Dolcetto is all about the leisurely enjoyment of sweet idleness. Inspired by the charm and craftsmanship of the food purveyor shops that lie along the weaving streets and alleys of Italy, Dolcetto is an artisanal pasticceria and all-day mercatino that takes one from morning to evening, work to weekend, with its sumptuous array of Italian food and drinks.

NAME: The Courtyard
DESCRIPTION: Located in the heart of the historic Fullerton Building, The Courtyard is a timelessly elegant setting for leisure dining and the daily ritual of English afternoon tea. - The Courtyard's Traditional Afternoon Tea experience stays true to the English ritual with a classic assortment of finely cut sandwiches and delicate pastries. On selected days, a harpist enchants the high-ceiling atrium with melodious tunes. Enjoy a round of storied teatime staples, from the simple yet elegant cucumber sandwich, favoured by aristocrats in the Victorian era, to the distinctive Battenberg Cake — a quintessentially English dessert, created in 1884 as the royal wedding cake for Princess Victoria, granddaughter of Queen Victoria, and Prince Louis of the Battenberg family.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 1 Fullerton Square Fullerton Hotel, The Fullerton Hotel, 049178

NAME: Caviar
DESCRIPTION: Experience Touches of Luxury, Perpetuated by Passion. Caviar is a modern, luxurious, caviar-based fine-dining.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 390 Orchard Road Palais Renaissance, #B1-07 Palais Renaissance, 238871

NAME: The Kitchen Table
DESCRIPTION: the kitchen table is a restaurant where we believe food is an exquisite journey to be cherished. Our menu revolves around three pillars: Local Comfort Food, Plant-based Products, and Wood Fire Specialties, embodying our dedication to excellence, innovation, and sustainability. These specialties are served in W Singapore Sentosa Cove’s tropical ambiance, embellished with unparalleled view on the marina. Whether you're a passionate foodie or simply in search of a delightful meal, we invite you to savor our menu at tkt. With our unwavering commitment to quality, creativity, and sustainability, we are certain that you will find an experience that gratifies your senses and nourishes your soul. Join us for our weekly B&F programming, carefully designed to tantalize your taste buds and elevate your dining experience!
GENERAL_LOCATION: 21 Ocean Way, W Singapore - Sentosa Cove, 098374

NAME: Waterfall Ristorante Italiano
DESCRIPTION: Nestled amid 15 acres of lush tropical gardens, Waterfall Ristorante Italiano offers authentic and unique Southern Italian cuisine that combines the freshest seafood and handmade pastas. Within the eclectic, colonial interiors of the restaurant lies a treasure trove of fresh seasonal produce. The restaurant's wine list is unlike any other. Choose from an extensive collection of wines to embark on a tasting journey spanning Italy.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 22 Orange Grove Road Shangri-La Hotel, Garden Wing, Shangri-La Hotel, 258350

NAME: Positano Risto
DESCRIPTION: Singapore's only halal Italian restaurant in the Arab Street area. Amazing Italian, Without Alcohol!

NAME: Nox - Dine In The Dark
DESCRIPTION: At NOX – Dine In The Dark, we invite you to plunge into an intriguing new world of mystery and sensation you have never experienced before, and join us on a culinary journey through taste, smell, touch and sound, in total darkness. Seated in our pitch-black dining room, you will be guided and served by blind or visually impaired individuals that have been specially trained to offer guidance and reassurance to sighted guests. It is truly a rich human experience when the roles are reversed and the blind become your eyes, opening your mind to a deeper consciousness. Also, discover our exquisite menu crafted from the finest ingredients by our Chef de Cuisine and his team, and enjoy our fine wine selection and unique signature cocktails customized for each individual's palate. NOX - Dine in the Dark is definitely more than just dining, it is a unique mind-altering sensory experience! Experience this new European dining trend first-hand and 'see' it for yourself!

NAME: Grand Shanghai
DESCRIPTION: Renowned for a unique dining concept paying homage to the "Old Shanghai" of the 1930s, the newly refurbished restaurant reopens its doors, introducing lavish contemporary interiors, regular live entertainment and a revamped signature menu that features authentic Shanghainese specialties. After two decades of bringing authentic Shanghainese cuisine to cosmopolitan Singapore, Grand Shanghai makes its highly anticipated return with a fresh look and elevated dining experience The new restaurant space promises a feast for the senses, inspired by the city's golden age when Shanghai came to be known as "The Paris of the East"". Against a backdrop of Old Shanghai - iconic art-deco motifs and traditional oriental designs - discerning diners can expect to immerse themselves in a vibrant atmosphere of fanciful soirees, live bands and decadent, artfully prepared delicacies.

NAME: Origin Grill
DESCRIPTION: Origin Grill is inspired by the origin of flavours, travel adventures and Singapore’s illustrious history of bountiful trade and tropical splendour. The restaurant has a farm-to-table concept with an intense focus on the use of fresh, high-quality ingredients sourced from artisan farms from around the world. Using a pared back style of cooking, the restaurant specialises in recipes that are clean, unpretentious but intriguing and massive on flavour. Diners can look forward to a culinary showcase highlighting the beauty of ingredients in their prime, as well as a wine selection featuring over 45 grape varietals handpicked from the best wine producing regions in the world.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 22 Orange Grove Road Shangri-La Hotel, Tower Wing, Lobby Level, 258350

NAME: Rise Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: At RISE Restaurant, the world is at your table. At our buffet restaurant, feast on a glorious variety of cuisines from around the globe. Sail through Southeast Asia with time-honoured classics, tuck into hearty European and American favourites, and dive into fresh free-flow seafood on ice. Post dinner, head next door to Renku Bar and Lounge for live piano music and enjoy your favourite tipple to round off the evening. #RiseSG
GENERAL_LOCATION: 10 Bayfront Avenue, Marina Bay Sands, Marina Bay Sands Hotel Lobby, Hotel Tower 1, 018956

NAME: Yakiniku Heijoen
DESCRIPTION: Our traditional techniq,ues and tastes have remained unchanged since our establishment in 1970.We are committed to serving A5 Japanese Wagyu beef that is purely bred in Japan,and creating restaurants based in Tokyo, including Ginza and Asakusa, which suit the characteristics of their local community. In Sihgapore we have a lot to offer based on our expertise in A5 Japanese Wagyu.

NAME: Man Fu Yuan
DESCRIPTION: Lauded by Singapore Tatler as one of Singapore's best Chinese restaurants and Michelin recommended, Man Fu Yuan is a stalwart in the Chinese fine dining scene in Singapore, serving culinary presentations that showcase an artful balance of spices and flavours, uplifted by modern interpretations and quality ingredients. Look forward to a refined dining experience underpinned by traditional culinary techniques with a touch of modernity, and elevate your experience with a handpicked selection of quality wines or premium tea pairings. Set within an elegant venue which accommodates up to 172 guests, including a suite of private dining rooms, Man Fu Yuan is well-suited for all occasions, from private business lunches to joyous celebratory events.

NAME: Summer Pavilion
DESCRIPTION: Serving Cantonese specialties and innovative modern presentations for lunch and dinner, Summer Pavilion provides an exquisite culinary experience amidst a picturesque garden.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 7 Raffles Avenue Ritz Carlton Millenia Singapore, The Ritz-Carlton, 039799

NAME: Paulaner Brauhaus Singapore
DESCRIPTION: Paulaner Bräuhaus is Singapore’s first and only authentic German microbrewery. The three-storey bar and restaurant at Millenia Walk is Asia’s model flagship store with fresh new interiors and an updated food menu. Keeping to the German “Geselligkeit” (sociability) concept, the updated menu of authentic Bavarian dishes is perfect with beer and for communal dining. Customers can look forward to revelling in the convivial atmosphere and the brand’s signature hospitality.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 9 Raffles Boulevard Millenia Walk, #01-01 Millenia Walk, 039596

NAME: Shivam Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Shivam Restaurant is a fusion vegetarian restaurant started by passionate entrepreneurs and the only one in Singapore to serve authentic Gujarati cuisine. We also serve Italian, Mexican, Fusion & Indian cuisines here. We are conveniently located right next to Mustafa Centre.

NAME: Josephine - French Cuisine & Wine Bar
DESCRIPTION: A trendy modern French Bistro-Style restaurant in the heart of Singapore District & vibrant Amoy Street

NAME: Tea Lounge
DESCRIPTION: Enjoy respite from the afternoon sun in the delightful environs of the Tea Lounge. Savour our elegant Weekday Three-tier Afternoon Tea featuring premium teas and coffees, finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones and pastries. Gather with family and friends for our Weekend High Tea Buffet, which showcases an extensive spread of local and international items.

NAME: The White Label
DESCRIPTION: Inspired by the Parisian cafes, The White Label's classy interior boasts elegant chandeliers, gold cutlery and marbled tables to transport diners to the city of love. With a mouth-watering selection of authentic Halal French cuisine infused with Malayan flavours such as Duck Confit and Salmon Beurre Blanc, The White Label is the perfect venue for romantic or celebratory dinners with friends and family. Treat your loved ones to an upscale French dining experience with a spread of popular and classic French dishes at The White Label

NAME: Meadesmoore
DESCRIPTION: Meadesmoore is a modern steakhouse that specialises in unusual cuts of beef and other meats, sourced from a network of trusted award-winning premium small producers. Helmed by Executive Chef Victor Loy, Meadesmoore is a joyous fist bump to the grand steakhouses of the early 1900s in the US and UK. Think: Big steaks charcoal grilled to perfection, accompanied by gutsy side dishes great for sharing, and decadent desserts to end your meal on a sweet note.

NAME: French Fold Orchard
DESCRIPTION: An all-day drinks and dining space features French crêpes. From early coffee through late night cocktails.

NAME: Soi Social
DESCRIPTION: Mealtimes and after-hours gatherings are about to sizzle. From the vibrant atmosphere to the aroma of grilling meat skewers wafting in the air, there’s plenty that will draw you into the new and chic foodie hangout of Thai street gastronomy

NAME: Rosso Vino
DESCRIPTION: Featuring the true taste of Italy, Rosso Vino has grown to be one of the finest in Singapore’s Italian restaurant scene. The restaurant offers a gastronomic journey that is centered on fulfilling its brand’s promise – quality and authentic Italian cuisine with genuine Italian warmth. Led by the co-owners Salvatore Adaldo and Carlo Mazzaglia, vow to deliver a top-of-the-line dining experience to its patrons, one meal at a time. Favorably located at Robertson Quay, this classy restaurant and wine bar flaunts a welcoming, tranquil atmosphere with alfresco seating overlooking the picturesque view of the Singapore River. Idyllic for any occasion – Rosso Vino will surely hit the spot serving up classic Italian flavors with a contemporary feel.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 15 Merbau Road, Next Robertson Quay Hotel, 239032

NAME: Merci Marcel Club Street
DESCRIPTION: We are a living and meeting space in Tiong Bahru, Club Street and Orchard bringing the Authentic French experience to Singapore. Rendez-vous over a cup of coffee, at brunch or for a quick lunch at our café chic. Savour our sharing plates and curl up on our sofas. Sip French wines or enjoy cocktails on our chic-bohemian atmosphere. Browse and shop from our carefully curated selection of wines, cheeses and boutique items. Immerse yourself in art, creativity and inspiration. Live life, la vie en Marcel.

NAME: Merci Marcel Orchard
DESCRIPTION: We are a living and meeting space in Tiong Bahru, Club Street and Orchard bringing the Authentic French experience to Singapore. Rendez-vous over a cup of coffee, at brunch or for a quick lunch at our café chic. Savour our sharing plates and curl up on our sofas. Sip French wines or enjoy cocktails on our chic-bohemian atmosphere. Browse and shop from our carefully curated selection of wines, cheeses and boutique items. Immerse yourself in art, creativity and inspiration. Live life, la vie en Marcel.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 390 Orchard Road Palais Renaissance, 01-03 to 04 Palais Renaissance, 238871

NAME: 25 Degrees
DESCRIPTION: A cult favourite among the Hollywood A-list, the award winning concept, 25 Degrees Burgers and Liquor Bar brings its signature West Coast flavour to Singapore. Originating from Los Angeles at the iconic Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel in Los Angeles, 25 Degrees is named after the precise temperature difference between a raw and well-done hamburger.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 200 Middle Road Hotel G Singapore, Ground Floor, Hotel G Singapore, 188980

NAME: Ocean Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Immerse yourself in the wonders of the ocean as you indulge in exquisite modern-European cuisine. Savour it all as you enjoy the company of majestic manta rays and 40,000 marine animals.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Equarius Hotel, West B1M Carpark, Resorts World Sentosa, 098269

NAME: Zhup Zhup By One Prawn & Co
DESCRIPTION: Home-Grown in SG Michelin Bib Gourmand 2022 and 2023 Prawn Noodles (Lunch) & Seafood Grill (Dinner) Founded by passionate young chefs determined to keep Singapore’s local culinary culture alive, and as seen on The Straits Times, Daniel Food Diary, Eatbook and more! Chef Gwyneth has amassed over 10 years of culinary experience under the tutelage of some of the most renowned chefs in Singapore from established restaurants such as Burnt Ends, Tong Le Private Dining and Forlino. From our richer broth to grilled seafood prepared freshly daily, we tirelessly pursue quality to bring you the best seafood experience in MacPherson.

NAME: SanSara
GENERAL_LOCATION: Grand Copthorne Waterfront Hotel, 392 Havelock Road., 169663

NAME: Cut by Wolfgang Puck
DESCRIPTION: CUT at the Marina Bay Sands in Singapore is the third location for master chef and restaurateur Wolfgang Puck's critically acclaimed steakhouse concept. Providing the finest range in beef selections, grilled over hard wood and charcoal, CUT is home to the true steak connoisseur. Choices from around the globe include USDA Prime, Australian Angus, and Wagyu selections from United States, Australia and Japan, and currently offering the uniquely marbled Snow Beef from Uenae Lake Farms, Hokkaido Japan. Our sophisticated menu is complemented by a range of produce and ingredients sourced directly from the Santa Monica's Farmer's Market in Southern California giving guests in Singapore an unparalleled experience of fine food, all while served in a hip, contemporary atmosphere. CUT also features a bar & lounge providing a menu spanning over 50 original, handcrafted cocktails and our "Rough CUTs" lounge menu of delectable bar snacks: open daily from 5:30 P.M. Onward.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2 Bayfront Avenue Marina Bay Sands, The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands, B1-71 , Galleria Level, 018972

NAME: Oscar's
DESCRIPTION: When it comes to dining, the Conrad Centennial Hotel does not disappoint with its wide array of choices. One of the most popular is our Oscar’s restaurant that is conveniently located at the lobby level of the hotel.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2 Temasek Boulevard, Conrad Centennial, Lobby Level, 038982

NAME: Asian Market Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Asian Market Cafe brings a glorious Halal-certified buffet line of local favourites and contemporary regional delicacies! Guests can expect to be treated to an array of well-loved Southeast Asian cuisine that pays tribute to the diversity of flavour and cultures within the region.

NAME: Lobby Lounge at Conrad Centennial Singapore
DESCRIPTION: Set in an opulent yet cozy ambience, the Lobby Lounge is a perfect place for daily lunches and afternoon tea. By night, the Lobby Lounge transforms into a picture of elegance and luxury with live music and cocktails. Signature to the Lounge is the Gin Experience with premium gins paired with the finest craft tonics from East Imperial, unique bitters from Fee Brothers, and over thirty garnishes are offered for the gin & tonic.

NAME: Salt & Palm
DESCRIPTION: Neighbourhood resto-bar, serving modern Asian cuisine in Joo Chiat.

NAME: Colony
DESCRIPTION: Located on level three of The Ritz-Carlton, Millenia Singapore, the name Colony alludes to the seafarious voyage that the British took to travel to the East Indies for trade and commerce in the late eighteenth century. Vintage maps and postcards which adorn the walls and decorative ornate leafing evoke the nostalgia of a bygone era, while eight different open concept kitchens, coupled with 'live' culinary showmanship, will bring diners on a multi-sensory journey through Singapore's heritage cuisines including Malaysian, Indonesian, Indian, Chinese and Western, with dishes that reflect the flavours of the nation's rich colonial past. Colony can seat a maximum of 260 persons and boasts a dynamic space that can be configured to accommodate groups of various sizes. The restaurant will offer breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea and dinner daily, and vintage Champagne brunch on Sundays.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 7 Raffles Avenue Ritz Carlton Millenia Singapore, The Ritz-Carlton, Millenia, 039799

NAME: Tanuki Raw at Jewel Changi
DESCRIPTION: Tanuki Raw is a restaurant and bar serving modern Japanese food, cocktails, and regionally brewed draft beers. Located on the top floor by the Canopy Park at Jewel Changi Airport, enjoy our signature donburi in a unique al fresco setting under the glass dome. Known for having Singapore's best raw happy hour, Tanuki Raw features oysters at 3 SGD per piece, draft beer at 10 SGD, and specials on cocktails, wine, and more daily.

NAME: Clove
DESCRIPTION: Welcoming you back to the popular all-day dining destination of CLOVE at Swissôtel The Stamford! Indulge your palates with a sumptuous international array of culinary delights and beverages. Celebrating some of the best cuisines in the world, experience a tapestry of aromas and flavours weaved together by an offering of native and international delights. Have your fill from a colourful display of vitality salads; fresh seafood on ice; smoked fish & charcuterie; breads; cheeses; and sweets. Not forgetting live stations of roasts and noodles; with an added decadent chocolate station on weekends. Get ready to unleash your appetites!
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2 Stamford Road, Level 2, Swissôtel The Stamford, 178882

NAME: CouCou Hot Pot Jewel
DESCRIPTION: "Coucou Hotpot, which has been known as the online celebrity hot pot restaurant in recent years, was founded in 2016 and is a mid-to-high-end hot pot brand incubated by Taiwan’s hot pot brand Xiabuxiabu. It uses a combination of hot pot and milk tea as an innovative model and focuses on gathering young people."
GENERAL_LOCATION: 78 Airport Boulevard Jewel Changi Airport Floor 02 Unit 208 209, 819666

NAME: Baba Chews Bar and Eatery
DESCRIPTION: An all-day dining restaurant in Katong, serving modern and traditional Asian fare, along with quality brews by TWG Tea and Common Man Coffee Roasters
GENERAL_LOCATION: 86 E East Coast Road Katong Square, Katong Square, 428788

NAME: Song Garden
DESCRIPTION: Discover modern Cantonese cuisine in a Chinese restaurant like no other. Located where Bugis Street meets Bras-Basah in one of Singapore’s more authentic areas, Song Garden gives you an unforgettable taste of the city’s culinary excellence. Our skillful chefs have elaborated a mouth-watering array of contemporary dishes. Pleasing to the eye, exquisite on the tastebuds – expect a dash of wow factor in each and every one. The setting is elegant. Filled with daylight at lunchtime, cozy when night falls, the main restaurant and six private dining rooms feature traditional Chinese furnishings and paintings. Ideal for banquets and business lunches in Singapore.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 122 Middle Road Mercure Singapore Bugis, Level 2, 188973

NAME: Beach Road Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: JW Marriott Singapore South Beach's signature restaurant, Beach Road Kitchen celebrates freshness in its offerings and an international spread on its sumptuous buffet and an a la carte menu. Highlights from the restaurant include a temperature-controlled seafood room with over 40 varieties of fresh seafood and antipasti, a vertical salad bar, a pizza oven, a charcoal grill with grilled-to-order meats and seafood, local favourites, a dessert showcase and more!
GENERAL_LOCATION: 30 Beach Road, Access Via Nicoll Highway, JW Marriott Hotel Singapore South Beach, 189763

NAME: The Lobby Lounge at InterContinental Singapore
DESCRIPTION: Elevate your senses within the exquisite heart of InterContinental Singapore - The Lobby Lounge. A splendid culinary transformation graces this esteemed haven, harmoniously blending the essence of contemporary allure with a deep-rooted respect for heritage. Discover a refined symphony of dining experiences, woven into the tapestry of this culinary marvel. Crafted upon four foundational pillars, each artfully hewn from the hotel's culinary treasures, the revitalisation unveils alluring new menus that beckon connoisseurs and epicureans alike. With an unwavering dedication to luxury hospitality, The Lobby Lounge transcends mere spatial definition to embody the very essence of the property’s DNA, where each touchpoint weaves cherished memories. Step into a realm where sophistication meets heritage, as The Lobby Lounge at InterContinental Singapore sets the stage for extraordinary moments that resonate eternally. IHG One Rewards members enjoy 20% savings.

NAME: Osia Steak & Seafood Grill, Singapore
DESCRIPTION: This award-winning, casual fine-dining restaurant offers a decadent selection of the finest, freshest ingredients grilled and roasted in a stone hearth oven to bring out maximum flavour. Signature dishes include Stockyard Beef’s colossal 1.5kg ribeye tomahawks, Mayura Station’s lucious Matsusaka full-blood Wagyu ribeye MS8+, grilled lobsters and Skull Island king tiger prawns. Savour these succulent delights along with a remarkable selection of Antipodean wines, enjoyed in good company in a convivial atmosphere.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 8 Sentosa Gateway Resorts World Sentosa, Resorts World Sentosa, 098269

NAME: Le Noir Bar & Lounge
DESCRIPTION: Le Noir offers food, drinks & live entertainment experience while enjoying spectacular views of the Singapore River. Wine, dine and dance the night away, with a delectable variety of western fare including our freshly prepared pizzas, sharing plates and delicious signature cocktails, and a line-up of live performances from talented local and international artists.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 2 Bayfront Avenue Marina Bay Sands, #01-84 The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands, 018972

NAME: Chifa!
DESCRIPTION: Amaze your palate with Peruvian-Chinese cuisine, known as ‘Chifa’. Birthed in the 1800s when Chinese immigrants incorporated Peru’s culinary heritage, it’s now a celebrated part of the nation’s identity. Savour it at Singapore’s first Chifa restaurant through Peruvian native Chef Ruben Rodrigo Serrano Cabrera’s creations, which are made using a curation of produce from his motherland.

NAME: Carousel Buffet
DESCRIPTION: Let Carousel buffet restaurant take you on a whirlwind dining adventure with up to 17 stations of culinary delights. Dive straight into the ocean’s fresh catches at our renowned seafood station – a crowd favourite for its impressive spread (up to 13 different varieties!). The latest addition includes gueridon service for desserts. Other cuisines include Mediterranean, Japanese, Indian and more. At Carousel, there’s certainly something for everyone. Winner of the prestigious AsiaOne People’s Choice for the Best Buffet Restaurant for 7 consecutive years. Carousel’s delicious buffet spread is prepared in halal-certified kitchens.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 25 Scotts Road Scottswalk, Royal Plaza on Scotts, 228220

NAME: The Line
DESCRIPTION: You will be able to savour all the delectable dishes from The Line in our newly created made-to-order menus served tableside. Choose from over 88 delectable choices — from fresh seafood on ice, sushi selections, authentic Thai salads, freshly-baked naans from the tandoor oven, homemade curries, through to dainty and delicious desserts, there’s something for every palate. As a destination of choice for family gatherings and birthday celebrations for almost two decades, The Line continues to bring a sense of occasion and to reignite the joy of dining with an intimate and new gourmet experience.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 22 Orange Grove Road Shangri-La Hotel, Tower Wing, Lower Lobby, 258350

NAME: Heart of Darkness
DESCRIPTION: Heart of Darkness Singapore is a restaurant and bar that provides a communal eating and drinking experience, built around a vibrant, passion-filled menu and our tasty brews. Our bar has 25+ FRESH. COLD. CRAFT. BEERS... 20 tried-and-true craft beer taps, with 10 local beer taps, cocktails, wine and more: there’s always something different to tickle your taste buds. We put a lot of love into every brew, using the finest ingredients, with the highest quality service from our staff and expect nothing less than a satisfactory experience for our guests. The Heart of Darkness menu is grounded in fusion cuisine. From tapas and edamame to tacos and burgers, our food menu offers something for everyone.

NAME: Fu Lin Men Cantonese Dining
DESCRIPTION: Located near the iconic East Coast Park, Fu Lin Men (Chinese Swimming Club) boasts a swanky interior, lots of natural light (when you dine during the day-time), and a lively atmosphere! Here at Fu Lin Men, we serve Hong Kong Dim Sum, Roast Specialities, Hong Kong style noodles and Cantonese wok-fried dishes! If you are looking for a place to host a small event at an affordable rate, then we are the place for you (able to hold up to 18 tables)! And if you need a dining place to bring your VIPs to, we’ve got you covered too! With 4 VIP rooms decorated beautifully, paired with our Hong Kong delicacy, you are sure to impress! We are “Open To The Public”.

NAME: Cou Cou Hot Pot I12 Katong
DESCRIPTION: "Coucou Hotpot, which has been known as the online celebrity hot pot restaurant in recent years, was founded in 2016 and is a mid-to-high-end hot pot brand incubated by Taiwan’s hot pot brand Xiabuxiabu. It uses a combination of hot pot and milk tea as an innovative model and focuses on gathering young people."

NAME: Beast & Butterflies

After 4 years of traveling the world, Pak realized the strong impact his mother's cooking had always had on him with its unique and genuine flavors. It was then when he decided to collect all of his mother's recipes to not only document for himself, but to also share with people he loved. The beef cutlet is deep-fried outside very quickly, so it's fairly rare inside. It used to be more cooked and you were to eat it as is, but as they became popular among visitors from overseas, they started serving a stone grill along with the cutlet so that you can cook as you like. I imagine there was an increasing feedback from the customers that the meat was too rare. I actually liked more the way it used to be, but guess it's better now for non-Japanese customers. It's 1,300 JPY (130g of beef) and comes as a combo and the photo abve is 2,100 JPY combo (260g of beef). I'd say 130g would be enough for most people.
