There is something to cater for all tastes with a wide range of vegetarian dishes. Our desserts are a special treat and have become famous over the years. We're perfect for business lunches and dinners, dates, girls' night out, Sunday brunch, family time - just about any reason to share fantastic food and ambiance with good people. See Less

NAME: Cheka Japanese Izakaya
DESCRIPTION: Japanese style Restaurant&Bar "IZAKAYA" which operated by Japanese in Nairobi Kenya The restaurant name "CHEKA" means "Laugh" in Swahili language:))

NAME: Fogo Gaucho
DESCRIPTION: Fogo Gaucho is Nairobi's Favourite Steakhouse set up in a beautiful ambience that gives a feel as though you are in a corner of South Brazil. If you are looking for a prime dining experience in a stylish, ambient environment either for a family outing, business lunch meeting or office party, Fogo Gaucho offers top class service to fit any occasion and a playground for children every Sunday.

NAME: Baraka Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: An all-day dining restaurant located on the ground floor of the Hotel with a full buffet breakfast, as well as an A-La-Carte menu.

NAME: Tamarind Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Nairobi's iconic seafood restaurant which originally opened in August 1977, has recently moved from the Central Business District to the leafy suburbs of Karen at the Karen Blixen coffee Garden. The menu is a blend of the best of French, Asian and African cuisines with specialties such as the famous Prawns Piri Piri, and Chilli Crab which have earned the Tamarind worldwide fame.

NAME: Tatu Restaurant By Fairmont
DESCRIPTION: The city’s iconic restaurant, Tatu, reopens on popular demand with a new menu specializing in finest of seafood, premium cuts of meat and vegetarian delicacies to tantalize your taste buds. Fashioned in contemporary African style, the restaurant benefits from a patio ideal for dining alfresco whilst overlooking the tropical garden. Feel welcome and book now !

NAME: Chophouse Nairobi
DESCRIPTION: The Chophouse Restaurant presents an inventive culinary experience that weaves together a fusion of Kenyan, Asian and Mediterranean Haute Cuisine. Our new menu masterfully elevates beloved grilled meat dishes to a level that is unmatched on the Continent, with in-house aging of meats up to 72 days. Each dish is designed with a poetic flair that pays homage to the elegance of Haute Cuisine, drawing from techniques of esteemed chefs from around the world. We are delighted to offer this bold new dining experience right here in Nairobi.

NAME: Thai Chi Restaurant - The Stanley Hotel
DESCRIPTION: A small piece of Thailand in Nairobi, Thai Chi has been awarded as the most authentic Thai restaurant in East Africa. With its traditional Thai decor and delectable Thai specialties prepared by experienced chefs from Thailand, Thai Chi is one of Nairobi's most elegant dining establishments.

NAME: Humidor Bar & Lounge
DESCRIPTION: Sophisticated lobby bar and cigar lounge at Radisson Blu Hotel, Nairobi Upper Hill that looks out over Nairobi. Our mixologists will whip up a drink of your choice from our wide selection of premium wines, whiskies, vodkas and rum.

NAME: Taste of China (TOC)
DESCRIPTION: Taste of China as a Brand has been open since March 2008. We started off at Prime Apartments as a poolside restaurant. Our shift to VIP Plaza was in October 2012 where we have tried to create a more contemporary restaurant. we have now moved to 12th floor of TRV Parkwest on 3rd Parklands avenue, diagonally opposite the mosque. in the restaurant we have Trees, dragons, butterflies, birds are all part of the décor. You have to see it to believe it! We are an Indo-Chinese restaurant, A restaurant with a view !! Come try the food and check out our view !!

NAME: Lord Delamere Terrace
DESCRIPTION: Provides a fresh modern environment with influences from the great history of the past. A lively and vibrant ambiance, all week throughout the weekend. Impeccable warm service and authentic Pan-African food as well as all time classics from all over the world, creatively presented. We bring our guests an experience to remember.

NAME: La Salumeria
Graze
DESCRIPTION: Sankara Nairobi's signature restaurant, Graze, is designed to indulge your inner gourmand. Graze is a modern take on the New York-style steakhouse, offering aged beef, succulent seafood and indulgent desserts paired to perfection with eclectic wines and whiskies from some of the finest producers in the world. The open kitchen, Josper grill, outdoor terrace, traditional booths and indoor fireplace magnificently balance the space while providing the ideal setting for an intimate business or social experience. Graze features a lunch and dinner menu, where diners can expect a wonderfully relaxed ambiance complemented by the attentive yet refined service for which Sankara Nairobi is known. Since opening, the restaurant has quickly gained a reputation as the best steakhouse in Nairobi. Graze is also the reigning World Luxury Restaurant Awards Continent winner in the Luxury Steakhouse/Grill category. Due to its popularity among hotel guests and locals, dinner reservations are recommended

NAME: Soaring Eagle Spur - Nairobi
DESCRIPTION: Spur serves its famous flame-grilled burgers and steaks, fresh salads and decadent desserts to families from all over the world. As a distinctly family-orientated band, we offer an environment where the whole “tribe” can come relax and enjoy themselves. This is the way it has always been at Spur and the reason why we have found a special place in the hearts of our customer over several generations!

NAME: Matteo's Italian Restaurant & Bar
DESCRIPTION: As a family run Italian Restaurant we are serving artisan Pizza and traditional Italian dishes in a lush tropical garden setting. Experience the taste of Italy in the heart of Karen, Nairobi.

NAME: Sierra Brasserie
DESCRIPTION: Sierra brings together unique South African wines from the lesser known wine estates and dry aged grass fed angus beef for the steaks and burgers from the foothills of Mt.Kenya for a uniquely African experience. Sierra also has its own state-of-the-art brewery on Mombasa road and they therefore make their own stout beer.

NAME: Embark Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: We are an intimate 12 - seater restaurant, offering a 7 courses tasting menu from Wednesdays - Sundays between 6:00 P.M. to 11:00 P.M. We also offer lunch on Saturdays and Sundays between 12:00 P.M. and 3:00 P.M.

NAME: Tambourin
DESCRIPTION: Tambourin is a rooftop Lounge and Restaurant designed to offer the most unique dining experience to guests. Tambourin focuses on a Levantine dining experience offering delicacies from the regions of Israel, Jordan, Lebanon, Palestine and Syria. Guests can relax to the sounds of ambient music, and enjoy shared Mezze platters in the comforts of Majilis - style cabanas. Tambourin is the perfect venue for sundowners, watch the world famous African sunset as you sip a cocktail and wind down after a busy day. There are daily performances by a Belly Dancer. Timings for the performances are: 20:00 - 20:15 21:00 - 21:15 22:00 - 22:15 23:00 - 23:15

NAME: 45 Degrees Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: The restaurant features a sustainably and organically grown ingredient-driven menu, utilizing produce from the restaurant's organic garden. While the menu holds its foundation in American dishes, it is influenced by French and Italian provincial cuisine. Our current hours are from 12pm to 11pm daily. Restaurant | Gallery | Bocce Courts

NAME: The Other Room Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Bold, Simple Farm-to-table Dining A pool & lawn-side restaurant bathed in sunlight Farm-to-table ingredients boldly, but simply prepared to let the natural flavors shine Scandinavian-styled interior Buffet and a-la-carte breakfasts and lunches Private dining and culinary events, late afternoons and evenings

NAME: La Cascina
DESCRIPTION: Italian Restaurant , Pizzeria, Homemade Icecream

NAME: beit e selam
DESCRIPTION: Our food and drinks, like our name, are a reflection of our home city, Nairobi, and influenced by the many culinary accents of the African continent.

NAME: Asmara Restaurant, Westlands
DESCRIPTION: Eritrean/Ethiopian and Continental cuisine prepared from the finest and freshest ingredients; a unique dining experience in a beautiful, modern and child-friendly setting. The ideal restaurant for friends and family!

NAME: Mama Rocks Gourmet Burgers - The Alchemist
DESCRIPTION: GOURMET BURGERS AFRICAN STYLE Bringing the African inspired ‘Gourmet Burger’ to the vibrant city of Nairobi, Mama Rocks is pioneering the Nairobi street food scene with an afro-cool food truck like no other. Created with love and the freshest, natural ingredients, every care has been taken to produce our range of exciting and unique burgers. Mama Rocks is brought to you by us, Samantha and Natalie, sisters who just want you to have great food and have fun! On a regular day you will find the truck at our very cool home base at the Yard (AKA The Alchemist Bar), Parklands Road, Westlands. The Mama Rocks food truck will also be COMING TO YOU – at the heart of the events scene. Follow us on Facebook or Instagram social media to keep updated about our location. And if you’re not there, MAMA DELIVERS through our partners Hello Food (Mama Rocks) (5km radius from Westlands) And MAMA CATERS. For a fun alternative catering solution that your guests will surely remember, choose Mama Rocks to cater for your event, private party or corporate function.

NAME: Open House Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: At Open House Restaurants, we believe that Fine Indian Cuisine comes from a delicate balance of succulent food, authentic ambiance and personalised service. So when you walk into our doors, be ready to experience a connucopia of indian flavours, whilst being transported into our traditionally set surroundings. Feel free to enquire about your taste preference or take suggestion from our experienced staff. Enjoy!

NAME: BangBang Thai Kitchen
DESCRIPTION: Home-style Thai food in Nairobi, located at Village Market in Gigiri.

NAME: Haandi Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Haandi specialises in North Indian Frontier cuisine and true to the spirit of the original concept, the masalas are freshly-prepared daily, all the dishes are cooked to order and absolutely everything you eat is created on the premises. Our trademark glass fronted kitchens add an element of drama to each restaurant, allowing you, the diner, to watch the chefs as they create their own brand of magic. We have always insisted on the freshest, finest ingredients available and this policy has rewarded us with a reputation where quality is paramount and the satisfaction of you, the customer, always comes first. and of course the service is exemplary.

NAME: Slate - Kitchen & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Slate offers a friendly and warm atmosphere, with heavy emphasis of French and Afro-Asian dishes made by our cordon bleu chef. This unique blend, allows one to experience a whole new genre of cuisines all at once. The ambience and décor amplifies a modern take of the French style architecture which is commonly bound by the characteristic design of the interior. Our in house hand crafted tailored cocktails are made from high end premium brands.

NAME: Pango Brasserie
DESCRIPTION: Pango Gourmet Brasserie, a member of Chaine des Rotisseurs, is a fine dining restaurant with an underground wine cellar.

NAME: Hemingway's Brasserie Nairobi
DESCRIPTION: With its warm and inviting ambiance, and serving breakfast, lunch and dinner, the Brasserie offers a wide choice of international dishes with modern European and South Asian flavours.

NAME: Jiko
DESCRIPTION: Jiko, the signature restaurant inspired by African cuisine is a tribute to local farmers; paying homage to crisp flavors and fresh, organic ingredients. Jiko authentically uplifts its inspirations while offering guests the delights of whimsy and fantasy through a playful approach to presentation.

NAME: Aero Club of East Africa Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: The Aero Club of East Africa's Restaurant is now managed by the Club and it is at the moment for members-only.

NAME: Hob House
DESCRIPTION: We serve Levant cuisine with mainly vegetarian and vegan dishes. We also serve a selection of chicken and fish dishes for non-vegetarians. Our fresh produce is sourced from the local organic farms near Nairobi. Our key spices and herbs are sourced directly from Lebanon to offer an authentic taste to our dishes. We strive to offer healthy options, and serve gluten-free upon request.

NAME: La Terrazza Italian Restaurant, Lounge & Art Gallery
DESCRIPTION: La Terrazza Italian Restaurant, Lounge & Art Gallery is located at The Greenhouse along Ngong Road, 4th Floor Suite-1. Nairobi Kenya.

NAME: Ankole Grill Kilimani
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Ankole Grill!, Kilimani. Named after the beautiful, ancient, iconic cattle breed of East Africa, the Ankole Watusi, we aspire to bring you a unique African steak - house experience! A place where steak house meets West African cookshop. A place where Swahili coconut curry meets a bone-in ribeye steak grilled to perfection. Come in for breakfast, lunch or dinner. Sip a hand-crafted cocktail or a glass rich, subtle or delicate glass wine. Karibu!

NAME: Mama Rocks Gourmet Burgers - Mega Mall
Sikia Fine Dining Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Fine Dining Cuisine offering a unique mix of exclusivity, comfort, sophistication and design. The a la carte menu is a tantalizing play of local and international cuisine, meticulously fused to offer the finest dining experience in Nairobi. Sikia is open for Lunch from 12 noon to 3:00p.m. and Dinner from 6.30pm to 10.00pm. Open six days a week Monday to Saturday. Closed on public holidays.

NAME: Royal Kitchen Indian And Chinese Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Located on the Westlands Road, Westlands, the Restaurant’s central location provides the perfect balance of comfort and privacy. The quaint, warm Royal Kitchen offers an extensive menu of Indian-Chinese and Continental cuisine, beverages, desserts and a daily special menu. Our doors are open from 12am – 3.30pm for Lunch and 6.00pm to 10.30pm for Dinner, a coffee menu is available anytime of the day. If you are looking to enjoy a Casual meal in a relaxed atmosphere then Royal Kitchen is the place for you. Whether it’s a light lunch of fresh salads, meaty sandwiches and delicious pastas, an aromatic cup of tea or a revitalizing cup of coffee ; or a moreish lunch of mouthwatering Indian and Chinese delicacies, we at Royal Kitchen are ready to offer you a memorable dining experience. Open seven days a week, anytime is a good time to stop by the Restaurant.

NAME: Tin Roof Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Quiet, quirky day-time cafe perfect for light, healthy lunches with great salads and fresh, exotic smoothies, juices and excellent coffee hand-roasted in Nairobi.

NAME: Tamarind Brasserie
DESCRIPTION: Tamarind Brasserie is located in a beautiful peaceful garden setting on Ngong Road. The Restaurant is open 09.00am through to 11.00pm. Diners have a fine choice of different areas for lunch or dinner. There is the indoor restaurant with adjacent outdoor terrace and garden, for a la carte dining. There are also a variety of functions areas and a vibrant sports bar.

NAME: The Mayura
DESCRIPTION: Mayura (Sanskrit: मयूर) is a Sanskrit word for peacock which is one of the most beautiful and sacred birds of the Hindu mythology. The Mayura experience has been designed around the ‘peacock’ theme. Be mesmerized by the vibrant and colorful interiors - the giant peacock feather décor on the ceiling, golden colored peacocks that adorn the walls, garden theme on the mezzanine to the breathtaking border and bar design.

NAME: Soko Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: 'SOKO,' meaning market in Swahili, focuses on using the finest organic ingredients and seasonally inspired produce to offer an exciting interpretation of classic dishes with a touch of progressive gastronomy. The daylight-flooded, restaurant with its cutting edge design, warm amber tones, private dining roundel and sublime terrace is the perfect venue for an upscale business lunch, a get together of a romantic dinner for two. The end result is an international and eclectic menu in an equally striking setting.

NAME: MeSo - Modern Asian Izakaya
DESCRIPTION: MeSo is a modern Asian Izakaya (i-zaka-ya) experience inspired by the journey of a hungry mind in a contemporary, luxury dining setting. Izakaya a combination of kanji (stay) (drink) (place) represents the rich sensory indulgence of our fresh ingredient dishes, in a fine-dining set up. Conveniently located at Westgate Mall, second floor, MeSo is a culturally vibrant and enchanting culinary haven in the heart of Westlands Business District for your business lunch or a leisurely catch-up with loved ones and friends. .

NAME: Kilele Nyama
DESCRIPTION: Located at the rooftop of ibis Styles Hotel- Rahpta Road Westlands, Kilele Nyama is a roast house with a modern twist. This is definitely Nairobi’s most stylish rooftop restaurant offering a variety of char-grilled cuts, the perfect home feeling and our amazing team is more than excited to welcome you.The restaurant boasts of an epic 360 panoramic view of Nairobi Skyline and on good weather days, you can spot Ngong Hills. Our Head Chef- Rubia Zablon- has tailor-made recipes that will leave you wanting to help yourself to a second serving every time you dine with us. We have also looked into a wider variety of sides and desserts to give you complete satisfaction. Our bar also has something for everyone from our carefully selected wine list, craft beer, local and international beer brands and cocktails made to precision by our in house mixologists for a sophisticated kick on your pallet.

NAME: Mediterraneo
DESCRIPTION: Mediterraneo Ristorante at The Junction is a secluded yet lively spot, bringing the shopping centre's vibrant, modern atmosphere together with a quaint Italian décor and - of course - excellent food. This branch features two floors, each with al fresco dining areas, perfect for a quick lunch, a long meal to catch up with friends or a romantic evening date. Our Junction branch also boasts some unique special offers, allowing you to enjoy more of the authentic Italian experience we strive to recreate.

NAME: Chefs Warehouse Beau Constantia
DESCRIPTION: A modern dining space with a sleek open-plan kitchen overlooking the Constantia wine valleys, Beau Constantia offers a casual fine-dining experience. Chef Ivor Jones offers up his unique perspective on the classic Chefs Warehouse dining, which is a mix between a traditional tasting menu and a small sharing plates experience of contemporary dishes. Our produce is local, partly grown on the farm, and is always seasonally driven. We work in collaboration with ethical producers like Soil for Life, Meuse farm and Abalobi to get the best ingredients and to discover and cook with lesser-known ingredients in new ways.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Erf 1026 Constantia Main Road, Beau Constantia Wine Farm, Constantia Neck, 7806

NAME: Osteria Tarantino
DESCRIPTION: Authentic Italian family-owned restaurant. Fresh Italian dishes by Chef Enrico Tarantino. Bookings essential via phone, WhatsApp or SMS. No email bookings.

NAME: Karibu Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: We are a Truly South African Restaurant situated in the World Class V & A Waterfront. We serve traditional unpretentious good South African cuisine to international guests and locals alike.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Shop 156, The Wharf Centre, Victoria Wharf, 8001

NAME: Mozambik V & A Waterfront
DESCRIPTION: With its roots firmly set in passion and its flavours unapologetically Afro Porto, the Mozambik restaurant group is fast becoming one of South Africa’s leading dining brands. From its launch as a single store in Ballito, Kwa-Zulu Natal circa 15 years ago, the brand has seen rapid growth over the past half-decade, now totaling 18 stores nationally. Later in 2019, the Mozambik brand will also expand north of the Limpopo with its first international store scheduled to open in Lusaka. Chef Brett Michelien has, over time, developed a range of bastings, sauces and rubbing spices that has become Mozambik’s trademark. The menu is inspired by Afro-Porto cuisine with a rich tapestry of flavour the common denominator across an eclectically styled offering. From traditional fare such as prawns through to Mozambik’s famous chicken, the menu offers a wide variety of taste experiences.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Dock Rd, Shop 8, Quay 5, V & A Waterfront, 8001

NAME: Cavalli Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Cavalli’s approach to cuisine can be described as ‘modern​, ​nature inspired cuisine’, inspired by a focus on our heritage​ as it draws upon​ the landscapes, flora and fauna of Southern and Continental Africa. ​ The menu ​seeks to​ take diners on a ​gastronomic ​journey, ​touching on points of nostalgia paired with an expertly crafted local and international wine list, artisanal cocktail, craft beer and a notable selection of single malt whiskeys. Herbs and a selection of vegetables on the menu are grown in the Estate's self sustained heirloom garden. The restaurant is set to establish itself as a premier fine dining destination locally and internationally and is now open for lunch and dinner 4 days a week, Wednesday through Saturday for relaxed, generous Bistro lunch and Fine-Dining Dinner and Sunday Fine-Dining Lunch.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Cavalli Wine Estate, Strand Road R44, 7129

NAME: Gibson's Gourmet Burgers & Ribs
DESCRIPTION: Approximately two years ago we started researching the "Best Burger", and after visiting colleagues in Chicago, New York and Las Vegas, together with our own Master Butcher at our Sister run Belthazar Restaurant and with our 27 year factory experience, the ultimate Gibson's Burger was created.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Shop 157 Lower Level V&A Waterfront, Shop 157 Lower Level V&A Waterfront, Victoria Wharf, 8002

NAME: Bo-Vine Wine & Grill House
DESCRIPTION: Experience laid back sophistication, on the vibrant Camps Bay Strip, one of Cape Town’s best locations –with views over the Atlantic… Immerse yourself in endless summer, We are a destination restaurant, Cape Town's premier Wine & Grill House. For the curious, follow the stairs and find the doors to The Attic by Bo-Vine, our intimate cocktail lounge. For the wine enthusiasts, sip on one of our beautifully curated wines from our newly opened wine bar. Let us elevate your dining experience !
GENERAL_LOCATION: 85 Victoria Road, Shop 1, The Promenade Shopping Centre, 8005

NAME: Mzansi
DESCRIPTION: Experience the Township of Langa at this traditional African restaurant. We cater to tourist and locals alike wishing to have a positive experience in Cape Town’s oldest township. Our kitchen is run by longtime Langa residents that have worked to put a modern twist on recipes that have been passed down through the generations. As you enjoy your locally sourced meal, a live Marimba band will entertain you with traditional African music (tipping is encouraged). Your support helps us to provide jobs and to empower our community. We kindly ask that you make a reservation/booking in advance for, we cook to order and are not a walk-in restaurant. Open for lunch and dinner, we request that you call 24 hours in advance or early in the morning. PLEASE NOTE: Our Restaurant will be closed September 19th-October 3rd, 2017 for holiday. We apologize for any inconvenience.

NAME: The Hussar Grill Century City
DESCRIPTION: The Hussar Grill Century City in Cape Town is regarded as one of South Africa's premier grill restaurants, serving only the best steak available, with a comprehensive wine menu.

NAME: Belly of the beast
DESCRIPTION: Chef's Anouchka Horn and Neil Swart. We offer a tasting menu for lunch and dinner in our 30 seater restaurant. There are no menu options or set amount of courses. All you do is show up and trust us to satisfy with our seasonal fare. We source from local sustainable producers and use every part of the animal. You can expect some dishes that might test your boundaries, but we always balance our menu so that everyone will enjoy the experience. The 30 seats make for a very personal dining experience, as we do everything from cooking to serving our food. Belly of the beast works on online reservations only and we require a deposit to confirm the booking.

NAME: Reverie Social Table
DESCRIPTION: Join the Social Table for a totally unique dining concept. An eclectic space to eat, drink and be merry with some fabulous company. Table d' Hote style eatery with a set 5 course dinner party, paired with boutique wines from around the Western Cape. Perfect for the lone traveler, couple, friends and groups. It's a must try when visiting the Mother City! Booking essential, no children under the age of 16.

NAME: The Cousins Trattoria
DESCRIPTION: "Founded in September 2012, our story began with two cousins, Andrea and Simone, driven by a deep love for their Nonna's traditional Romagna recipes. They decided to share their passion in the city they adore, Cape Town. One year later, Luca, the third cousin, joined the family business, infusing even more flair and passion. We wholeheartedly welcome you, just like family."

NAME: Whole Earth Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Whole Earth Cafe provides a oasis for great true to nature cuisine, made with only the freshest ingredients. The menu has something for everyone including those with allergies, conscious eaters or those seeking heavenly home bakes. At Whole Earth Cafe we recognise that a great dining experience encompasses far more than just excellent food and wine, so we have a great service focussed team and have ensured that our homely environment is comfortable and inviting. Whether you arrive on bike, car, with furry friends, or on a tour bus - we look forward to welcoming you next time you're passing by.

NAME: La Colombe
DESCRIPTION: La Colombe, one of Cape Town's most well-loved and awarded restaurants. Contemporary French-meets-Asian fine dining.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Constantia Main Rd, Silvermist Wine Estate, 7806

NAME: Burger & Lobster
DESCRIPTION: Burger & Lobster was founded in 2016 with the idea of going back to basics of a restaurant culture where people were offered only a few items that would get people talking - a burger, a lobster roll and fresh lobster. The First B&L in South Africa started in Cape Town on Bree Street. B&L has a world renouned cocktail bar offering the best original cocktails in Cape Town made with all home-made ingredients. B & L is a trendy and vibey place that gets people coming back. The Burger is made with highest quality natural beef and the Lobster is sustainable live lobster. Each dish developed the best it can be, surrounded with good people and great energy.

NAME: Homespun
GENERAL_LOCATION: 1 Porterfield Road, Opposite Catch 22 & next to The Fat Greek, 7441

NAME: The Woodlands Eatery
DESCRIPTION: Matteo & Mizio, born and grow up in Bologna & Firenze, in 2017 took over the restaurant and introduce their Italian heritage and traditions. Located in the heart of Gardens, right under the beautiful Table Mountain, they welcome you like family and they will make you feel you are in Italy with their passion for food & hospitality.

NAME: Miller's Thumb
DESCRIPTION: Miller's Thumb is an iconic long-standing restaurant in Cape Town specialising in fish & seafood-inspired dishes. It's bustling, cozy and filled with quirky character. Enjoy the freshest fish, straight off the boat and into our kitchen, cooked to perfection in a multitude of creative ways.

NAME: Iron Steak and Bar
DESCRIPTION: New no-fuss steak concept on Bree Street. We're all about good food, drinks and happy times. Only the best grass fed beef in Cape Town cooked either on our charcoal open fire grill or in a Spanish charcoal oven.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 114 Bree Street, Next to Heritage Square, 8000

NAME: FYN
DESCRIPTION: A South African and Japanese restaurant experience by Peter Tempelhoff, Jennifer Huge & Ashley Moss.

NAME: GOLD Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: GOLD Restaurant in Cape Town offers an authentic African experience. So much more than just an African restaurant, a night at GOLD is an immersive experience that will take you on a 14-dish taste-safari paired with traditional Mali puppets and entertainment.

NAME: The Lighthouse Cafe
DESCRIPTION: The Lighthouse Café has a beautiful ambience; it is an inviting space, light & airy with a French Provençal and Coastal feel which makes one feel right at home. Together he inspirational and dedicated Lighthouse team have truly created a “home from home” experience for their customers.

NAME: De Grendel Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: De Grendel Wine Estate is home to the award-winning De Grendel Restaurant where the Graaff family’s passion for winemaking extends to the philosophy they employ at the estate’s restaurant: the use of in-season and locally sourced fresh produce, and a menu that is updated regularly, reflecting the unique culinary heritage of the Cape and created with complementary De Grendel wines in mind.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Plattekloof Road, De Grendel Wine Estate and Restaurant, 7500

NAME: madam taitou
DESCRIPTION: Authentic Ethiopian cousin restaurant and art gallery combined concept very carefully selected old and new art works from allover Africa including interesting vintage items in display for sale . Madam taitou offer green and very natural environment in a buzz city centre for those who would like relaxed atmosphere
GENERAL_LOCATION: 77 Long Street, 74B wale Street corner of wale and Buitengracht, 8001

NAME: Belthazar Restaurant & Wine Bar
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Belthazar, a veritable theatre of fine food and wine on the cutting-edge of "shoppertainment". A multi-purpose restaurant, grill, wine bar and gourmet home accessory shop, Belthazar brings a chic new concept in the culinary arts to Cape Town.Belthazar is the realization of a lifelong passion for wine shared by the Belthazar team. Their vision was to create the largest "wine by the glass" wine bar in the world. Experienced sommeliers expertly serve up to 250 of the Cape's finest wines by the glass and advise customers on a wine-list of up to 600 fine wines and sought-after rare vintages.Indulge your palate. Belthazar is so much more than good food and wine. Indulge in the best - from the world's finest wine glasses and revolutionary wine technology to the slick service, superb aged Karan beef, export quality Mozambican shellfish and the freshest South African seafood. We invite you to indulge in the grand finale - a platter of boutique South African cheeses perfectly paired with a selection of Cape port wines...
GENERAL_LOCATION: Shop 155, Lower Level Victoria Wharf, Shop 155, Lower Level Victoria Wharf, V&A Waterfront Entrance 4, 8002

NAME: Arnold's Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Situated beneath Table Mountain, we're open for Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner. We're best know for our Amazing Breakfasts, and Walk-on-the-Wild-Side Venison meats. On the menu is Kudu, Ostrich, Gemsbok, Warthog Ribs and Crocodile. We look forward to welcoming you!

NAME: Signal Restaurant Waterfront
DESCRIPTION: With panoramic views of Signal Hill, Signal Restaurant provides a welcome setting on the water's edge. The menu is a unique combination of flavours incorporating influences from the many cultures that called upon this region in days gone by. The aged yellowwood furniture juxtaposed with crisp white linen, all skillfully positioned in the glow of the eccentric hand-crafted chandeliers sets the atmosphere for a new level of hip hotel dining.

NAME: Mantra Cafe
DESCRIPTION: Mantra Cafe offers a sophisticated and stylish dining experience with magnificent seaviews in Camps Bay

NAME: Cafe Orca
DESCRIPTION: We are a family run seafood restaurant situated in a beach cottage with arguably the best views Melkbosstrand, Cape Town

NAME: Mozambik Somerset West
DESCRIPTION: Passionate about friends and family coming together over exceptional food and a welcoming experience! This is exactly what we have created, a “sink your toes into the sand and sip on cocktails and R&R’s while the sun goes down” experience.
GENERAL_LOCATION: , Cnr De Beer Ave & Broadway Rd, Shop 27g, The Sanctuary Shopping Centre,, 6665
REVIEW_TAGS: will definitely be back for more

NAME: Giovanni's
DESCRIPTION: No matter how infrequently you visit, you will always be greeted like a regular.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Corner R44 & Main Road, Shop 27, Waterstone Village, 7129

NAME: Sevruga Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Sevruga is located in the V&A Waterfront, in the Cape Town harbour. The restaurant’s sunlit and leafy patio looks out at the water and the docked catamarans. The interior has delightful leafy patterns and a variety of green textures. A fine-dining establishment which sources ethical and delightfully fresh seafood, it is also known for its sushi and cocktails. Sevruga and its dedicated team can organize any function or private events in this beautifully laid out space.

NAME: The Hussar Grill Mouille Point
DESCRIPTION: The Hussar Grill Mouille Point in Cape Town is regarded as one of South Africa's premier restaurants, serving only the best steak available, with a comprehensive wine menu.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 163 Beach Road, New Cumberland Building, Mouille Point, 8005

NAME: Dash Restaurant & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Dash Restaurant & Bar, although it caters for Queen Victoria Hotel guests, is a stand-alone establishment that welcomes patrons from near and far. Extraordinary artworks embellish the walls in a bold fashion. Further, a live pianist sets the tone during dinner service from Tuesday to Saturday, a delightful accompaniment to the exquisite fine dining offered at this restaurant. The menu is concise and changes every few weeks. The chef and his team place much focus on each ingredient’s unique flavour and combine them creatively to delight the palate. The bar offers an extensive selection of single-malt whiskies and wines, and is a tasteful meeting spot.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Portswood Close, Portswood Ridge, V&A Waterfront, 8000

NAME: NV-80 Grill & Bar
DESCRIPTION: Setup, owned and run by the legendary Goncalves brothers, Victor and Naldo, NV-80 is the connection to years of dedication to industry and craft. An ode to the classic grill houses of yesteryear, NV-80 is a nod to a bygone era of real service, exceptional food and a classic yet contemporary dining aesthetic. Serving beautiful steaks, seafood, salads and a wide array of starters, sides and specials, NV-80 has something for everyone. Over the years NV-80 has become a staple with locals and tourists and has earned NV-80 a reputation as a Cape Town institution. Bought in 2022 by NoName Hospitality Group and partners with the aim of honouring the brands legacy while adding value for a loyal customer base. NoName Hospitality Group intends to build on the brands reputation for quality product and service as well strive to uphold the incredible standards and time honoured traditions instilled by the brothers. Your old favourite reimagined.

NAME: The Avontuur Estate Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Put us on your G.P.S.... Avontuur Estate, nestled on the Helderberg mountain, with horses, vines and Table Mountain in the distance is a calm haven from the hustle and bustle of the city. A mere 45 minute drive from the airport with ample parking, Avontuur is a destination you should have on your GPS. Award winning wines and knowledgeable tasting room staff will pique your taste buds regarding our wines and our restaurant with inside as well as outside seating, has panoramic views to take your breath away. Hearty portions, aromatic flavours and delectable food is the order of the day at the Restaurant, with attention to detail and service excellence being the norm. Call us to book your table, your guests won't be dissapointed. 021 855 4296

NAME: SeaBreeze Fish & Shell
DESCRIPTION: SeaBreeze brings a fresh take on a traditional seafood restaurant, celebrating Cape Town's rich seafood heritage. Find us at 213 Bree Street

NAME: Zest Restaurant - Sea Point, Cape Town
DESCRIPTION: Mediterranean-Asian fusion restaurant. Flame grill cooking of meat, fish and vegetables. Fresh and local at its best. Oyster Bar. Sea views and sunsets. Freshly squeezed fruit used in cocktails, juices and smoothies.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 94 Regent Road, 2nd Floor - Piazza Da Luz, 8005

NAME: JARRYDS Brunch & Bistro
DESCRIPTION: JARRYDS Brunch & Bistro is an all-day brunchery located in the heart Sea Point. We take all-day breakfast seriously and love a slow morning filled with too much brunch accompanied with the perfect flat white, breakfast mimosa or a fresh pressed juice. Let the morning melt into the afternoon with our famous eggs Benedict, irresistible breakfast bruschetta or a JARRYDS favourite. If you’re not feeling eggy, we have a plentiful selection of lunch style house salads, burgers and bagels available all-day. We are a conscious eatery that is passionate about its inputs and we only use the freshest ingredients, free range eggs and some of the best coffee in town. JARRYDS is our ultimate expression of our passion for food, casual dinning and that homely feeling of your local neighbourhood cafe.

NAME: Ben's on the Beach
DESCRIPTION: Situated on the beachfront in the Strand, Ben's on the Beach boasts spectacular views across False Bay, towards Cape Town. Veteran award-winning restaurateur Ben, and his wife, Shirley (a former hotel school lecturer), established Ben's in 2004. They have created a stylish yet relaxed venue, where a varied and well-priced selection of dishes is offered. Ben's is one of the few remaining establishments that continues to dry-age meat - the time-honored and superior method. At Ben's you will not find over-priced and under-portioned "haute cuisine". We believe that the new expression "less is more" is gobbeldygook, where food is concerned. We concentrate on the simple yet timeless dishes that diners return to again and again, such as a great steak, fresh linefish, and the ever-popular creme brulee. At Ben's, you will discover generous portions at honest prices. We look forward to your visit ... And then return!

NAME: The Hussar Grill Camps Bay
DESCRIPTION: The Hussar Grill Camps Bay in Cape Town is regarded as one of South Africa's premier grill restaurants, serving only the best steak available, with a comprehensive wine menu.

NAME: La Boheme
DESCRIPTION: also operates during the day as La Bunixa tapas bar.

NAME: Foxcroft
DESCRIPTION: Fine dining by Glen Williams and Scot Kirton served casually in a wine focussed, leafy Constantia setting.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Groot Constantia Road and Constantia Main Rd, Shop 8/9 High Constantia Centre, 7806

NAME: The Pot Luck Club
GENERAL_LOCATION: 373-375 Albert Road, The Silo, The Old Biscuit Mill, 7925

NAME: Pigalle Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Pigalle Cape TownWell-known as the perfect venue for a stylish evening out, we offer guests live entertainment from our dance floor alongside superb dinner courses. Renowned for our fresh seafood and Chalmar steak, our menu comprises of classic dishes with a subtle Portuguese flair. Including a spacious cigar lounge and private dining room our venue is versatile as well as suitable for private functions.

NAME: Henri's Restaurant & Wine Bar
DESCRIPTION: Walking into Henri's, you will be greeted by the owner and the staff who will treat you like guests in their own home.Henri's is conveniently situated on Somerset West's Main Road in a heritage building that has been renovated into a spacious contemporary restaurant. Well known for their aged grass-fed beef as well as the freshest local seafood. The menu can be described as comfort food with a modern global influence. You can also enjoy a drink on our patio or at the stylish bar. Once you've discovered Henri's you'll be back (and back again!)
GENERAL_LOCATION: Corner Lourensford and Main Road, Lionviham, 7130

NAME: Quentin at Oakhurst Barn
DESCRIPTION: Capital Cape colonial country cooking at its finest!

NAME: Addis in Cape Ethiopian Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Addis in Cape! Voted best African Eatery in Cape Town, an authentic Ethiopian restaurant that caters for Non-vegetarian, Vegan and Vegetarian clients. We provide a unique communal dining experience you, your family and friends will remember. From traditional hand-wash ceremonies to our traditional Ethiopian coffee we promise a memorable experience. Ethiopian cuisine is famous for its rich aromas and generous use of herbs and spices. The country was historically situated on trading routes that included the trade of many exotic spices; this history has had a tremendous influence on the taste of Ethiopian food as we know it. Today most of the herbs and spices are blended and prepared in the home with great love and attention, as are those used in Addis in Cape. The dishes that you taste here are unique to Ethiopia and we are proud as a restaurant to share them with you.

NAME: Zest
DESCRIPTION: Zest Restaurant is a Mediterranean Bistro located in the small coastal town of Gordon's Bay. Zest serves contemporary Mediterranean cuisine with a twist. It is located on the beach front, which offers spectacular views of False Bay. It is a quaint family owned Restaurant that boasts with two qualified Head Chefs. It offers the best dining experience in the Bay, which will even satisfy the hardened critics. Their stylish menu features a wide variety, including fresh seafood, poultry, beef, pork, in season vegetables from local gardens and farms, as well as homemade soups, breads and decadent desserts, always presented tastefully. Come to Zest and enlighten your senses!

NAME: The Hussar Grill Rondebosch
DESCRIPTION: The Hussar Grill Rondebosch in Cape Town is regarded as one of South Africa's premier restaurants, serving only the best steak available, with a comprehensive wine menu.

NAME: Col'Cacchio Foreshore
DESCRIPTION: Col'Cacchio Foreshore in Cape Town CBD is a Italian restaurant, serving you gourmet wood-fired pizzas, sumptuous pastas and the freshest salads!
GENERAL_LOCATION: 42 Hans Strijdom Avenue, Shop 2, Redefine North Wharf, 8001

NAME: Two Oceans Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: The Two Oceans Restaurant opened its doors in December 1995, and is an integral part of the development at Cape Point, which is now part of the newly proclaimed Good Hope Section of the Table Mountain National Park. There is much here for visitors: from excellent dining and browsing through the curio shop, to witnessing the crashing waves where two oceans do battle near the tip of Africa. Set into the cliffs high above the south-western most tip of the Cape Peninsula, the Two Oceans Restaurant has a spectacular view over False Bay and comfortably seats some 300 guests. The innovative design of the restaurant ensures that all guests are able to enjoy the stunning views of this unique location – a view that is unrivaled and world renowned. Of course, you can also enjoy some of the Western Cape’s most magnificent wines when you dine at the Two Oceans Restaurant. The restaurant's extensive outdoor deck presents plenty of opportunity for an incredible breakfast as well, or to catch some sun before taking the Flying Dutchman funicular up to the lighthouse, saving your energy for a walk down to one of the many beaches in the reserve. Our team of chefs meticulously prepares the comprehensive menu. The restaurant’s elegant fare is served in a relaxed manner, and can be enjoyed on our deck, or in the restaurant itself. Fresh seafood is our specialty, especially our world famous Two Oceans Restaurant Seafood Platter. We also cater for vegetarians, meat & salad lovers, and the younger ones.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Cape of Good Hope Nature Reserve, 7975

NAME: Damhuis Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Enjoy a relaxed dining experience in a South African heritage building. The Damhuis Restaurant, housed in one of the oldest buildings in the Western Cape, serves fresh seafood and hearty traditional South African cuisine in a unique setting with​ a rich history and boasts views of iconic Table Mountain and Robben Island. Come rain or shine; the Damhuis Restaurant is the perfect spot for a family-friendly dining experience and a must-visit stop when exploring Melkbosstrand or the West Coast of South Africa.

NAME: Ginja
DESCRIPTION: Ginja caters to guests of the Victoria & Alfred Hotel as well as other patrons. A stone’s throw from the water’s edge in the heart of the V&A Waterfront, the restaurant exudes a wonderful atmosphere, enhanced by its contemporary interior and superb views of Table Mountain. The menu comprises a wide selection of dishes, inspired by various cuisine styles, to satisfy all palates, a true reflection of the chef’s talent. The spectacular setting encourages guests to savour the moment to the fullest, whether they are enjoying a cup of coffee and cake with colleagues, a meal with family, or a sundowner with friends. Native Espresso Bar, within the restaurant, further offers a sensational coffee fix and on-the-go baguettes for breakfast or lunch.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Dock Road, Victoria & Alfred Hotel, On the Waterfront Pierhead, V& A Waterfront, 8001

NAME: Cheyne's
DESCRIPTION: Incredible Contemporary Asian Cuisine, Cocktails and an impressive selection of wines.

NAME: Massimo's
DESCRIPTION: Voted BEST PIZZA IN AFRICA by 50TopPizza (in 2019 and 2021). We make amazing pizza plus daily specials, using only the best, mainly locally sourced ingredients, and the owners are always present to ensure quality & consistency. Check us out on google for more information amazing new vegan menu. We are dog friendly, we even have a doggy menu! We even have our frozen pizzas for sale in several supermarkets! Try our Spiriti Famosi liqueurs, available in many liquor shops or online.

NAME: Afternoon Tea at Mount Nelson, A Belmond Hotel, Cape Town
GENERAL_LOCATION: 76 Orange Street, Belmond Mount Nelson Hotel, 8001

NAME: Manna Epicure
DESCRIPTION: The passionately-crafted menu reflects a synthesis of French and South African cuisines for breakfast, lunch and dinner! Open 7 days a week.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 1 & 2 Elm Court, Cnr of Kloof Nek & Burnside Rd. Tamboerskloof, 8001

NAME: The Indian Chapter Restaurant
DESCRIPTION: Welcome to our home. At the Indian Chapter in Blouberg, our culinary offering will take your taste buds on a sensational journey to the land of Kings. Our chefs sing while they cook & you will feel the love in both our curries & tandoor delicacies. Our decor is authentic, the ambience fantastic & our bathrooms are beautiful. Belly dancing every Friday. Booking essential. Hope to see you soon.

NAME: Cafe Charles
DESCRIPTION: A quaint and cosy café situated in the heart of De Waterkant. Café Charles serves up a tasty breakfast fare, light lunch options, artisan small batch coffee, organic tea, local Cape Malay specialities and other delicious treats. The garden area with fountain is a favourite spot to enjoy a relaxed lunch and glass of wine under the shade of the old, winding, red peppercorn tree. The small dining room with antique fireplace is perfect for coffee dates or quick business meet-ups, but on warmer days be sure to put on your sunnies and SPF and enjoy the city views from the roof deck!

NAME: Villa 47
DESCRIPTION: A new culinary concept celebrating Italian cuisine and showcasing authentic ingredients within 3 unique restaurant environments. Locanda, on the ground floor, is a relaxed Italian bistro where guests can experience regional speciality dishes prepared authentically. The first floor, is a cosy setting which is perfect for a romantic night in the city. This area is also available for exclusive hire to larger group bookings. There is also the courtyard which offers a lavish lounging area where guests are able to unwind with a cocktail and enjoy one of our carefully crafted antipasto platters. This space is also open to private functions and is perfect for a laid-back cocktail evening with a diverse canape menu to keep all your guests happy.

NAME: Steffanie's Place
DESCRIPTION: We're a special place, a place for languid lunches and decadent dinners.

NAME: Baia Seafood Restaurant
GENERAL_LOCATION: 6262 Victoria Wharf V&A Waterfront, Shop 6262, Upstairs, Victoria Wharf, V & A Waterfront, 8002

NAME: Tiger's Milk Camps Bay
DESCRIPTION: Tiger’s Milk is the best destination for ‘dude food’, made good. Our menu takes pizza, grills, burgers and beer to the next level. We’re big on bringing friends together over mouthwatering food, ice-cold drinks, and a fun night out. Tiger’s Milk Camps Bay is set on the bustling beachfront where tourists and locals alike meet for a good time and a bite to eat. It’s the perfect spot for breakfast overlooking the ocean or 2 for 1 cocktails while watching the sunset.

NAME: Paranga
DESCRIPTION: PARANGA IS NOT JUST A RESTAURANT, IT’S A LIFESTYLE Kove Collection’s flagship beachfront restaurant offers laidback luxury, refined taste and iconic hospitality. Circa 2002, Paranga was born – and with it the Camps Bay essence that defines it. It’s classy, it’s irreverent. It’s laidback high society meets Cape Town casual. Effortlessly sexy. Classically cultivated. Walk straight off the beach to enjoy languid lunches that become impromptu dinners and bottomless champagne. It’s the smell of endless summers and the taste of legends.
GENERAL_LOCATION: The promenade, Victoria rd, Camps Bay, Shop No. 1, The Promenade, 8005

NAME: Ocean Basket Kenilworth Centre
DESCRIPTION: Ocean Basket Kenilworth Centre offers Mediterranean style seafood at exceptional prices. We’re mad about fish, calamari, prawns, & family.

NAME: PRIMI Camps Bay
DESCRIPTION: PRIMI Camps Bay will satisfy you biggest cravings for pizza, pasta and more. Come enjoy passionate service and good food in generous portions.

NAME: The Hussar Grill Willowbridge
DESCRIPTION: The Hussar Grill Willowbridge in Bellville is regarded as one of South Africa's premier restaurants, serving only the best steak available, with a comprehensive wine menu.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Carl Cronje Drive, Shop G21, Willowbridge Shopping Centre, 7530

NAME: Carne (Kloof)
DESCRIPTION: The Carne Collection has expanded to include the trendy Carne on Kloof which is bursting with popularity, as well as Carne Constantia, answering the need for an excellent steak in the Southern Suburb. The menu at both the Kloof and Constantia outlets bring a wide selection of classic Italian fare and introduce new meat alternatives to well-known 95 Keerom favourites such as tongue carpaccio and the signature slow baked lamb ravioli. Traditional dishes such as Bollito Misto, a rare north Italian speciality of mixed boiled meats, underlines the absolute authenticity of the menu. This coupled with Giorgio¿s commitment to using only the finest, freshest ingredients, serving vegetables especially grown for his restaurants. As much as each Carne signature restaurant proudly portrays its own visual identity, it is undeniably Georgio¿s personality, authenticity and insistence on the best that guarantees an elite hands-on eating experience.

NAME: Chefstable Capetown
DESCRIPTION: CHEFSTABLE CAPETOWN is by appointment or prior booking only. It is rustic fine dining, boutique and intimate Social CHEFSTABLE hosted by Chef Santi Louzán at a private location, where he serves food that will take you on his culinary journey. The table can be booked as a Private table or for the weekly social gatherings as a shared social experience with others you have never met before. Menus are seasonal and are chosen by chef. Usually a 7 course menu with tasting wines. Everyone arrives at the same time and are seated together. Location address is only given after payment of reservation has been received and confirmed.

NAME: Tiger’s Milk Long Street Gallery
DESCRIPTION: Tiger’s Milk is the best destination for ‘dude food’, made good. Our menu takes pizza, grills, burgers and beer to the next level. We’re big on bringing friends together over mouthwatering food, ice-cold drinks, and a fun night out. Tiger’s Milk Long Street is the perfect inner-city hangout for after-work drinks, lunch meetings or juicy burgers. We host a monthly comedy night and regular live performances.

NAME: La Parada V&A Waterfront
DESCRIPTION: As one of the leading small plate offerings in SA, we continuously serve innovative and mouthwatering dishes with a Spanish influence. La Parada V&A Waterfront boasts scenic mountain views and a feeling of being in nature while enjoying innovative cocktails and delicious tapas. Constantia Nek is home to our weekly Sunday Funday parties complete with the best vibe, well known local DJ’s and flowing drinks. We also host bottomless froze brunches, Saturday morning yoga and Sunset Sounds on the last Friday of every month.
GENERAL_LOCATION: 1 Dock Road, Shop 18, Alfred Mall, V&A Waterfront, 8001

NAME: The Hussar Grill Somerset West
DESCRIPTION: The Hussar Grill Somerset West in Somerset West Central, is regarded as one of South Africa's premier restaurants, serving only the best steak available, with a comprehensive wine menu.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Shop 26, Waterstone Village, Cnr R44 and Main Rd, 7130

NAME: Saveur
DESCRIPTION: Saveur Restaurant Group is a modern, European style restaurant group, making quality food and service accessible to the local market in a comfortable, contemporary setting. We are responsible corporate citizens with a commitment to our environment and the community.
GENERAL_LOCATION: Shop WC2A Simon's Town Boardwalk Centre, Wharf Street, Simon's Town Boardwalk Centre, 7975

NAME: Tashas Waterfront
DESCRIPTION: Beautiful food. Stunning environments. Engagingly delivered. tashas began with one store in Atholl, Johannesburg. Now we have locations across SOuth Africa and in the UAE. Each tashas is a little bit the same and a little bit different making each store unique in its offering as well as the design.

NAME: The Stables Restaurant At Vergelegen
DESCRIPTION: Enjoy the simplicity of dining out at the "Stables at Vergelegen". Classic, with a modern twist, the 'bistro' style restaurant offers a varied, contemporary menu of simple and visually delectable dishes for a relaxed, family friendly dining experience. Whilst sipping on award-winning wines, enjoy breath-taking views of the Hottentots Holland mountain range and soak up the creative juices of the varied and eclectic local artists whose art works adorn the walls. (Breakfast and lunch served Monday - Sunday).

NAME: Kloof Street House
DESCRIPTION: Kloof street house is an eclectic inspired restaurant and bar set in a magnificent Victorian house on the famous Kloof Street, nestled in the Table mountain valley, Cape Town. Join us in our garden for Saturday and Sunday Brunches, daily lunches and Sunday lunch Jazz, candle lit dinners in our dining rooms, drinks in our beautiful garden under the palm trees or just relax on our chesterfield couches in our cozy lounge. With our inviting homely feel and warm welcoming service, Kloof street house makes you feel just right at home.

NAME: Live Bait Kalk Bay
DESCRIPTION: Live Bait Kalk Bay is all about casual, comfortable dining. The first Live Bait opened in the Kalk Bay harbour on the water’s edge in 1999. This quaint location is popular with young couples, families and tourists looking to enjoy a lazy lunch or casual dinner by the sea.

NAME: Aubergine
DESCRIPTION: Owned and run by German chef Harald Bresselschmidt, Aubergine is a sophisticated, romantic restaurant in Cape Town which combines a rich history with contemporary style, innovative food and classic service – whether you’re joining us for lunch or dinner.
